notes.title: Minos: Dawn of the Bronze Age
notes.notes:
[h2][img src="https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/686/4uyyg90offhzqhzrd4xl51.png"][/img][/h2][h2][b]Palaces and Mysteries of Crete[/b][/h2][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]The sun glistens over the blue waters of Crete, and the majestic palaces of Knossos hold the secrets of an ancient civilization. In [url="https://tabletopia.com/games/minos-dawn-of-the-bronze-age-2"][b]Minos: Dawn of the Bronze Age[/b][/url], you take command of one of the great Minoan clans and shape the fate of your people. Every choice — building cities, opening trade routes, issuing decrees — becomes part of history.[/p][p align="start"]The Minoans were a peaceful civilization: their strength lay not in conquest, but in the wisdom of their leaders, mastery of trade, and rich culture. Now it’s your turn to prove your strategic skill, leadership, and foresight to claim the title of true Minos. [b]The Solo mode[/b] lets you experience these challenges alone, facing a clever opponent determined to contest your claim.[/p][p][/p][h2][img src="https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/686/meeibzcqiadgjj73bioxz1.png"][/img][/h2][h2][b]The Art of Power[/b][/h2][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]In [b]Minos[/b], strategy and history are intertwined: every die, every card, and every action influences the fate of your clan. Smaller dice grant access to powerful actions, while larger dice advance you along progress tracks and provide unique rewards. Decree cards offer instant effects and triggered bonuses, letting you create one-of-a-kind combinations.[/p][p align="start"]Coins and weaponry are more than resources — they symbolize power and opportunity. Warriors strengthen your clan’s presence, defend cities, and engage with the Sea Peoples — mysterious actors of the Bronze Age whose true role in history remains an enigma. Solo mode transforms these actions into a genuine challenge: every decision demands careful planning and anticipation of your opponent’s moves.[/p][p][/p][h2][img src="https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/686/y6rpmphyrxymtotf2w5s61.png"][/img][/h2][h2][b]A History Full of Mysteries[/b][/h2][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]The Labrys, the double-headed axe of the Minoans, adorned rituals and symbolized the power of priestesses. It may have even inspired the name of the labyrinth of Knossos, a place of riddles and trials.[/p][p align="start"]The Minoan fleet connected Crete with Egypt, the Levant, and Anatolia, transporting olive oil, wine, pottery, and luxury goods. Minoan art often depicted daily life, religious ceremonies, and nature rather than warfare, setting this civilization apart from its contemporaries.[/p][p align="start"]Every city or tower you build, every ship you advance, every resource you collect, and every decree you issue on the board brings this history to life. You’re not just taking actions — you are living the era, making choices that could have changed the course of ancient Crete.[/p][h2]
[img src="https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/686/4llv7pv1oid9hjfycjh3j0.png"][/img][/h2][h2][b]A Test of Leadership[/b][/h2][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i]Minos[/i] is a challenge for strategic minds. Players compete for influence, build cities and farms, develop trade and culture, and advance along progress tracks. Battles with the Sea Peoples demand calculation and courage, while managing resources requires precision and foresight.[/p][p align="start"]Solo mode lets you test yourself against Rhadamanthus, the automated brother of Minos. His actions and strategies force you to adapt, craft combinations, and anticipate moves as if leading a clan in real historical conflict.[/p][p align="start"]Each game is more than a play session. It’s a chance to step into the shoes of a ruler, manage your civilization, construct cities and palaces, navigate trade routes, and exercise the wisdom that could become legendary. The history of Crete comes alive on the board: the Labrys, palaces, trade, and power become part of your personal journey toward immortality.[/p][p][/p][h2][img src="https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/686/gcn7nav9xfe4v50jzgjmzc.png"][/img][/h2][h2][b]Step into the Legend of Crete[/b][/h2][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Minos: Dawn of the Bronze Age[/b] is a game where strategy, history, and challenge unite into one epic adventure. Become Minos, prove your right to leadership, and leave your mark on the legend of ancient Crete.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][url="https://tabletopia.com/games/minos-dawn-of-the-bronze-age-2"][b]Lead Your Clan, Shape History — Play on Tabletopia![/b][/url][/h3]

notes.title: Synchro Horizon — Gateway to the JRPG Roguelike
notes.notes:
[p][img src="https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/602/scy6gqoxorhcsud9xihhh3.png"][/img][/p][h2]The Seasons Are Turning. Can You Stop the End?[/h2][p]
Winter is coming—but not the kind you’ve read about. In [b]Synchro Horizon[/b], each step you take brings the world closer to its final breath. You are a hero in the land of [b]Valentia[/b], racing against time, building your team, and battling the cosmic force known only as the Celestial.

This is a [b]1–8 player tactical JRPG roguelike[/b] on the tabletop — part strategy game, part emotional odyssey. Imagine the magic of your favorite RPGs, the pressure of a ticking clock, and the freedom of endless replayability. [b]This isn’t just a game. It’s a fight for a world on the edge.[/b]

[img src="https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/602/nhqkwzq2u20pgblgonk172.png"][/img][/p][h2]A Living World, One Step at a Time[/h2][p]
Your journey unfolds in phases — [b]explore, battle, discover, survive[/b]. You and your party move across a modular map of Journal tiles, triggering events, uncovering secrets, and stumbling into battles that could break you. Every turn could be your last — or the start of a legendary comeback.

Combat is [b]tactical, fast, and full of surprises[/b]. Heroes and monsters take turns on dual initiative tracks, keeping everything visible and tight. No delays. No hidden triggers. Just pure, clean strategy.

And then, there are the shards — the lifeblood of your power. Each turn, you can use one of each color, plus one clear shard as a wild. That’s it. Simple? Maybe. But when you’re surrounded, and every ability costs a different shard... simplicity starts to feel like a trap. And that’s the thrill.

[img src="https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/602/tv7hhzlneqx68kzsmumao3.png"][/img][/p][h2]You Don’t Just Fight—You Grow[/h2][p]
From humble beginnings to battle-hardened warriors, your heroes change. Level up through [b]seven tiers[/b]. Unlock new skills, then flip your entire hero sheet for a powered-up form at higher levels. Their tactics shift. Their roles evolve. What worked before may not work now — and that’s the point.

You’ll build your party from over [b]30 unique heroes[/b], each with their own playstyle and mechanics. Frontliners who block with their bodies. Ranged attackers with piercing precision. Tricksters who manipulate time and position. No two are alike — and the combinations are endless.

Combat happens on a [b]tactical grid[/b]. Position matters. Enemies can push you, pull you, isolate your healer, or expose your caster. So you’ll learn. Adapt. And master the rhythm of movement and timing.

[img src="https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/602/ghvtjnptvbqwecrz96exf5.png"][/img][/p][h2]Fight Together or Fall Alone[/h2][p]
Every journey starts with one question: Who will stand beside you? Your team isn’t just a set of stats. It’s your engine of survival. Your combo machine. Your emotional backbone.

But [b]Valentia[/b] won’t go easy on you. Over [b]50 different monsters[/b] await — each with distinct abilities and behavior patterns. Some lock down movement. Others break your lines apart. And then there are the Celestials — terrifying elites that shift the rules of the game. These aren’t just stronger enemies. They’re puzzles, disasters, and bosses all rolled into one.

You can play [b]solo[/b]. Or with friends. Cooperate. Plan. Scream at each other when your positioning ruins the perfect combo. And when you win? You’ll know it wasn’t luck. It was teamwork, timing, and guts.

[/p][previewyoutube="PN1Hb4hV00M;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Try It Now on Tabletopia[/h2][p]
Not sure if this world is for you? You can jump in today on Tabletopia — free, online, and available right now. The full gameplay loop is there. Play solo. Test team setups. Feel the flow of combat. Try and survive a full run.

This isn’t a teaser. [b]It’s the real game[/b] — already playable, already deep. And it’s the perfect way to learn the mechanics before the physical box lands on your table.

Synchro Horizon is more than just cards and tokens. It’s a living, breathing tactical RPG, crafted with care and challenge in equal measure.

It will test you. It will surprise you.

[/p][h3][url="https://www.tabletopia.com/games/synchro-horizon"][b]Light the Beacon — The Journey Starts on Tabletopia![/b][/url][/h3]

notes.title: Botanicus: Mastery Through Soil and Strategy
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/534/dpzlwpveyiyln8uogjnild.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Cultivate Beauty, One Decision at a Time[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]You are an aristocrat of the late 19th century. With newly acquired land, a loyal gardener, and a taste for the exotic, you set out to build a botanical garden unlike any other. But beauty alone is not enough. Visitors have discerning eyes and very specific expectations. To outshine your rivals, you must plan, plant, and adapt — not only to please the crowd, but to grow a garden of rare elegance and strategic depth.[/p][p]In [url="https://tabletopia.com/games/botanicus"][b]Botanicus[/b][/url], each turn invites tactical choice. Select an action space before others can, maneuver your gardener among flower beds, and place plants according to ongoing objectives. Coin economy, careful positioning, and timing matter: your gardener moves one footprint at a time, each step costing a coin — and every action has its price.[/p][p]Tasks are the heart of your reputation. Each row of your garden must meet the exacting standards of visiting patrons. Complete their requests to gain prestige and unlock more demanding challenges. As your garden grows, so does its complexity — but also its brilliance.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/534/nww2r9nldxhqtdcfzatke1.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Why Strategists Will Thrive in the Garden[/b][/h2][p] [/p][p]This is a game of deliberate pace and layered outcomes. No luck determines your fate — only your foresight. Action selection is contested and dynamic, with each player competing to claim powerful effects before others. You must anticipate their intentions, adjust your rhythm, and carve out advantage.[/p][p]Garden cards give flexibility: spend two coins to perform a tailored action, or sell the card for three coins and secure your next turn’s position. Watering, planting, advancing along tracks — each decision is interconnected. No step is wasted, but none can be repeated.[/p][p]Round by round, your garden becomes a canvas of spatial control, clever sequencing, and evolving purpose. In the second round, flipped flower tiles alter the field, offering new actions and surprises. And in the final act, a single last move may tip the balance.[/p][p]If you're ready for more, the [b]Expert Variant[/b] brings asymmetric layouts, animal tokens, and secret scoring conditions. Play with two gardeners instead of one, unlock hidden bonuses by caring for animals in your flower beds, and pursue unique endgame objectives. [/p][p][/p][h3][img src="https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/534/e4gm4gxgylce0beruozv43.png"][/img][/h3][h2][b]For the Botanically Minded[/b] [/h2][p][/p][p]Among the most prized flora in [b]Botanicus[/b] are the Level IV plants — rare specimens that represent true horticultural prestige. Here are just a few:[/p][list][*][p][b]Nepenthes Alata[/b] — a carnivorous pitcher plant from the Philippines, with tooth-like ridges to trap insects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Victoria Amazonica[/b] — the giant water lily with blooms over 40 cm wide, warming its petals to lure beetles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Selenicereus Grandiflorus[/b] — the “Queen of the Night,” a cactus that flowers only once a year, for one night.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Brugmansia[/b] — the “angel’s trumpet,” beautiful yet toxic, with pendulous blossoms and hallucinogenic alkaloids.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Monstera Deliciosa[/b] — known for its split leaves and edible fruit, ripening like a green pinecone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dracunculus Vulgaris[/b] — the dragon lily, exuding the scent of decay to attract pollinators.[/p][/*][/list][p]These plants aren’t just names on tokens. They embody centuries of botanical exploration, scientific curiosity, and horticultural achievement — and their inclusion makes each garden a living museum.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="FKFjACWqCdc;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][b]Let Strategy Flourish at Tabletopia[/b][/h2][p] [/p][p][b]Botanicus[/b] isn’t about reacting — it’s about composing. Each choice is a seed. Each turn, a season. The competition is constant, the tempo elegant, and the reward lies in your foresight.[/p][p]You can now play [b]Botanicus[/b] online on [b]Tabletopia[/b], the platform for digital board games. Play or test your skills against real opponents. No downloads, no setup time — just strategy, beauty, and bloom.[/p][p] [/p][h3][url="https://tabletopia.com/games/botanicus"][b]Play Botanicus today — and let your brilliance blossom[/b][/url][/h3]

notes.title: SPOOKTACULAR: SCREAMS FROM THE SCREEN
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/342/jkztte1jpxddzi5vbyias4.png[/img]
[b]The old Silver Cinema[/b]—abandoned for years, its velvet seats faded, its reels long unwound—flickers to life on the last night of October. Wind howls through broken windows. Neon buzzes faintly above the entrance. On the marquee, a torn banner struggles in the storm: “All-Night Spooktacular Film Festival.” Horror fans shuffle in, clutching popcorn and VHS tapes, unaware their tickets are one-way only.

The storm builds. Clouds claw at the sky like a werewolf at the screen. Lightning forks across the night, striking a substation with a deafening crack. Inside, the movie stalls. The image stutters. The film sizzles. Then the audio dies—replaced by static, a hiss, a groan.
And then... they emerge.

Not actors. Not special effects. These are monsters. Real monsters. Torn from celluloid. Brought to life. You are one of them.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/342/ljun9ynlulag7t03ssmyl7.png[/img]
[h2][b]MONSTERS OFF THE REEL[/b][/h2]

[b]Spooktacular[/b] is a cinematic horror board game where you become one of twenty unique monsters born from the darkest corners of B-movie nightmares.
You’re not just wearing a costume. You are the thing under the bed. The whisper in the duct. The shadow in the back row.

You crawl out of the screen into a crumbling movie theater overrun with panicked spectators. Your mission? Haunt, hunt, destroy—and become the most terrifying creature ever committed to film. Each monster comes with its own rules, its own tempo, and its own method of making the audience scream.

One stalks from the vents. One devours entire aisles. One brings the ushers back from the grave. Some thirst for flesh. Others for fear itself.

Every playthrough is a forgotten horror flick—one that never made it past the censors. Unpredictable. Blood-soaked. Brilliant. And when it’s over, only one scream will echo as the final credits roll.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/342/wu1ahxcdmbofn8rspqalg2.png[/img]
[h2][b]A GAME THAT CELEBRATES OBSCURE CINEMA AND FEAR THAT LINGERS[/b][/h2]

This isn’t nostalgia. It’s resurrection. Spooktacular pays tribute to the grainy late-night horrors we weren’t supposed to watch—but did.

Each monster is inspired by horror subgenres that defined (and warped) generations:
[list]
[*] The stitched horrors of mad science.
[*] The syrupy decay of body horror.
[*] The hiss of creature features.
[*] The creeping dread of psychological torment.
[/list]
These monsters aren't tropes—they're tributes. Each one plays like its own genre. Want to control a shape-shifting slasher that kills with timing and style? It’s in the box. Prefer the creeping mist that consumes rooms, erases exits, and leaves whispers behind? Also here.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/342/usbwpiktu2dqckyhkkbjj3.png[/img]
[h2][b]TERROR YOU CAN TOUCH[/b][/h2]

[b]Spooktacular[/b] is not a reboot. Not a parody. It’s a ritual built from cardboard, plastic, and pure analog dread.

Inside the box, you’ll find:
[list]
[*] 20 fully asymmetric monsters, each with its own power set. Some whisper through walls. Some twist reality. Some… just want to be loved.
[*] A modular cinema board, including screening rooms, projection booths, vents, popcorn machines, exits that never work, and secret passageways that may or may not exist.
[*] Streamlined rules that are easy to learn but layered in darkness. New players can jump right in, but the longer you play, the deeper the terror grows.
[/list]
Every playthrough is a new VHS tape you found in your uncle’s basement. Unlabeled. Unfinished. Unexpected. Just press “Play”… and hope it ends before it ends you.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/342/lcaneenggrwzxjjcktjd33.png[/img]
[h2][b]BUT YOU’RE NOT ALONE IN THE DARK[/b][/h2]

[b]Spooktacular[/b] is a game of horrific competition. Every player controls a different monster, and every monster wants the spotlight.

You’ll stalk the same theaters. Hunt the same prey. But others are always one scream ahead. They’ll slam doors in your face, lure victims away, set traps in the aisle, or strike when your back is turned.
You can form uneasy alliances. Whisper across the lobby. Team up for a scene or two. But in the end, there can be only one name on the marquee.

There are no friends in this flick. Only survivors. And those who don’t get a sequel.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/342/igos8lfiruhff1aopisok0.png[/img]
[h2][b]WANT TO PLAY TONIGHT?[/b][/h2]

Can’t wait for the box? You don’t have to.

[b]Spooktacular[/b] is already haunting the digital realm [b]on Tabletopia[/b]—a full tabletop simulation of the physical game. Not a cut-down demo. Not a video game. The actual board, the monsters, the tokens. Everything you’d find in the box… and a little extra glitch around the edges.
You and your friends can play online from anywhere, in real time. Explore the cinema together. 

Practice your scares. Perfect your strategy. Or just bask in the haunted glow of 1980s analog terror.
New to horror board games? Great. Tabletopia lets you learn the mechanics at your own pace. Try solo runs. Host digital screenings. Introduce your cult… we mean, your group… to the experience.

Whether you’re in Tokyo or Toledo, the nightmare is only a click away.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/342/co3bji7qcae7jmc7ym75k2.png[/img]
[h2][b]A LOVE LETTER TO VHS FEVER DREAMS[/b][/h2]

There’s no jump-scare economy here. Spooktacular invites you into an immersive horror world built not just on fear—but texture, pacing, atmosphere.

Each game is a session of creative performance. You’re not just winning. You’re starring in a forgotten film that never saw daylight. The creak of a reel. The warped tracking line. The moment the film melts and something stares back.

If you remember taping over old rentals. If you ever squinted at shadows behind the screen. If you know horror doesn’t need CGI to chill your bones—this is for you.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/342/ifz6fiovc9mmlh5xjbidb6.png[/img]
[h2][b]AND NO ONE LEAVES UNAFFECTED[/b][/h2]

[b]Spooktacular[/b] isn’t just a game. It’s a séance in a box. A late-night TV broadcast you were never meant to see. A degraded tape that shouldn’t have survived… but did.

It’s for those who grew up on flickering screens, midnight movie marathons, and the hum of rewinding horror.

It’s for those who miss cigarette burns in the corner of the frame.

For those who remember that true terror doesn’t come from polygons, but from static, silence, and the sudden scream in a pitch-black room.

[previewyoutube=SzV_qDbNvnc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]THE FINAL REEL IS SPINNING[/b][/h2]

The lights are dimming. The usher has vanished. The exits are jammed.

If you want to be part of this flick—step into the frame.
Or stay seated.
In the dark.
Let the screen glow.
And watch… as they find you.

[h3][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/spooktacular]The spooky awaits at Tabletopia[/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Legend of the Ancient Forest: The Epic of Everdell Duo
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/253/ewwzmdle65uyooez27ouyr.png[/img]
[h2][b]Call of Ancient Destiny [/b][/h2]

In the age when the world was still young and the mists of memory veiled the forested heart of [b]Everdell[/b], legends stirred like whispers among the leaves. Beneath the ancient oaks and watchful elms, it was not war that shaped the fate of realms, but the artistry of creation, the wisdom of rhythm, and the spark of imagination. And so, in this verdant cradle, a remarkable game emerged— [b]Everdell Duo[/b] —where destiny entwined with nature itself, and each action sang like a note in a sacred hymn echoing through generations.

Beneath the gaze of towering trees, brave souls who answered the forest’s call felt the stirrings of forgotten magic—an invitation to weave their fate into the living tapestry of the realm. The game was more than mere play; it was ritual, journey, transformation. Every move became a heartbeat, every card a relic whispering secrets of the ancients. Those who dared to enter [b]Everdell Duo[/b] stepped into a timeless current, where intuition and legacy flowed together like roots beneath the earth.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/253/rywphz6uetqmncevzjyi7d0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Awakening the Tree of Life [/b][/h2]

With the first glimmer of dawn, the forest stirred from its slumber. Light filtered through canopies as nature opened her vault of treasures—amber drops nestled in mossy hollows, silken wood damp with memory, and streams murmuring ancient truths. The guardians of this world, modest yet tireless, set forth to gather these sacred offerings. Each of their movements, deliberate and reverent, echoed with purpose, as if nature herself guided their hands.

To the untrained eye, these helpers were but humble creatures. Yet their every step was a verse in the forest’s great symphony—a song of rhythm and renewal. Gathering wasn’t a task; it was devotion. With each token collected, they shaped not only cities, but stories. And with every story, the Tree of Life awakened, stretching its roots into the dreams of those who dared to build.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/253/6yyaqkrcwkg9jbozhmt6i4.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Grand Dance of the Seasons [/b][/h2]

Time in [b]Everdell[/b] does not merely pass—it performs. The forest unfolds its saga in four movements, like an eternal ballad. [b]Spring[/b] arrives first, gentle and bright, its dew-kissed leaves symbols of fresh beginnings. In its breath lies a quiet optimism, an invitation to plant the seeds of greatness. [b]Summer[/b] soon bursts forth, wild and fervent, drenched in sun and ambition. It is a season of bold choices and dazzling plays, where light and shadow dance across cards laid like stepping stones toward legend.

[b]Autumn[/b] arrives not with decline, but with golden wisdom. Crimson leaves drift like memories, and the realm becomes a canvas of harvest and reflection. Here, the fruits of courage and strategy find form—each action preparing the soul for what lies beyond. Then, [b]Winter[/b] descends. Silent, crystalline, still. Beneath the frost, dreams rest. And in that pause—sacred, hushed—the land gathers its breath for the rebirth to come. In every cycle, the game shifts, not in mechanics alone, but in mood, challenge, and meaning.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/254/b68stiqh6awyishbecmrd4.png[/img]
[h2][b]Of Sun, Moon, and Memory [/b][/h2]

Amid the forest’s winding paths, two forces guide every fate: the radiant [b]Sun[/b] and the elusive [b]Moon[/b]. These ancient tokens are no mere game pieces—they are keys to hidden power, timekeepers of legend. When placed upon a card, they stir slumbering runes, ignite forgotten spells, and awaken destinies etched into parchment long before the first turn was taken.

The path of the player is never singular. Some venture alone, dueling fate itself with resolve and cunning. These solitary heroes weigh every decision, for each token spent may ripple across the map of the world. Others choose companionship—two souls forging one vision. In the cooperative mode, creation becomes communion. Cities rise not from singular effort, but shared rhythm. With trust and timing, allies uncover rituals long buried in the roots of the land. Victory here is not louder—it is deeper.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/254/8qrmyuv2fylm1u7oc36ro7.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Rune-Laced Tapestry [/b][/h2]

Every card in [b]Everdell Duo[/b] is a manuscript, and each rune upon it a verse in the language of old. These are not static tools—they are living stories. Some depict mythical beasts or forgotten trades; others whisper of places not marked on any map. Yet none reveal their strength at once. Only under the gaze of the [b]Sun[/b] or [b]Moon[/b] do they glow, revealing hidden strengths, branching paths, and fleeting chances.

To master these runes is to become part seer, part scribe. It requires more than calculation; it demands attunement—to listen when the forest rustles, to feel when the wind shifts. In this game, even the smallest card might tip the balance of an empire. Players who lean into the lore—who play not just with logic, but with heart—will find that every rune holds not just power, but purpose.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/253/cqgnean1hdvkzytxzmgpk7.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Hidden Struggles[/b][/h2]

Not all is light beneath [b]Everdell’s[/b] boughs. Where the canopy thickens and moonlight hesitates, shadows lurk. Here lie the trials not written in rulebooks, where doubt, misjudgment, and unforeseen peril creep into the player’s path. These challenges do not roar—they whisper. They tempt with false moves and punish with quiet finality.

Yet even in these darkened glades, the tokens remain a lantern. Guided by ancestral wisdom and sharpened intuition, players can outwit these spectral threats. Every misstep becomes a lesson, and every recovery a triumph. The battle is never just for resources or reputation—it is for the soul of the city you build and the legacy you leave in the soil.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/253/nnppo55jzvx35wqdyn3ak9.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Unseen Builders [/b][/h2]

Behind every bold strategy and radiant token stand the tireless helpers—the quiet builders of [b]Everdell Duo’s[/b] greatness. Small in stature but mighty in purpose, they gather wood, draw water, and bear amber not as servants, but as keepers of continuity. Their journey is one of devotion, and in their simple toil lies the soul of the game.

Each action they take is sacred. Every bundle they return carries not just goods, but the weight of effort, patience, and hope. Through their labor, stories take shape, strategies become substance, and cities rise like myths carved from moss and stone. Their song is not loud—but it is lasting.

[previewyoutube=OhLCVcopiOs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]The Eternal Flame [/b][/h2]

And then, when the final season wanes and the sky blushes with dusk, the saga draws to a hush—not an end, but a return. The city stands, shaped by memory, shaped by choice. notes.title: Solar Sphere: Command Protocol Engaged
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/222/gylxjt576buz9fzynytbic0.png[/img]
[h2][b][System Initialization...][/b][/h2]

Loading... Connecting to core ship network... Confirming status...

Connection established. Core directives received.

[b]Command priority:[/b] Absolute.

[b]Ship designation: [/b]Celestial Vanguard.

[b]Mission:[/b] Construction of Dyson Sphere.

[b]Status:[/b] Critical.

Energy base… unstable. Fluctuations detected.

Platform supports connection through [b]Tabletopia[/b]. Game module activated.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/222/k1pquytnfhsdk081ljctu4.png[/img]
[h2][b][Game: Solar Sphere.] [/b][/h2]

You are the captain of a spacecraft orbiting a dying sun — a last ember of warmth in a universe growing colder by the hour.

Your orders are clear: initiate and complete the construction of a [b]Dyson Sphere[/b] — the ultimate feat of engineering and hope. A colossal structure to harness the full energy of the star. Success means salvation. Failure means extinction.

But you are not alone.

Other captains, with the same mission, may assist you — or compete. You cannot predict their motives.

And beyond human factions… an alien threat looms. They view the Dyson Sphere as a violation. An intrusion.

[b]Your only tools:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dice, to generate and allocate energy.
[*] Drones, to carry out your commands.
[*] Strategy, to withstand the chaos that follows.
[/list]
[b]Error:[/b] Communication systems offline.

[b]Connection to other players:[/b] unavailable.

[b]Resources:[/b] severely limited.

[b]Countdown initiated. Time until stellar collapse:[/b] classified.

You must act. Every cycle matters. Every misstep echoes through history.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/223/28huzdc3fzu1jlva6hqwm0.png[/img]
[h2][b][Preparing for Operations…][/b][/h2]
 
[b]Resource load:[/b] 70%... Checking active drones…

[b]Drone readiness:[/b] 3 of 6 operational.

[b]Reprocessing module:[/b] available.

You begin with dice — the embodiment of volatile energy. They are not weapons, but tools. With each roll, you shape the fate of the [b]Sphere[/b]. You must channel these fragments of energy into tasks: mining, building, expanding, defending.

Drones assist in translating your dice into action — but your fleet is small. Each drone represents a lifeline. And you have too few.

[b]ERROR:[/b] Not enough drones to perform all actions.

[b]Reprocessing required.[/b]

Reprocessing dice gives you new drones. But there is always a cost: time. Lost opportunities. A weakening of momentum.

And time… is not on your side.

[b]WARNING:[/b] Enemy signals detected.

[b]Estimated arrival:[/b] imminent.

Alien resistance is mounting. Unknown entities oppose the birth of the [b]Sphere[/b]. You must now make a crucial choice:
[list]
[*] Spend resources to bolster your defenses?
[*] Or continue building and risk exposure?
[/list]
Every decision builds pressure. Every second lost is a step closer to failure.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/223/lyx393wisvvq3fbfbk7d44.png[/img]
[h2][b][Warning. Enemy Attack…][/b][/h2]
 
[b]ALERT:[/b] Perimeter breach detected.

[b]Energy system status:[/b] unstable.

[b]Defense systems:[/b] partially online.

The first wave is here.

Alien ships pierce the void. They attack not with hatred, but with conviction — to stop what they believe is a cosmic transgression.

You are the last shield between them and the future of humanity.

To defend the Sphere, you must sacrifice resources intended for construction. If you hold them off, you buy time.

If not… the entire project could collapse.

[b]ERROR:[/b] Not enough drones for effective defense.

[b]Redistribution required.[/b]

You stand at a crossroads:
[list]
[*] Delay the project and survive?
[*] Or gamble everything on pushing forward?
[/list]
[b]WARNING:[/b] Alliance with other players unavailable.

[b]You are alone.[/b]

Isolation breeds clarity… and fear.

[i]Choose wisely, Commander.[/i]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/223/cqvu4zs6lubysmv2jomyeu.png[/img]
[h2][b][Dice Reprocessed. Emergency Activation…][/b][/h2]
 
Reprocessing complete. New drones generated.

But it’s not enough.

The [b]Sphere’s[/b] systems are strained. Internal energy levels are falling. Every reprocessed die draws from your core reserves. Your hands tremble over the command interface. One more reallocation, and you might lose control altogether.

[b]ERROR:[/b] Insufficient resources for reprocessing.

[b]Critical state approaching.[/b]

Your drones scramble across the hull, rerouting power conduits and fortifying defenses. But the core trembles. It cannot take much more.

Do you prioritize defense? Do you risk another reprocessing? Or do you gamble on the final push toward construction?

[b][Alert: Energy levels critical…] [/b]Alien pressure increases. Internal alarms echo in your ears. You're bleeding time, losing options.

[b]And yet — you must keep building.[/b]

[b]You must.[/b]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/223/i92eja2lb23boz0xqkrji2.png[/img]
[h2][b][Expansion of the White Dwarf. Not Enough Drones…][/b][/h2]

[b]ALERT: [/b]Solar flare surge detected.

[b]Expansion opportunity unlocked.[/b]

The dying star pulses — a final gift. A chance to expand your reach. With corporate-sponsored tech, you can unlock new sectors of the [b]Sphere[/b] and harvest additional energy. But expansion comes with a cost.

You need robots. Not drones, not dice — but specialized AI units designed for energy harvesting. Activating them requires immense investment and energy redirection.

[b]ERROR:[/b] Robots offline.

[b]Activation protocols require full reallocation of current efforts.[/b]

Meanwhile, the enemy adapts. They strike harder, faster. The system begins to fragment. Your stabilizers blink red.

You are trapped in a loop of risk:
[list]
[*] Expand and gain strength?
[*] Or defend and delay collapse?
[/list]
One misstep, and the star collapses with your dream still unfinished.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/223/khvhyi6mzmcsqnuf1yrjwb.png[/img]
[h2][b][Final Stage. Resources Running Low…] [/b][/h2]

[b]ERROR: Energy running out.[/b]

[b]Critical failure approaching.[/b]

[b]All systems under threat.[/b]

This is it.

The last cycle. The final attempt.

The Dyson Sphere is close to completion, but your reserves are almost gone.

Drones are breaking down.

Dice are too few to reprocess.

Enemies are circling like vultures.

And the Sphere remains — incomplete.

[b]RECOMMENDATION: Initiate Final Protocols.[/b]

[b]Engage in emergency construction override.[/b]

You must sacrifice the last of your power. Every last unit of energy must be focused on finishing the project — even if that means leaving yourself defenseless.

Will you risk it all for the [b]Sphere[/b]?

[b]WARNING:[/b] No more second chances.

[b]This is your final directive.[/b]

The stars fade. Silence approaches.

Your next move decides everything.

[previewyoutube=Ok2pQZUJ3k0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b][Objective: Build the Dyson Sphere or Perish…][/b][/h2]

The final alert echoes across your command bridge. You breathe in silence, surrounded by flickering consoles and dying power cells. There are no reinforcements. No alliances. Just you, your drones, and the dream of a sphere to outshine the stars.

Will your name be remembered as the one who brought light back to humanity — or as another lost whisper in the void?

The mission is clear. The [b]Sphere[/b] awaits.

[b][Command Override Accepted.][/b]

[b][Final directive locked.][/b]

[b][Execute.][/b]
 

[h3][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/solar-sphere][Initiate final protocol. Now on Tabletopia.][/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Paths of Glory: A Time to Forge the Fate of the World
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/194/ojzlcgzhovjbh3vdwbwxt3.png[/img]
[h2][b]Paths of Glory — A Guide to the Great War[/b][/h2]

A foggy morning....

The first steps on a land where the scent of gunpowder mingles with the heavy fragrance of spring. A strange, ominous moment — when the world has not yet awakened, but the war is already endless. In the distance, echoes of artillery fire can be heard, the noise — not just disagreements. This is war. Great, brutal, all-consuming. A war that will shape the fates of entire nations. A war from which there is no escape.

[b]Paths of Glory[/b] is not just a game. It is a masterfully recreated history that will make you feel what it was like to lead nations through the fog of [b]World War I[/b]. A game where every decision is not just a move but a fateful step that will decide whether blood will be spilled on the battlefield or peace will be maintained on the brink of tragedy.

War in [b]Paths of Glory[/b] is not abstract, it's not just dry statistics on a screen. It's a battlefield soaked in blood, mud, and smoke, where heroes and traitors march side by side, and the fates of entire states are decided in a matter of hours. The actions that unfold in this game are an epic filled with drama and tension. You will experience fierce battles, international intrigues, and agonizing decisions, where every mistake could lead to tragedy.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/194/x2dlnfpw2qdeqqdasni4i1.png[/img]
[h2][b]Through Smoke and Ashes — Battles and Intrigues[/b][/h2]

Far ahead, artillery shells explode. The wind carries dust mixed with the scent of gunpowder. You are the commander of an army, and your first decision is one that will shape the future. Shells are bursting, soldiers are falling, but you must not think about what is happening here and now. You must think about what will happen in days, weeks, and months to come. This is [b]Paths of Glory[/b] — a game where every action you take has consequences. There is no room for impulsive decisions here. Every move is a strategic maneuver, carefully thought out to the smallest detail.

In this game, you will experience one of the most grueling and dramatic periods in human history. Offense, defense, counterattack — everything happens here and now. It's not just commanding an army. It's guiding the destinies of nations. This is a war where every step could be decisive. Where even winning a battle could mean losing the war. This is not just a game; this is a war where every decision counts.

In [b]Paths of Glory[/b], you are not only commanding armies, but also navigating diplomatic struggles, where every ally may become a future traitor, and enemies are the ones with whom you must sign agreements that could determine not only your future but that of entire nations. In this game, strategic and diplomatic maneuvers are just as crucial as successful battles. You decide not only which armies to send to the front, but also whether you will be a loyal ally or an unpredictable traitor. Every action you take will impact the course of the events

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/194/h74naibdpzo0xaqdyljhh6.png[/img]
[h2][b]Eternal Victories and Tragedies: The Epic of Strategy[/b][/h2]
 
As in real war, [b]Paths of Glory[/b] offers no easy decisions. This war game is not about simple victories, it’s about overcoming unimaginable difficulties and making tough, often terrifying choices. There is no standing still here, as every minute brings new challenges. Every battle is like the final stand in a trench. Every decision you make is a step through a minefield, where a moment of triumph may quickly turn into a catastrophic defeat.

Each army is not just a few dozen units on the battlefield. It is thousands of soldiers, each with a face, a life, a tragedy. By commanding your forces, you are not just making decisions — you are feeling the weight of them. You decide who will go to battle and who will remain in the rear to protect the homeland. In [b]Paths of Glory[/b], there are no easy paths. This is not just a strategy game — it’s a game where you must feel the pain and passion of war, its brutal realities and tragedies.

The epicness of this game lies in its ability to faithfully recreate the atmosphere of [b]World War I[/b]. The countless details, carefully crafted, immerse you in the reality of the time: from the maps and the armies to the political maneuvers and diplomatic agreements. Battles are not just combat; they are your ability to predict the enemy’s actions, to block their plans with subtle and complex moves.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/194/18jnalzb7xsqzmw67zslj4.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Power of Decisions: Every Move Tells a Story [/b][/h2]

In [b]Paths of Glory[/b], every move matters. Each action you take is not just a step forward; it is a fateful moment that will shape the outcome. You decide not only how the battle will unfold, but also what strategies will form the foundation of your future victory. The game demands your full attention. Every move is not just a process — it’s a moment when you have to make a choice that either leads to victory or destroys your entire army.

Each of your decisions, from when to strike to what diplomatic actions to take, will have a lasting impact on the outcome. In [b]Paths of Glory[/b], there are no simple roads to victory. This is not just a game; it’s a true war. Only the most skilled strategists can emerge victorious, making moves that are not only logical but also perfectly align with historical realities.

Every action you take will affect the fate of the game. You send your armies to advance or retreat them to the rear. Every soldier, every decision — it’s a choice that could completely change the course of history. In [b]Paths of Glory[/b], the game does not end with a victory or defeat — it continues in your thoughts, making you ponder what could have been done differently, what you missed, and what you failed to consider.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/194/aveh8un11szwzw5ye6ogub.png[/img]
[h2][b]Global Fame and Recognition: Why You Should Play[/b][/h2]

[b]Paths of Glory[/b] is not just another war game. It is a cult classic, recognized and loved worldwide. It has earned its place in history as one of the most influential and profound strategy games ever created for tabletop gaming. [b]Why?[/b] Because [b]Paths of Glory[/b] doesn’t just give you the opportunity to play. It gives you the chance to be part of a grand story. A story where every action you take matters.

The game has rightfully received recognition for its complexity and depth. notes.title: Nucleum: Split the Atom of Progress!
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/165/sqqcigbhuwhpqfawclvbh0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Beyond Steam: The Atomic Revolution[/b][/h2]

Open the gates to an alternative [b]19th century[/b], where the whisper of uranium overshadows the clanging of steam engines, and become not just an industrialist, but a maestro of the industrial revolution whose conducting gestures determine the fate of an entire epoch.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/165/rmno4cfeebe4zbydflfpp0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Atomic Energy Sings the Future[/b][/h2] 

In early industrial [b]Saxony[/b], [b]Elsa von Frühlingsfeld[/b] introduced [b]Nucleum[/b], an elegant device containing the power of the atom. Demonstrating it to a skeptical [b]King[/b], she revealed its ability to boil water and drive machinery through steam – a process she termed [b]"atomization"[/b], merging science and wonder.

Despite initial doubts, [b]Nucleum[/b] quickly inspired awe. [b]Saxon[/b] cities glowed with unprecedented light, factories gained immense power, and railways and power lines spread rapidly, distributing atomic energy across the nation. From a quiet region, [b]Saxony[/b] swiftly transformed into a leading center for science and engineering, a beacon of progress for the continent.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/165/lx74zmuwrvtzndayw60bb3.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Titans' Call: Forge an Atomic Empire[/b][/h2]
 
The [b]Saxon[/b] atomic breakthrough echoed across [b]Europe[/b], drawing ambitious inventors, engineers, and industrialists to the king's court, all seeking to ride the wave of this new era. Only the boldest would prevail.
And now this tempting chance falls to you. Take the form of one of these titans.

Can you, like a wise chess player, calculate each of your moves on the board of industrial warfare, ahead of your competitors by several steps?

As a skilled diplomat, will you be able to negotiate the most lucrative deals for the vital uranium from the depths of Bohemia, feeding the insatiable hunger of your growing industry?

Will you be able to erect the most magnificent and efficient [b]Nucleum[/b], these temples of new energy, to light the way for your empire to unprecedented prosperity?

[h2][b]A Glimpse Into Glory: The Path to Victory[/b][/h2]
 
[b]Isle of Trains: All Aboard[/b] is more than just a card game; it's a challenge that tests your ability to think ahead, plan your moves, and adapt to the shifting dynamics of the railway world. It’s a game where every choice counts, where your decisions will shape the future of the island's bustling railway system.

And what makes it even more exciting? It’s already won the [b]People’s Choice Award for Best Strategic Card Game at the 2023 UK Games Expo[/b], and was nominated for the same category. [b]Isle of Trains: All Aboard[/b] is not just a game; it’s a journey toward becoming the greatest railway conductor the world has ever known.

Will you rise to the challenge and build the most efficient and profitable train empire, or will you be left behind in the dust?

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/132/ck2x8w3cmrbvsbkodndo82.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Island Awaits: Your Empire Starts Here[/b][/h2]

In [b]Isle of Trains: All Aboard[/b], you’re not just playing a game — you’re building a railway empire. It’s up to you to manage resources, optimize train configurations, and deliver valuable cargo and passengers across the island. The game is centered around a collection of cards that represent train cars, locomotives, freight, passengers, and buildings, each offering unique advantages. As a conductor, your job is to play these cards strategically, building and upgrading your trains, loading them with cargo and passengers, and completing contracts that bring you closer to victory.

But this is no easy task. You will need to make hard decisions, balancing the immediate rewards of delivering goods with the long-term goal of building the most efficient network. Every choice you make could either be the stepping stone to victory or a costly mistake.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/132/ygqq45orjzgkmemheknnp5.png[/img]
[h2][b]Powerful Cards: Your Tools for Victory[/b][/h2]
 
In [b]Isle of Trains: All Aboard[/b], cards are the core of the game. But these aren’t just ordinary cards; they are the backbone of your strategy. Each card you draw can serve multiple purposes, making your gameplay dynamic and filled with endless possibilities. You’ll use cards to build locomotives, create freight and passenger cars, and construct buildings to enhance your railway’s efficiency. But cards aren’t just for construction — they are also your cargo. Each card can be loaded into freight cars to transport goods across the island, earning you bonuses and valuable points.

The multi-use nature of these cards forces you to think ahead and plan your moves carefully. Do you use the card to strengthen your own train, or do you pass it along to an opponent’s train to gain a tactical advantage? The choice is yours. But no matter what, you’ll need to adapt to the changing landscape, balancing your immediate needs with the long-term strategy to stay ahead of the competition.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/132/fy5gmc0d04kdha6jvhmqn3.png[/img]
[h2][b]Loading Cargo and Passengers: A Game of Strategy and Timing[/b][/h2]
 
One of the key aspects of [b]Isle of Trains: All Aboard[/b] is the use of cargo and passengers. These aren’t just resources you transport — they are your pathway to victory. As you build your train cars, you’ll have the opportunity to draw passengers who want to be delivered to various destinations across the island. These passengers are drawn at random, making the game feel fresh and unpredictable every time you play. Each time you deliver passengers, you’ll earn immediate bonuses, which can turn the tide in your favor.

But there’s a twist: You can also load cargo and passengers onto other players' trains, allowing you to interfere with their progress while gaining extra bonuses. While helping your opponents might seem counterproductive, in Isle of Trains, every move has a dual purpose. The right placement of cargo or passengers can boost your score while slowing down your opponents.

This layer of strategy adds a fascinating dynamic to the game. It’s not just about building your train; it’s about managing the balance of power on the island. You’ll need to constantly weigh the benefits of your actions, deciding when to help others, when to hinder their progress, and when to strike for your own gain.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/132/czv6qxuaf7ywhw220emqo1.png[/img]

The solo mode is more than just a way to pass the time. It’s a chance to hone your strategies and see how far you can push your railway-building skills. Every decision counts, and every action will be a test of your ability to plan, adapt, and make the right choices under pressure. [h2][b]The Art of Strategy: Outwit Your Opponents[/b][/h2]

Winning [b]Isle of Trains: All Aboard[/b] is about more than just luck or chance. It’s about being strategic, adaptable, and thinking ahead. The multi-use cards, dynamic gameplay, and unique interaction with other players make this game an exciting and rewarding experience that’s perfect for both newcomers and experienced gamers.

notes.title: Point Galaxy & Propolis by Flatout Games - Have Fun!
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/944/fzonww5jz6qsf2szn0ljyw0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Two games from Flatout Games - two worlds: Point Galaxy and Propolis call you on a journey![/b][/h2]

Discover the exciting world of board games with Flatout Games, creators of hits like [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/point-salad][b]Point Salad[/b][/url], [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/calico][b]Calico[/b][/url], and [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/cascadia][b]Cascadia[/b][/url]!

We present to you the long-awaited duo of games that will take you to the vast expanses of space in [b]Point Galaxy[/b] and the world of medieval beekeeping in [b]Propolis[/b]. Incredible adventures full of strategy, excitement, and engaging gameplay await you!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/944/8lzcnbz6mc29acbcwqugl9.png[/img]
[h2][b]Point Galaxy: Become the architect of your galaxy![/b][/h2]

Embark on a space journey where you will create unique star systems by collecting cards with images of planets, stars, moons, asteroids, and wormholes. Place them strategically to score the most points and prove your superiority as a space tycoon!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/944/slgdfzyggqy7okykoqsaih.png[/img]
[h2][b]Starry Path to Victory: the mechanics of Point Galaxy in detail[/b][/h2]

Imagine yourself as the architect of your own galaxy!

In [b]Point Galaxy[/b], you will draft cards and create your own unique star systems from them. Each planet has its own numerical value, and your task is to place them in a logical order, creating harmonious and efficient solar systems. Think about how to arrange the planets in ascending or descending order to get the most benefit.

The [b]stars[/b] you add to your systems enhance your points, but require careful planning. Placing a star above a group of planets can give you a significant advantage, but only if you calculate its influence correctly.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/944/9jbqzimgobvim7ianqyxa0.png[/img]
[b]Moons[/b] provide additional bonuses if they are located next to planets of the corresponding color. This is a great way to get extra points if you can create successful combinations.

[b]Asteroids[/b] open up the possibility of getting additional points for the majority, and wormholes allow you to [b]"reset"[/b] the sequence of planets, adding an element of surprise and tactical flexibility. Use wormholes wisely to change the course of the game in your favor.

And, of course, do not forget about the rocket tokens, which give you access to powerful scoring conditions at the end of the game!

Collect as many tokens as possible to gain a decisive advantage. [b]140[/b] unique double-sided cards of planets and space objects guarantee that each of your games will be unique and unrepeatable!

Discover an endless variety of strategies and combinations!

[previewyoutube=AhLrMQ-ZgIg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]Propolis: Build a hive worthy of a queen![/b][/h2]

Feel like a medieval beekeeper, competing for the title of the most successful ruler of a bee colony! Send your hardworking bees to collect valuable resources - pollen and propolis, strengthen your positions in the flower meadows and build magnificent structures to earn the favor of the queen and lead your hive to prosperity!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/944/vtpd2ge8yoo3finwkvvu91.png[/img]
[h2][b]From pollen to the palace: the mechanics of Propolis in detail[/b][/h2]

In [b]Propolis[/b], you will place your worker bees on cards with landscapes to collect the necessary resources - pollen and propolis. These resources will be used to build various structures that bring you victory points and open access to new opportunities. Each building has its own unique function and cost, so plan your actions carefully.

Strengthen your positions by [b]"flipping"[/b] your bees to get additional bonuses and advantages. This will allow you to get more resources or strengthen control over the territory.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/944/5j6umflijvjytrxzuxy086.png[/img]
[b]Territory control[/b] plays a key role in [b]Propolis[/b]. The player who controls most of the bees in a row of landscape cards receives valuable rewards. The struggle for territory adds an element of competition and interaction between players to the game.

Your main goal is to build a magnificent palace for your queen, which will bring you the most points and ensure your unconditional victory!

The palace is a symbol of your success and power. [b]Propolis[/b] is a harmonious combination of elements of worker placement, engine building, territory control and tableau building.

Each of your decisions will be crucial as you strategically place your bees to collect resources and dominate the flower meadows. Think through your every move to outwit your rivals and achieve the prosperity of your hive.

[previewyoutube=tiMOVSYFoTI;full][/previewyoutube]

We are pleased to invite you to try [b]Point Galaxy[/b] and [b]Propolis[/b] in digital format on the [b]Tabletopia[/b] platform! This is a unique opportunity to get acquainted with the games, learn their rules in an interactive mode and appreciate the exciting gameplay without leaving your home.

Play with friends, find new opponents from all over the world, participate in tournaments and just enjoy your favorite games at any time convenient for you! Try [b]Point Galaxy[/b] and [b]Propolis[/b] on [b]Tabletopia[/b] right now and see their superiority!

Get [b]FREE[/b] exclusive promotional materials that will make your games even more diverse and interesting!

For [b]Point Galax[/b]y, you will receive 4 bonus rocket tokens! These tokens will open up even more opportunities for scoring points and allow you to create truly unique and powerful galaxies, full of unexpected combinations and strategic possibilities. Imagine what incredible combinations you can create with these additional tokens!
 
[h3][b]Bee Treasures: bonuses for Propolis [/b][/h3]

For [b]Propolis[/b], you will receive 12 building/landscape cards and 4 starting cards of buildings/queen's palace! These additional cards will significantly expand your building options and allow you to create even more diverse and impressive hives, each with its own unique strategy and architecture. [b]Flatout Games[/b] has earned recognition for its engaging and high-quality games that are easy to learn, but which offer unlimited opportunities for strategic thinking. By supporting this project, you are not just purchasing two amazing games; you are becoming part of the friendly [b]Flatout Games[/b] family and helping us bring joy and excitement to game tables around the world.

[h2][b]Join us![/b][/h2]

So, friends, [b]Point Galaxy[/b] and [b]Propolis[/b] are not just games, they are an invitation to an amazing world where you can show your strategic talents, explore the vastness of space and create your own honey empire.

notes.title: Hey, sea wolves! Ready to dive with Finspan?
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/893/mcrf8v35gzjbf8ygzkh09f.png[/img]
[h2][b]Ahoy, fellow angler![/b][/h2]

The time has come to test yourself in a real deep-sea adventure! Enough standing on the shore watching others haul in their catch—now it's your turn!

[b]Finspan[/b] isn't just a game; it's your chance to become a true marine researcher, exploring the vast ocean depths in search of the most fascinating fish that lurk beneath the waves.

You'll venture into three unique oceanic zones—the vibrant [b]Sunlight Zone[/b], the mysterious [b]Twilight Zone[/b], and the uncharted [b]Midnight Zone[/b]. Each dive will reveal new species of fish, each with its own unique abilities and advantages. Nurture young fish, form massive schools, and earn points to become the greatest marine researcher of all time!

The ocean is calling, captain—so don't hesitate!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/893/b7tokyrjnzoqakqbybojdp.png[/img]
[h2][b]What is Finspan?[/b][/h2]
 
In [b]Finspan[/b], every game is a new underwater expedition. You start small, with just a few fish, but as the game progresses, you build a thriving underwater ecosystem. Your goal? To create the most successful marine research project while leaving your competitors in the dust. 

[h3][b]How does it work? It’s simple:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Discover and collect different species of fish.
[*] Care for their offspring—without young fish, you can't form schools!
[*] Build massive schools of fish to earn maximum points.
[*] Strategize your dives—each choice you make can lead to victory or disaster.
[/list]But don't think it's as simple as just catching fish. 
Like real fishing, success in [b]Finspan[/b] requires patience, skill, and the right strategy!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/893/ipp8mhr8gswe2tagknrzs2.png[/img]
[h2][b]Where Should You Cast Your Net? The Three Oceanic Zones [/b][/h2]

Each ocean zone in the game offers its own unique challenges and opportunities, influencing your strategy:
[list]
[*] [b]Sunlight Zone[/b] (0–200 meters) – This is where life flourishes! With plenty of light and vegetation, this zone is ideal for discovering fish eggs and nurturing young fish.
[*] [b]Twilight Zone[/b] (200–1,000 meters) – The sunlight fades, but life persists. Rare species of fish with special abilities thrive in this zone.
[*] [b]Midnight Zone[/b] (1,000+ meters) – Total darkness reigns here, but don’t be fooled—this is home to bioluminescent creatures, giant predators, and other fascinating deep-sea species.
[/list]Placing your fish in the wrong zone can cost you dearly. So choose wisely!

[h3][b]How to Play Finspan?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Discover new fish and place them in the appropriate zone. Some species can only survive at specific depths, so pay attention!
[*] Lay eggs and nurture young fish. Without a thriving next generation, you won’t be able to form powerful schools.
[*] Form schools of fish. The bigger the school, the more points you earn!
[*] Keep an eye on your competitors. You’re not the only fisherman in the sea, and others will be trying to outmaneuver you.
[*] Plan ahead. Some fish consume others, while some provide unique benefits. Your strategy must be well thought out!
[/list]
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/893/i7md6we562sbu7sdsla7d0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Finspan is Now Available in Digital Format![/b][/h2]

No fishing buddies around for a tabletop game? No problem! [b]Finspan[/b] is now available in digital format on [b]Tabletopia[/b], bringing all the excitement of the tabletop game to your screen.

[h3][b]Why play the digital version?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Instant access – No setup time, no missing pieces—just jump right in!
[*] Play with friends worldwide – Challenge opponents from anywhere in the world.
[*] Smooth gameplay – Automated scoring and rule enforcement make every game effortless.
[*] Perfect for learning – New players can learn the game step by step with interactive guidance. 
[/list] The digital version of [b]Finspan[/b] retains all the mechanics of the original board game while making the gameplay smoother and more accessible.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/893/tvuw7ixcpbbqgzzsip0jl6.png[/img]
[h2][b]Fascinating Facts Inspired by Finspan [/b][/h2]

Love fishing? Then you’ll enjoy these deep-sea facts inspired by the game:
[list]
[*] Some deep-sea fish are so rare they've only been seen a handful of times! In [b]Finspan[/b], you’ll have the chance to discover these elusive creatures.
[*] Many deep-sea fish glow in the dark! If you dive into the [b]Midnight Zone[/b], you’ll encounter bioluminescent species that light up the abyss.
[*] Some fish change gender during their lifetime – starting as males and later becoming females. This phenomenon, called hermaphroditism, is reflected in the game’s mechanics. 
[*] In the real world, the biggest fish is always the one that got away! But in [b]Finspan[/b], the larger your catch, the better your chances of victory.
[*] Each fish in the game is based on real species! The developers consulted marine biologists to ensure scientific accuracy.
[*] [b]Finspan[/b] isn’t just a game—it’s an educational journey into the underwater world. Every fish has real-life characteristics and behaviors.
[/list]
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/893/kantv9zdoydtjsswp4yq95.png[/img]
[h2][b]Why Finspan is the Ultimate Deep-Sea Adventure[/b][/h2]

If you’re a fan of strategic board games, [b]Finspan[/b] is a must-try! Whether you’re an experienced tabletop gamer or a casual player looking for something unique, this game offers an immersive, educational, and competitive experience that keeps you hooked from the first dive to the last.

But what makes [b]Finspan[/b] truly special? Here’s why this game stands out among other strategy games:

[h3][b]Perfect Balance of Strategy and Exploration[/b][/h3]
 
Many board games rely on sheer luck, but [b]Finspan[/b] rewards careful planning, resource management, and strategic thinking. You can’t just collect fish at random—every decision matters. Should you focus on gathering eggs, nurturing young fish, or forming massive schools? Maybe you should invest in rare species that grant unique advantages? Your choices will define your path to victory! 

[h3][b]A Deeply Thematic Experience[/b][/h3]
 
One of the biggest strengths of [b]Finspan[/b] is how well it captures the wonders of marine biology. Unlike other abstract strategy games, every fish in [b]Finspan[/b] is based on a real species, with abilities that reflect their actual behavior. The division of ocean zones isn’t just for gameplay—it mirrors scientific classifications of marine habitats.

For example, some species thrive only in the [b]Sunlight Zone[/b], while deep-sea predators dominate the [b]Midnight Zone[/b]. Just like in real life, larger fish consume smaller ones, and some species exhibit unique survival mechanisms, such as bioluminescence or schooling behavior.

This isn’t just a game—it’s an educational journey into the ocean’s depths!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/893/cz28yvgqbnppjvfvvru6m1.png[/img]
[h2][b]Stunning Artwork and Immersive Design[/b][/h2]

From the moment you open the game, you’re transported into an underwater world filled with vibrant marine life. The illustrations are breathtaking, and every card feels like a miniature scientific discovery.

The artwork, crafted by talented artists who specialize in scientific illustration, ensures that each fish looks as realistic as possible while maintaining a beautiful, game-friendly aesthetic. If you appreciate games with high-quality production and artistic value, [b]Finspan[/b] won’t disappoint! 

[h3][b]Perfect for Solo and Group Play[/b][/h3]
 
Whether you love playing competitive strategy games with friends or enjoy testing your skills solo, [b]Finspan[/b] offers both options. The game is designed for 1–5 players, making it a fantastic choice for game nights, family gatherings, or even a quiet solo session where you can perfect your strategy.

Few board games offer such a rich experience across different player counts. [b]Finspan[/b] scales beautifully, whether you're diving in alone or competing against skilled opponents! 

[h3][b]Digital Convenience with Tabletopia[/b][/h3]

Can’t always gather around a table? No problem! [b]Finspan[/b] is now available in digital format on [b]Tabletopia[/b], bringing all the excitement of the tabletop game to your screen.

Whether you play in person or online, [b]Finspan[/b] delivers the same thrilling challenge and strategic depth every time!

[previewyoutube=Fuvsx5Hd3iE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]A Game That Keeps You Coming Back for More[/b][/h2]
 
One of the greatest things about [b]Finspan[/b] is that no two games are ever the same. The way fish are discovered, the strategies you develop, and the unpredictable decisions of your opponents create endless replayability.

With multiple paths to victory, every session is a new adventure, full of discoveries, challenges, and brilliant tactical moves.

So, what are you waiting for? It’s time to cast your net, dive into the depths, and become a legendary marine researcher!
 

[h3][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/finspan]Play it now on Tabletopia[/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: A Gest of Robin Hood: Lords and Outlaws Unite
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/793/gprvtecsv3wvtcmd7i1uz2.png[/img]
[h2][b]Unveil the Enchantment of Medieval England[/b][/h2]

[i]Hark, ye noble adventurers, and gird thy loins for a wondrous journey into the heart of medieval [b]England[/b]! Here lies a tale most thrilling, woven by [url=https://www.gmtgames.com/][b]GMT Games[/b][/url] into their latest masterwork, [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/a-gest-of-robin-hood][b]A Gest of Robin Hood[/b][/url]![/i]

The illustrious [b]COIN[/b] (Counter-Insurgency) system takes you back to the perilous and vibrant days of late [b]12th-century England[/b]. If thou hast tasted the delights of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/red-dust-rebellion][b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b][/url], their previous creation, thou shalt already know the bountiful excitement and deep strategy that awaits. Yet, [b]A Gest of Robin Hood[/b] proffers a rare treasure: an unparalleled blend of historical fidelity, asymmetric gameplay, and the timeless allure of the legend of [b]Robin Hood[/b].

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/793/42wzxgfad5ybkfl1fdmcm3.png[/img]
[h2][b]Let the Saga Unfold[/b][/h2]

Step boldly into the annals of legend, where the bold [b]Robin Hood[/b] and his [b]Merry Men[/b] defy tyranny, the feudal lords wield their iron fists, and common folk rise up against the yoke of oppression. Feel the spirit of adventure in every moment:
[list]
[*] The rush of peril and triumph — as Robin Hood evades the Sheriff of Nottingham’s clutches, orchestrating a secretive rebellion in the shadows.
[*] Pride and elation — when thy cunning stratagems bear fruit and thou dost outwit thy adversaries with sheer brilliance.
[*] Endless surprise — for each game spins a new yarn, with its asymmetric mechanics ensuring a fresh and unpredictable tale every time.
[/list]
This game calleth to all with a heart aflame for heroism or a mind bent on preserving order. Each move thou takest doth weave a compelling tapestry where courage, strategy, and chance unite to shape a story uniquely thine.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/793/stdyfmyv32rysq3h5zksbc.png[/img]
[h2][b]Gamecraft Wrought with Mastery [/b][/h2]

[b]A Gest of Robin Hood[/b] brings the renowned [b]COIN[/b] system to new heights, crafting an experience that is both accessible to novices and rich in challenge for seasoned strategists. Consider the wondrous mechanics that make this game shine:
[list]
[*] [b]Asymmetric Gameplay:[/b]
[*] Each faction doth boast its own unique goals and abilities.
[*] [b]Robin Hood[/b] and his band seek to outwit the [b]Sheriff[/b], amassing resources and inspiring revolts among the downtrodden.
[*] The [b]Sheriff[/b] and his allies strive to suppress these uprisings, holding fast to their dominion over the land.

[*] [b]Swift Playtime:[/b]
[*] Designed for completion in under an hour, this game be perfect for a lively evening or a brief escape into adventure.

[*] [b]Hidden Movement:[/b]
[*] As the [b]Sheriff[/b] hunts [b]Robin Hood[/b] across [b]Nottinghamshire[/b], [b]Robin[/b] hides amidst his [b]Merry Men[/b], a shadow in the woods.
[*] Treasure-laden carriages become both prize and peril, for they may conceal either riches or the [b]Sheriff’s[/b] hidden henchmen.

[*] [b]Perilous Encounters:[/b]
[*] When [b]Robin Hood[/b] confronts travelers, he doth draw from the [b]Traveler’s Deck[/b], where fortunes and dangers alike await.

[*] [b]Eventful Turns:[/b]
[*] Cards of chance bring surprises aplenty, steering the tale in wondrous and unexpected directions, immersing thee further in the rich lore of medieval [b]England[/b].
[/list]
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/793/wyxhjutpjvr2ukqcumwbh1.png[/img]
[h2][b]Why Tabletopia Beckons[/b][/h2]

[b]Tabletopia[/b], the digital realm of board game delights, doth provide the perfect stage for [b]A Gest of Robin Hood[/b]. Consider the bounteous benefits:
[list]
[b]Ease of Access:[/b]
[*] Dispense with the tedium of setting up a physical board; commence thy quest at once.
[*] With [b]Tabletopia[/b] available on tablets and computers, thou mayst play wheresoever thou art.

[b]Learning Aids:[/b]
[*] Built-in rules and tutorials shall guide thee, ensuring even the greenest of players finds their way.

[b]Shared Joy:[/b]
[*] Connect with players across the lands, sharing camaraderie and contest in equal measure.

[b]Time Well Spent:[/b]
[*] With its swift setup and seamless controls, thou shalt spend thy time not in toil but in reveling in strategy and delight.
[/list]
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/793/3eg4s3ksfcrlwaxogzagq2.png[/img]
[h2][b]What Sets A Gest of Robin Hood Apart?[/b][/h2]

[list]
[b]Thematic Richness:[/b]
[*] Relive the stirring legends of [b]Robin Hood[/b], whether thou dost side with the cause of justice or uphold the realm’s order with an iron hand.

[b]Welcoming Yet Deep:[/b]
[*] For those unversed in the ways of board games and seasoned veterans alike, this game doth offer both a warm welcome and a thrilling challenge.

[b]Historic Truth:[/b]
[*] Step into a world meticulously crafted to mirror the struggles, triumphs, and culture of medieval [b]England[/b].

[b]Legendary Drama:[/b]
[*] Each turn builds upon the last, a crescendo of suspense and triumph that doth immerse thee fully in the legend of[b] Robin Hood[/b].
[/list]
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/793/pfutyfop4jgs0zyugnk4lf.png[/img]
[h2][b]Robin Hood Through the Ages [/b][/h2]

[b]Robin Hood[/b], the valiant outlaw, first sprang forth in the ballads of the [b]14th century[/b], his tales sung by bards and etched into the hearts of the people. The allegorical [b]Piers Plowman[/b] marked his early appearances, and [b]A Gest of Robyn Hode[/b], printed ere the dawn of the [b]16th century[/b], cemented his place in the annals of lore. In those early days, Robin was rough-hewn and fierce, a guerilla fighter for the oppressed.

Historians such as [b]Rodney Hilton[/b] have since argued that [b]Robin Hood[/b] embodied the spirit of the emerging free peasantry, a beacon of hope against the injustices of an unequal world.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/793/agi4m8zc7mk0wwgqszxsvf.png[/img]
[h2][b]A Kinship with Red Dust Rebellion[/b][/h2]

For those who delighted in [b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b], rejoice! [b]A Gest of Robin Hood[/b] doth retain the brilliance of the [b]COIN[/b] system, while offering:
[list]
[*] A lighter and swifter experience, both thrilling and approachable.
[*] A grounding in history that lends depth and relatability to the tale.
[*] A concise playtime, perfect for swift yet engrossing sessions.
[/list]
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/793/zqfy5xq1zokos1tzfp8hib.png[/img]
[h2][b]Tidings of the Merry Man [/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Timeless Lore:[/b]
Tales of [b]Robin Hood[/b] have echoed through the ages, from the [b]13th century[/b] to this very day. 

[*] [b]Sherwood’s Shelter:[/b]
The [b]"Major Oak"[/b] in S[b]herwood Forest[/b] stands yet, a living relic of the legend’s heart.

[*] [b]Mind over Might:[/b]
[b]Robin’s[/b] wit and cunning have ever been his greatest weapons.

[*] [b]A Shadow of Truth:[/b]
Some believe [b]Robin Hood[/b] to have been a real figure or a composite of many outlaws.

[*] [b]Songs of Yesteryear:[/b]
Ballads of his deeds were sung in fairs and taverns, spreading his fame far and wide.

[*] [b]Honor Amid Rebellion:[/b]
Ever a champion of the poor, [b]Robin[/b] harmed not the innocent, his blade sharp but his heart kind.

[*] [b]Faithful Companions:[/b]
[b]Little John[/b], [b]Friar Tuck[/b], and [b]Maid Marian[/b] stand ever by his side, their tales enriching the lore.
[/list]
