notes.title: Mars on Fire! For the Independence of the Red Planet!
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/662/ayttdusz7za4nbg7jic4po.png[/img]
[h2][b]Open a New Chapter in Interplanetary Conflicts: Red Dust Rebellion[/b][/h2]

Are you ready to experience a legendary strategic game filled with political intrigue and interplanetary battles?

Meet [b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b], the first game from the famous [b]COIN[/b] (Counter Insurgency) series now available in digital format on [b]Tabletopia[/b]! This is a groundbreaking moment for strategy fans: now you can experience the legendary [b]COIN[/b] mechanics in digital form without leaving your home. 

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] offers a unique blend of political intrigue, thrilling battles, and deep strategic decisions, which only the [b]COIN[/b] series can offer. Now, you can immerse yourself in the world of revolutionary conflicts on Mars in an online format!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/663/u6p0uidjfby7spvp9mwam0.png[/img]
[h2][b]The First COIN Game on Tabletopia: Revolution on the Red Planet[/b][/h2]

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] is not just another strategy game — it is the first game from the [b]COIN[/b] series to be available on [b]Tabletopia[/b].

Inspired by one of the most popular series of board games about counterinsurgency warfare, it transports players to the future, where Mars becomes the arena for intense political and military conflicts. With the newly available digital version, [b]COIN[/b] fans can finally experience the strategic depth of this iconic series directly on [b]Tabletopia[/b] — without the need to gather complicated components or find a physical space to play. All you need is an internet connection and the desire to dive into a world of revolutionary intrigue and cosmic battles.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/663/1zci1yx6ne1iy5ekjapen5.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Martian Struggle for Freedom Begins[/b][/h2]

[i]"200 years of Earth’s rule. 200 years of commands from the distant blue ball in the sky. Spoiled politicians from Earth, playing golf under the warm sun, sipping French champagne, and eating grapes, dare to tell us how to live? They don’t know us because they — they are not us! We are the sons and daughters of Mars! The children of the Red Planet! We were born in red dust and say: enough with Earth's rule!"[/i] — [b]Aroha Thompson[/b], representative of [b]"Red Dust"[/b] and organizer of the [b]Mining Union[/b]. These words are a call to action for those ready to stand with those tired of Earth's oppression. 

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] takes you to the 2250s, when [b]Mars[/b] becomes the center of revolution, and its inhabitants begin their fight for independence. The future of the [b]Red Planet[/b] depends on who will win in this epic battle for freedom.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/663/zrt6ufdtncnqtz8xmjabbd.png[/img]
[h2][b]The World of the Game: Mars in the 2250s[/b][/h2]

The year 2250 has arrived, and the 200th anniversary of the first human colony on [b]Mars[/b] is approaching. These are two centuries of challenges and achievements. [b]Mars’s[/b] surface is a barren desert, and those who survive here have settled in vast underground cities known as Labyrinths. Life in these subterranean structures is a constant fight for survival, where every step requires effort and every decision has its consequences.

[b]Mars[/b] is not just a colony — it’s a world where everyone seeks freedom. While some want to turn [b]Mars[/b] into a mirror of Earth, with green forests and oceans, others oppose terraforming, believing it will destroy the planet’s unique ecosystem.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/663/qp11micdjhva1r44hmlu43.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Game Factions[/b][/h2]

In [b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b], you will choose one of several unique factions, each with its own goals, approaches, and methods. You will control one of them to lead it to victory and shape the future of the [b]Red Planet[/b].

[list]
[*] [b]Martian Transitional Government (MG):[/b] Represents the political balance between Earth’s and Mars’ interests. This faction seeks to maintain the status quo, balancing Martian protests and Earth’s demands.

[*] [b]Corporations (CORP):[/b] Resource-hungry forces dependent on Earth’s government for support. These factions fight for power and resources, but their decisions are always influenced by the political situation.

[*] [b]Red Dust Movement (RD):[/b] A faction fighting for Mars’s independence. This faction opposes Earth’s dominance and wants Mars to decide its own fate.

[*] [b]Church of Return (CR):[/b] A radical faction opposing terraforming and seeking to preserve Mars’ unique ecosystem in its natural state. These fanatical forces will do anything for their cause.
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/663/lxaxrzzi8cfpjycgkx1z12.png[/img]
[h2][b]Gameplay and Features[/b][/h2]
 

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] is not just a strategy game — it is a true simulation of interplanetary conflict, where you will need to make complex political and military decisions. The game combines elements of diplomacy, strategy, and tactics.

[list]
[*] [b]Hostile Environment:[/b] Dust storms block access to regions, and battles in the Labyrinths can damage infrastructure. All of this complicates the game, making you consider many factors in your strategy.

[*] [b]Unpredictable Raiders:[/b] The Church of Return acts unexpectedly, disrupting the plans of other factions and creating chaos among enemies.

[*] [b]Orbital Warfare:[/b] Satellites offer unique surveillance opportunities and hidden options for attack, opening up additional strategic possibilities.

[*] [b]Multiple Battlefields:[/b] The game features several different locations for battles, including the Labyrinths, the Gella Basin, and the plains of Arabia, each with its own unique features that affect the course of battle.

[*] [b]Flexible Logistics:[/b] Control of spaceports allows players to quickly move forces between regions, giving them strategic advantages.
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/662/zhxqrs3fmwxmxkjrncvbk1.png[/img]
[h2][b]Legendary COIN Game System[/b][/h2]

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] is the first [b]COIN[/b] game now available on [b]Tabletopia[/b], offering a unique experience with the legendary system of the series. The game emphasizes not only military actions but also political manipulation. Each faction has its own goals and resources, and your task is to plan your moves so that they lead to victory.

[list]
[*] [b]Long-term Strategies:[/b] Resources from Earth arrive slowly, which forces factions to plan their actions well in advance.

[*] [b]Territorial Control:[/b] Controlling key areas on Mars provides significant advantages, helping factions strengthen their positions and push forward their goals.

[*] [b]Dynamic Conflict:[/b] Alliances, betrayals, and unexpected attacks create constant tension, and each decision can change the course of the game
[*] 
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/663/pve0rrxenzyiux17ftu8d2.png[/img]
[h2][b]Immersion in an Epic Struggle [/b][/h2]

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] offers an exciting strategic experience set in the future, where [b]Mars[/b] fights for its independence. Strategies, diplomacy, and the struggle for resources intertwine in a dynamic conflict. Every decision you make can affect the future of the [b]Red Planet[/b]. Play as one of the factions, carve your path to victory, and create your version of [b]Mars’s[/b] future.

[h3][b]Unique Game Features[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Historical Context:[/b] The game is based on a carefully crafted science fiction story that makes it particularly engaging for fans of the genre.

[*] [b]Multilevel Mechanics:[/b] Each faction has unique abilities and strategic goals, adding variety to every game.

[*] [b]Complex Diplomatic Relations:[/b] Form temporary alliances, betray allies, or become a leader of independence by deciding who your friends and enemies are.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=l9ruesGhArQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]Be Part of Mars’ History[/b][/h2]

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] immerses you in the atmosphere of classic science fiction, where Martian colonies, deserts, underground cities, and orbital stations become the battleground for epic struggles. This is not just a game, but an opportunity to become part of history and take part in the fight for the future of the [b]Red Planet[/b].

Join the revolution, become part of the struggle for freedom, and create your future for [b]Mars[/b]. [b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] is not just a game; it is a chance to experience strategic depth and witness a true cosmic revolution. 

[h3][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/red-dust-rebellion]Play Red Dust Rebellion on Tabletopia today![/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Not today, guard!
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/656/o0n9i0d97riok9onb2gub3.png[/img]
[h2][b]Welcome to Spike Island, Prisoners![/b][/h2]
 
Well, well, I see you're already thinking about your little escape, huh? Don’t kid yourself. You can’t escape. Here, on [b]Spike Island[/b], we control everything. And if you haven’t figured it out yet, I decide who leaves and who stays behind these walls forever.

But if you want to feel free for even a second, I have an offer for you — play the game. I’ll give you a chance. But rest assured, you won’t win. I’m watching your every move, and I know your weaknesses.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/656/qlbpuevtqbmzrohu5nexg0.png[/img]
[h2][b]What’s this game about?[/b][/h2]

You’ll be testing your skills in a game called [b]Escape from a Vile Victorian Prison: Fled[/b]. This isn’t a game for the faint of heart. It’s made for people like you, who think they can outsmart me and my loyal guards.

The task is simple — gather everything you need to escape. Yes, you’re lucky; you get to use tiles to pave your way through the prison. But remember, every action you take could cost you your freedom if I decide to intervene. Be careful, because you won’t be able to hide from me forever.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/656/2wbtnyatglyohz3dnpiqx7.png[/img]
[h2][b]What are the rules of the game?[/b][/h2]

Every step, every decision matters. You will collect tiles to create new rooms, hallways, and doors. But remember, my guards are always on the lookout. Every wrong step — it’s a chance to end up in solitary. So think twice before you move. The tiles give you opportunities, but they also hide dangers. The contraband you collect will help you escape, but to do that, you must act secretly and plan every move carefully. The more you move, the more likely you are to attract my attention. It’s not just a game of speed; it’s a game of survival.

Here’s the kicker — you have to be at roll call when I whistle. If you're not in the right room when I call for roll, you risk being caught and sent to solitary. Success in this game depends on how well you can predict my moves. Will you outsmart me, or will you end up locked up forever? Every decision counts, and the wrong choice could land you back in the dark, cold cells.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/656/yoy9ywca4sn6b43cwyclfh0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Who are the characters in this prison?[/b][/h2]

In this game, you're one of the prisoners on [b]Spike Island[/b]. But don’t think you’re like the rest. Each of you has strengths and weaknesses. I’ve been watching you all for a long time, and I know what you're capable of. But if you want to win, you need to play this game with your wits. We are all traps, and you are the hunter. Either you become the prey, or you walk away a winner. But remember, winning means more than just outwitting the guards. It means escaping the prison — and escaping me.

[b]Edmond Power:[/b] Driven by hunger and desperation during the famine, Edmond started small by swiping a pint of milk—but his ambition got the better of him when he tried to steal an entire cow. Now he’s locked away, but he’s still bold, determined, and stubborn. Edmond’s strength lies in his daring nature, but his recklessness might lead him straight into a trap. Will he learn to temper his ambition before it’s too late?

[b]Thomas O’Neill: [/b]A smooth-talking pickpocket with a knack for charm, Thomas “borrowed” a silk neckerchief for his sweetheart—at least, that’s what he claimed. In reality, he’d already traded it for tobacco. His gift of persuasion could be his ticket to freedom, but his greed and shifting loyalties might sink him. Will he be able to charm his way off the island, or will his schemes unravel?

[b]Father Lyons:[/b] A priest with a flexible view of morality, Father Lyons believes that some rules are meant to be bent—especially when they "hinder the well-being of one’s soul." He’s cunning, respected, and trusted, making him an ideal smuggler of forbidden goods. But how long can he hide behind his holy facade before his sins catch up with him?

[b]James Cleary:[/b] A notorious trickster, James was so driven by his passions that he secretly married two women at once. Neither wife took kindly to the betrayal, and neither did the magistrate. His ability to weave lies and charm his way into hearts has kept him alive—but love, or revenge, might be the one snare he can’t escape.

[b]Denis Hourigan:[/b] No prisoner is more obsessed with escape than Denis. A master negotiator, he trades stamps, buttons, and even a Christmas cake sent by his aunt for tools of freedom—spoons, files, and keys. His singular focus on escape makes him resourceful, but desperation can cloud judgment. Will his relentless drive set him free—or seal his fate?

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/656/axg7gizxz7kpt7iddvvl62.png[/img]
[h2][b]How to Win? What Do You Need to Do?[/b][/h2]

In this game, you won’t just run through rooms. You will navigate through dangers, lure me into traps, and collect everything you need for your escape. Each tile you add to the board could be your key to freedom. But remember — each tile could hide a threat. The more you act, the more likely I am to notice. You need to manipulate the situation, be sneaky, and act quickly.

You need to gather contraband, escape tools, to gain an advantage. But you know what? You’re not the only one hunting for it. I’m watching you. And if you get caught, believe me, you’ll find yourself in the darkest corner of this island. You need to pick the right tiles and move silently, or you won’t survive long enough to finish the game. But if you outsmart me, you might just make it.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/656/3sbk7wu0bk8h1lt46kj620.png[/img]
[h2][b]Roll Call — It’s No Joke[/b][/h2]

My guards know exactly what to do if you don’t show up at roll call. Every step you take could be your last if you’re not in the right room. I’ll be keeping an eye on you, and if you fail to avoid my gaze, you’ll regret it. Even if you find your way through all the walls and doors, if you’re not in the right place at the right time, I’ll catch you.

Every move must be planned, every step calculated. My game isn’t just about luck. It’s a chess match, and I’m always one step ahead. And if you make even one mistake, I’ll take advantage of it.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/656/jspyvuf1ukhlqnacy95bx0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Why Should You Play Fled? [/b][/h2]

You want to escape, I know that. But do you think you can? If you’re sure you can handle my game, if you’re ready to prove you have what it takes to break out of Spike Island, then play. This is your chance at freedom. But remember, no one has ever left here, and you’ll probably be the next one caught in my grip.

Fled isn’t just a game. It’s a test of your courage, your ability to plan, and your willingness to act. If you want to test your skills and prove you're worthy of victory, then start the game. But know this — I’m always watching, and only you can decide if you’ll win. If you can — show me you deserve to be free.

[previewyoutube=dYcpTqkQuK0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]There’s an Exit, But It’s Not for Everyone [/b][/h2]

I’m watching every one of you. Be clever, be careful, and be ready to fight. And remember — I’m always one step ahead, but I’m giving you a chance.

Play Fled and show me that you’re the first one who deserves to walk out of here alive and victorious. The stakes are high, the walls are closing in, and every moment you hesitate could be your last.

Will you escape, or will you end up a forgotten prisoner, trapped for all eternity? The choice is yours — for now.
 

[h3][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/fled][b]Play it now on Tabletopia[/b][/url][/h3]

[b]Dear fellow citizens[/b],
The moment has come for each of us to take a decisive step in shaping the future of the world. We are on the edge of change, in an era where global events and political strategies are interwoven. Those who seize this moment will shape the future of a new world order.

The game [b]World Order[/b] gives each of us the opportunity to be part of this historic moment and view global challenges through the lens of a leader. Today, I am not only addressing you as a leader of this great country but also as a person who understands the importance of the changes taking place. We stand at a turning point when historical forces, global strategies, and political intrigues are intertwined, and those who can handle this challenge will become the leaders of the new world order. The game [b]World Order[/b] provides each of us with the chance to view this challenge through the prism of global decisions.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/613/sh2izdwboc06gt1keju851.png[/img]
[h2][b]Choose Your Nation and Lead the Fight for Global Dominance[/b] [/h2]

In [b]World Order[/b], you become part of the global political stage, choosing one of the great powers: Great Britain, the United States of America, China, Russia, or the European Union. Each of these players has its own strategy, opportunities, and unique resources that must be utilized in the fight for global dominance. This all unfolds against the backdrop of the new challenges faced by the world. The world order is indeed changing. We see how old players are losing influence, while new powers are taking center stage. Great Britain, once ruling the world, now faces the reality that its position is no longer as strong. We see China, with its expansionist policies, striving to assume the role of world leader. Russia, not lagging behind in its ambitions, is already establishing its strategic plays on the world stage. The European Union, as a united force, fights for its place in global politics, constantly balancing between economic interests and internal challenges. And all of this happens in real-time, in a world experiencing the most significant changes since the Cold War.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/613/e73zypz3votzly09jnmhga1.png[/img]
[h2][b]World Order is Not Just a Game[/b][/h2]
 
It is a unique opportunity for each of us to experience real political maneuvers, complex economic decisions, and large-scale military strategies. We will witness how different countries and regions of the world will strive to occupy central positions on the global stage. The game is not just about winning. It is about understanding what the real world order is, how it is built, who shapes it, and what factors influence its formation. In [b]World Order[/b], each of us will have the chance to demonstrate our diplomatic skills, economic acumen, and military strategy. Will you have enough wisdom to become the leader of this new era?

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/613/pvybpwlbtdzq1i28bcohr6.png[/img]
[h2][b]Strategy, Diplomacy, and Power [/b][/h2]

In [b]World Order[/b], players will employ a strategy-building system that combines elements of diplomacy, economics, and military power. Each player has the opportunity to build influence around the world, form alliances with other countries, strike favorable economic agreements, and, when necessary, use military force. It is a game where every action you take will have consequences. The strategies you choose will impact the future of your country and the entire world order. Thus, you are not just playing as one of the great powers — as a leader, you must make decisions that could forever alter the course of history. This game is a test of your leadership, your ability to influence the world, and your understanding of what is really happening in global politics.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/613/idqomuz0xuwnbtqvfvo2x3.png[/img]
[h2][b]What Makes World Order Unique?[/b][/h2]

This game combines not only an exciting and immersive gameplay experience but also a deep academic foundation. The developers have spent years researching to reflect the realities of modern world politics. Each country you represent has its own approach to international relations, its strengths and weaknesses, and unique opportunities for creating alliances and expanding influence. This is not just entertainment — it is an opportunity to see how global political mechanisms work and how they can be managed in an era of uncertainty and a rapidly changing world.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/613/bchthkqk3eugvaaqzfopi0.png[/img]

Today, the world is at a turning point: the economy is changing, nations are becoming increasingly interdependent, and the role of international organizations and alliances is constantly being reassessed. I believe many of you notice how geopolitics is becoming more prominent in our daily lives. You must understand how this process works to make the right choices. And [b]World Order[/b] is a game that helps you understand how everything is structured. Not just from the outside, but from the inside, through the lens of personal decisions and actions. This game will make you reflect on what is really happening in global political matters — matters we often hear about on TV or read in the news but that are sometimes difficult for us to grasp.

notes.title: Take the Crown, Subdue the Eternal Darkness!
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/574/vu1hclfn6ndvzgsp9jdf91.png[/img]
[h2][b]The time has come to step out of the light and embrace the shadows.[/b][/h2]
 
[b]Shadow Moon[/b], once a forgotten mining colony on the fringe of the galaxy, now gleams as the outer sector’s brightest trading hub. But beneath its glittering skyline lies a cesspool of corruption, deceit, and ambition. This is a world where laws are irrelevant, alliances are fleeting, and fortunes are won through cunning and ruthlessness.
 
It is here, in the underbelly of society, that legends are born and empires rise. Will you seize the moment to carve your place in this brutal world?
 
To rule, you must outwit your enemies, command your forces, and take what is yours by any means necessary. On [b]Shadow Moon[/b], the only rule is survival of the most cunning.


[h3][b]In Shadow Moon, nothing is as it seems.[/b][/h3]

Beneath the polished exterior of prosperity lies a world that thrives on chaos. This is where the desperate come to gamble everything, where betrayal is a currency, and where survival requires a sharp mind and sharper instincts.
 
The question is not whether you will face opposition but how you will overcome it. To succeed, you must embrace the very chaos that consumes others. This is not a place for the faint of heart; it is a proving ground for the bold, the ruthless, and the relentless

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/573/6wbyhd1gckuyp2fk7fitm5.png[/img]
[h2][b]Your Mission: Build an Empire in the Shadows[/b][/h2]
 
In [b]Shadow Moon Syndicates[/b], you assume the role of a ruthless crime boss leading your syndicate to dominance. This is not a game for the faint-hearted.
 
Over four cutthroat rounds, you will battle for control of key regions, orchestrate daring heists, and assemble a team of specialists to crush your rivals. Every decision counts, every move must be calculated, and every alliance must be treated as a means to an end. The stakes are high, and failure is not an option. The player who accumulates the most credits by the end of the game becomes the [b]Sovereign of Shadow Moon[/b], a title that commands respect, fear, and ultimate power.Victory demands more than brute force.
 
You must master the art of strategy, understanding when to strike and when to deceive. Influence is your currency, and the regions of [b]Shadow Moon[/b] are your battlegrounds. Will you dominate through sheer aggression, outmaneuver your rivals with clever tactics, or manipulate others into doing your bidding? The path to power is yours to forge.
 
[b]Shadow Moon[/b] is alive, dynamic, and unforgiving, where your rivals are not just obstacles but active participants in your downfall. Every action you take shifts the balance of power, creating a living, breathing battlefield that rewards ingenuity and punishes carelessness.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/574/h9og3gnxiwwraci9jytn75.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Chaos of Shadow Moon: A Ruthless World Awaits[/b][/h2]

[b]Shadow Moon[/b] is a world of contradictions. Its bustling markets and gleaming towers hide a dark truth: the planet’s heart beats to the rhythm of crime. Street gangs prowl the alleys, corporate agents deal in secrets, and so-called humanitarians cloak their ambitions in charity. notes.title: In the Footsteps of Pioneers: A Temple Guide
notes.notes:
Embark on an exciting and adventurous journey across [b]North America[/b] with brave pioneers and pilgrims! 

[b]Temple Trip[/b] is an exhilarating and dynamic board game designed for families to enjoy together. In this game, each player takes on the role of an explorer visiting important cultural and historical landmarks of [b]LDS temples[/b].

Gather your loved ones—whether it's family or friends—and prepare for an unforgettable race as you visit over [b]80 temples[/b], spanning from [b]Edmonton in Canada[/b] all the way to [b]Juarez[/b], [b]Mexico[/b], from the icy landscapes of [b]Anchorage[/b] to the tropical beauty of [b]Hawaii[/b], [b]Seattle[/b], and [b]Fort Lauderdale[/b].

[b]Temple Trip[/b] is a unique game that combines the enriching subjects of geography and history, transforming them into a thrilling adventure [b]for 2 to 10 players, ages 8 and up[/b].

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/540/zdwnlxquuwsmazpz5iuwt7.png[/img]
[h2][b]Game Features[/b][/h2]
 
The temple race begins in [b]Salt Lake City[/b], the heart of this thrilling expedition, where each player will choose a starting point and select the number of temples they need to visit—typically between 5 and 6 temples.

The ultimate goal is to be the first player to visit all their assigned temples and return to the main temple in [b]Salt Lake City[/b].

Strategic planning is essential as players need to chart their own routes while simultaneously blocking their opponents' paths! Throughout the game, players can use [b]"obstacle cubes"[/b] to create roadblocks that hinder others' progress. On top of that, the game offers different modes of travel, such as air travel or road trips, which can be activated on specific routes, adding depth and variety to the journey.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/541/0fzkpmf8zceonfjtujnwa1.png[/img]
[h2][b]How to Play[/b][/h2]

To start, decide how many temples each player will need to visit to win. Once that’s settled, place the pieces at the designated starting airports, and each player will receive a set of temple cards. You will also receive a red cube to represent roadwork and a black cube for adverse weather, which you can strategically use to create obstacles on your opponents' paths.

Each player takes turns rolling the dice to move across the board, racing against others to reach their assigned temples as quickly as possible. However, switching between travel modes—whether by car or plane—requires an additional task, so players need to plan their moves wisely to avoid delays. It’s not just about speed but also about managing your resources and keeping your opponents at bay.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/540/ilqwmuqy9frnnhssiqzhub.png[/img]
[h2][b]Amazing Route Options and Cards[/b][/h2]
 
One of the most exciting aspects of [b]Temple Trip[/b] is the variety of routes players can choose.

Each route offers unique conditions and challenges that will test the players' decision-making abilities. Some routes involve air travel, which can give you an advantage by bypassing certain obstacles, while others require border crossings that may slow you down unless you can roll the dice successfully to bypass them.

[b]Special Task[/b] cards add an extra element of surprise to the game, as they can reroute players to different cities or even send them on unexpected detours. These cards can drastically change the course of the game, forcing players to adapt their strategies on the fly. Among these cards, players may also find rare and valuable ones, like the coveted [b]"Fast Pass"[/b], which allows you to bypass certain border restrictions, giving you a significant edge over the competition.

Staying alert and making the best use of these cards can make the difference between victory and defeat.
 
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/541/snykhbmcqi89smxldr7ld4.png[/img]
[h2][b]Rewards Along the Way [/b][/h2]

Every time a player visits a temple, they flip over a card to confirm their task completion and gain rewards.

In addition to the satisfaction of marking another temple visit off the list, players can collect obstacle cubes that they can use to block the routes of other players. This adds an important tactical layer to the game: not only do players need to pick the fastest and most efficient routes, but they must also protect their paths from being disrupted by others. 

Players need to think ahead, balancing their progress with defensive tactics to ensure they don’t fall behind or lose momentum due to well-placed obstacles. 

[h3][b]Final Stretch and Victory[/b][/h3] 
Once a player has visited all their assigned temples, they can begin their final dash back to Salt Lake City.

But don’t think the race is over yet!

The other players can still use their cards to delay or reroute the leading player, making it a dramatic finish to the game. The first player to reach [b]Salt Lake City[/b] after completing their temple visits is crowned the winner and becomes the ultimate pioneer of this [b]North American adventure[/b].

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/541/owcjjyin4w4kqnvt4mx5n7.png[/img]
[h2][b]Components and Design[/b][/h2]
 
The game set includes a vibrant array of components that make [b]Temple Trip[/b] not only fun to play but also visually appealing. It features a detailed game board with city locations clearly marked, 10 colorful player markers, 16 black cubes and 16 red cubes for creating obstacles, 2 standard dice, as well as temple and task cards. There are also bonus and blank cards included, allowing players to personalize the game with their own cities and tasks, further enhancing the fun and replayability for the whole family. Whether you are a first-time player or an experienced gamer, these customizable elements make every playthrough unique and exciting.

notes.title: A Dynamic Card game with Cats and Strategy!
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/483/lfjefvhiflkh4gyvhhp4v1.png[/img]
[h2][b]Welcome to the Cat Sudoku: Summer Festival![/b][/h2]
 
Immerse yourself in the captivating and exciting world of this unique card game that combines the logical thinking of [b]classic Sudoku[/b] with the enchanting atmosphere of a magical [b]Japanese summer festival[/b]. This game promises not just 20 minutes of bright enjoyment but a whole ocean of emotions and entertainment, turning the rules of Sudoku into a thrilling adventure accessible for 1 to 4 players.

[b]Cat Sudoku[/b] invites both newcomers and seasoned strategists to dive into a tranquil yet exhilarating atmosphere where every decision you make is an important step toward victory!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/485/qq2w18dvxto9q0jp7wqyq1.png[/img]
[h2][b]Game Overview[/b][/h2]

The main objective of [b]Cat Sudoku: Summer Festival[/b] is to place numbered and colored cards on a 3x3 grid in such a way that each number and color is unique within its row and column.

But that’s not all! Throughout the game, you also collect reserve tokens and strive to position your cards in a special scoring zone to accumulate points and outpace your opponents.

Each new move can dramatically change the game's dynamics, and strategic card usage and reserve management will be crucial to your success. As the deck depletes, the challenges become more complex, and every player aims to score as many points as possible. [b]Cat Sudoku[/b] is the perfect choice for a cozy family evening or a relaxing solo gaming experience. Hold tournaments with friends or immerse yourself in a world of puzzles alone—this festival promises unforgettable moments and joy for everyone!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/486/6lnv4iyqsywmduf3jzthd5.png[/img]
[h2][b]How to Play[/b][/h2]
 
[list]
[*] [b]Draw a card and placeit![/b]  Start your turn by drawing a card from the deck and placing it on the grid, following the [b]Sudoku rules[/b]: each card must have a unique color and number in its row and column. After successfully placing a card, place the host figure (meeple) on it, adding a visually appealing element. If your card meets special placement conditions, you can earn a valuable reserve token that will become your trump card in the next round!

[*] [b]Manage your reserve.[/b] If placing a card on the grid is impossible or undesirable, add it to your reserve. Later, you can play it by spending two reserve tokens, allowing you to apply strategy in the future. Mastering your reserve management becomes key to staying ahead in the competition and achieving victory. Use your reserve wisely to not only protect your position but also create new opportunities to attack your opponents!

[*] [b]Scoring.[/b] The winner will be the player who accumulates the highest number of points from the cards in their scoring zone. But be careful: cards left in reserve may cost you points, so thoughtful reserve management becomes a vital element of strategy. In the case of a tie, the player with the most reserve tokens wins, making every decision you make critical and meaningful!

[*] [b]Advanced Scoring.[/b] To add extra challenges, you can use a stack-based scoring system. Players earn bonus points for forming stacks of two or three cards, making the game even more thrilling! Create strategies, combine cards, and enjoy the expanded rules that make each game unique!
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/486/i4fdljwszuagrrsw9ngjb3.png[/img]
[h2][b]Discover the Thrill of Player Count Dynamics![/b][/h2]

Get ready for an exhilarating gaming experience!

Each time you add a new player, the stakes get higher, and the strategy deepens. With every new player comes their own scoring column, creating a dynamic landscape where every move can either bolster your score or inadvertently assist your opponents.

[h3][b]The excitement ramps up at three players![/b][/h3]
 
Unlike four-player games where scoring columns overlap, each player has their own dedicated space to shine. To combat crowding, we introduce a vibrant purple card suit for higher player counts, giving you even more strategic options. No matter how many players join, the game flows quickly, keeping everyone engaged. Just remember to be cautious around the corners when playing with four; they’re shared spaces, and you won't be the only one vying for those points!

[h3][b]Master Your Strategy![/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Maximize Your Scoring Potential:[/b] Aim to fill your scoring column with as many cards as you can during your turn. In basic scoring mode, each card earns you a point, so the more you play, the more you score. It’s that simple!

[*] [b]Outsmart Your Opponents:[/b] Turn the tables on your fellow players by strategically placing cards that hinder their moves. If you can position cards to block them from playing effectively, you’ll gain the upper hand. Forcing them to either stash cards in their Reserve (leading to negative points) or inadvertently placing them in your scoring area is a win-win for you!

[*] [b]Keep Reserves Ready:[/b] Always maintain at least two Reserve Tokens. This flexibility allows you to adapt quickly and offload a Reserve Card when necessary, keeping your strategy fluid and effective.

[*] [b]Avoid Carelessness:[/b] Stay sharp! Mistakes can lead to unintentional giveaways of Reserve Tokens to your opponents. Playing carelessly isn't just a slip-up; it could mean the difference between victory and defeat.

[*] [b]Observe Your Opponents:[/b] Keep a close eye on the Reserve Cards of other players. By playing your cards strategically, you can potentially block their optimal moves. If they’re hoarding yellow cards, place yours in a way that limits their options and maximizes your advantage!

[*] [b]Weigh Your Options:[/b] Sometimes, it’s worth it to give your opponents a point if it means you can gain Reserve Tokens. Remember, each Reserve Card could translate to three points for you, while your opponent gaining a token might only give them three as well. It's a calculated risk that often pays off!

[*] [b]Stay Aware of the Deck:[/b] Be mindful of how many cards remain in the deck. If you’re holding onto Reserve Cards, make sure you’re not left empty-handed when the game draws to a close.
[/list]

notes.title: Experience the Thrill of Stamp Collecting with Stamp Swap!
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/393/f1tfvwgas0cb5xqqghvti1.png[/img]

Have you ever been captivated by the intricate art, historical stories, and global connections behind stamp collecting? 

If so, then [b]Stamp Swap[/b] is the perfect game for you!

Designed by the renowned [b]Paul Salomon[/b], creator of popular games, [b]Stamp Swap[/b] takes you on a thrilling journey through the timeless hobby of philately (stamp collecting) and turns it into an exciting, strategic board game experience you can share with family and friends. Whether you’re a seasoned collector or new to the world of stamps, this game offers a fast-paced and fun way to immerse yourself in a unique collecting adventure.


[h2]Why Stamp Collecting?[/h2]

Stamp collecting is a hobby steeped in history, art, and culture. For decades, enthusiasts have been drawn to the diversity of designs, stories, and significance that each stamp represents. From rare historical stamps to modern commemorative issues, the world of stamps is as vast as it is fascinating.

[b]Stamp Swap[/b] pays homage to this beloved pastime, making it accessible, competitive, and fun for everyone—while keeping the spirit of collecting at its heart. It's a celebration of the beauty and storytelling of stamps while adding the thrill of strategy to the mix.


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/476/8sqzkgrskmws38kxs38k91.png[/img]

[h2][b]Game Overview:[/b][/h2]
 
In [b]Stamp Swap[/b], players compete over the course of three engaging rounds, each of which is filled with drafting, trading, organizing, and optimizing their personal collection of stamps.

But this isn’t just about grabbing as many stamps as you can—it’s about carefully curating your collection to match the most valuable, rare, and strategically important stamps.

With a mix of strategy, negotiation, and luck, every choice you make could bring you one step closer to victory.


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/453/vyc0yyzwigfxvzx7jkk9zm0.png[/img]

[h2][b]How to Play:[/b][/h2]
 

[b]Stamp Swap[/b] revolves around three key phases each round, where players will need to balance strategy, risk, and reward. The gameplay is designed to be simple enough for beginners to pick up, yet deep enough for seasoned board gamers to sink their teeth into.
 
[list]
[*] [b]Draft & Collect:[/b] The round begins with players drafting from a selection of tiles laid out on the table. Some tiles are face-up, allowing you to see exactly what you’re getting, while others remain face-down, adding an element of surprise. These tiles represent the stamps you’ll collect, along with bonus cards that can enhance your strategy. The tension lies in choosing between taking a known value or gambling on hidden treasures—some of which could include rare gold-foil stamps that can earn you big points.

[*] [b]Divide & Choose:[/b] Once the drafting is complete, players are faced with a crucial decision—divide your collected tiles into two groups. You’ll offer one group to another player, while keeping the other for yourself. It’s a test of judgment and strategy: do you keep the better set of stamps for yourself, or offer it to manipulate your opponent’s choices? The stakes are high, and clever decisions in this phase can make all the difference in the final score.

[*] [b]Score & Organize:[/b] At the end of each round, players will score points based on a set of predetermined goals. These goals vary from round to round, but they might include collecting stamps from specific regions, completing themed sets, or acquiring the rarest stamps available. Each goal can only be scored once, so you'll need to plan ahead and focus on completing your collection before others beat you to it. With three rounds in total, the player who scores the most points by the end of the game is declared the winner, earning the prestigious title of [b]Master Philatelist[/b]!
[/list]


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/452/qcuebdrvdy5t59zjpglat5.png[/img]

[h2][b]Features You’ll Love:[/b][/h2]
 
[list]
[*] [b]Strategic Depth and Replayability:[/b] No two games of [b]Stamp Swap[/b] are ever the same. The combination of drafting, dividing, and scoring objectives creates a wealth of strategic options, ensuring that every decision counts. As the game evolves over three rounds, you'll need to adapt to new challenges and stay one step ahead of your opponents to win.

[*] [b]Stunning Components and Design:[/b] Featuring beautifully illustrated stamp tiles, the game evokes the elegance of real-world philately. Each tile is meticulously crafted, showcasing both classic and modern stamp designs. The rare gold-foil stamps add a luxurious touch, elevating the overall aesthetic and making the game a visual delight.

[*] [b]Accessible yet Challenging:[/b] [b]Stamp Swap’s[/b] rules are easy to learn, making it a fantastic choice for casual gamers and experienced board game enthusiasts alike. Its blend of simple mechanics and rich strategy means players of all skill levels can jump in and enjoy. Whether you're playing with friends at a game night or introducing younger family members to the joys of collecting, [b]Stamp Swap[/b] has something for everyone.

[*] [b]Solo Mode and Multiplayer Options:[/b] Want to test your stamp-collecting skills solo? [b]Stamp Swap[/b] offers a solo mode where you can challenge yourself against a tough AI opponent, making it the perfect companion for solo gamers. And when you’re ready for a full multiplayer experience, the game supports up to five players, providing a competitive yet friendly atmosphere for group play.

[*] [b]Collecting Meets Competition:[/b] [b]Stamp Swap[/b] masterfully blends the joy of stamp collecting with the thrill of competition. As you draft, trade, and organize your collection, you’ll be constantly thinking about how to outwit your opponents, while also enjoying the satisfaction of building a unique and valuable set of stamps.
[/list]


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/452/kmifwnigt1yguzaifh7zca.png[/img]

[h2][b]Unforgettable Moments Await in Stamp Swap[/b][/h2]
 
In conclusion, [b]Stamp Swap[/b] is not just a board game; it is an exciting journey into the world of stamp collecting that combines strategy, art, and captivating historical narratives. The game offers a unique opportunity to immerse yourself in the rich and diverse realm of philately, where every decision holds significant importance.

One of the key features of [b]Stamp Swap[/b] is its ability to maintain interest over many gaming sessions.

Each round is filled with unexpected twists and strategic choices, making every game unique. Players can adapt their approaches depending on the situation, competing for rare and valuable stamps, which ensures high replayability. This game also develops critical thinking and strategic planning skills, making it a valuable activity, not just entertainment.

Moreover, [b]Stamp Swap[/b] provides players the chance to evaluate risks and make decisions based on limited resources, which can be very beneficial both in the game and in life.


[previewyoutube=Xn6I8hboxyo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Play with your loved ones![/b][/h2]
 
So gather your friends and family, as [b]Stamp Swap[/b] is not just a game about stamps; it is a collection of unforgettable moments and vibrant experiences. By delving into the world of collecting, you will discover numerous stories behind each stamp. Get ready for strategic battles, friendly negotiations, and the joy of building your unique collection!

[b]Stamp Swap[/b] awaits you to deliver unforgettable experiences and new connections in the world of philately.


[h3][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/stamp-swap]Play it now on Tabletopia[/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Gems of Iridescia: A Thrilling Gem Mining Adventure Awaits You!
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/463/9lvgqm2x0natvsei9x24w2.png[/img]

Welcome to the captivating world of Iridescia, a land once abandoned but now ready to be rediscovered.

Centuries ago, a powerful cataclysm forced the inhabitants of Iridescia to flee their homeland, taking to the skies and leaving behind a rich world brimming with rare gems, forgotten relics, and untold secrets.

The time has come for explorers to return, and you are one of the bold adventurers ready to brave these lands.

In [b]Gems of Iridescia[/b], you’ll lead your clan on an epic journey to mine valuable gems, restore the ancient relics of this forgotten civilization, and ultimately claim the throne of Iridescia.

This thrilling game of strategy, luck, and adventure combines worker placement, resource management, and relic restoration, creating a dynamic gameplay experience that’s easy to learn but difficult to master.

Whether you’re new to board games or a seasoned player looking for your next challenge, [b]Gems of Iridescia[/b] promises to immerse you in a world filled with twists and surprises. Can you rise above the competition and earn enough [b]Royalty Points[/b] to prove your right to rule?


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/463/59kly3qtenhmevfavum4f6.png[/img]
[h2][b]Choose Your Champion and Begin the Journey[/b][/h2]
 
Every great adventure starts with a hero, and in [b]Gems of Iridescia[/b], you’ll have the chance to choose from one of four unique adventurers, each with their own distinct traits, backstory, and strengths. Will you take control of a powerful mechanical robot, unstoppable in its pursuit of gems and glory?

Or will you lead a noble rhino explorer, whose strength and determination are unmatched?

Each character offers a different playstyle, allowing you to approach the game in a way that matches your strategy.

[h3][b]As soon as you step foot in Iridescia, the adventure begins. [/b][/h3]
 
The game board is divided into a vast network of hidden tiles, each concealing valuable resources. As you explore the land, you’ll uncover new locations, mine precious gems, and face difficult decisions that will impact your success.

Every move you make can change the course of the game, as the market for gems is constantly in flux.

Will you be able to capitalize on the shifting market, or will your competitors outsmart you and take control of the most valuable treasures?

The fate of Iridescia lies in your hands.


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/463/aqq35icnsr8crjd5rsyw63.png[/img]
[h2][b]Explore, Mine, and Build Your Wealth[/b][/h2]

The world of Iridescia is teeming with hidden treasures just waiting to be unearthed. As you move across the board, you’ll flip over tiles to reveal gems buried beneath the surface. Each gem color corresponds to a specific dice value, and your mining success will depend on your ability to roll the right numbers.

But this is no simple dice game — you’ll need to carefully plan your moves and manage your resources if you want to come out on top.

Do you take a risk and push your luck to mine more gems, or do you play it safe and secure the resources you already have?

With each successful roll, you’ll add valuable gems to your cargo hold. These gems can be used in several ways: you can sell them for gold to purchase powerful tools, trade them for [b]Royalty Points[/b] by restoring ancient relics, or hold onto them for future opportunities. The gem market is constantly changing, and the value of your resources can plummet if you wait too long to sell.

Timing is everything in [b]Gems of Iridescia[/b], and those who can read the market and act quickly will have a huge advantage over their rivals.


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/464/hi32x90cww6iar7lzzoyk0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Master the Art of Timing and Strategy[/b][/h2]
 
One of the most exciting elements of [b]Gems of Iridescia[/b] is the dynamic and ever-changing gem market.

Every action taken by you or your opponents can cause the value of certain gems to rise or fall. This means that careful planning and strategic thinking are essential if you want to outwit your competitors. Do you sell your gems early to secure a modest profit, or do you wait for the market to peak, risking a potential loss in value?

The right move at the right time can make all the difference, and a single miscalculation could leave you empty-handed.
 
[h3][b]But selling gems isn’t your only path to victory[/b][/h3]
 
Throughout the game, you’ll have the opportunity to purchase powerful tools from [b]Rumi[/b], the [b]Traveling Merchan[/b]t. These tools offer a wide range of abilities, from enhancing your mining skills to sabotaging your opponents. Using the right tool at the right moment can turn the tide of the game in your favor, allowing you to mine more efficiently, restore relics faster, or disrupt your rivals’ plans. A clever combination of tools and timing can give you the edge you need to claim the throne.


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/464/visc0zsk7kz7dgsi0i9pn2.png[/img]
[h2][b]Unearth Ancient Relics and Prove Your Right to the Throne[/b][/h2]
 
While mining gems and manipulating the market are important aspects of [b]Gems of Iridescia[/b], the ultimate goal of the game is to restore ancient relics and earn [b]Royalty Points[/b]. The more relics you restore, the closer you come to proving your worth as the ruler of Iridescia.

But restoring relics isn’t easy — you’ll need to find the right combination of gems to unlock their power. Each relic type ([b]Jewelry[/b], [b]Technology[/b], and [b]Lore[/b]) offers different rewards, and completing a full set of relics will grant you massive bonuses at the end of the game.

In addition to the standard relics, the game features a special artifact known as [b]the[/b] [b]Iridia Stone[/b]. This legendary relic is hidden somewhere in the world of Iridescia, and the first player to uncover it will gain a significant advantage in their quest for the throne. [b]The Iridia Stone[/b] is a wild card that can be used to complete any relic set, giving its holder a major boost in [b]Royalty Points[/b]. Will you be the lucky explorer who finds this legendary treasure, or will it fall into the hands of your rivals?

One of the things that makes [b]Gems of Iridescia[/b] so unique is its blend of simplicity and depth. The game is designed to be easy to learn, with straightforward rules that allow players to jump into the action without spending hours reading through rulebooks. Within minutes, new players can start exploring, mining, and making strategic decisions. But beneath this simplicity lies a deep and complex game that offers endless opportunities for mastery.

Every playthrough of [b]Gems of Iridescia[/b] is different, thanks to the variety of secret objectives, hidden tiles, and multiple ways to score points. Whether you focus on mining, relic restoration, or market manipulation, there’s always a new strategy to explore.

The game’s dynamic market system ensures that no two games are ever the same, as the value of gems shifts in response to player actions. This creates a constantly evolving challenge, where your success depends on your ability to adapt to changing circumstances and outthink your opponents.


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/465/5llslyii6n8edwqtlszv1c.png[/img]

For players who enjoy a solo experience, [b]Gems of Iridescia[/b] offers an engaging and challenging single-player mode.

In this mode, you’ll face off against the automated [b]Rhom deck[/b], a relentless opponent that simulates the actions of a competing player. notes.title: Epilogue: Dying Together — Telling Together
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/442/86y9nk7nv81xyzizy33df6.png[/img]
What will your final chapter be? An epic tale of heroism? A tear-filled tragedy? Or a hilarious slip on an infinite sea of banana peels?

With [b]Epilogue[/b], you and your friends will discover the unexpected end of your journey together.

This one-of-a-kind storytelling game turns simple word fragments into a memorable, collaborative narrative about how you all meet your untimely demise.

[h2][b]Where It All Begins…[/b][/h2]
 
You awaken in a vast, endless desert with nothing but a door on the horizon. Your friends are there too, but no one knows how you arrived. What lies beyond the door? Why are you here? 

In [b]Epilogue[/b], the story is yours to create. Through word fragments, you and your friends will build a narrative together, deciding whether your final moments are filled with laughter, suspense, or something completely unexpected. Was it shenanigans, a heartbreaking farewell, or just a bizarre twist of fate?


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/440/qocxcyvk9tmykrfwzz2gzn.png[/img]
[h2][b]How the Game Works[/b][/h2]
 
Playing [b]Epilogue[/b] is easy, yet the creativity it sparks is boundless!

Each player starts with a card containing fragments of words. On your turn, you combine fragments to form a word, then pass the storytelling torch to another player, who must incorporate that word into the unfolding tale.

For example, if you form the word [b]"BAT"[/b], the next player weaves that into the story—maybe a creature in the night, or a strange object lying on the ground. It’s up to them!

Players take turns, each adding new pieces to the story, building it word by word, until all the cards are played. The player who uses the final card will close the tale, bringing your shared adventure to its dramatic or humorous conclusion.

[h3][b]Collaborate, Create, and Connect[/b][/h3]
 
Epilogue isn’t just a game—it’s an experience that encourages creativity, teamwork, and connection. Not everyone might feel comfortable creating a story at first, but the game brings out the storyteller in everyone. It’s a space where ideas flow freely, where each contribution builds on the last, and where no one knows how the story will end until the final card is played. For added fun, you can introduce awards for the best plot twist, the longest word, or the funniest moment!


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/440/e9wxebvc20oyhqcy2wmis3.png[/img]
[h2][b]A Perfect Game for Any Gathering[/b][/h2]
 
Whether you're enjoying a casual game night with friends or family, [b]Epilogue[/b] offers a one-of-a-kind experience. It’s more than just a game—it’s a way to connect, laugh, and create lasting memories with those around you. The unpredictable and collaborative nature of the storytelling ensures that each game is unique, leaving you with a new story to tell every time.

[h3][b]Ready to dive into a world of captivating stories?[/b][/h3]
 
This is your adventure, and it’s up to you how it unfolds. Start by exchanging ideas, allowing each player to add their unique perspective. Every step you take creates an exciting plot full of unexpected twists and intriguing details.

Let your imagination and creativity flow freely, allowing the stories to develop in surprising directions. Each new word and fragment adds depth and mystery to your tale. In the process, you not only craft an engaging narrative but also strengthen your connection with other players, discovering their thoughts and ideas.

As all the cards are played, conclude your story on a high note, leaving listeners in anticipation and curiosity. Allow your creativity to guide you to unforgettable moments, and remember: every story you tell is a reflection of your imagination and shared experience. Explore new horizons as you immerse yourself in this amazing world!

[b]Epilogue[/b] is designed for cooperative play, but feel free to introduce fun challenges like awarding points for the best story twist, the longest word, or the most surprising ending. Be creative, have fun, and enjoy making memories with your friends!


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/441/lrlv9cnwydrgkjfy6vfpr1.png[/img]
[h2][b]What Makes Epilogue Special?[/b][/h2]
 
The simple mechanics are just the start—the real magic happens in the stories you create together.

With over 280 word fragments, [b]Epilogue[/b] gives you the tools to build nearly any 3–6 letter word in the English language, leading to endless story possibilities.

Whether your tale is filled with drama, laughter, or intrigue, no two games will ever be the same.

For newcomers, we’ve included three quick-start teaching cards, making it easy to jump right in. These cards guide you through the rules and gameplay in just minutes, ensuring you can focus on the fun and creativity from the start.

[h3][b]Capture Your Best Stories[/b][/h3]
 
On the back of the rulebook, you’ll find a space dedicated to epitaphs—a place where you can jot down the most unforgettable moments from your games. Over time, this section will become a living history of your shared stories and experiences with friends.

[h3][b]The World of Ghosties Awaits[/b][/h3]
 
For those who want to delve deeper into the lore and charm of [b]Epilogue[/b], we’ve created [b]Epilogue: Ghosties[/b]—a beautifully illustrated picture book filled with quirky art and stories about the lovable ghost characters you’ll encounter in the game. Ever wonder how Aerobics Aika or Boo’reguard Buttersworth met their end?

Find out in this delightful addition to your [b]Epilogue[/b] experience!


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/440/dl3fexgh50odxt1nyotqt5.png[/img]
[h2][b]Unlock Exclusive Rewards on Kickstarter![/b][/h2]
 
Join our exciting [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/violetdaisygames/epilogue-finish-your-story][b]Kickstarter[/b][/url] campaign and unlock a variety of exclusive rewards!

As a valued backer, you’ll receive luxurious card finishes and a sturdy cover for the rulebook to enhance your gameplay experience. Plus, enjoy a beautifully screen-printed jute bag, perfect for keeping your cards safe and easily transporting [b]Epilogue[/b] wherever you go.

Delve deeper into the enchanting world of [b]Epilogue[/b] with our [b]Ghosties picture book[/b]—a delightful collection of stunning artwork and captivating backstories about the quirky characters you’ll encounter during your adventures. This charming addition enriches your understanding of the [b]Epilogue[/b] universe and complements your gaming experience.

These exclusive rewards are available only to our [b]Kickstarter[/b] supporters, making this an unmissable opportunity to elevate your game. Act now to secure your rewards and embark on an unforgettable journey through the world of [b]Epilogue[/b]!

This isn’t just a game—it’s a gateway to creativity, imagination, and connection. 

[b]Epilogue[/b] invites you to explore the unknown, craft tales of adventure, laughter, and suspense, and leave a lasting legacy of shared stories. Whether it’s a grand tragedy or a comedic mishap, the story is yours to tell.

Welcome to [b]Citizens of the Spark[/b] — a place where your mind for strategy and innovation will shape the destiny of your city. This customizable card game challenges you to recruit powerful citizens, harness their unique abilities, and gather sparks of progress.

Are you ready to lead your city to greatness?

[h2][b]Claim the Power of the Sparks![/b][/h2]

In this world, the strength of your city is tied to the citizens you gather. The more citizens of a particular type you attract, the stronger their impact becomes. Build your dream city, unleash the full potential of your citizens, and collect sparks to solidify your dominance.

But beware—once the deck is empty, only the player with the most sparks will reign supreme!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/407/njrxcjfwnfz2ulzj3vqlj7.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Legacy of the Transmission[/b][/h2]
 
Long ago, the creatures of Fera were simple beings, until a cosmic Transmission transformed their world, igniting their intelligence and sparking unprecedented technological advancements.

Nature and machines flourished in harmony—until now. A prophecy hidden within the Transmission foretells a time of upheaval, when only one city will stand as the pinnacle of progress while the others crumble. As a city leader, your mission is clear: gather the brightest minds, recruit resourceful citizens, and claim your place as the ultimate power in Fera. 

Will you be the one to secure the blessing of the Transmission, or will your city fade into obscurity?

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/407/eqscdm6lgf7cn0kmro6w83.png[/img]

Every decision in [b]Citizens of the Spark[/b] counts.

Choose your citizens with care, activate their abilities with precision, and watch as your rivals scramble to keep up.

The game offers rich layers of strategy, with 30 distinct animal citizens to recruit, each with unique skills. Whether you’re building clever combos or reacting to your opponents’ moves, the possibilities for tactical play are endless.
 
[list]
[*] [b]Recruit & Grow:[/b] Attract citizens and group similar types to amplify their strength.

[*] [b]Activate & Challenge:[/b] Unleash powerful abilities, but be prepared—your opponents can follow your lead!

[*] [b]Claim Victory:[/b] The player with the most sparks when the deck runs out wins. And if there’s a tie? The prophecy declares you all victorious!
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/407/psiqy8uizsmotqcnz6uix1.png[/img]

Fans of games like Dominion, Wingspan, and SmashUp will feel right at home here. With stunning anthropomorphic animal artwork, smart engine-building mechanics, and constant player interaction, this game is filled with exciting moments from start to finish.

Plus, there’s never any downtime—when one player acts, everyone has a chance to respond, keeping the action flowing until the very last spark is claimed!

[h3][b]Endless Replayability[/b][/h3]
 
No two games are ever the same.

With 30 unique animal citizens, every game of Citizens of the Spark presents new strategies, challenges, and opportunities for clever combos. Each session is a fresh chance to lead your city to victory, making it endlessly replayable.

Yet, as a seasoned adventurer, you know that wealth is only part of the reward.

True victory lies in claiming the rarest treasures and earning titles that bards will sing of for centuries.

Welcome to [b]Split the Hoard[/b], an immersive, fast-paced card game for 2-5 adventurers. In just 20 minutes, you’ll be engaged in an intense game of strategy as you try to outwit and outmaneuver your fellow adventurers.

It’s not just about grabbing gold, but making sure what you walk away with is more valuable, more legendary, and more powerful than anything anyone else can lay claim to.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/362/wqrsoe2qzkvsakwnyxmny8.png[/img]
[h3][b]The Story:[/b][/h3]

The mighty dragon has been vanquished, but your journey isn’t over. Standing amidst a vast cavern filled with untold riches, you and your companions face one final challenge: who gets what?

Bruised and battered from the fight, you know you can't linger long. An army of scavengers is on the way, eager to take the hoard for themselves.

Every second counts as you sift through piles of treasures, desperately searching for the items that will make your legacy unforgettable.

Will you claim the treasures that align with your secret agendas?

Will your haul win you the most glorious titles, or will someone else walk away with the honor that could have been yours?

[h3][b]How to Play:[/b][/h3]

Split the Hoard is played over a series of strategic rounds. Each round involves three key phases:

1.[b] Reveal[/b] – Search the dragon’s hoard for new treasures. Players draw treasure cards, unveiling priceless artifacts, gold, and special items that could help secure their legacy.

2. [b]Negotiate [/b]– This is where things get interesting. Players take turns negotiating deals, stealing from each other, or cutting temporary alliances to secure the most valuable loot. Bluffing, trading, and making deals are key to getting what you need—and preventing others from doing the same.

3. [b]Claim[/b] – Add the treasures you've successfully claimed to your haul. But be careful: the treasures you add now could make you a target in the next round.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/362/ztzcaxnxpx9yff8mjkcwf2.png[/img]
[h3][b]The Race to Glory:[/b][/h3]

The game ends when the treasure is empty - when there is nothing left to take.

But the real test comes during the final scoring. It’s not enough to simply collect gold.

Players score points based on the treasures they’ve acquired, their secret agendas, and the impressive titles they’ve won throughout the game.

Public titles are awarded for achieving visible objectives, like collecting sets of certain treasures.

But hidden personal titles are where the real strategy lies, offering unique bonuses if you can fulfill your secret goals.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/362/biyxwk8schf9bfwssywm67.png[/img]
[h3][b]Key Features of the Game:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Hidden Agendas: Each adventurer has secret objectives that guide their strategy. Will you focus on gathering artifacts, amassing gold, or securing magical items? Only you know—and that keeps everyone else guessing.

[*] Negotiation and Bluffing: The game’s heart lies in its negotiation mechanics. Will you make a deal to share treasures, or will you bluff and backstab your way to victory? The choice is yours, but beware: betrayals have consequences!

[*] Set Collection and Victory Points: Gathering treasures isn’t just about wealth; it’s about assembling the right combinations of loot to maximize your score. Whether you’re collecting rare magical items or piling up gold coins, every decision impacts your final points.

[*] Fast-Paced Rounds: Each round is quick but packed with strategic depth. Players must think on their feet, react to shifting alliances, and make tough choices in a limited time frame.
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/362/vv7z66cw6jviqymu2bksvf.png[/img]
[h3][b]The Final Showdown:[/b][/h3]

As the game reaches its climax, the pressure mounts. The treasure dwindles, and every decision feels more critical than the last.

Do you secure that last rare artifact for yourself or sabotage your rival's plans?

Do you reveal your full hand of treasures, or keep some cards close to your chest for a surprise victory?

When the last card is drawn, it’s time to see who truly made the most of their opportunity. Points are tallied from your collected treasures, public titles, and secret agendas.

The adventurer with the highest score claims not only the hoard but also eternal glory. 

[h3][b]Why Play Split the Hoard?[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Quick and Exciting: A full game lasts just 20 minutes, making it perfect for game night or quick sessions between other adventures.

[*] Endless Replayability: With different adventurers, secret agendas, and treasures in each game, no two rounds of Split the Hoard are ever the same. You’ll keep coming back, discovering new strategies and ways to outwit your friends.

[*] Interactive Gameplay: This isn’t a game where you sit back and watch others play. Every turn involves active participation—negotiating deals, forming alliances, and making big plays to control the outcome.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=2hzB7c0XSGE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Who Will Love This Game?[/b][/h3]

If you enjoy games that involve strategy, bluffing, and negotiation, Split the Hoard is for you.

Fans of fantasy, treasure hunting, and classic adventuring tropes will especially love the game’s theme.

But even if you’re new to fantasy games, the fast-paced, engaging mechanics of Split the Hoard will quickly draw you in.

Whether you’re playing with friends or family, the interactive nature of the game makes every round an adventure.

Why wait when you can start playing right away? The moment our campaign ends, you’ll get immediate access to your digital rewards—printable files and game materials—delivered straight to your inbox. No delays, no waiting. Just pure, instant fun!
