notes.title: Fate of Witches: Master Dark Magic, Build Your Coven, Seize Power!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/11995444/ed032523154b82f4f0844c5d404c9cba40107810.png[/img]
In the cursed village of [b]Black Hollow[/b], the night is thick with fear, and the air smells of burning wood and flesh.

The [b]Grand High Witch[/b], ruler of the secretive [b]Council of Witches[/b], has mysteriously perished. Her death has left a power vacuum, and the witches are now locked in a bitter struggle, each vying to be her successor. But only one can claim the title of [b]Grand High Witch[/b], and the path to victory is fraught with peril. As villagers whisper of dark omens and strange disappearances, panic spreads like wildfire. The [b]Witch Hunter[/b], armed with ruthless conviction and aided by his loyal [b]Hound[/b], is on the prowl. No witch is safe.

In this world of treachery, dark magic, and blood oaths, you must rise above the others. As a powerful head witch, you are tasked with building the most formidable coven, securing forbidden relics, and mastering ancient spells. But the [b]Witch Hunter's[/b] eyes are everywhere, and betrayal lurks in the shadows.
 
Will you be the one to seize power and reign supreme, or will your dreams of grandeur turn to ash?
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/388/rrkrjy02leksdotkvazz5d.png[/img]
Welcome to [b]Fate of Witches[/b] —a chilling, strategic card game where dark forces collide and survival is anything but guaranteed.

[h2][b]A Race Against Time and Suspicion[/b][/h2]
 
In [b]Fate of Witches[/b], players take on the role of ambitious witches, each attempting to build the most powerful coven in the village while evading the deadly [b]Witch Hunter[/b].

The game is played over several rounds, with each player recruiting strange and powerful characters, collecting magical items, and casting dark spells to gain an advantage. Every decision is a risk, and one wrong move could end in capture, trial, or worse—execution by fire.

The tension rises as the [b]Witch Hunter[/b] moves through the village, uncovering secrets and hunting down anyone suspected of practicing witchcraft. 

Will you have the wits and cunning to outsmart him? 

Will your rivals sabotage your plans, or will they fall prey to their own ambition?

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/388/y7jxcjtt9jtzhajplgvunc.png[/img]
[h2][b]Strategize, Sacrifice, and Survive[/b][/h2]
 
In [b]Fate of Witches[/b], strategy is key.
 
The game features a dynamic coven-building system, where you’ll need to carefully select which characters to recruit to your side.
 
Each character comes with unique abilities and attributes that can drastically change the flow of the game. Some characters can be sacrificed, unlocking dark powers in the Graveyard that can turn the tide in your favor. But beware—each sacrifice comes with a cost, and the path to victory is paved with the bones of your fallen allies.

As you recruit more witches to your coven, you'll also gather mystical items and tokens that can boost your score or enhance your abilities.
 
Magical artifacts such as enchanted cauldrons, cursed amulets, and forbidden tomes can give you the upper hand, but only if you use them wisely.
 
Timing is everything, and knowing when to cast a spell or perform a ritual can be the difference between triumph and downfall.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/388/xwyd7sovry4zkwhvyjgtf5.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Power of Sacrifice[/b][/h2]

Not all cards are meant to last.

In the world of [b]Fate of Witches[/b], power often requires sacrifice. Some of the most powerful abilities in the game are unlocked by sending your witches to the [b]Graveyard[/b]. When a character is sacrificed, they flip over, revealing their [b]Graveyard[/b] value and unlocking new powers. Their Blessed or Cursed tokens also flip, altering their effect and potentially swinging the game in your favor. This mechanic adds a grim layer of strategy to the game—sometimes, the only way forward is to betray those who serve you.

By sacrificing characters, you not only increase your score but also open new pathways to powerful combos.
 
Each decision to sacrifice must be weighed carefully—will the short-term gain be worth the long-term cost?
 
Will the dark magic unleashed by your sacrifice propel you to victory, or will it mark the beginning of your downfall?

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/388/puhlbkaamegglmyfyk1re0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Build Your Coven, Build Your Power[/b][/h2]
 
[b]Fate of Witches[/b] revolves around its unique engine-building mechanics. Players draft characters from the Village Deck, each with distinct abilities—some excel in spells, others in stealth or force.

Balancing your coven’s strengths is essential for victory. As the game progresses, powerful combos emerge, giving you the upper hand or shielding you from the [b]Witch Hunter’s[/b] pursuit. Along the way, gather magical items like the Enchanted Cauldron or Witch’s Amulet, but be cautious—each item has a cost.

A Village on Edge Tension fills the game’s atmosphere, with the [b]Witch Hunter[/b] constantly on your trail.

Each round presents new threats and opportunities through the Night Event Deck, which adds unpredictability. Will you find aid or face a deadly curse? As suspicion grows, the [b]Witch Hunter[/b] draws closer, forcing every move to be more critical.

[h3][b]Endless Replayability and Strategic Depth[/b][/h3]
 
With 60 unique cards, every game is different, offering endless challenges and strategies. The drafting mechanic and changing events keep players on edge. Easy to learn but hard to master, [b]Fate of Witches[/b] promises an engaging experience for all players, whether solo or with friends.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/389/edxbdexjhin6xt7n2gcqz6.png[/img]
[h2][b]The [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fate-of-witches-game/fate-of-witches-card-game]Kickstarter[/url] Journey[/b][/h2]

[b]Fate of Witches[/b] is more than just a game—it's a passion project years in the making. And now, through [b]Kickstarter[/b], we have the opportunity to share it with the world. We’ve chosen [b]Kickstarter[/b] to ensure that we can bring this game to life with the highest possible quality. As a small indie team, we rely on the support of our backers to make this vision a reality.

From the moment you pledge, you’re not just buying a game—you’re helping us craft a complete experience, from the meticulously hand-drawn artwork to the finely tuned mechanics. We’ve chosen not to include stretch goals because we are committed to delivering the best version of [b]Fate of Witches[/b] right from the start, without compromising on quality. 

Your support means everything, and to show our gratitude, all backers will receive a free 10-card micro-expansion called [b]Witch's Runes[/b], introducing new gameplay elements to further enhance your dark journey.

[b]Kickstarter[/b] allows us to reach a global audience, connecting players from all over the world who share our love for dark, strategic games. With your help, we can bring [b]Fate of Witches[/b] into your hands—and together, we’ll raise the stakes of what an indie game can achieve.

[previewyoutube=K8nwgAw4koM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]Are You Ready to Embrace the Darkness?[/b][/h2]

In [b]Fate of Witches[/b], survival demands cunning.

Will you sacrifice allies, harness dark power, and evade the [b]Witch Hunter[/b], or fall victim to your own ambition?

Back us now and claim your place as the [b]Grand High Witch[/b]—if you dare.

[h3][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/fate-of-witches-game]Play it now on Tabletopia[/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Welcome to the exciting adventure of building your very own mining town!
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/351/yukud6mcywsgrj949pirr1.jpg[/img]
In [b]Minecart Town[/b], a board game for 1-4 players, you will lead a group of settlers who have ventured into untamed lands in search of a safe and prosperous home.
 
Surrounded by raw resources, it's up to you to turn this barren land into a thriving city with a bustling transportation network!
 
[h3][b]The primary goal of the game[/b][/h3]
 
Is to earn the most victory points by skillfully managing resources, constructing buildings, and laying down railways to transport valuable minerals. Every decision is a step towards building an even more productive supply chain. Over the course of 4 rounds, your small settlement can blossom into a bustling town!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/351/noqx1uh5dy1mlk0shfhxd7.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Key Features:[/b][/h3]
 
Unique city-building mechanics: Construct buildings that will generate the resources you need and connect them with railroads. Efficient transportation planning is the key to success!
 

Efficiency is everything: You’ll need to carefully allocate limited resources and plan each move to maximize your efficiency. Will you focus on building new structures, or improve your existing transport routes?
 

Endless combinations: With 78 unique building tiles, no two games will be the same. Showcase your strategic brilliance by creating clever combinations and optimizing resource flow!
 

Fast-paced gameplay: Most actions take place simultaneously, keeping the game fast and engaging. Plan ahead and race toward victory!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/351/ovrnhkj6qk2pkomraplef0.png[/img]
[h3][b]Each round consists of several phases:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Resource production[/b]: Your buildings generate vital resources like wood, stone, coal, and more.

[*] [b]Construction[/b]: Use your resources to build new structures and expand your settlement.

[*] [b]Railway planning[/b]: Design rail routes to link your buildings and ensure resource delivery.

[*] [b]Resource transportation[/b]: Without proper rail connections, resources cannot be transported between buildings.

[*] [b]Resource processing[/b]: Move resources along your railways to convert them into victory points.
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/354/u7kzyqhdyte0kuxpo5jqj3.png[/img]
[b][h3]In Minecart Town, planning is everything.[/h3][/b]
 
Each round brings you closer to the final phase, where your transportation and production system will run at full capacity.
 
By the end, you'll witness the exciting payoff of a well-executed plan, with chain reactions of efficient deliveries leading to victory.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/357/x3zqhgujbtzrj1cbrsjw80.png[/img]
[b][h3]What’s New in This Version?[/h3][/b]
 
Minecart Town is a reimagined version of the original My Trolley Town, developed in collaboration with Studio GG and JELLY JELLY GAMES.

We've revamped and enhanced the game to make it accessible to players worldwide.
 
[b]Here are the key improvements:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Brand-new artwork by Sai Beppu;

[*] More building tile options for varied strategies;

[*] A new solo mode that lets you explore the depths of the game on your own;

[*] Streamlined setup and endgame, making gameplay quicker and more convenient;

[*] Upgraded components and revised rules for smoother play.
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/357/cptf3skzlqsqyhvgzsjfi6.png[/img]
In [b]Minecart Town[/b], you have the ultimate chance to put your strategic thinking to the test as you build the dream town your settlers have longed for.
 
With a vast array of development possibilities, each game offers fresh opportunities to experiment with unique building combinations, crafting a town that runs like a well-oiled machine.
 
Every choice—whether it’s prioritizing resources, constructing vital railroads, or aligning your buildings for maximum efficiency—carries significant weight and will shape the future of your town.
 
You’ll have to balance immediate needs with long-term goals, ensuring that your town not only thrives but flourishes.
 
As you carefully lay each tile and map out the perfect system, the satisfaction of seeing your strategic plans come to life makes every moment both exciting and rewarding.
 
Every game is a new chance to push your creativity and decision-making skills to their fullest potential.

notes.title: Step Into the Shoes of a Ruthless Mob Boss in 1920s Manhattan!
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/ypbkz6xe1fkpzdfsrhejve.png[/img]
The Roaring Twenties are calling it's time for you to answer as a cunning, ruthless mob boss in [b]Speakeasy[/b].

This thrilling borough control game takes you to the heart of Prohibition-era Manhattan where you'll build your empire, make deals, and fight for control of the city's lucrative underground liquor trade.

Think you've got what it takes?

[b][h3]Welcome to Prohibition-era Manhattan[/h3][/b]

The year is 1921. The United States is dry, but in Manhattan, the booze is flowing – if you know where to look. Behind closed doors, hidden from the prying eyes of law enforcement, speakeasies thrive.

As one of the most notorious mob bosses in the city, you have big plans for your operation.

[h3][b]What is your mission?[/b][/h3]

Dominate the underground liquor business, expand your influence across the city, and earn the respect of none other than Lucky Luciano, the kingpin who controls Manhattan’s entire organized crime network.

But success won’t come easy.

Every move you make is risky, and every rival gangster is vying for the same power.

In Speakeasy, you’ll need more than brute force to prevail – you’ll need subtle strategy, smooth negotiations, and a willingness to get your hands dirty.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/cd9y3ll6exzzslt0viom44.png[/img]
[h3][b]Build Your Empire, One Speakeasy at a Time[/b][/h3]

In Speakeasy, you’re more than just a gangster – you’re the boss of a growing criminal enterprise.

The game combines worker placement, map management, and territory control mechanics to create a deep strategic experience where every decision matters.

Whether you’re opening new Speakeasies, upgrading your operations into swanky nightclubs and casinos, or strategically taking over rival territories, you’ll always be working toward one goal: to become the most powerful mob boss in Manhattan.

Your journey begins with a small speakeasy tucked away in one of Manhattan’s many neighborhoods. From there, you’ll expand – setting up more operations, producing and distributing illegal alcohol, and making strategic upgrades that will help you grow your wealth and influence.

You’ll have to manage your resources carefully to ensure you have enough booze to keep your customers happy and enough thugs to protect your territory.

Play Smart or Play Dirty – The Choice is Yours!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/tnfnaqym6mlx9wx81q1hj1.png[/img]
[h3][b]Speakeasy offers you endless possibilities to build your empire[/b][/h3]

Will you play fair, stay under the radar, and quietly outsmart your opponents?

Or will you take a more aggressive approach, raiding rival gangsters, robbing rumrunners, and striking fear into the hearts of your enemies?

You will need to hire thugs to help protect your bars and do your dirty work. These loyal soldiers can be strategically placed to protect your buildings, or used to raid your competitors' operations, stealing their valuable resources and weakening their position.

But be careful - the attacks do not go unnoticed, and there is always the possibility of revenge.

Do you have what it takes to hold your ground?

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/wjjbsw5fvjlxihesp21c91.png[/img]
[h3][b]Build Alliances, But Trust No One [/b][/h3]

In Speakeasy, you're not alone.

Rival mob bosses, each with their own ambitions, fight for control of Manhattan's boroughs.

Sometimes, a strategic alliance can be your ticket to success, allowing you to take down a more powerful rival or expand into a lucrative new area.

But trust is a rare commodity in the criminal underworld, and alliances can quickly turn sour.

Be prepared to betray your allies when the time comes, and make sure you're not double-crossed.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/h38nklszoyrjbbhfidrs75.png[/img]
[h3][b]Outsmart the Law and Lucky Luciano[/b][/h3]

As your empire grows, so will your reputation.

But be careful – success attracts attention. 

The cops are always on the lookout for illegal liquor operations, and the more you expand, the more likely you are to fall under their radar. 

You’ll need to bribe law enforcement to keep your operations running smoothly, but even then, one wrong move could destroy your entire empire.

And it’s not just the law you have to worry about.

Lucky Luciano, the mob boss who controls all of Manhattan, is keeping a close eye on you. 

He expects his share of the profits, and if you fail, you could be in big trouble.

Keeping Luciano happy is crucial to your survival – disappoint him, and he won’t hesitate to send his goons to stop you. 

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/ga9q8s7sd2pvcmjfgzrg50.png[/img]
[h3][b]Rise to the Top or Fall to the Bottom[/b][/h3]

In the cutthroat world of Prohibition-era Manhattan, there’s only one path to victory: money and power.

As you navigate the dangerous streets of the city, your ultimate goal is to amass more wealth than any of your rivals.

Whether you earn your fortune legally or illegally, gain your empire or lose it all, do you have the cunning, strategy, and ruthlessness to outlast your competitors?

[url=https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/hngzm3fiskqc3qszk6vhza.png][img][/img][/url]
[h3][b]Key Features of Speakeasy:[/b][/h3]

Worker Placement & Card Management:
Carefully manage your resources and workers to expand your speakeasy empire while staying ahead of the competition.

Area Control:
Battle for dominance over Manhattan’s lucrative districts, strategically taking over rival territories to grow your influence.

Goons & Mobsters:
Hire goons to defend your buildings or attack rival operations, and form alliances with other mob bosses to gain the upper hand.

High Stakes:
As your empire grows, so does the risk. Bribe cops to stay off your trail, keep Luciano happy, and fend off rival attacks as you rise to power.

Immersive Theme:
Step into the gritty world of 1920s Manhattan, where speakeasies, mobsters, and jazz rule the streets.

[previewyoutube=ZRapbkjEfvU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Can You Rule Manhattan?[/b][/h3]

Speakeasy is more than just a game—it's a thrilling journey into the dark, dangerous world of Prohibition-era organized crime.

With every turn, you'll make critical decisions that could make or break your empire.

Will you rise to the top of the criminal underworld, or will you be crushed by your rivals?

The Roaring Twenties await you—grab your fedora, pour yourself a glass of the finest (illegal) booze, and get ready to take on the challenge of a lifetime.

It's time to make your mark on Manhattan in Speakeasy.

notes.title: Rolling Realms Redux – Your Ticket to a World of Endless Strategy and Fun!
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/308/chftk3qxs2znipfowzx3p1.png[/img]
Discover [b]Rolling Realms Redux[/b], a unique game where players compete to become the best by collecting as many stars as possible over three thrilling rounds.
 
This game offers exciting mini-games, and each playthrough presents a new set of challenges, thanks to 12 unique “realms,” each with its own opportunities and rewards.
 
It’s not just a game—it’s an adventure with dice and markers, where you’ll actively record results and use them to claim victory.
 
[b][h3]Core Gameplay Mechanics: [/h3][/b]
At the start of each turn, one player rolls two dice. The results can be used by all players to activate different realms on their cards, generate resources, and earn stars.
 
Every turn provides unique action opportunities, where each decision you make could be crucial in your quest for victory.
 
Three rounds of intense moments and surprising strategies await, and only the player with the most stars will triumph!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/319/dp7g3rgtctjiwzxb1y8yv0.png[/img]
[h3][b]What Makes Rolling Realms Redux Special?[/b][/h3]
 
One of the unique features of this game is the carefully designed box—it’s specifically made to fit all realms ever released!
 
We’ve meticulously calculated space for all existing and future realms, so you can be confident that your collection will always have room for new additions.
 
Plus, we continue to release promo realms that add fresh twists to the game, keeping it exciting and unpredictable.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/319/odm7vdj83uriyykyp3zosb.png[/img]
[b][h3]A New Wave of Strategic Possibilities Rolling Realms Redux[/h3][/b] 
Was born in the early days of the pandemic when many people around the world found themselves in isolation.
 
Thanks to its accessibility and flexibility, the game quickly gained popularity.
 
The game’s core is built around realms inspired by various board games, and over time, its world continued to expand through collaborations with well-known publishers and designers.
 
This edition features 12 completely new realms created exclusively for Redux, making each playthrough fresh and filled with new challenges.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/319/psoffrdzatldovivsyzshj.png[/img]
[b][h3]Game Details:[/h3][/b]
The game is designed for 1-6 players, but if you want, you can expand the number of participants to unlimited by combining multiple sets.
 

Play remotely or asynchronously, making Rolling Realms Redux ideal for virtual game nights with friends, no matter where they are.
 

Each round consists of 9 turns, where dice rolls determine how you will activate your realms, generate resources, and earn stars. A key element of the game is using resources to create additional dice and increase your chances of victory.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/319/k1yz3kgw7bywn0hyz4wx5i.png[/img]
[h3][b]Endless Replayability[/b][/h3]
 
With such a variety of realm combinations, every playthrough promises to be unique.
 
Rolling Realms Redux offers over 40,000 possible realm combinations, making the game practically infinite in its strategies and scenarios.
 
This ensures that you’ll never get bored, as each time, you’ll find new tactical approaches!
 
Expanded Game Features:
 
For those seeking even more variety and challenges, we’ve prepared special expansions.
 
The Risky Rewards mini expansion and the Beyond the Realmiverse campaign offer new paths to develop your strategy.
 
Risky Rewards adds additional resources and ways to earn stars, while Beyond the Realmiverse is a four-chapter solo campaign filled with challenges, where you’ll combine and choose realms to complete various missions.
 
Whether you’re playing solo or with friends, Rolling Realms Redux offers hours of exciting gameplay, full of unexpected twists and strategic decisions.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/319/mmcedwf8yfriscdezx0wi7.png[/img]
[b][h3]Solo Players' Opportunity: The RRR Ball Tournament[/h3][/b]
For those who prefer solo play, a unique tournament mode called RRR Ball was designed by renowned game creators Morten Monrad Pedersen, Karel Titeca, and Lieve Teugels.
 
In this mode, you’ll compete in a series of tournaments, trying to outscore bots and earn the title of champion. The tournament spans across five leagues, each offering different levels of difficulty, starting with the hardest—League 1—and ending with the easiest—League 5. In each league, you’ll face three bots, and your skill in using resources and strategic decisions will determine if you rise to the top.
 
How the Tournament Works:
 
Each tournament lasts five weeks, with two matches per week: one between you and a bot, and another between two bots. The results of these matches determine how many goals you score for that week.
 
A unique aspect of the tournament is that winning a match doesn’t directly benefit you—only the number of goals matters, as they affect your overall position in the tournament. At the end of the season, based on your performance, you’ll either be promoted to a higher league, stay in the current one, or be relegated to a lower league.
 
Promotion and Relegation:
 
If you score more goals than the bots, you’ll become the league champion and move up to a tougher league. If you’re already in League 1 and win, you’ll earn the title of RRR Ball Grand Champion! If your score is lower, you’ll be relegated to an easier league. After this, a new season begins, and you can start competing again with a clean slate.

[previewyoutube=5zlu2PryzKY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Why Choose Rolling Realms Redux?[/b][/h3]
 
This game is perfect for strategy lovers, where every action can dramatically change the course of the game.
 
Whether you’re playing solo, with friends, or taking part in unique tournaments, Rolling Realms Redux offers a versatile experience that will remain engaging for a long time!

notes.title: Guilds of Adviria: A contest of courage, glory, and adventure awaits!
notes.notes:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/304/e7bypgx85pxjtd9bucwjy4.png[/img]
[h3][b]In the mythical land of Adviria, a thrilling challenge awaits.[/b][/h3]

Once united, powerful guilds now find themselves in friendly rivalry, each striving to prove their dominance by producing the greatest heroes.

In this world ruled by courage, strategy, and adventure, the ultimate test of strength and wit is about to begin. Only one guild will emerge victorious, claiming the revered title of the greatest in the realm.

[h3][b]Prepare for Adventure![/b][/h3]

The excitement begins as 26 mysterious adventure tiles are placed face down, waiting to be discovered.

The grand game board is set, and the guilds take their positions, ready to face the challenges ahead.

Legendary heroes, shuffled into the deck, will soon be revealed, but their identities remain secret until the crucial moment.

Each guild leader, represented by a pawn, stands ready to guide their adventurers to glory.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/304/prxfrkxbpvvxav3rzfjta0.png[/img]
[b][h3]Modesty marks the start of each guild’s journey. [/h3][/b]
With three cards and tokens, they begin their quest.

Dice—the instruments of fate—are poised to determine each player’s path. But who will make the first bold move?

The honor belongs to the last adventurer to spot a dragon in the skies—or, failing that, the youngest among them takes the lead!

With cards in hand and anticipation in the air, the adventure begins, opening the door to new strategies and endless possibilities.

As the players embark on their quests, courage is important, but often, cleverness leads to true victory.

If the deck of cards runs out, there’s no need to fear—the cards are reshuffled, allowing the adventure to continue until the Grand Finale arrives, signaling the last draw.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/304/ilmn7hxxrnshw5h3ve7wq0.png[/img]
[h3][b]Heroes, Warriors, and Unstoppable Adventurers[/b][/h3]

On your turn, roll the dice and advance your pawn six spaces. Every quest tile you reveal brings you closer to glory.

If you hold the right quest card, you can complete the quest, raising your guild's standing. Will it lead to treasure—or danger?

For those who favor strength over subtlety, the warriors of Adviria are your path to riches.

They can recover lost quest tiles and reclaim precious gold, proving that brute force can rival magic in this enchanted land.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/304/ijxzxmysejzo8iyba6nkbg.png[/img]
[b][h3]Masters of Magic: Wizards and Jesters[/h3][/b]
Wizards in Adviria wield incredible power. Each time a wizard is played, your card limit increases, offering new opportunities for powerful strategies. But such magic comes at a cost: every spell demands one gold.

As the game progresses, wizards grow even more critical, unlocking paths when others find themselves trapped by circumstance.

And then there’s the Joker, the wildest card of all

This versatile adventurer can take on any role—warrior, wizard, fairy, or adventurer. Used wisely, the Joker can be the difference between victory and defeat, bending the rules of fate in your favor.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/304/obanym6semfikhpqh1onq5.png[/img]
[b][h3]Rivalry and Risk: Unfriendly Moves[/h3][/b]
As the tension builds, so does the rivalry.

Find yourself next to another player’s pawn, and you can make an unfriendly move—steal cards or send them back to the guild base. These bold, daring moves can change the course of the game in an instant, keeping everyone on their toes.

[b]Grand Finale: The Battle for Glory[/b]

As the deck of cards thins, the Grand Finale begins.

The flow of new cards stops, and only the savviest players can continue, sacrificing wizards to stay in the game. Each move becomes more critical, and every decision could determine the fate of your guild. The race for victory has begun.

[b]The Final Battle[/b]

When the adventure concludes, it’s time to count your spoils.

The guild with the most gold and completed quests claims victory, their heroes immortalized in legend.

But beware—the final reveal of a hidden hero can turn the tides, allowing an underdog to surge to the top in a dramatic twist!

Whether you play solo or with friends, the adventure is no less epic.

Even without direct competition, each quest is a thrilling test of skill, wit, and determination.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/304/eprinkeds2f6dpyihvlkd3.png[/img]
[b][h3]The glory of Adviria beckons![/h3][/b]
The guilds have answered the call—now it’s your turn. Will you rise to greatness and secure your place in history?

An adventure of a lifetime awaits!

[h3][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/advyria][b]Play it now on Tabletopia[/b][/url][/h3]

notes.title: Rival Restaurants: Ignite Your Culinary Ambition!

[h3][b]Welcome to [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/rival-restaurants]Rival Restaurants[/url]![/b][/h3]
 
Where the sizzling excitement of culinary competition meets the thrill of high-stakes strategy!
 
This isn’t just a board game; it’s your chance to step into the spotlight and transform your culinary dreams into a reality. In this electrifying showdown, you’ll manage a bustling restaurant, face off against rival chefs, and navigate a dynamic culinary landscape.
 
Are you ready to rise to the challenge and turn your restaurant into the city's most coveted dining destination?

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/248/pvtvupcei0p8awyegwwli0.png[/img]
[b][h3]Objective: Claim the Title of "The Wiener"[/h3][/b]
In Rival Restaurants, your ultimate goal is to be the first to earn 20 popularity points and be crowned “The Wiener!” Achieve this by acquiring and trading ingredients to complete mouthwatering recipes. The more complex and sophisticated the recipe, the more points it’s worth. 
 
[b]Your journey unfolds across three action-packed phases each day:[/b]
 
MONEY & MOVE: Start each day by collecting your income and strategically choosing your location. Once you’ve made your choice, you’re set for the day, so select wisely. This phase sets the stage for your day’s decisions, so plan your moves with precision.
 
BUY & BARTER: With a minute on the clock, buy as many ingredients as you can from your current location and trade with other players. This phase is where your negotiation skills shine – secure the best deals and build a stockpile of essential ingredients to create winning recipes.
 
COOK & COUNTER: If you’ve gathered all the ingredients needed for your recipe, it’s time to cook and earn those valuable popularity points. After cooking, restock the counters and prepare for the next round of culinary action.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/248/wzrqgeanyd855fe30z3avd.png[/img]
[h3][b]Unleash Your Chef’s Unique Power[/b][/h3]

Every player commands a unique chef, each equipped with their own special powers.
 
These asymmetrical abilities allow you to bend the rules and gain a competitive edge.
 
With twelve distinct chefs to choose from, you’ll find strategies and tactics that fit your playstyle. At the start of the game, select from a variety of restaurants, each offering a unique progression path with special rewards for reaching popularity milestones of 3, 7, and 12 points.
 
Enhance your strategy further by acquiring action cards – powerful, one-time-use cards that can turn the tide of the game.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/248/efddxemo8qfugbhwinxc82.png[/img]
[b][h3]Why Rival Restaurants Will Keep You Coming Back for More:[/h3][/b]
Thrilling Real-Time Competition: Experience the excitement of fast-paced gameplay where every decision matters. The game unfolds over three dynamic phases each day, providing constant opportunities and challenges. Each playthrough is unique, ensuring that you’re always engaged and ready for the next round.
 

Diverse Restaurant Themes: Dive into a rich variety of restaurant themes, each offering distinct strategic advantages and gameplay elements. Whether you’re running a high-end fine-dining venue or a bustling street food market, each theme presents its own set of rewards and challenges. Choose wisely and tailor your strategy to fit your theme, ensuring that no two games are ever the same.
 

Engaging Head-to-Head Battles: Immerse yourself in the heart of culinary competition. Use powerful action cards and create inventive recipes to outmaneuver your rivals. Every card and recipe plays a crucial role in your strategy, making each decision and action critical to your success.
 

Strategic Depth: Winning in Rival Restaurants requires more than just culinary skills. It demands astute strategic thinking and effective management. Balance your budget, optimize your menu, and navigate the competitive landscape to build a restaurant that stands out from the rest.
 

Unforgettable Culinary Experience: Rival Restaurants offers an immersive culinary adventure filled with memorable moments and intense competition. Experience the thrill of managing your own restaurant, competing with other chefs, and serving dishes that captivate and delight your customers. Every game session promises strategic depth and excitement.
 

Dynamic Challenges: Face a series of dynamic challenges as you progress through the game. Unexpected events, evolving customer demands, and rival strategies will test your skills and adaptability. Each challenge adds complexity to the game, making your quest for culinary supremacy even more engaging and rewarding.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/248/gqmyv5h4bdibrpkfjo3zs2.png[/img]
[b][h3]Endless Variety for Unmatched Replayability[/h3][/b]
Rival Restaurants offers unparalleled replayability with up to 12 unique chefs, 8 diverse restaurant themes, and 48 different recipes.
 
No two games are ever alike, ensuring that you’ll always have a fresh and exciting experience. The innovative “all together” mechanism keeps everyone engaged, eliminating wait times and enhancing the game’s strategic depth. Easy to learn but challenging to master, Rival Restaurants caters to both seasoned gamers and newcomers alike.
 
Get ready for non-stop fun as your friends will undoubtedly want to play again and again.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/248/jzbes6gtngdz09ajncztdc.png[/img]
[h3][b]Meet the Chefs Who Make Rival Restaurants Sizzle![/b][/h3]
 
In Rival Restaurants, chefs have a variety of unique abilities that add strategic depth to the game.
 
These abilities can include ejecting other players from their location, increasing the cost of purchases for others, substituting one ingredient for another with bonuses, replacing meat ingredients with vegetables, and forcing other chefs to switch locations for a fee. Other abilities might involve blocking counters for other players, transferring garbage items to others, receiving free ingredients with purchases, buying action cards without visiting special locations, and making other chefs pay money at the end of a phase.
 
Each ability impacts the game, creating unique tactical opportunities and diverse gameplay scenarios.

Elevate your gameplay with the exhilarating Kitchen Squad Mode in Rival Restaurants!
 
This innovative 2-player variant introduces a new level of strategy and excitement. In this mode, you will oversee the operations of three chefs while working alongside an NPC (non-player chef) who acts as a semi-ally. The addition of the NPC not only adds a new layer of strategic depth but also provides opportunities to disrupt your opponent's plans and access additional markets.
 
This dynamic gameplay ensures that every decision you make is crucial and impactful, transforming each game session into a thrilling culinary showdown.

[h2][b]Have you ever wanted to express your feelings in a way that words alone can't capture? [/b][/h2]
 
Music has a magical power to touch the soul, and with [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mix-tape]Mix Tape[/url], you can harness that power to win the heart of someone special. This isn't just a game—it's your chance to become a musical genius, crafting the ultimate playlist that resonates with every emotion you want to convey.
 
In Mix Tape, you're not just a player; you're a music producer on a mission.
 
[h3][b]Your goal:[/b][/h3]
 
To record the perfect set of songs on both sides of a cassette tape that speaks directly to your crush's heart.
 
This game combines the nostalgic charm of creating mixtapes with the thrill of strategic gameplay. Every decision you make matters, from the songs you choose to the way you mix and match different moods and genres.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/233/jslyqwtuiuh4zbv06wcwfb.png[/img]

[h2][b]How does it work?[/b][/h2]
 
Each turn, you'll take one of several actions: draw new songs from the radio, record a song onto your tape, or adjust your mixer's settings to fine-tune your sound.
 
But that's not all—every song you choose has unique attributes that can help you score points in different ways. Some songs are perfect for writing heartfelt love notes, while others will help you create harmony with the previous tracks, amplifying your overall score.
 
[h3][b]But there’s more![/b][/h3]
 
Your mixtape isn't just about the songs. You'll also have a Mixer Board at your disposal, allowing you to tweak the Volume, Bass, Mid, and Treble levels.
 
These adjustments aren’t just for show—they can give you the edge in scoring by improving how your songs fit together. As you move sliders up, you'll unlock bonuses, like drawing more cards or recording songs with fewer resources.
 
The better you fine-tune your tape, the higher your score at the end of the game.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/234/j1gdygb2asygcwviwelem7.png[/img]

[h3][b]As if that weren't enough, each player is given a Crush Card at the beginning of the game.[/b][/h3]
 
This card represents your crush's preferences—whether they love rock ballads, smooth jazz, or energetic pop hits. Recording songs that align with your crush's taste will earn you bonus points, especially if you can pair them with songs they love to hear back-to-back.
 
And don’t forget to write those love notes! The more notes you write, the more points you’ll rack up, making your mixtape an unforgettable gesture.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/234/q9yk9ejeujge81pbgpama0.png[/img]

Imagine the satisfaction of seeing your carefully curated mixtape come together, track by track, knowing that each choice you make brings you closer to winning the game—and maybe even winning someone's heart.

Whether you’re racing against rivals to claim victory or banding together to vanquish fearsome foes, every choice you make will shape your destiny.

[u][b]Your Mission: Save the Teensies, Conquer the Board[/b][/u]

The heart of the adventure is simple yet pulse-pounding: be the first to rescue three Teensies and complete a full lap of the board. In competitive mode, it’s every hero for themselves – only the quickest and most cunning will emerge triumphant.

But in cooperative or solo mode, the stakes soar even higher. You and your allies must unite to save the Teensies, all while dodging destruction and defeating a formidable Boss before time runs out. Victory demands not only speed, but also a keen understanding of the game’s intricate mechanics and a commitment to teamwork.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/209/efnhjry5pl6xgh108aq6i5.png[/img]

[u][b]Forge Your Path to Glory[/b][/u]

Every move counts as you navigate the treacherous landscape of the Glade of Dreams. Strategic card choices will dictate your actions – whether it’s moving, jumping, sliding, or striking. Will you take the leap of faith or play it safe? The choice is yours!

As you journey across the board, you’ll encounter obstacles, face off against enemies, and seize every opportunity to outmaneuver your opponents. And in the spirit of fair play, the game keeps the competition fierce by granting extra move actions to the player furthest behind, ensuring every race is a nail-biting thrill.

[u][b]Beware the Hazards![/b][/u]

As the adventure unfolds, the board becomes ever more perilous. Your actions could spell disaster or lead to unforeseen consequences. And just when you think you’ve mastered the game, new layers of difficulty will challenge your skills and strategy.

Need a moment to catch your breath? The Bubble action allows you to gain temporary immunity, but it’s a risky move – will you dare to take it?

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/209/cecdaj0uocgvrwr7cieo72.png[/img]

[u][b]Unleash the Heroes Within![/b][/u]

The true excitement of Rayman The Board Game lies in its rich variety of actions and strategies. From the moment you choose your hero, you’re drawn into an epic adventure brimming with daring leaps, graceful slides, and powerful strikes. Every action card in your hand is a key to your success, offering unique ways to navigate the board and outsmart your opponents.

Use your skills to dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and pull off complex maneuvers that will leave everyone else in awe. Each turn is a new opportunity to showcase your heroism and inch closer to victory.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/209/wuzpk53m5h2tfyu1sujce3.png[/img]

[u][b]Race to Save the Teensies[/b][/u]

As you dash through the lush landscapes of the Glade of Dreams, your mission remains clear: save the Teensies! These tiny, yet mighty creatures are scattered across the field, waiting for a hero to free them. To rescue them, you’ll need the Slap action – a versatile move that can also be used to strike at enemies or disrupt other players.

But beware, other heroes are vying for the same Teensies, and only one can claim the prize! In cooperative and solo modes, Bosses appear as powerful adversaries that require teamwork and strategy to defeat. These titanic foes roam the board, creating new challenges and unleashing special attacks on players. If even one hero falls during the battle with a Boss, the entire team loses – and the forces of evil claim victory. The pressure is on as you and your team race to save the Teensies and emerge triumphant.

[b][img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/209/smhybaamg5uyagmwl6ty52.png[/img][/b]

[u][b]Craft Your Own Adventure[/b][/u]

One of the most thrilling aspects of Rayman The Board Game is its endless adaptability. The game’s modular design lets you mix and match board tiles, creating unique environments and challenges for every playthrough.

[u][b]Looking for an even greater challenge? [/b][/u]

Add more hazards, face stronger Bosses, or limit the number of Teensies you need to save.

The possibilities are limitless, ensuring that no two games are ever the same. Whether you’re a seasoned Rayman fan or new to the Glade of Dreams, you’ll find countless ways to tailor the adventure to your liking.

[previewyoutube=v40oyzoY_LE;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Become a Legend in the Glade of Dreams![/b][/u]

Now is your moment to become a legend.

In Rayman The Board Game, every race is a heart-pounding adventure filled with unexpected twists and turns. With deep strategic gameplay, engaging mechanics, and endless customization, this game promises hours of fun for players of all ages.

So gather your friends, choose your heroes, and prepare to race, battle, and save the day in the magical world of the Glade of Dreams.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/209/q3bcklzz7yzgrybcznwwu0.png[/img]

[u][b]Are you ready to rise to the challenge?[/b][/u]

[b]The Teensies are counting on you – don’t let them down![/b]

notes.title: Dive into the mesmerizing world of classical music with Luthier!
notes.notes:
[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/luthier-the-art-of-the-instrument]Luthier[/url] invites you to enter the enchanting world of classical music, a realm where instrumental craftsmanship comes alive through the dedication of master craftsmen.
 
Imagine a time in Western Europe when music soared to unprecedented heights. This golden age was defined by the craftsmanship behind the instruments we value today. It wasn’t just about melodies; it was about the harmonious collaboration between craftsmen who meticulously carved and created everything from elegant violins to majestic pianos.
 
The influence of great composers like Bach, Mozart and Beethoven is reflected in every note played. Imagine the passion and precision with which these masterpieces were brought to life, every string and key a testament to the eternal spirit of creativity. They created emotions that transcended time and space, giving us a legacy that continues to captivate hearts around the world.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/146/sfzakevgfnjtkaybwmr2q0.png[/img]
 
Join us on this journey through history, celebrating the intersection of craftsmanship, creativity, and music that defines the very essence of classical heritage.
 
As a family of artisans, you’re on a thrilling quest to earn prestige through your extraordinary craftsmanship. Create stunning instruments that captivate the audience, deliver exhilarating performances that leave them breathless, and master the art of repairs to keep those instruments in perfect harmony.
 
Your patrons adore your work and reward your dedication generously, but tread carefully! Their patience is not infinite. If you falter in meeting their expectations, you risk losing their loyalty. A fallen patron can tarnish the hard-earned reputation of your family and erase the glory you've built.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/146/lyfdlzdjvaxqfst2n3czdo.png[/img]
 
Embrace the challenge! Engage with your community, showcase your unique talents, and nurture those crucial relationships. Your journey isn't just about crafting; it’s about thriving in a world where artistry and accountability go hand in hand. Will you rise to the occasion and secure your family’s legacy, or will you let it slip away, unseen and unappreciated? The choice is yours, and every decision counts!
 
Experience a unique combination of hidden crafts and worker recruitment mechanics! Manage resources to create a variety of tools, attracting real historical patrons. Balance skill development along different paths, unlocking specialized abilities and bonuses. Expand your family, gather materials, and improve your craft at the workbench, competing with rival families for prestigious places in the orchestra!
 
With a unique blend of hidden trades and worker placement mechanics, you'll manage resources to create a variety of musical instruments while engaging real historical patrons. Choose how to balance skill development across different tracks, unlocking specialized abilities and bonuses.
 
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/146/rg2aghyqmhzsaxutqyjpbe.png[/img]

Throughout the game, your family will expand and attract new patrons, acquire plans for breathtaking instruments, gather materials, and perfect your craft at the workbench. Compete with rival families for the prestigious First Chairs in the Orchestra!
 
Focus on strategies like musical performance, crafting, repairing, or training students – every decision shapes your path and opens up multiple paths to victory.
 
Play solo or with friends! Single-player mode features a smart AI opponent that simulates real players, allowing you to enjoy the full experience solo or add it to your two-player games for an extra challenge.
 
Discover harmony in a delightful fusion of theme and mechanics, perfect for strategy players and classical music lovers alike. So grab your chisel and join the apprentice to hone your skills on Tabletopia!

notes.title: Bring hyper-intelligent bees to outer space!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/78f3248f525d7f8c4aef4fa8b89bd13204488a53.png[/img]

Welcome the newest game by Stonemaier Games on Tabletopia! Apiary is set in a far-distant future when humans no longer inhabit Earth. The cause of their disappearance (or perhaps their demise) is unknown, but their absence left a void ready to be filled by another sentient species.

Over the span of untold generations, one species of the humble honeybee evolved to fill that void. They grew in size and intelligence to become a highly advanced society. They call themselves Mellifera, and they have made substantial technological advances in addition to the technology they adapted from human ruins, up to and including space travel.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/012/060/oifjvxwyg4jcbgqvkqvro6.png?width=3200&height=1800&auto_optimize=low[/img]

In the game, each player controls one of twenty unique factions. Your faction starts the game with a hive, a few resources, and worker bees. A worker-placement, hive-building challenge awaits you: explore planets, gather resources, develop technologies, and create carvings to demonstrate your faction's strengths (measured in victory points) over one year's Flow. However, the Dearth quickly approaches, and your workers can take only a few actions before they must hibernate! Can you thrive or merely survive?

notes.title: Leave your rivals behind in the Great Dino Rush!
notes.notes:
The Bone Wars, also known as the Great Dinosaur Rush, was a period of intense and ruthless competitive fossil hunting between two American paleontologists: Edward Drinker Cope and Othniel Charles Marsh.

During this time, which started in 1897, both men used every method available to outdo each other in the field. Teams were bribed, bones were stolen and dig sites are even damaged and destroyed. They also sought to damage their rival's reputation by attacking them in scientific publications.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/b66cc1bfd0cd563ebc383e7f8b8bbdca24fc13c5.jpg[/img]

In Bone Wars, the newest title by Game Brewer, players take on the role of a palaeontologist in the late 1800s. During this time, a bitter rivalry was waged between Othniel Marsh and Edward Cope, two world-renowned palaeontologists. They both tried to outdo the other in discovering new species of dinosaurs, going so far as to bribe workers, steal or even destroy bones. The players are palaeontologists working for one of these legendary men or are perhaps working on their own behalf – trying to outdo all competition.

During the game, players have to make clever use of their action cards, which they play in the slots under their player board. These action cards can either activate their team - digging up fossils and discovering new species in the field - or their paleontologist - who spend their time publishing species, debunking other players' papers and getting awards.

notes.title: Participate in the completion of Mozart's last piece
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/efc66f7e1e9daa09173a46d44d093b350cd93312.jpg[/img]

[i]Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is dead. His last conscious action on his deathbed was composing the Lacrimosa movement of his Opus Requiem. You, as one of his sponsors, will meet with the widow in order to participate one last time in the funding of the works of the Austrian genius. Also, you will reminisce and retell all your memories alongside Mozart in order to make sure that she portrays you under the best light when writing her memoirs in order to enter history as Mozart's most important patron.[/i]

[previewyoutube=wIyArNj03Tg;full][/previewyoutube]
In [i][b]Lacrimosa[/b][/i], players take the roles of patrons of the late musician, contributing with their fundings to the composer's works one last time. During the game, you play in two different timelines: the present and the past. In the present, you commission the missing parts of the Requiem from other composers in order to complete it. When developing past events, the game takes place in five epochs in which you contribute by buying new compositions from the composer to sell or exhibit, accompany him on the different journeys through the main courts and theaters in Europe, and gather the resources you need in order to support the musician during his career.

[previewyoutube=CEH2pZM8PUA;full][/previewyoutube]
During the game, you play cards from a limited hand that you will improve as the game progresses. These cards can be played either as actions or as resource generators, and players need to optimize their resources and finances in order to support their best version of the story and their relationship with Mozart.

notes.title: Restore life to Animal Kingdom
notes.notes:
Preserve the wilds of Africa! Serengeti Sanctuary is a game for two to four players aged 7+ which takes 30 to 60 minutes to play. The game has a wildlife conservation theme, and features beautifully designed cards with wild animals from the Serengeti and a range of African terrain settings. The players seek to expand their wildlife reserves as successfully as possible. The game is live on Gamefound now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/815b6094ccc0866038610a966dcdc34a2540bdcb.png[/img]

Each turn the players draft cards from the play area following simple rules. They also have park staff members who give extra drafting abilities. The aim is to build sets of animals and therefore accumulate a growing score. Once the drafting is completed, players take turns to choose how many of their cards to play. The score they achieve is added to the victory track, and the points gained that turn are also used to enhance their staff team and gain sanctuary tokens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/73e7af0907544dcb5b1905ae9514446a498fee19.jpg[/img]

As the sun rises over the vast and untamed wilderness, you gather with a group of chieftains from different tribes at the ceremonial gaming area. You take your place, ready to prove yourself and build the most prestigious Chiefdom.

[previewyoutube=yve6dZqY8zs;full][/previewyoutube]
In [i][b]Chiefdom[/b][/i], you are tasked with building up your own Chiefdom from scratch. The game begins with an empty plan, and it's up to you to carefully choose what icons to draw and how to draw them based on the dice rolled on each turn.

With a roll of the dice, the game begins. You choose your actions simultaneously with the other players, using the values rolled to determine what icons you will draw and how to place them. Will you draw a lake or a forest? Will you give your people jobs such as fishing, woodcutting, or building? Every decision must be carefully thought out to ensure a balanced Chiefdom that can provide for its people.

[previewyoutube=1UHUd00JOB8;full][/previewyoutube]
But the competition is not just about building a functional Chiefdom. As chieftains from different tribes, you are vying for prestige and recognition. You want to create the most impressive Chiefdom, one that will be remembered for generations to come. As you work to build up your Chiefdom, you must also ensure that your people are fed, sheltered, and employed.

As the game progresses, tensions rise, and you must remain focused to outmaneuver your opponents. Will you take risks to try and secure victory, or will you play it safe and ensure a steady rise to the top? notes.title: Win the favor of the Gods in this epic auction, area-control game
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/bf836abda33bfcb41aa992ca5d254d00223d74db.jpg[/img]

In the Cyclades archipelago, off the shores of a divided Greece, players develop their cities and compete for supremacy under the watchful gaze of the gods.

[previewyoutube=Ur-ZmUgfNxE;full][/previewyoutube]
In [i][b]Cyclades: Legendary Edition[/b][/i], designers Bruno Cathala and Ludovic Maublanc have reworked the Cyclades base game and its many expansions to make gameplay more dynamic and fluid.

[previewyoutube=nCRkwW66Jlw;full][/previewyoutube]
The game features a strategic bidding system that defines the actions available to each player on their turn. You must balance your finances to optimize the various actions provided by the different gods, with each player gaining the support of only one god each turn. The game features a shorter and more dynamic bidding phase than the original Cyclades thanks to a new exponential bidding scale. Six gods are available instead of the five, increasing the variety of actions available:
[list]
[*] Ares allows the movement of player armies and the building of fortresses.
[*] Poseidon allows players to move their navies and build ports.
[*] Zeus allows his followers to hire priests and build temples.
[*] Athena provides her worshipers with philosophers and universities.
[*] Apollo increases the income of his worshipers.
[*] Hera provides mercenaries to enforce your troops during battle.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/ec5b1b2017b7a676456b3208c00a7753fdf52ff4.jpg[/img]

Players now use landscape tiles to assemble the modular game board during set-up, allowing for ever-changing maps and game strategies. New creatures and heroes are available in the base game, offering new strategic opportunities to build metropolises and gain decisive advantages on the battlefield. Your goal is to be the first to control three metropolises, which can be obtained as follows:
[list]
[*] Economic development, by constructing four different buildings.
[*] Intellectual development, by owning four philosophers.
[*] Heroic deeds, when sacrificing a hero.
[*] Military conquest, when seizing an enemy city by strength.

notes.title: A team of Seekers work together to fight back the Darkness
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/0eb7309d1d875e9ca63e6772a243f7c5ff3c5ace.jpg[/img]

In [i][b]Kinfire Chronicles: Night's Fall[/b][/i], a 1-4 player co-operative, quest-based RPG board game, players take on the role of seekers, adventurers who are fighting to push back the darkness threatening to change and destroy the world of Atios. The game plays as a campaign of 15+ quests, and each quest takes an average of 45-60 minutes to complete. Within each quest, players can expect to make choices related to adventures, battles, NPCs to speak to, and more. These choices create a branching story in the game, allowing the entire campaign to be replayable.

[previewyoutube=H-LnI4yscX4;full][/previewyoutube]
Each quest has three phases: adventuring, battle, and exploration. In the adventuring phase, players make choices based on options presented on the quest cards and need to accomplish something (such as crossing a river or chasing down a suspect) by flipping the correct number and color of cards from their decks. In the battle phase, players work together to defeat enemies on a physical battle map. Turns are determined by drawing chits out of the destiny bag, with each enemy having numbered tokens that correspond with different attacks and actions. Players may play action cards on their own turns to do damage and can play boost cards on other players' turns to do things like reduce damage, move players, or even return a drawn chit to the destiny bag for redraw. The game doesn't end if an objective isn't achieved or an enemy defeats the heroes, but it will affect later gameplay and choice options. Lastly, on certain quests players can return to the city in the exploration phase to speak to NPCs, purchase items, and level up their decks.

[previewyoutube=obIIkhd8Nms;full][/previewyoutube]
Woven throughout each of these phases are cards that require you to make a choice, such as resting before moving on or charging into battle, or whether or not to spare someone's life. The characters in the game have their own set of morals and standards, and playing according to your character can earn you Kinfire tokens that help you level up. Ultimately though, the decisions you make are yours alone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/12a3f285911d2be81451f6ff0b7036d4d2787a5b.jpg[/img]

• Explore Biomes. Choose your path wisely within a sprawling, ever-changing castle! Will you upgrade one of the character powers with a scroll? Or will you choose a chest to equip a new weapon? Will you find the hidden runes that will open new paths and access new biomes? This won’t be a walk in the park, though. Because the island is infested with the abominations born from the Malaise, be ready to…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/f506cf84d4b96fe54ea1a29eaecdbc039d172dd6.jpg[/img]

• Kill Enemies. Each character class has unique power sets and a deck of action cards. For each enemy encounter, you will only need to pick one action card to cover all three phases of a fight. Loot equipment, gold, scrolls, and Cells from the corpses of your enemies and get stronger, but beware... Your health pool is limited and sooner or later you will...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/9053310d5aeb6b2c4f977c7c8e443dccbd100f25.jpg[/img]

• Die. Wandering through enemy-infested dungeons isn't the safest activity, even for your beheaded heroes. There will eventually be one monster too many, or you could step on a fatal trap and lose all your scrolls, equipment, and accumulated gold. But this is far from the end for you! Even in death you will be able to keep your precious Cells to…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/6565f5b126a55caeb281808931521ac31ff0487d.jpg[/img]

• Mutate. The Collector will let you spend your Cells to buy permanent mutations that will give you more power... forever! Choose cards to buy from three different decks: Brutality, Survival, or Tactics. Get action cards to enhance your card deck. Find blueprints to grow your loot deck. Increase your health pool. Unlock additional item slots, and much more… Unless you prefer to throw your Cells into this mysterious well... It seems like a pretty stupid thing to do with your hard-earned Cells, but hey, you do you, bud... Death is no excuse to take a nap, so...

[previewyoutube=DxI0yLXjo4Q;full][/previewyoutube]
• Repeat. Death is not the end either! You’ve already lost your head, remember!? As the day starts again in a new loop, use your new permanent mutations to exact revenge on whatever killed you last time. Go further and deeper into the island and kill the bosses to access new starting biomes. Previously-played biomes keep changing as stronger monstrosities spawn in them, along with powerful new items. But large families are only half the battle: to score a lot of points, they also need access to watering holes and must avoid bad weather.

Are you a fan of classic board games, but find it difficult to get your hands on them? Have you ever wanted to see rare and out-of-print games from gaming history, but can't visit a physical museum? Then Tabletopia has some exciting news for you!

We're thrilled to announce our upcoming project, the Board Game Museum. This digital museum will showcase the biggest and greatest retro games and out-of-print classics in gaming history, all in one convenient location. These classic games will be available for a new digital audience through our best-in-class Unity 3D, in-the-browser application.

We want to make sure the Board Game Museum features the games that you, the players, want to see. That's why we're asking for your input! We've created a short survey with just four questions to help us determine what you'd like to see in this project!

So whether you're a die-hard board game enthusiast or just curious about gaming history, we want to hear from you! Take the survey and share it with your friends and fellow gamers to help us create the ultimate digital archive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/128472b510ae254bbae41e94ca9085eba4c8f4fc.jpg[/img][i]We want to hear what you want to see![/i]

To give you an idea of the games our users have suggested, we received a wide range of responses to our end-of-year survey. Some of the most popular classic games mentioned include [i]Grand Austria Hotel, Warhammer Quest: The Adventure Card Game, Glory to Rome, Stone Garden, Hive, Monopoly, Guild Ball[/i], and [i]Magic Realm[/i]. We also received requests for older and harder-to-find games such as [i]Dozo, Snapshot[/i], and [i]Stellar Conquest[/i].

Thank you for your participation, and we can't wait to share the Board Game Museum with you soon! Stay tuned for updates on our release date and more information about the exciting games that will be featured in the museum.

notes.title: Based on Scandinavian troll legend, steal princesses and other nonsense!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/a164ca04259ab9a69d1f8b426f5aa09e38bad91c.jpg[/img]

[i]Trolls are not big and stupid, as many would have you believe. Not long ago they lived among us and they used their cunning magic to look like us humans. They lived with their cattle in the mountains. Their caves were beautiful and luxurious with a lot of silver, gold, gems, and a table full of delicious food. In Sweden, there is an expression for this “Rich as a troll”.

Trolls were not evil if you didn’t treat them badly, they could even be helpful to those who treated them well. But they often played tricks on humans. Their magic power (trollkraft) could distort the vision of humans so the troll looked like a human, an animal, a log, and a stone and even become invisible. But they also had some weaknesses. They couldn’t stand the sounds of church bells or steel, not to mention the sight of sun.[/i]

[previewyoutube=_v3XwIicivA;full][/previewyoutube]
[i][b]Trolls & Princesses[/b][/i] is a “worker movement” game. You play as one of four troll clans and to get the mountains king’s favour, you try to impress him.

[previewyoutube=zJQts2lU36E;full][/previewyoutube]
The players get favour (in the form of victory points) when they do what trolls usually do: swap changelings, “hire” humans, tear down church bells, kidnap princesses, build their cave, and use troll magic. To succeed, the players must collect resources and move around their trolls to do different actions. [i][b]Arcana Rising[/b][/i] invites up to six spellcasters to participate in a competition to acquire arcane artifacts and cast mighty spells in an effort to gain knowledge and power. As they gather their mystical relics, they note the passing of the moons, which amplify the power of certain schools of magic, allowing wizards to cast spells at the peak of their power!

[previewyoutube=tjsMwNJWbps;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Arcana Rising[/i] is a drafting and engine-building game in which players compete over three rounds to craft a magical engine that will power their collected artifacts and generate points for them at the end of the game.

On a turn, players select a single card from the pile they are passed. Once a card has been selected, players pass the remaining cards clockwise, then choose whether to add the newly acquired card to their tableau OR to discard the card in order to run their engine and cast their spells. Randomized moon tokens tell players which of their spells may be cast. Therefore, the timing of executing your powers is nearly as important as the powers themselves.

The cards fall into schools of Charms, Herbology, Blood Arts, Potions, Alchemy, and Artifacts. Only a single type of spell can be cast each turn, depending on a randomized order for that round.

[previewyoutube=9nGxx2ofi8g;full][/previewyoutube]
After three rounds of drafting, players calculate their scores based on the unique set of artifacts they have collected, and the player with the most victory points wins!

Designed by Stan Kordonskiy ([i][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dice-hospital]Dice Hospital[/url], [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/rurik]Rurik[/url], [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/lockup-a-roll-player-tale]Lock Up[/url][/i]), developed by Jonny Pac ([i]Coloma, Sierra West, Lions of Lydia[/i]), solo mode by Drake Villareal ([i]Solani, Spook Manor[/i]), and illustrated by The Mico ([i][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/raiders-of-the-north-sea]Raiders of the North Sea[/url], [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/paladins-of-the-west-kingdom]Paladins of the West Kingdom[/url], [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/villages-of-valeria]Villages of Valeria[/url][/i]), [i][b]Endless Winter: Paleoamericans[/b][/i] takes place in North America, around 10,000 BCE. Players guide the development of their tribes across several generations—from nomadic hunter-gatherers to prosperous tribal societies. Over the course of the game, tribes migrate and settle new lands, establish cultural traditions, hunt paleolithic megafauna, and build everlasting megalithic structures.

[previewyoutube=YhK8tIfyVwI;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Endless Winter[/i] is a euro-style game that combines worker placement and deck building in an innovative way. Each round, players send their tribe members to various action spaces, and pay for the actions by playing cards and spending resources. Tribe cards grant additional labor, while Culture cards provide a variety of unique effects. As an alternative, cards can be saved for an end-of-round Eclipse phase, where they are simultaneously revealed to determine the new player order, and trigger various bonus actions.

[previewyoutube=QnN7BVyJRhI;full][/previewyoutube]
The game features a novel blend of interwoven systems and mechanisms, such as multi-use cards, area influence, tile placement, and set collection. Plus, there are many viable paths to victory. After four brisk rounds, scores are tallied, and the tribe with the most points wins!

notes.title: A Yahtzee-like dice game where the dog always wins!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/c823745a1b81847d7a853538e4802e4d857c75d0.jpg[/img]

[i][b]Lucky Dog[/b][/i] is a dice game where the dog always wins. There are two ways to play: A free-for-all 2-4 player version, and a 2-player cooperative version.

In the free-for-all version players take turns revealing 5 cards with parameters (such as 3 of a kind, 3 in a row, two pair, etc.) The player rolls 5 six sided dice and then may discard and reveal one new card. The player then gets an opportunity to reroll any of the dice up to twice, trying to fulfill the parameters of as many of the cards as possible. When they are done re-rolling, they take and score any of the revealed cards that the dice fulfill the parameters for. Players take turns in this manner until a player reaches 20 points, then the player with the most points at the end of the round wins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/7ae158f56e34b245ef37f1aeebc4bb8450eaddb6.jpg[/img]

In the 2 player cooperative version, each player will have 2 hidden cards in their hand. The player who's turn it is rolls all five dice and choose to 'keep' any of the dice, but must choose at least one. The second player takes and rolls any of the un-kept dice, then they can keep any of the dice, but must keep at least one. Players roll dice back and forth like this until all dice are kept. As soon as that happens, both players can score any cards in their hand that the dice meet the parameters for. If the players collectively score at least one card, they may keep playing by drawing up to two cards and starting a new round. If they can't score a card, it's game over with a total score equal to all the cards scored. [i]-Description from [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/352681/lucky-dog]BGG[/url][/i]

notes.title: Axis or Allies vie for control of the Mediterranean
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/fae390283a515f863ae1e32f49343e0ef759a08a.jpg[/img]

November… 1942. World War 2 ravages the globe in a bloody conflict for the very soul of humankind. Across the war-torn regions of the Mediterranean, the Axis powers of Germany and Italy control much of the theatre. But the mighty nations of the United States and Great Britain are on the move, launching a massive offensive —code-named Operation Torch.

[previewyoutube=yNsvxHUFAgM;full][/previewyoutube]
But where will the secret Allied fleet choose to land its assault? Will they reclaim air superiority, control the sea, and gain a foothold in the underbelly of Axis-held Europe, or will Axis forces repel the Allies back in a storm of blood and fire?

[previewyoutube=XkMBFR1F0Dw;full][/previewyoutube]
[i][b]Song for War: Mediterranean Theater[/b][/i] is a tabletop strategy game based in the contested regions of southern Europe, north Africa, and the Mediterranean Sea during World War 2. Representing one of four nations, players must work together as the Allies (US or Great Britain) or Axis (Germany or Italy). Players have the option to set strategy, move units, attack and defend as individual nations or simultaneously as the Allied or Axis team. Innovative mechanics allow players to deploy their land, sea, and air units strategically as combined forces, with faster units moving first and more often, followed by heavy units with stronger firepower. Take strategic objectives, control shipping lanes and resupply, deploy new technologies and units, and recreate historical events to defeat the enemy and win the day.

notes.title: 3 expansions for the dice-rolling worker placement game
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/57e04b43c59779d1bb2ef00c31326d6b373dbd0e.jpg[/img]

[i][b]Dice Hospital: Community Care[/b][/i] is the new box with 3 expansions for the original game: [i]Dice Hospital[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/575e11773113a7bc6623a5d36b3d19f1145de441.jpg[/img]

[h3]"The City" Expansion[/h3]

The intake phase is now replaced by a set of city tiles where players use their ambulances and paramedic tokens to collect patients.
This vastly increases interactivity, as now players have a direct say over which specific dice you pick up, as well as bonuses gained by picking up unhealthy patients! But watch out, any patients left in the city who have not been tended to, neglect in value and the player(s) who picked up the healthiest patients that round gain fatality tokens, if the worst happens to the patients! This expansion also includes a helicopter miniature (used to pickup patients from anywhere in the city grid for whoever is the first player that round) in the Kickstarter edition.

[previewyoutube=ifVPwO6Rk1M;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]"The Maternity" Expansion[/h3]

This expansion includes normal sized pink mother dice and smaller pink baby dice! This expansion also increases interaction by making players compete for objective cards set by the "city" to ensure a good amount of mother and baby dice are discharged (with often other colour combinations) by the end of the game. This also includes a new spatial element to the game in which mothers only neglect when untreated and in a ward with other dice. Players also roll the birthing die to see whether they receive single or twin babies!

[previewyoutube=Yb70GDvOtMc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]"The Improvements" expansion[/h3]

This expansion allows for almost unlimited customisation! Players will be given a free-to-visit worker placement board where they can pick up room improvements specific to a colour of their choice. This expansion vastly increases the crunchiness of the game and is for players who have played the original game "wanting more".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/d21243f44a62f2716bfdd372cca692bd94145c0f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Build the most appealing routes for the laziest passengers in the world.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/ce032b2f5646b442564ab61dc7350374d907aa60.jpg[/img]

In [i][b]On the Underground: Paris/New York[/b][/i], players build the Paris Métro lines or the New York City Subway lines. Each player controls 2-4 different lines, depending on the number of players.

[previewyoutube=8TFh3yQLxWU;full][/previewyoutube]
On each turn, four destination cards are available, corresponding to stations on the map. You can take up to four actions; an action is either building track by placing one of your track tokens on the board or taking a branch token. A player may use two branch tokens to branch out of an existing line (whereas normally lines can be extended only at the endpoints). After each player's turn, a passenger token is moved along players' lines, avoiding walking as much as possible, to reach one or two destinations determined at the beginning of the turn. Destination cards corresponding to the visited stations are then replaced by new ones, then the next player takes their turn.

Players score points in two ways:

[list]
[*] By building track and connecting their lines to various types of stations, by collecting landmark tiles (in Paris), by connecting stations across water (in New York) or at the end of the game if they have achieved their secret objectives (in Paris).
[*] By having the passenger use their lines when moving.
[/list]
After all destination cards have been drawn and all players have taken the same number of turns, the game ends.

[previewyoutube=_0G3t_fa5TM;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Paris[/i] is a thoughtful map offering many options. To win, you need to strike the right balance between collecting sets of tokens, connecting secret destinations, blocking other players while not being blocked yourself, and of course carrying the passenger. Paris is the refined elder sister of the original On the Underground: London map and is recommended for experienced players.

[i]New York[/i] is a fast-paced map reflecting the hectic pace of life in the Big Apple. It encourages players to mirror real life by creating lines through Manhattan, but you have to build quickly to keep up with the always-moving passenger.
