notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/3be7688f86d100ffef6010e74e3dffe466f35326.png[/img]

Accuse and defend your fellow townsfolk as you hunt down the witches of Salem. Act fast, before conspiracy turns you against your own.

The year is 1692, and it is a perilous time to live in the town of Salem, Massachusetts. One wrong step, or one misplaced accusation, and you could be the next witch to hang. "Salem" takes players into this perilous world and lets them re-live the tension, politics, and religious extremism that still has people talking about it 300 years later.

Players can play as prominent villagers from the old Salem town, and even read their bios in the instruction manual. The servant girl Mary Warren, pastor Samuel Parris, farmer John Proctor, storyteller Tituba, and beggar Sarah Good are some of the 12 characters featured in the game.

Players, each acting as one of these unique characters, are given 3-5 Tryal cards (depending on the number of players). These Tryal cards reveal the true identity of each player, "Witch" or "Not a Witch."

[previewyoutube=zrzMhU_4m-g;full][/previewyoutube]

During gameplay, players gather cards that they use to accuse, or defend, other players. Deciding who to trust is key to survival, since you can never play a card on yourself. When you suspect someone to be a witch, you can begin accusing them with red accusation cards. When enough accusations have been placed on one of the players, the player who lays the final accusation chooses one of that player's Tryal cards to reveal. Once all "Witch" Tryal cards have been found, the villagers of Salem win.

Players can also use green and blue cards such as "Alibi", "Stocks", "Matchmaker", "Asylum", and "Scapegoat" to help or hurt their allies or enemies.

As players draw cards, they will eventually draw black cards that take immediate effect. One black card, "Night", forces all players to close their eyes while the Witches choose someone to eliminate and the Constable chooses someone to potentially save. The other black card, "Conspiracy," forces all players to take a face-down Tryal card from the player to their left. Killing witches quickly is essential, otherwise "Conspiracy" may soon have the whole town turned evil.

Before long, accusations will be flying, and screams of "She's a WITCH!" will wake the neighbours. Will you be the hero who purges your town of witches, or will you be wrongly accused and hung for witchcraft? Or perhaps you will be a witch yourself, escape conviction, and bring Salem to the ground.

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/resident-evil-3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/52e28b0511e04880091fcb85b3f64086e451a757.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Dive In!
notes.notes:
Ready to make a splash? These acquatic-themed adventures will have you exploring all the depths of undersea board gaming - from the serene beauty of the Great Barrier Reef all the way to the unknowable horrors of deep...

 
[b][h2]Sea Change[/h2][/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/b1b98754b3a645cbe540fdff381f13066ca0b81d.jpg[/img]

In this light trick-taking game, players attempt to win tricks containing cards with positive points, and avoid cards with negative points. At the end of the round, check which suit is trump. The 0 from that suit, and only that suit, is now worth 5 points. All other 0s are not worth any points.

A re-implimentation of Inside Up Games' highly successful Gorus Maximus, this one has... shall we say, more family friendly art than its predecessor. Now instead of bloody gladiatorial combatants, you'll be playing gorgeous sea creatures from your hand! New art, same innovative trick taking gameplay.

 
[h2][b]Virtual Reef Diver[/b][/h2]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/2c23ff72a0032b1df90630f3e70ca780407ab055.jpg[/img]

Dive into the beautiful Great Barrier Reef as citizen scientists on the frontline of Australia’s fight to save the largest reef on earth. Using your powers of deduction, you will identify a vast array of marine life and utilise advanced technologies to navigate your way through natural disasters and the catastrophic impacts of climate change. Join your fellow divers and lead the fight to protect and save our reef!

The information in this game is based on research being undertaken at the Queensland University of Technology. To contribute to this research, please visit virtualreef.org.au.

 
[b][h2]The Great Barrier Reef[/h2][/b]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/travelbuddygames/the-great-barrier-reef-card-game][h3]Currently on Kickstarter![/h3][/url]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/b7a770d3cb40eb5013f50e44f90c22a70ee246ad.jpg[/img]

The Great Barrier Reef Card Game is a clever card game for anyone who loves the reef, sea life, diving, or just cool games! In the game, you get to curate a portion of the reef so that it best fits the needs of the sea life that lives there. Try to great the conditions most favorable for a thriving ecosystem while discouraging the presence of invasive species.

The main gameplay consists of laying reef tiles that overlap and create the best arrangement of fish based on the current scoring conditions. It's light but with an interesting spacial challenge.


[h2][b]Oceans[/b][/h2]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/37333e5ca76ec9b97534ce470147796493d5bd6f.jpg[/img]

Oceans portrays the dynamic ecosystem that exists below the water’s surface through the specific traits of individual species and the interaction of those traits among species to determine which species survive, which thrive, and which go extinct.

This game is an interactive engine builder, where players evolve their species in a continually changing ecosystem. Players must adapt their interconnected ecosystem to survive against the inevitable march of time (Aging), as well as a multitude of predators looking for food.


[b][h2]Aquatica[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/2ae6aeea8351f94510d42c2d8f7677781cfdcf8e.jpg[/img]

Aquatica is a deep, but easy to learn family engine builder about underwater kingdoms.

In the game you will become one of the mighty ocean kings, struggling to bring glory to his realm. To win the game, you need to capture and buy locations, recruit new characters, and complete goals; each of these actions gives you victory points at the end of the game. To do so, you need to play cards from your hand (each with a unique set of actions) and combine them. Don't think it's simple! With a good strategy during your turn, you can take up to ten actions in a row.

You will encounter plenty of mysterious ocean creatures and take them to your hand. With their help you will explore the unknown locations and rise found resources from the ocean depths to your kingdom. Mechanically this is represented with the help of three-layered player board and the unique mechanism of card-rising.

 
[h2][b]Aquanauts[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/6abc16ef40f6854006ae05b6850cc4e3f486b845.jpg[/img]

In Aquanauts, players take the role of deep sea researchers scouring the depths of the darkest reaches of the ocean for insights into life beneath the waves.

You'll share a research base at the bottom of the ocean with your rivals, as well as set up your own laboratory systems to extract the right samples.

After coordinating your robotic assistants and your specialist Aquanaut to extract the best from the labs, you'll send your findings to the surface to cash in on the fame of publishing a paper of your findings - but be careful, your rivals are also trying to do the same thing! Plan your research carefully and get to the surface first.

Aquanauts features an accessible engine building and resource management puzzle wrapped in a worker placement system, providing a great introduction to euro style gaming as well as giving an entertaining experience to veteran gamers who want to explore the deep ocean.


[h2][b]Nemo's War[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/ac5c27044dcd65c55f089c3b794cdd2861aad0fc.jpg[/img]

Nemo’s War is based on the novel "20,000 Leagues Under the Seas" by Jules Verne. It’s a single-player game of underwater exploration and combat circa 1870. You are Captain Nemo, commander of the Nautilus. You will search the oceans, fight vessels of all nations, brave the hazards of the seas, find mysterious treasures, behold and chronicle amazing wonders, and travel around the world in your quest for knowledge and vengeance.

This critically acclaimed game is widely considered one of the best solo games, but 2-4 players can join in on the fun coorperatively!

 
[h2][b]The Refuge[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/d3593f405decd32bf2380cbedc7160ab07ea9390.jpg[/img]

Due to extensive use of nuclear weapons during The Great War, much of Europe’s surface has become uninhabitable. Controlling the deep sea is now the key to global power.

Breakthroughs in underwater technology have followed military necessity: new methods for propelling divers and submersibles, better diving suits, and compact breathing systems.

No longer tethered to air hoses, divers are venturing deeper and further into the sea than ever before. Maybe too deep…

In Terror from the Deep's Competitive Dive, 2-6 divers compete by racing to the goal and planning movement to outwit their opponents — all while escaping from the Kraken's wrath! The object of the game is simple: Be the first to an unlocked escape pod, and you'll escape with the cargo and win!

notes.title: Play 2019 Golden Geek Nominees Right Now!
notes.notes:
The [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/thread/2402641/14th-annual-golden-geek-awards-nominations-open]nominees for the 2019 Boardgamegeek Golden Geek awards[/url] have been announced, and [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/geekawards/boardgame]voting is now open[/url]! If you want to make a more informed decision before casting your vote (or just experience some really fantastic games), here are some award nominees you can play right now!


[h2]WINGSPAN[/h2]
[i]Nominated for Game of the Year, Card Game, Family Game, Innovative, Solo Game, and Strategy Game[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/47afb505682cafd17ceae29fe55ad2d986114493.png[/img]

This debut design from self-proclaimed “spreadsheet geek” Elizabeth Hargrave has already swept up the 2019 Kennerspiel des Jahres, and is currently sitting pretty as the number 21 overall ranked game on BGG. With its satisfying engine-building akin to Terraforming Mars and Gizmos, it’s undeniably one of the hottest games of 2019

Play as bird enthusiasts — researchers, bird watchers, ornithologists, and collectors — seeking to discover and attract the best birds to your aviary. Each bird extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your habitats, and the winner is the player with the most points accumulated from birds, bonus cards, end-of-round goals, eggs, cached food, and tucked birds.


[h2]TAPESTRY[/h2]
[i]Nominated for Game of the Year[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/60f64eb08e3b80e632e30294e76e4ca84e6d8888.png[/img]

The other Stonemaier-published game to make the list. Designed by Jamey Stegmaier, this 1-5 player civilization-inspired Eurogame sees you creating the empire with the most storied history - from the dawn of mankind, to their assent into the stars and beyond.

On your turn, you’ll choose one of four advancement tracks (science, technology, exploration, and military) to progress on. Move yourself up one space, gain the benefits, and leverage your asymmetric abilities to your path to victory. You can go hard on one track or play a balanced game to slow your opponents down. The strategy is dynamic every game!


[h2]BARRAGE[/h2]
[i]Nominated for Game of the Year, Innovative[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/a3aaee066411af00e838607a73b9dacf3961428c.png[/img]

Dice Tower Seal of Approval!

Barrage is a resource management and strategic placement game, in which players will compete to build their majestic dams, raise them to increase their storing capacity of precious water, and deliver all the potential power through pressure tunnels connected to powerhouse energy turbines.

Barrage includes two innovative and challenging mechanics. The Construction wheel has to be managed by players to carefully plan their actions and handle their machineries, since both your action tokens and resources will be stored on the wheel and will come back only after a full wheel round is completed. The more you will construct and perform maintenance on your wheel, the earlier you will get back your resources and actions.


[h2]PALADINS OF THE WEST KINGDOM[/h2]
[i]Nominated for Game of the Year, Artwork & Presentation, Strategy Game[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/324a66599ecec1d453dc89fcabe1f2ca2404c899.png[/img]

Ready the horses and sharpen the swords. The Paladins are approaching!

The aim of Paladins of the West Kingdom is to be the player with the most victory points (VP) at the game's end. Points are gained by building outposts and fortifications, commissioning monks and confronting outsiders. Each round, players will enlist the help of a specific Paladin and gather workers to carry out tasks. As the game progresses, players will slowly increase their faith, strength and influence. Not only will these affect their final score, but they will also determine the significance of their actions.


[h2]ESCAPE PLAN[/h2]
[i]Nominated for Artwork & Presentation[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/8607bc9e1d414a38d386eeea05b62dcedccf4e7a.png[/img]

Design by Vital Lacerda (The Gallerist, Lisboa, On Mars). Artwork by Ian O’Toole (Nemo’s War, Vinhos, Clinic). The perfect recipe for an amazing game.

In Escape Plan, players are the thieves, but they may influence the cops' moves every turn. The robbers move on a modular board trying to reach the best spots to recover their loot and escape from the city with more money than the other thieves. The cops are trying to thwart their escape plan — by force if necessary. The players play cards to aid their escape and slow the other players down. The players take actions that allow them to move and to engage gangs, mules, and snitches.

The game design is influenced by great heist films.


[h2]VILLAGERS[/h2]
[i]Nominated for Card Game[/i]

You are the founder of a new village during the middle ages, in the years after a great plague. The loss of so many people has created big problems for the survivors. Many of the people the villagers used to depend on for essential things like food, shelter and clothes are gone. Craftsmen find themselves without suppliers of raw materials, traders have lost their customers and many have lost their farms and workshops as they escaped the plague.

This medium-light city builder has a surprising amount of depth and some adorable artwork!


[h2]CARTOGRAPHERS: A ROLL PLAYER TALE[/h2]
[i]Nominated for Family Game, Solo Game[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/c52bbf0e776f389ff1060a5bf963669dfe07031e.png[/img]

One of the most streamlined and accessible flip-and-writes out there! The presence of monster cards in the deck also gives it a bit of interaction, evolving the genre beyond a simple multiplayer solitaire.
 
In Cartographers, players compete to earn the most reputation stars by the time four seasons have passed. Each season, players draw on their map sheets and earn reputation by carrying out the queen's edicts before the season is over. The player with the most reputation stars at the end of winter wins!

[h2]GLEN MORE II: CHRONICLES[/h2]
[i]Nominated for Strategy Game[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/2ea313ef756bc9f439cbf14b6c3cd3e56a673a8a.png[/img]

Glen More II: Chronicles is a sequel to Glen More, expanding the gameplay substantially compared to the original game.

In Glen More II: Chronicles, each player represents the leader of a Scottish clan from the early medieval ages until the 19th century, a leader looking to expand their territory and wealth. The success of your clan depends on your ability to make the right decision at the right time, be it by creating a new pasture for your livestock, growing barley for whisky production, selling your goods on the various markets, or gaining control of special landmarks such as lochs and castles.

notes.title: Solve Mysteries (And Finish Your Homework)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/206786f6702b9cd51b10f5ff4fa7de7f3e6faa9f.png[/img]

[i]The landscape was full of machines and scrap metal connected to the facility in one way or another. Always present on the horizon were the colossal cooling towers of the Bona Reactor, with their green obstruction lights.

If you put your ear to the ground, you could hear the heartbeat of the Loop – the purring of the Gravitron, the central piece of engineering magic that was the focus of the Loop’s experiments.[/i]


This is Tales From The Loop - a cooperative board game for 1-5 players. Take the roles of local kids and investigate whatever phenomena that threaten the islands (or perhaps just the local video store), and hopefully stop them.

Each day starts at school, but as soon as the bell rings you can use whatever time you have before dinner and homework to go exploring! Player actions are integrated, meaning there’s no downtime as you wait for others taking their turn. It also makes cooperating with your fellow players dynamic as you can react to things that happen in a turn and don’t have to plan it all out from the start.

Based on the award-winning artwork by [url=https://www.simonstalenhag.se/]Simon Stålenhag[/url], this game is now live on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1192053011/tales-from-the-loop-the-board-game]Kickstarter[/url], but you can play the first scenario [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tales-from-the-loop-the-board-game]right now on Tabletopia[/url]!

notes.title: Legacy to Last Eons
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/07f40570286e573553b1b57713d0de3c82aad155.png[/img]

Your goal is simple. Create a civilization rich with culture able to stand the test of time. To succeed, you will need to not only focus your energy on your own civilization, but those of your rivals as well. With a shared pool of resources to fight over, and a unique bidding mechanic that will have you guessing at your opponents intentions, [url=https://www.instagram.com/moaideasgame/]Moaideas Game Design[/url] brings a tactically minded medium weight game for 2-5 civilizations will keep you on your toes from start to finish.

You start with a civilization that has an initial focus, such as Military or Trade. While many games reward a strong strategy from the start with a hyperfocus on your end goal, The Flow of Time instead rewards quick thinking and the ability to adapt to changing circumstances on the fly. You might start the game as a bloodthirsty clan, only to inevitably become a peaceful trade empire by the end.

A central tableau stores cards across the ages for players to bid on to improve their civilization or potentially lay waste to others. Players have five actions on their turn, which minimizes analysis paralysis for those groups that have players like that. You can activate cards you’ve previously purchased, harvest resources to let you pay for cards, or use the final three actions to interact with the cards available on the tableau, purchasing or investing in them to improve your civilization.

Designer [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgamedesigner/81801/jesse-li]Jesse Li[/url] (Guns & Steel, Ponzi Scheme) has created a game that combines many of the familiar elements of other civilization builders (7 Wonders, Through the Ages, Tapestry) and brought his own spin to it. It has clear, concise rules which are easy to teach people new to the genre, and lacks complex interactions that muddy down other civilization builders and prevent them from being as accessible.

That doesn’t mean [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-flow-of-history]The Flow of History[/url] is without its tricks. It brings a fresh, unique take to bidding mechanics by allowing you to invest in cards on the table, only to purchase them in a later round. This signals your intention to buy a card, but opens it up for players to snipe it from you. Having a card sniped from you gets you has you getting your investment back, as well as half the resource tokens from the supply... allowing crafty players to potentially bluff their way into resources if they can guess their opponents moves, force a player to overspend resources, or deny a player a crucial card.

The Flow of History offers both players seasoned to the Civilization Builder genre, and those new to it a game of interesting, thought provoking possibilities. Clocking in at less than 90 minutes for a full 5 players, it doesn’t overstay its welcome. Those that like their games with a nice amount of player interaction will find themselves right at home here in a game that is quick to teach, but hard to master.

notes.title: It Belongs in Galactic Museum!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/ba2f61574497910f149090e6409fec2dfdc2dc51.png[/img]

A century from now all that remains of Earth is the detritus that humanity left behind. The races of a neighboring solar system have a penchant for artifacts left behind by extinct races. In [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/excavation-earth-ks]Excavation Earth[/url], you lead one of these races of alien explorers on their quest to excavate rare human artifacts and curate the ultimate art collection to sell off.

Excavation Earth is divided into three rounds, each of which starts with players drafting a hand of multi-use cards that will be used to perform actions. Players then take quick turns playing actions that allow them to move their explorers around the world map, excavate for artifacts, and deploy traders to bazaars and influencers to affect prices and wheel and deal on the black market.

The artifacts you dig up can be either sold to the bazaars housed on one of the aliens' ships that landed on Earth or added to a collection that will be sold off as a coherent art collection to museums back home. Excavation Earth ends after three rounds and the player who makes the most money during the game wins.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mightyboards/excavation-earth]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

Fight for gold, blood and glory in asymmetrical skirmish game Valknut which is available on [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/valknut]Tabletopia[/url] and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/luisbrueh/valknut/]Kickstarter[/url] now!

notes.title: Scheme. Build. Adventure.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/54476d704825ee1ea38bc67fbec0d2857627b7e5.png[/img]

Have you ever wanted to manage a fantasy guild of adventurers starting from fledgling adepts up through heroes and legends? With [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/guild-master]Guild Master[/url] from [url=http://www.goodgamespublishing.com/]Good Games Publishing[/url], now you can. Playing up to 4 over the span of 1-2 hours players will try to become the most renowned guild in the land.

Guild Master has a unique mixture of mechanics up its sleeve. At first glance the gameplay loop might seem simple: order your adventurers to go out and attempt contracts to gain coin or fame, recruit adventurers to do more complex contracts, or hire builders to upgrade your guild… but designer [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgamedesigner/110626/chris-antony]Chris Antony[/url] has made each of those choices carry weight, meaning, and tension.

Adventurers have things they’re good at, and combining those skills is a core part of the game. These will get you a larger chance at winning skill checks, giving a dice per skill point in order to beat static numbers, or rival guilds. They also have abilities that can only be activated in certain rounds of the game.

Giving your adventurers tasks is done in secret simultaneously by all players, programming out what you hope to achieve for the round, and combining skills of adventurers to help (Robo Rally, Root). Once revealed however, you may find that an order you programmed was too late and a rival guild got there first, or possibly worse, you are both attempting to do the same thing, and are contesting.

Contesting guilds behave differently depending on the action they’re contesting, with some actions simply requiring the adventurers to use their skills to beat the contest, or have the player have offered an adventurer more than another guild. But in the case of contracts, you’ll be negotiating with other guilds openly, discussing what facets of the contract you’d like to split, and then finally secretly revealing if you intend to cooperate, or conflict further.

Normally, negotiation in games becomes a centrepiece (Twilight Imperium, Rising Sun, Cosmic Encounter), but with Guild Master, there is tension to every action so that it becomes a seamless part of the game instead. Some games also restrict you in what you can negotiate on, but here even flat out bribing is encouraged.

There is a lot of depth, nuance and tension in Guild Master, with each action you can take being crafted to be as interesting as possible. With so many branching paths to victory, this is a game that will keep you wanting to play again for different outcomes. Do you have what it takes to make the most famous guild in the land? Or will your accomplishments lie unremembered through the sands of time.

[i]Tabletopia Tip: Some games have zones where only you can see what is in them. Where you give out orders in Guild Master is one such place.[/i]

notes.title: Become Divinity Itself
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/3b1aae77b8288d54ca0c98249e041880b285ed3b.png[/img]

The gods weep. Having been abandoned by their mortal followers who instead choose to wage war, their power is waning. As the last of their worshippers turn their backs on their once loved gods, they die. Their tears crash into the ground causing destruction and mayhem in their wake… but they also contain power, power to outrun death itself, and perhaps even the power to ascend mortals to godhood. Now war is waged anew, one in which a new pantheon is born.

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/godtear-board-game]Godtear[/url] by [url=https://steamforged.com/godtear]Steamforged Games Ltd.[/url] is a tabletop skirmish and area control game for two in which larger than life champions, already infused with the powers from these tears, come together to form warbands and face off to control those that remain. These powerful titans, along with their followers clash in a brutal game of war for those that love a bit of strategic carnage.

Warbands are full of Champions and their followers, and you get to choose which fill your warband. If you like to mould the world around you perhaps the Shapers will be for you. Want to get in your enemies face and deal damage? Slayers or Maelstroms are your best bet. Playing defensive is the role of Guardians. These different abilities ensure those who prefer different aspects of combat in games get to use characters that match their playstyles.

Designers [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgamedesigner/35570/david-carl]David Carl[/url], Alex Hall, and Steve Margetson have created an interesting premise of a game which manages to capture the turning tides of battle. Actions performed when combat is likely to be the thickest can get the richest rewards, but also carry with them greater risk. Defeat in one turn may be turned into victory the next. 

Some skirmish games can be very restrictive about letting certain heroes/champions be fielded with others (Underworlds, Guild Ball, Blood Rage). Not so with Godtear. Want nothing but champions that can manipulate the world? You can absolutely do that. Thanks to each champion having its own followers, games are easy to setup and involve simply picking what champions you would like in your warband, what scenario to play, and jumping into combat.

Each of the scenarios not only offer replayability, but add features that provide a shifting landscape over time, often allowing a player who was defeated in a turn a tactical advantage to use in future turns. When coupled with synergy between champions the number of decisions you can make during a game is simply staggering.

Godtear is the skirmish game that you can pick up and play no matter what your experience with the genre is. While it has significant depth within its mechanics, the gameplay is incredibly familiar to those who are used to miniature combat in other games with grids (Pathfinder, Mice and Mystics, Descent), and so becomes easy to teach. It’s fun just controlling a single champion, but really hits its stride when you create warbands.

Find out if your warband has the strength to claim the tears of long perished gods to gain immortality… and beyond.

[i]Until the end of the month of April Steamforged Games Ltd is providing [url=https://steamforged.com/sfg-news-blog/10-4-2020-play-godtear-online]an event[/url] where you can win the ability to choose which miniatures on Tabletopia get alternative digital sculpts! All you need do is play on Tabletopia and submit a screenshot of your game for a chance to win.[/i]

[img]https://front-us2.tabletopia.com/static/files/002/990/L3py6MKmR97faoFcLIznz2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Combat an Ominous Force
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/a2a7b80ab7734e7d9a934f3435a92fe5bbbd09d6.png[/img]

Publisher [url=http://www.garphill.com/]Garphill Games[/url] brings [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/bethel-woods]Bethel Woods[/url]; a fast paced co-operative adventure for 2-4 players where you must prevent the destruction of your home. By gaining the knowledge required to construct a machine mysteriously known as the ‘Daydreamer’ throughout the course of the game you will be able to protect your home... and hopefully from there, protect the world.

Set in the universe of “Hours” created by author [url=https://jessyribordy.com/home]Jessy Ribordy[/url] (Falling Up, The River Empires), you play as overseers of a ragtag group of young mechanics, engineers and more to repair the various ancient machines scattered throughout the forest and defend them from spies trying to bring apart calamity and the end of all you know.

Bethel Woods is played with a mancala style mechanism (Trajan, Five Tribes, Istanbul). Each turn players will pick up and move a group of workers from the machine they’ve been working on to assist other workers in a clockwise or counterclockwise fashion. Unlike many games with mancala mechanisms, Bethel Woods provides each worker with the ability to perform actions, and the freedom of direction provides strategic depth.

These workers will then be able to fix various malfunctions that have occurred throughout the game, gaining knowledge for the player overseeing the work. Workers are specialists however, and can only repair what they know how to fix. If the player has gained enough knowledge of a single type through a set collection mechanic (Terraforming Mars, Spirit Island, Pandemic), they can start to rebuild part of the ‘Daydreamer’.

If slowly malfunctioning machines weren’t enough of a problem to deal with, spies are attempting to cause more chaos and discord by actively trying to make the machines they are near go critical. Thankfully, each player has a unique character ability which will provide them with benefits to hopefully counteract these problems as they arise.

Designer [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgamedesigner/12547/shem-phillips]Shem Phillips[/url] has truly made a game of possibilities and complex decisions. As the game comes closer to reaching its conclusion, the situation will often become more and more dire, with more interesting and far reaching choices to make. This provides a steady difficulty curve through its entire playthrough, and additional difficulty options and random player powers make replayability high.

Repair almost forgotten technology. Uncover and fend off spies. Use long forgotten knowledge to build your own defences. Will you protect the orphanage? Or will the ominous force threatening Bethel Woods succeed, and plunge the world into darkness.

[i]Tabletopia Tip: You can select multiple pieces by holding shift and selecting individual pieces to group them together. Alternatively shift and left mouse will create a bounding box to make a selection.[/i]

notes.title: The Promise of Power Untold
notes.notes:
Control territories, develop your character and battle rivals in mysterious world of Planet Fulcrum!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/81f6d4c88bd44a0e1c0732563dfc78ab1824d5de.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/planet-fulcrum]Planet Fulcrum[/url][/h2]
[u]1-4 players; 30-90 minutes[/u]

Planet Fulcrum is a strategic, area control board game with tech-tree character development and deck-driven battle. Players assume the role of an unwitting adventurer. Transported, stranded, and endowed with powerful abilities by the mysterious planet to compete for its gifts.

notes.title: Escape Box in My Pocket
notes.notes:
Inspect objects & documents and solve puzzles in a series of scenarios Pocket Investigations.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/651/1TqZJQNSwBEluXiNSzEhyA.jpg?maxwidth=1600&maxheight=900[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/pocket-investigations]Pocket Investigations[/url][/h2]
[u]1-4 players; 30- 90 minutes[/u]

3 Available scenarios:
- Merry Christmas: help Santa Claus make his gifts! (Difficulty 1/3)
- Casino Krysos: the Gang des Casinos recruits new talents: simulate a heist in Monte-Carlo. (Difficulty 2/3)
- Prelude: track down a serial killer: will you save his next victim in time? (Difficulty 3/3)

notes.title: Weapon of Choice
notes.notes:
Gather resources and food, fight deadly predators, and learn the mysteries of fire in board game Don't Let It Die!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/632/F4Q3gTBCbL5RqcZjAAI6q1.jpg?maxwidth=1600&maxheight=900&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/don-t-let-it-die]Don't Let It Die[/url][/h2]
[u]1-4 players; 45-90 minutes[/u]

Designed from the ground up to offer a re-playable, interactive, strategic cooperative experience. The key to victory lies in your group's ability to adapt to the ever-present and always changing threats of prehistoric life. Should you focus on hunting and foraging to feed your starving tribe? Or should you be more concerned with supplying the dwindling fire with more wood? Perhaps constructing a weapon or tool might ease the stress of gathering resources... These choices and more await you in what will surely be the ultimate test of survival.

notes.title: Alchemists and Philosopher's Stone
notes.notes:
Explore medieval world where mysticism and science are inseparable in alchemy with board game Materia Prima!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/586/Rb099BVaL3jjmgyId8bdf0.jpg?maxwidth=1600&maxheight=900[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/materia-prima]Materia Prima[/url][/h2]
[u]2-4 players; 1-1.5 hours[/u]

Materia Prima is a competitive sandbox game with an unique mix of several influences and styles. It combines various mechanics, such as dice rolling while fighting, deck building while recipe exploration, grid movement on a modular game board, pick up and delivery while resource mining, resource management while crafting items and area control by creating little helpers, the Homunculi.

notes.title: Find Your Inner TRI
notes.notes:
Take role of amateur triathlete and steady your state for race in board game Triathlon Series!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/591/OsnW0zQR6b6qHcdvQaPCl2.jpg?maxwidth=1600&maxheight=900[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/triathlon-series]Triathlon Series[/url][/h2]
[u]2-4 players; 45-90 minutes[/u]

Triathlon Series is the first tabletop game inspired by this wonderful way of living: The TRI of life :). Some of you may recognize this pattern: few years ago, extra kilos, chaotic living&Co. And suddenly, a new path is born, where equilibrium rules our life, where swim-bike-run is not a question of fitness, but a way to be.

notes.title: Danger in the Forest
notes.notes:
Fight cat knights to defence your tribe in board game Forest Guardians!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/542/eEymRxnDHBryt7f1oiZwd6.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/forest-guardians]Forest Guardians[/url][/h2]
[u]1 player; 10-15 minutes[/u]

In this solo strategy card game, player must fight the evil cat knights to avoid the destruction of the forest and its entire tribe. The player wins when all enemies are dead. The player loses when all heroes are dead or not all enemies can be eliminated. This game was made by Marta Viader for the 2020 - 9 Card Game Print and Play Design Contest. Enjoy :)

notes.title: I Kiss the Reef in Aquatica
notes.notes:
Become mighty ocean king and encounter plenty of mysterious creatures in board game Aquatica!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/527/rouIjfSj4VAKnbPICwvk30.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/aquatica]Aquatica[/url][/h2]
[u]1-4 players; 30-60 minutes[/u]

Aquatica is a deep, but easy to learn family engine builder about underwater kingdoms. In the game you will become one of the mighty ocean kings, struggling to bring glory to his realm. To win the game, you need to capture and buy locations, recruit new characters, and complete goals; each of these actions gives you victory points at the end of the game.

notes.title: Wizards of Pizza
notes.notes:
Buy ingredients and make pizzas to earn reputation in board game Pizza Master.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/502/SHBjlt8V1d376GEPGbKfx2.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/pizza-master]Pizza Master[/url][/h2]
[u]2-5 players; 30-50 minutes[/u]

Pizza Master was the master chef of Wizards of Pizza, once known as the best pizza restaurant in the world. However, after the master chef mysteriously disappeared, its reputation has been on the decline. To reclaim number one spot, all talented Pizza Trainees assemble and hold a COMPETITION. The one who is truly skilled and able to earn the most reputation will be named the next “Pizza Master”.

notes.title: Despicable Minions
notes.notes:
Send your daemon warrior into the Infernal Circle to do battle for glory and honor in board game Daemon Dice.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/499/5Ghap3Vy3dVEvEAqOu2sB0.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/daemon-dice]Daemon Dice[/url][/h2]
[u]2-4 players; 20-30 minutes[/u]

In the halls of Hell, the daemon lords settle their differences like gentlemen — which is to say, they send their minions to do battle for them, with the winner bringing honor for its master. The most powerful lords keep stables with hundreds of daemonish minions, monsters bred or just stitched together for nothing but combat. It isn't uncommon for these monsters' masters to invent a quarrel just to see their minions fight!

notes.title: Discover the Deep
notes.notes:
Become deep sea researcher scouring the darkest reaches of the ocean in board game Aquanauts.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/589/Gnc8KPIXaPNLkhecqPFsb1.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/aquanauts]Aquanauts[/url][/h2]
[u]2-4 players; 60-90 minutes[/u]

Aquanauts features an accessible engine building and resource management puzzle wrapped in a worker placement system, providing a great introduction to euro style gaming as well as giving an entertaining experience to veteran gamers who want to explore the deep ocean.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/itbboardgames/aquanauts-discover-the-deep]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Work, Buy, Consume, Repeat
notes.notes:
Challenge to reach maximum happiness by balancing aspects of material life in educational card game The L.O.O.P.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/481/QaAgLA1zJQQZZ6RYDR7Oe0.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-loop]The L.O.O.P.[/url][/h2]
[i]2-4 players; 40-60 minutes[/i]

Short for the "Life Of Ordinary People", The L.O.O.P. is a 2-4 persons educational card game about Consumerism, Materialistic Lifestyle, and Personal Happiness. Players are challenged to reach maximum HAPPINESS by balancing the 3 aspects of material life while preventing a total resource DEPLETION. Work, Buy, Consume, and Die? Do you think you have what it takes to break this L.O.O.P.?

notes.title: Animal Instinct
notes.notes:
Play sentient animals that inhabit world without humans in card game Animal Empire.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/487/9bpcZmwlJi0gqTxdfZDvh0.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/animal_empire]Animal Empire[/url][/h2]
[u]2-8 players; 30-60 minutes[/u]

Capture kingdoms, build your armies, and conquer the world in this intense medieval anthropomorphic card game from Half-Monster Games. Put your strategic, diplomatic, and command skills to the ultimate test in Animal Empire: Conquer or be Conquered!

notes.title: All For Me Grog
notes.notes:
Run your own tavern in immersive engine builder game Tavern Masters!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/482/2BSasmQXHH69RI8K0RhTT0.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tavern-masters]Tavern Masters[/url][/h2]
[u]1-6 players; 20-30 minutes[/u]

Tavern Masters is the exciting tableau-building card game of tavern-running fun by Dann Kriss! Each player is a new tavern owner, setting up shop in a thirsty village full of thugs and soldiers, mages and nobles! Head-to-Head, Cooperative, and Solo play available! Includes Dirty Deeds Expansion, and Games Of Chance Expansion!

notes.title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
notes.notes:
Become an old-timey doctor, drunk as hell and curing plague and blood ghosts with cocaine and amputations!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/469/htuiaxyzo6SYNsE1XdFkEB.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/trust-me-i-m-a-doctor]Trust Me, I'm a Doctor[/url][/h2]
3-8 players; 15-60 minutes

In this hilarious debating game you, as Doctors of the undetermined olde times, attempt to treat each other’s disgusting Ailments with some of the most gruesome and spine-tingling Cures in history, derived from the finest medical science of the age.

notes.title: Escape from Paradise
notes.notes:
Escape the mysterious and rapidly approaching dangerous FOG in thrilling board game The FOG.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/402/b2wOPdtEfQy51Rr6842fN4.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-fog]The FOG[/url][/h2]
[u]1-4 players; 45-90 minutes[/u]

The FOG is a new competitive, challenging and thrilling game with 45 to 90 minutes playing time for 1 to 6 players who decide about the fate of villagers of a lonely beautiful island – who are trying in sheer panic to still reach their boats at the beach to escape the mysterious and rapidly approaching dangerous FOG. The game combines tactical depth with high replayability through the islanders different movement options and a very variable setup mechanism.

notes.title: Battle of Dice Armies
notes.notes:
Lead fantasy army in fast-rolling game Dragon Dice!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/391/qppAjmk7glDLS6z2IWsaf5.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dragondice]Dragon Dice[/url][/h2]
[u]2 players; 30-60 minutes[/u]

Players use colorful dice to represent armies of different fantasy races which battle to control essential terrain in this fast-rolling game. Any number of players can join the struggle, although it's designed as a multiplayer game. The first player to capture two terrains immediately wins the game, or you may try to obliterate your opponent's dice. Spells and layered strategies benefit certain races as you try to control the odds in this dynamic game full of surprises!

notes.title: The Psychic Espionage "Game"
notes.notes:
Become psychically-powered agent in hidden movement game MIND MGMT!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/374/C6AEDM3xHhA7MvaF3H2Sq2.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mind-mgmt]MIND MGMT[/url][/h2]
[u]2-5 players; 45-75 minutes[/u]

In this psychic espionage “game,” one player is the Mind MGMT Recruiter, who must scour the city for new recruits without revealing their position or goals. All other players are Rogue Agents, who must try to stop Mind MGMT before they acquire too many new recruits!

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mindmgmt/mind-mgmt-the-psychic-espionage-game]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: The Prince's Dream
notes.notes:
Scheme and fight for influence and power as immortal vampire in board game Vampire: The Masquerade - Vendetta!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/353/kyt4iyUEPoNcQQD9PM5Yn7.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/vampire-the-masquerade-vendetta]Vampire: The Masquerade - Vendetta[/url][/h2]
[u]3-5 players; 30 minutes[/u]

Vampire: The Masquerade - Vendetta is an asymmetrical competitive card game of strategy, bluff, and deduction, designed by renowned game designers Charlie Cleveland (Subnautica) and Bruno Faidutti (Citadels). Players will take control of the scheming vampires and fight at several locations to win the support of influential allies and ultimately challenge the throne of Chicago.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/horribleguild/vampire-the-masquerade-vendetta]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: All Bets Are Off
notes.notes:
Bet on and rig the gladiatorial games in award-winning board game Gladius.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/358/8RzDri9TSFy5zzWUOtzjuI1.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/gladius]Gladius[/url][/h2]
[u]2-5 players;15-30 minutes[/u]

In Gladius, play as cunning Roman spectators trying to make the most money by betting on gladiators competing in the gladiatorial games. Through the skillful use of underhanded tactics, players can help and hinder teams to alter the outcome of each battle. Can you outwit your opponents to turn a profit, or will you be left empty-handed?

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/catquartetgames/gladius]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Our New World
notes.notes:
Create the civilization with the most storied history in asymmetric board game Tapestry.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/345/L069k0dhANlMT7RdDZcuT3.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tapestry]Tapestry[/url][/h2]
[u]1-5 players; 1.5-2 hours[/u]

In Tapestry, you start from nothing and advance on any of the 4 advancement tracks (science, technology, exploration, and military) to earn progressively better benefits. You can focus on a specific track or take a more balanced approach. You will also improve your income, build your capital city, leverage your asymmetric abilities, earn victory points, and gain tapestry cards that will tell the story of your civilization.

notes.title: Find Your Way
notes.notes:
Explore, integrate and utilize the rooms of the vast space Ark in engine building game Ark: Awakening.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/310/ujTVQQcdctninyOYAeKUC2.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/ark-awakening]Ark: Awakening[/url][/h2]
[u]1-3 players; 30-90 minutes[/u]

Ark: Awakening is a hybrid worker placement and area-control game with deep engine building. During the gameplay, the central board is constructed by placing tiles next to each other. The goal of the game is to unravel the reason/mission why your alien faction is at the Ark and then activate specific parts of the Ark in order to achieve your mission. The first player that does so, wins.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/skyport/ark-awakening]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Nightmarish Dream
notes.notes:
Survive and fight against the odds with limited resources in reverse deck building game Ruins: Death Binder.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/335/bydFoWCYIvg4PyOaoHc0G1.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/death-binder]Ruins: Death Binder[/url][/h2]
[u]1 player; 30-75 minutes[/u]

Ruins: Death Binder is a board game that incorporates unique reverse deck building and dungeon crawling mechanics. Player chooses his path and delves into the dungeon filled with different events and encounters. During the game your character gains taint, more taint it gathers the stronger and more difficult enemies are sent your way.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/heavypunch/ruins-death-binder]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Because I'm Batman!
notes.notes:
Take on the roles of heroes from Gotham City in Batman: The Animated Series Adventures!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/313/lfEs3DP1Mm6LBtbC0Gq303.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/batman-the-animated-series-adventures]Batman: The Animated Series Adventures[/url][/h2]
[u]1-5 players; 1-1.5 hours[/u]

Batman: The Animated Series Adventures - Shadow of the Bat brings new heroes, villains, battles, and gameplay to the AUGS. Hero players can take back the streets of Gotham City as Batman, Batgirl, Robin, Catwoman, and Commissioner Jim Gordon. While not as well trained as his masked allies, Gordon is able to command the GCPD beat cops, making him a new type of hero. Looking for a bit more fire power? Upgrade those beat cops to Detectives Harvey Bullock and Renee Montoya.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/idwgames/batman-the-animated-series-adventures]Kickstarter[/url]! The other great thing is that recently [url=https://tabletopia.com/games?sortType=ModificationDate]Tabletopia catalogue[/url] had reached 800 games!!![/b]

notes.title: Everybody Wants to Rule the World
notes.notes:
Seize the reins of power and become the ruler of our world in strategy conspiracy game Deep State!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/316/LBgFmf1zkby7YiWgwIdhRC.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/deep-state]Deep State: New World Order[/url][/h2]
[u]2-4 players; 45-75 minutes[/u]

Everything you do is shrouded in secrecy. Your trained agents infiltrate governments, banks, criminal syndicates, stock exchanges, research centers... You make treaties with well-known and hidden organizations, such as the Trilateral Commission and the Illuminati, the Communist League and the Masons, the CIA and the Cosa Nostra, and more. You carry out covert operations — coups, sponsored guerrilla wars, and even direct military interventions. And finally, you embed yourself in international projects such as Comintern and Unified Nations, which shape the history of the world.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crowdgames/deep-state-new-world-order]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Work it Harder, Make it Better
notes.notes:
Take on the role of rookie employees on factory producing electric vehicles in Kanban EV board game.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/309/DPGsxopMCyOgxzIB6cHyST.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/kanban-ev]Kanban EV[/url][/h2]
[u]2-4 players; 1.5-2.5 hours[/u]

"Kanban" — or 看板, the Japanese word for billboard — is a term for the visual cues that might be used in a lean, efficient assembly line in order to expedite and smooth workflow. These signals get the workers what they need, where they need it, when they need it to create a just-in-time (JIT) production system. The setting for the game Kanban EV is an electric car assembly line. The players are ambitious managers who are trying to impress the board of directors in order to achieve as high a position as possible in the company and secure their careers.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eaglegryphon/kanban-ev]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: The Show Must Go On
notes.notes:
Try to win the most viewers over an evening of television as fledgling TV network in The Rival Networks board game!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/309/O0XHY6ILFLO52WxghVuOB1.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-rival-networks]The Rival Networks[/url][/h2]
[u]2 players; 30-45 minutes[/u]

The Rival Networks is a standalone 2-player version of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-networks]The Networks[/url]. You do not need to have played The Networks to play this game. In The Rival Networks, you’ll take turns improving your Network’s most important prime time slots. On your turn, you’ll develop a Show, and sign a Star and an Ad. Shows and Stars give you Ratings Points, which turn into Viewers. You’ll use Ads to buy powerful Network Cards that offer useful powers. Which Network will get the most Viewers and win the game?

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gilhova/the-rival-networks]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Don't Hate on My Christmas Jams
notes.notes:
Produce and sell the best jams in small town in the US in the '50s.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/288/gaCYzm20g6i0qhghj83PH1.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/frutticola]Frutticola[/url][/h2]
In Frutticola players will take on the role of business leaders specialized in growing and selling fruits and jams, trying to become the most rich in town by the end of the year! With just a few Workers and Farmers, you'll have to choose when to send them to the orchards and when to buy pesticides, fertilizers and other items in the shops. Who will prove to be the best entrepreneur?
[previewyoutube=_gNO3INebG4;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/166119889/frutticola]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Colonists of the Caribbean
notes.notes:
Feel the atmosphere of West Indies in card game Island Siege!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/299/dDCXKdWY9VzmVoVf4nNtz9.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/island-siege]Island Siege[/url][/h2]
[u]2-4 players; 15-30 minutes[/u]

The goal is for players to get all of their colonists into play on their forts, buildings and ships. Be careful, though, whenever a fort is destroyed by an opponent’s fleet all of the colonists on that fort and its buildings are returned to the player's imperial board to start again! Alternately, players may win by earning 20 gold from constructing buildings and ships. Winning requires a keen balance of building and laying an Island Siege!

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/apegames/island-siege-anniversary-edition]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Honey, I Shrunk the City
notes.notes:
Build your city wherever you want with pocket-sized game Micro City!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/290/PBJyyzPeEv1rINbyt6GNMw0.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/micro-city]Micro City[/url][/h2]
[u]1 player; 15-30 minutes[/u]

Build your city wherever you want! At home, on the train, on the plane. As the name says, Micro City is a small game about building your city. Several game modes, various challenges, different levels of difficulty and random distribution of districts will make each game different!

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thistroygames/micro-city-pocket-sized-citybuilding-game]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Zero Hour: Nine AM
notes.notes:
Immerse yourself in a fast-paced race to the final frontier: space.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/223/kxfb2xtZvesxgUxAGOlgw2.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/rocketmen]Rocketmen[/url][/h2]
[u]2-4 players; 30-90 minutes[/u]

A deck-building confrontation of swift decision-making and tactical choices, Rocketmen gives you the feel of taking a front seat in a technologically wonderful spectacle of space exploration. It’s up to your predictive abilities and resource management skill to determine what kind of endeavor would be most suitable for paving the way to Earth’s celestial neighbors. It doesn’t matter whether it would be a lowEarth orbit satellite or a manned base destined for the Red Planet; plan your mission carefully, equip your shuttles and rockets craftily, yet do not hesitate when your gut instinct tells you when it’s time to launch!

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/phalanxgames/rocketmen]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Theomachy
notes.notes:
Battle to determine the fate of the cosmos in asymmetric strategy game Glorantha: The Gods War!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/258/Hzo8xNy33F1QO6CtynDok5.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/glorantha-the-gods-war]Glorantha: The Gods War[/url][/h2]
[u]3-4 players; 1.5-2 hours[/u]

Designed by Sandy Petersen and set in the mythic world of Glorantha, The Gods War is a fast moving multiplayer strategy game set in a universe on the brink of disaster.  In The Gods War, you take the part of powerful elemental forces, battling to determine the fate of the cosmos.  The Gods War was in development for more than three years and is tightly balanced.  It is highly asymmetric featuring wildly different factions.  Fight over territory, perform miracles, and command monsters and gods.  Storm the gates of heaven itself or watch the world collapse into the Chaos Rift.

[b]Reprint & NEW Expansions are available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/petersengames/glorantha-the-gods-war-reprint-and-new-expansions]Kickstarter[/url] right now![/b]

notes.title: Battleship operational
notes.notes:
Choose your species and command your fleet to destroy your opponent's ships and claim victory in Orion's Spur!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/258/sAiWVQa3DDT9feUclPSu52.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/orions-spur]Orion's Spur[/url][/h2]
[u]2-4 players; 30-60 minutes[/u]

In Orion's Spur, you play as one of 4 species prominent in the Orion's Spur part of the Milky Way: the Terrans, the H'ssuk, the Mroo'shen, and the Churrap. Each species has their own tactics and ship decks that you'll use to take out your opponents fleet for victory points while waiting for reinforcements to arrive. Players will take turns activating their ships, triggering their species' special abilities, or regrouping their fleet as the skirmish evolves into a full-on fight to emerge supreme.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fieroinitiative/orions-spur]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Masters of the Night - now on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
History exiled you from castles and crypts long ago. In this new century, you are wanderers, endlessly searching for a new home, new servants and fresh, fervid blood.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/176/jdnX8kWlMUh8pMElHpBmd3.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/masters-of-the-night]Masters of the Night[/url][/h2]
[u]1-5 players; 60-90 minutes[/u]

Masters of the Night is a  solitaire or cooperative game - one to five players play on the same side and will either win or lose together. You play as members of a vampire clan slowly regaining their former power. With the help of your minions, you will fight against the agents of the Inquisition, cast fear into the hearts of the people with your hunts, and shape dread sigils in different city districts, all in preparation for the grand Blood Moon ritual that will confirm your grasp on the city and its fate. But beware, the longer you prepare for the ritual, the harder it will be to complete it. Your enemies are searching for you constantly and when they find you, even vampire magic may not stop them.

[b]The game is available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ares-games/masters-of-the-night-solo-and-cooperative-vampire-boardgame?ref=d9li9b]Kickstarter[/url] right now![/b]

notes.title: New Continent
notes.notes:
Check out expansion to Wingspan that focuses on European birds.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/172/ho85qAnbJwjMXUlKIqZHF3.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/wingspan-european-expansion]Wingspan: European Expansion[/url][/h1]
[u]1-5 players; 40-75 minutes[/u]

In this first expansion to Wingspan, we increase the scope of the world to include the regal, beautiful, and varied birds of Europe. These birds feature a variety of new powers, including “round end” powers, powers that increase interaction between players, birds that can cover multiple spaces to make future actions more profitable, and birds that benefit from excess cards/food. The European birds are designed to be shuffled into the original deck of cards (and cards from future expansions).

notes.title: Duck Hunt
notes.notes:
Hunt for furry woodland creatures in totally not-serious card game of skill, sabotage and luck Duck, Buck, Moose.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/200/07roW0knyz5bStyetwl2aL.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/duck-buck-moose]Duck, Buck, Moose[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 15-30 minutes[/u]

Journey into the wilderness, collecting licenses and gear and search for that prized buck (or just knock off a few rabbits). Gun jam your opponents or spook their animals to stay in the lead.

[b]"Duck, Buck, Moose is a deceptively simple card game teeming with creative flair and depth of strategy. Well worth the investment!" [i]~ Tyler, The Board Game House[/i][/b]

notes.title: We Got a Problem
notes.notes:
Evacuate crew members from an exploding spaceship, taking them via pods to secure refuges on a nearby moon.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/195/E1y2Vu0cYaqEgktH4L16l2.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/escape-pods]Escape Pods[/url][/h1]
[u]1-5 players; 25-35 minutes[/u]

Escape Pods is a game of spaceships and escape. The goal of the game is to rescue as many crew members as you can, taking them from the spaceship to the four shelters in some nearby moons. However, be careful: The combination of crew members in each shelter could make the escape not completely successful!

notes.title: Hippocratic Oath
notes.notes:
In a worker placement game Dice Hospital players must treat as many patients as possible to appease the local authorities!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/179/kGRfmKxmgPSIKFEU3ylN43.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dice-hospital]Dice Hospital[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 45-90 minutes[/u]

Players use their hospital staff to treat patients on their personal hospital player boards. However, players may also call in specialist staff to react to certain situations that arise to score more points with the authorities! The game uses worker placement mechanics for the staff, dice as the patients where low scores indicate low health and a personal player board of actions to treat patients. The player with the highest reputation wins the game!

notes.title: Paper Universe
notes.notes:
Welcome to Origami Islands, uncharted and untouched by a tip of a marker pen.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/159/SOOPciRvzK9BVatpNj1tF1.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/origami-islands]Origami Islands[/url][/h1]
[u]1-5 players; 30 minutes[/u]

Listen to the whisper of paper waves as you paint the islands with the seasons’ colors – the scarlet flame of autumn, the lush green of spring and summer, and the winter’s blue glow. Choose your islands wisely, make proper bets, find a middle way between speed and quality – and lay your path to victory in this roll-n-write game. Conquer the infinite ocean of Origami islands!

notes.title: Duck Sanctuary
notes.notes:
Come enjoy the company of the ducks while visiting the different locations around the park.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/176/ZYw6mmTqSyTnhfPgD3qvF2.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/ducks-in-tow]Ducks In Tow[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 30-60 minutes[/u]

In Ducks in Tow, you are walking around the park feeding the ducks their favorite food. When you feed them, they start following you and you must lead them to their favorite location in the park. When you successfully lead them to their favorite location, you take a photo with them and they waddle off to find their friends. Maybe you’ll see them again later as you continue your walk around the park.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1812622835/ducks-in-tow]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: General Frost
notes.notes:
How to plan and execute the largest military campaign in history? Find it out in board game 1941: Race to Moscow.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/168/GtlHD6wiowqIvwIHRqw8v0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/1941-race-to-moscow]1941: Race to Moscow[/url][/h1]
[u]1-4 players; 1.5-2 hours[/u]

In 1941: Race to Moscow, players take the roles of chiefs of staff (or quartermasters) of three massive Army Groups, formed from close to 200 divisions, aiming at three targets in the Soviet Union - Moscow, Leningrad, and Rostov. The campaign was planned to be swift and daring, with a goal to reach the objectives before winter. In reality, after the final push - Operation Typhoon - the invading troops reached the vicinity of Moscow and looked through binoculars at the Kremlin spires on one frosty December morning. And then the Soviet counteroffensive started.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/phalanxgames/1941-race-to-moscow]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: The Ultimate Formula
notes.notes:
You are an adept of the mysterious art of alchemy, seeking a way to become the successor of the greatest alchemist ever living - Hermes Trismegistus.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/150/aXPRac7hM4wxT3oLo37re0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/trismegistus-the-ultimate-formula]Trismegistus[/url][/h1]
[u]1-4 players; 1.5-2 hours[/u]

Trismegistus: The Ultimate Formula is played over three rounds during which you will draft exactly three dice. By expertly utilizing the potency of your drafted die, you will be able to transmute precious materials, collect alchemical essences, purchase and activate artifacts, and perform experiments that will progress you along four mastery tracks. You will also build a secret hand of publication cards which - together with the value of your experiments, the completed formulas of your Philosopher's Stone, and your collected gold - will determine your final score in victory points and, perhaps, make you the greatest alchemist, someone able to rival Hermes Trismegistus himself!

notes.title: A Place in Time
notes.notes:
Jump on board the good ship Tranquility and set sail for paradise.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/159/iE2Kvai4pEy46nZmOxBGV4.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tranquility]Tranquility[/url][/h1]
[u]1-5 players; 15-20 minutes[/u]

Tranquillity is a co-operative card game for 1-5 players and is recommended for ages 8-100. The players must fill the sea with islands and guide the ship home before any player runs out of cards. In the world of Tranquility though, the only way to play is in silence.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/boardgamehub/tranquility-a-co-operative-card-game]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: True Detective
notes.notes:
You have only 12 hours to solve or commit the crime of the century in board game Clash of Minds: Holmes vs Moriarty!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/163/t9SXMSY8lyoKBuHlk5T633.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/clash-of-minds-holmes-vs-moriarty]Clash of Minds: Holmes vs Moriarty[/url][/h1]
[u]2 players; 30-45 minutes[/u]

Clash of Minds: Holmes vs Moriarty is a two-player card game in which players take roles of the famous detective Sherlock Holmes and his greatest rival, professor James Moriarty. Those two powerful minds will try to figure out the intentions of their adversary every step of the way.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/clashofminds/clash-of-minds-holmes-vs-moriarty]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Escape Room on Your Table
notes.notes:
Challenge yourself alone or with a group of friends and try to solve the deviously ingenious puzzles, while making story-based choices which influence the ending of each narrative in Escape Tales.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/107/JR75Zciur4LOwyVxA3fnz8.jpg[/img]

In [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/escape-tales-the-awakening]Escape Tales: The Awakening[/url] players take on the role of Sam, whose daughter has been in a coma for over two months and whose doctors still cannot explain how this happened or what caused it.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/115/JJnxSCgswhyPVFVq7BDVD2.jpg[/img]

In [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/escape-tales-low-memory]Escape Tales: Low Memory[/url] players will delve into the stories of three characters and will uncover — step by step — the plot that connects them all.

notes.title: All for one and one for all
notes.notes:
Search without restraint, fight relentlessly and survive ruthless world until daylight!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/140/KbdAjgzyyYxrfBkQNGy5YO0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/until-daylight]Until Daylight[/url][/h1]
[u]3-6 players; 1-2 hours[/u]

Until Daylight is a cooperative survival 3 to 6 players card game, taking place in a chaotic world filled with infected. Each turn, players search the rubble to find objects, weapons and ammunition to survive the hordes of raiders and infected who will attack your group wave after wave. Your fate is bound, if one of you dies, it’s game over.

[previewyoutube=Z7zZktjo_9g;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 8-Bit Art, 64-Bit Gameplay
notes.notes:
Fight foes ranging from shoggoths and cacodemons to gnomes and cosmic clouds in 8-Bit Attack!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/087/Py8KywtKmaJQu1iUvLfQAB.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/8-bit-attack]8-Bit Attack[/url][/h1]
[u]2-5 players; 20-60 minutes[/u]

8-Bit Attack is a game of manic co-operative battle, inspired by the old side-scrolling console games we all loved. Each player controls a gallant 8-bit hero who, with his friends, has to take out a series of minibosses. You must power-up your heroes until they’re tough enough to take on the final boss – none other than Cthulhu himself! Every game is focused directly on tactical boss fights and hero advancement!

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/petersengames/8-bit-attack]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: As the flowers blossom, empires will rise
notes.notes:
Hatch dragons and raise your army of heroes to save fairies from savage beasts in Dwar7s Spring!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/149/6LdWvztyMBnfD9NN9rmjpE.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dwar7s-spring-game]Dwar7s Spring[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 45-90 minutes[/u]

The last winter was harsh, we did our best and yet... barely survived. But we are not alone anymore. We have DRAGONS! Its time to spread our settlements and expand across the world and assemble an army of heroes to battle monsters in the wildlands. Spring is upon us.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vesuviusmedia/dwar7s-spring]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: The Floor is Lava
notes.notes:
Avoid deadly traps, brave scorching lava and defeat the temple's mysterious guardians in Sub Terra II: Inferno's Edge!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/147/HvwZjpmeloYy35uEuYG4G3.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sub-terra-ii-inferno-s-edge]Sub Terra II: Inferno's Edge[/url][/h1]
[u]1-6 players; 45-75 minutes[/u]

In Sub Terra II: Inferno's Edge, players will be progressively revealing new tiles, forming the board, mapping the volcanic temple from its sunlit entrance to its fiery core. As players explore through the temple, they will have to overcome obstacles, avoid hazardous terrain, and face the ferocious guardians of the 'artifact'. On each player's turn, after taking their actions, a random hazard will activate, making careful planning of actions essential to survival.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/itbboardgames/sub-terra-ii-infernos-edge]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: World of Darkness
notes.notes:
Try a thrilling adventure in a World of Darkness where your approach and choices will impact the story. 

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/131/N3koHwtW3nDGWwEjpiwIW2.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/vampire-the-masquerade-chapters]Vampire The Masquerade: CHAPTERS[/url][/h1]
[u]1 player; 30-60 minutes[/u]

Welcome to narrative co-op board game which will be available on Kickstarter Q1 2020. Pick a character with its highly detailed miniature and start your adventure. With immersive branching scenarios, earn experience points and develop your character playing solo, or up to 4 players in full version.

notes.title: Soldiers of the Sea
notes.notes:
Explore the seas and fight for treasures in pirate fantasy board game Avast!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/026/lUlWI0LjhdkPRvCi4YlK10.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/avast]Avast[/url][/h1]
[u]2-6 players; 30-120 minutes[/u]

It is the Age of Piracy and the best way to make a living is with a strong ship and crew. Pirate Captains are gaining notoriety for their exploits and crews are being formed from all walks of life. Riches are won with witts, sword and flintlock and losses are counted in blood. All of the trade of the entire world is up for grabs with opportunity for wealth all around, if you know how to go out and get it, and you do not mind getting bloody.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/20496713/avast?ref=a8xsm0]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Traditional Farmers’ Bread
notes.notes:
Try a worker placement euro-style game Pandemain: Traditional Farmers Bread!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/119/pxbXYDCf4KN0Ljf5VSubk3.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/pandemain-traditional-farmers-bread]Pandemain[/url][/h1]
[u]1-4 players; 45-120 minutes[/u]

Set in medieval Germany, Nördlingen bakers will try to gain the favor of the catholic church in order to be honoured al Saint Honoratus of Amiens festivity. To do so, the players will bake different kinds of bread to sell at the villages to keep the nobles happy, while making constant donations to the church and avoid enragin the Holy Inquisition.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/amphoragames/pandemain-traditional-farmers-bread?ref=crm4dc]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Warm Craft
notes.notes:
Experience the colorful and crafty world of fiber arts with ArchRavels!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/118/3uxUbNQ8DtC9pWT5SMGpZ0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/archravels]ArchRavels[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; ~45 minutes[/u]

Play as one of four characters, each with their own unique crafting specialty. Hit the Yarn Bazaar to build up your stash. Follow the patterns to make cuddly bears, warm blankets, and cozy scarves. Along the way you’ll get some unique special requests. Turn in your completed items to master a pattern, complete projects, and score points. When the project list runs out, the crafter with the most points wins!

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/xyzgamelabs/archravels]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Monster Chef
notes.notes:
Try monstrous recipes for your monstrous customers in a light eurogame for the whole family Monster Food Trucks!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/082/TYU1wdNrVwlBqF6DucHpo2.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/monsterfoodtrucks]Monster Food Trucks[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 45-90 minutes[/u]

In Monster Food Trucks you will become a monstruous chef dedicated to satisfy the hunger of any creature ready to pay for your amazing dishes.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/littlehousebg/monster-food-trucks]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: The Guilds
notes.notes:
Try to organise your team of workers in an attempt to turn their initial scanty resources into a thriving economic system in Key Market II.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/031/YxOM9oe9qQZZfsQT02muC0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/key-market-second-edition]Key Market II[/url][/h1][u]2-4 players; 75-105 minutes[/u]

Key Market was the sixth game in the Key series of stand-alone games published by R&D Games set in the medieval lands of Keydom, with components in both English and German. Designer David Brain and developer Richard Breese have now re-visited Key Market, adding four new guilds to the game and updating a number of the original guilds to give an even more challenging gaming experience.

notes.title: Labyrinth of insectoid god
notes.notes:
Try a gritty, ruthless, Euro-style, co-op dungeon crawl Perdition's Mouth: Abyssal Rift!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/085/IKtwhfHg521RbbsoK4Kn21.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/perdition-s-mouth-abyssal-rift]Perdition's Mouth: Abyssal Rift[/url][/h1]
[u]1-6 players; 30-180 minutes[/u]

Perdition's Mouth: Abyssal Rift is intended to be a new kind of dungeon crawl, one that embraces the European school of game design with clever and elegant mechanisms and emphasizes strategy while minimizing luck. Cooperation, planning, and the enemy response deck eliminate the need for chucking dice, creating a tense combat environment with meaningful decisions! The rondels provide another tactical layer, including the enemy's devious and challenging AI.

notes.title: Rainbow Ride
notes.notes:
Exploit unwitting unicorns and their mindless desire to run on rainbows for profit and glory in a betting tactical game Unicorn Fever!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/093/WKQzb9tpZKS739ShDacOP0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/unicorn-fever]Unicorn Fever[/url][/h1]
[u]2-5 players; 45-90 minutes[/u]

Few know that whenever a rainbow appears, unicorns will start to race on it to dive into the pot of gold at the end. But all those who do, also know that it is a great chance to earn a humongous amount of gold!

Each player is a wealthy bettor, determined to be recognized as the most skillful unicorn-race wagerer of the Great Unicorn Racing Championship and hold this title until the next rainbow appears. During 4 races, players will try to place successful bets to gain Victory Points and Gold.

To reach their goal, they will sign Contracts with unscrupulous citizens of the fairy realm to hire their services and turn the odds of the race in their favor, play Magic cards to straight up fix it, and try to avoid squandering all their hard-earned Gold and be forced to ask the Elf-Mob for Loans. At the end of the Championship, the player with the most Victory Points will be the winner! 

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/horriblegames/unicorn-fever]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: With Your Drill, Pierce The Heavens!
notes.notes:
Greetings Employees, and congratulations on having been selected for the Stardrill Corporation mission to Titan.

[url=https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/082/G88xdzp71OyHVgFZ2BTMH3.jpg][img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/082/G88xdzp71OyHVgFZ2BTMH3.jpg[/img][/url]
