[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/titan-2020]Titan[/url][/h1]
[i]2-4 players; 1-2 hours[/i]

You lucky few have been chosen to be the first to set foot on the surface of Saturn’s largest moon! Initial scans have revealed huge reserves of a variety of resources, including valuable Deuterium. Your mission is to retrieve them from Titan’s depths.. Deploy your extraction network through the different layers of Titan and fill your cargo holds with as many resources as you can!

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/holygrailgames/titan]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Amicus Plato, sed magis amica veritas
notes.notes:
Live an Epic Odyssey adventure as one of Ancient Greece’s greatest thinkers in sandbox tabletop game Philosophia!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/829/H6VJxV9ta2HFJuDbxo5Zx0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/philosophia]Philosophia[/url][/h1]
[u]1-6 players; 45-90 minutes[/u]

In Philosophia, you will build schools, battle it out in public debates, learn profound wisdom and make deals with the Olympic Gods. All in an attempt to prove yourself the greatest mind of the era. The goal in Philosophia is to gain three labyrinth tokens before the ancient Greek Empire is superseded by the Romans. 

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cogitoergomeeple/philosophia]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Tesla vs Rasputin
notes.notes:
Try new interchangeable modules that can be used in various combinations in board game The Rise of Fenris, final expansion to Scythe.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/050/OPcVTOUzh7h9TrPjFWWFs5.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/scythe-the-rise-of-fenris]Scythe: The Rise of Fenris[/url][/h1]
[u]2-5 players; 1.5-2 hours[/u]

Empires have risen and fallen in the aftermath of the Great War, and Europa stands on the precipice of a new era. The economy is robust, morale is high, and defenses are strong. There are reports from the countryside of strange soldiers with glowing eyes, but they seem distant and harmless.

notes.title: Crazy Taxi
notes.notes:
Race to pick up and deliver passengers without pushing your luck too much in Taxi Derby.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/034/KnF8igqIBBC4zLizFpasc0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/taxi-derby]Taxi Derby[/url][/h1]
[u]2-5 players; 60-75 minutes[/u]

You are a taxi driver in the City of Ixat. The city is growing at an unprecedented pace and the arrival of Zipp Taxi, a new driving app, has upended the traditional taxi industry. Everyday drivers like yourself compete to provide the best service and attract the highest paying customers. Do you have what it takes to come out on top in this crazy Taxi Derby?

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1479689674/taxi-derby]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Snake Eater
notes.notes:
Slither in, writhe around and establish dominance in card driven abstract board game Serpent Master. 

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/016/ecvq6C2ZF0otsYVoewE133.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/serpent-master]Serpent Master[/url][/h1]
[u]1-4 players; 30-45 minutes[/u]

Serpent Master is a game of getting on top and staying on top. Players control a serpent and battle for supremacy in pit style action. Players slither in to claim their initial territory. The fun really begins as players slither around and over the top of other players trying to stay on top while holding the most territory.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/toreshgames/serpent-master-the-game]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Every Day is Night
notes.notes:
Try to become the city's best mixologist for the night in a marble drafting cocktail recipe fulfillment game On The Rocks!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/014/9bMzQBVtHY1xg1jvz3UTc7.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/on-the-rocks]On The Rocks[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 45-60 minutes[/u]

Welcome to On The Rocks cocktail lounge, where only the city's best Mixologist expertly prepares cocktails patrons are craving. In this competitive mixology game, players complete drink orders for money and additional tips, but beware of the mixologists removing ingredients from your drinks.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pentreegames/on-the-rocks-3]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Seat of Power
notes.notes:
Capture, gerrymander, and maybe even betray your morals to win in the political strategy board game SHASN.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/018/42yqzHzP0Vt8C7fLuJGyQa0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/shasn-the-political-strategy-board-game]SHASN[/url][/h1]
[u]3-5 players; 1.5-2 hours[/u]

You are a politician in the middle of a heated election. Prepare to make tough policy decisions, earn and manage resources and voters, adapt to the changing news landscape, and find yourself in constant stages of negotiation and sabotage. Experience the short-term and long-term pressures of decision making and be alert to the constantly shifting balance of power.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/zainmemon/shasn-the-political-strategy-board-game-break-ks]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Medieval Mayhem
notes.notes:
Pit your wits against your enemies and watch them crumble in defeat as you defend your stronghold and plot their destruction in the Kastles boardgame.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/983/sHFb6jvAb73qGmEY03FkT3.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/kastles]Kastles[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 10-20 minutes[/u]

Kastles is a fast and furious mini strategy defence card game: a real punch-up in your pocket. Every game is different as you use your cards to plan your attacks, deploying gunpowder, flaming arrows, lethal catapults, saboteurs and even a wizard to control and command the fearsome dragon. A 20-minute game that’s easy to learn, fun to play and not very educational.

notes.title: Where the Dungeon Pets Are
notes.notes:
Buy baby monsters! Feed them and watch them grow! Clean their cages! Win or lose, you are sure to enjoy the Dungeon Petz board game!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/003/mDCTAMcyqMt4xk39Un5y13.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dungeon-petz-by-vlaada-chvatil]Dungeon Petz[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 1-2 hours[/u]

Become the leader of an imp family that has just started a new business – breeding and selling petz. Sound simple and safe? Well, we forgot to mention that those petz are for Dungeon Lords. This means magical, playful, sometimes angry monsters that constantly desire attention and at the very moment you want them to demonstrate their qualities to buyers they are sick or they poop. Sometimes you are even glad that you got rid of them – but the profit is unbelievable.

notes.title: Man Creates Dinosaurs
notes.notes:
Build and run your own successful dinosaur park in worker placement game DinoGenics!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/003/CCHhOKYZE0SVascw4nYjt0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dinogenics]DinoGenics[/url][/h1]
[u]1-5 players; 1.5-2 hours[/u]

Each player is the head of their own corporation with access to their own private island resort. Each season, players assign agents to the mainland to compete over DNA and other limited resources. Once collected, players can build fences, various park facilities and populate their parks with dinosaurs. Parks with the most prestigious dinosaurs will attract the most visitors. But beware; if dinosaurs are neglected or improperly penned, they will attempt to escape and spread havoc through the entire park.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1541227444/dinogenics-controlled-chaos-and-2nd-printing]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Against Evil Genius
notes.notes:
Compete to construct the greatest fantasy characters, gather information about the looming threat and prepare for a final showdown against the beast!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/953/jbtBWdQoAerTPr4x8QPqu0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/roll-player-monsters-minions]Roll Player: Monsters & Minions[/url][/h1]
[u]1-5 players; 1-2 hours[/u]

A call to arms! An abomination is terrorizing villages throughout the kingdom, leaving behind a path of death and destruction. The king has summoned all able-bodied adventurers to return to the capital and organize a plan to rid the kingdom of this menace.

Where is the Monster's lair? What obstacles will there be along the way? What will its next strike be? Players earn additional Reputation Stars by driving back the evil Monster and its Minions. The player with the most impressive reputation wins the game and becomes heir to the kingdom!

notes.title: In the Lair of the Black Dragon
notes.notes:
Free six mythical creatures, trap wicked Black Dragon and collect treasures along the way in solitaire game Crystallo.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/986/9nTrpDXi32upZbAGx5Kcq1.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/crystallo-solitaire-puzzle-game]Crystallo[/url][/h1]
[u]1 player; 20-30 minutes[/u]

Crystallo is a solo puzzle/abstract card game with a light fantasy theme. Explore the cavern lair of the wicked Black Dragon by placing cards, free six magical creatures by creating crystal sets, and, if you should succeed with that task, trap the dragon in his own cave. Collect treasure along the way, and you may emerge a wealthy champion!

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lightheartgames/crystallo-the-award-winning-solitaire-puzzle-game]Kickstarter[/url] (Late Pledge)![/b]

notes.title: Deep Blue and Blazing Red
notes.notes:
Connect as many exits on your board as possible in the multiplayer puzzle game Railroad Ink.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/984/tYM6roiTzdSjDEow8I3nZ4.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/railroad-ink]Railroad Ink[/url][/h1]
[u]1-6 players; 20-30 minutes[/u]

New lands have opened up and the race is on to create the best network of rail and road lines through it. In Railroad Ink, players roll the Route dice and must then draw the subsequent results on their individual Route boards.

The Deep Blue Edition brings Rivers and Lakes to the board, giving players more ways to create Routes and score points. The Blazing Red Edition challenges players with falling Meteors and erupting Volcanoes. Can players keep their Routes together amid all the carnage?

notes.title: Castle That Dragon Built
notes.notes:
Use all of your cunning to build a castle that will inspire people in Dragon Castle board game.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/965/qpkhbaayFDstcyqmZIWTnD.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dragon-castle]Dragon Castle[/url] [/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 30-45 minutes[/u]

Dragon Castle is a game freely inspired by Mahjong Solitaire. During your turn, you take a pair of identical tiles from the central "castle" (known as the Dragon Castle) and place them on your own realm board to build your own castle. From time to time, you may sacrifice these tiles to acquire shrines in their place.

When the Dragon Castle has been reduced to only one floor, the end of the game is triggered. After one final round, the player with the most points is the lord of the new Dragon Castle…and the winner of the game!

notes.title: Maddest Hatter
notes.notes:
Compete to acquire the most outstanding hats and become the maddest!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/977/H1e8GSrdoH3KfyOBLtYFS7.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/hats]Hats[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 20-30 minutes[/u]

You have an invitation at 5 pm at the Mad Hatter’s garden. The table is ready, the cookies taste like buttery heaven, and the tea is strong and spicy. 

[b]"More Sugar?" [/b]

The Mad Hatter gives you a bizarre look. “Yes pl…” 

[b]"Time's up!" [/b]

He interrupts you. Sugar, cookies, and millions of hats fly everywhere. Tea spills all over the tablecloth as he proceeds with a huge smile on his face. 

[b]"It's time to play a game"[/b]

notes.title: Misty Mountain
notes.notes:
Mine, Forge and Fight your way through a Mountain full of Gold and Goblins in Dwarf board game!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/886/u9KMuUPoy8dZLomzm5oMzO.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dwarf]Dwarf[/url][/h1]
[u]1-5 players; 15-20 minutes[/u]

In Zanziar, dwarfs dedicate their lives to society. Everything is done for the communal good and dwarfs stoically sacrifice their time - and their lives - for others. Not all dwarfs are created equal though - some are honoured and valued for their greater contributions to dwarfkind.

In Dwarf, you will explore the halls and mineshafts of the mountain as you seek metals, with which to forge spectacular weapons and insignia. Other races are jealous of the dwarfs’ success, however, and you will also have to help protect the Mountain from these monstrous invaders.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ddpgames/dwarf-board-game]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Little Green Box
notes.notes:
Try one of sixteen games (family, strategy, solo and classic) from Green Box collection!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/948/0vUN1viNto4UCqyH58yGHA.png[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/green-box-of-games]Green Box of Games[/url][/h1]
[u]1-8 players; 5 minutes - 3 hours[/u]

The Green Box of Games is a game system that comes with a collection of 16 games you can play. Designed to be like a deck of cards for board games the box is filled with versatile components, tiles, cards, cubes and dice, that you can use to play lots of different games, or even create your own. The games included in the rulebook spans from quick family games to more complex strategy games, plus a few traditional classics, and includes solo games as well as games for up to 8 or 10 people.

notes.title: Order Versus Chaos
notes.notes:
Build up your hero as you play, getting tougher, faster, deadlier in Eternal Adversary board game. Will you fight for Order or Chaos?

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/962/3Z3GiGQqyoB8V8NrxJgMm6.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/eternal-adversary]Eternal Adversary[/url][/h1]
[u]2-6 players; 1.5 hours[/u]

Millennia ago, a cataclysmic event tore time apart when the agents of Chaos tried to change history and wipe out mankind. Now countless timelines of earth exist, with the different Ancient Empires of man thriving to this day. Chaos has begun the final battle to destroy all of the timelines of Earth.

A single timeline of Earth must remain for humankind. The ancient warrior societies must band together to fight for existence and Chaos must destroy Earth if they are to have a future in this final timeline. Which side will you choose?

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/petersengames/eternal-adversary]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Subway
notes.notes:
Develop the Underground and attract passenger traffic in a remastered edition of the clever network-building game On the Underground.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/956/iHgXjlMDXn7HuI1sKsZTL0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/on-the-underground]On the Underground[/url][/h1]
[u]2-5 players; 1 hour[/u]

The massive network of London Underground stations makes up one of the most complex transportation systems in the world, and On the Underground challenges you to develop it. Build the most successful lines, connect them to landmarks and attract passenger traffic!

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ludicreations/on-the-underground-london-berlin?ref=1ldxq4]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Championship of Timelines
notes.notes:
Take part in the greatest entertainment spectacle ever staged with Super Fantasy Brawl board game!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/955/KTmQggcFnk0tOlAHXSAgM1.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/superfantasybrawl]Super Fantasy Brawl[/url][/h1]
[u]2 players; 20-40 minutes[/u]

Super Fantasy Brawl is a fun, fast-paced competitive miniatures board game. Players select a team of three champions and combine their unique action cards to create a synergistic action deck. The game is faction-free, so players have their choice of any combination of champions they wish. Each turn, the players use their hand of action cards to maneuver, attack, displace enemies, and claim objectives to score victory points.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1162110258/super-fantasy-brawl]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Saving Hasselhoff
notes.notes:
Become heroic White Cell Agents and dive into Templetown, the body-wide city thriving inside Stanley Hasselhoff.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/955/YK9WcdhZMPZbxzeqi1TbX6.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/trouble-in-templetown]Trouble in Templetown[/url][/h1]
[u]1-4 players; 45-90 minutes[/u]

Trouble in Templetown is an immersive cooperative & competitive game (1-4 players) wherein you take the role of White Cell Agents, fighting against assaulting germs and viruses. Your mission is to keep the germs in check while building enough immunity walls to insulate Stanley from the spreading infection. Fail at that, and you'll have one last shot at saving his life by taking on the virus behind this whole thing in an all-or-nothing face-off…"

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2fat2fly/trouble-in-templetown]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Welcome to the Wilds
notes.notes:
Build your deck by choosing and shuffling together 3 different Animal factions and try to take down your opponent’s Strongholds in Untamed: Feral Factions.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/947/Cbfj8c9pN8irfEq8cOEHz6.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/untamed]Untamed: Feral Factions[/url][/h1]
[u]2 players; 20-30 minutes[/u]

Untamed: Feral Factions is a fast-paced shuffle-building card battle game. Players each take control of three animal factions that battle together to bring down the opponent's three Strongholds. Each faction has its own unique appearance, Stronghold, and play style. By combining three different factions each game, players will be able to discover new synergies, combos and strategies.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/grumpyowlgames/untamed-feral-factions]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Somewhere Under the Sea
notes.notes:
Escape the Kraken in the solo and cooperative dive, or go head-to-head in a heart-pounding race against other divers in a combo-driven nautical adventure The Refuge: Terror from the Deep.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/943/YiOa1KwUvY1xfnA4jzpiT1.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-refuge-terror-from-the-deep]The Refuge: Terror from the Deep[/url][/h1]
[u]1-6 players; 20-60 minutes[/u]

Due to extensive use of nuclear weapons during The Great War, much of Europe’s surface has become uninhabitable. Controlling the deep sea is now the key to global power.

Breakthroughs in underwater technology have followed military necessity: new methods for propelling divers and submersibles, better diving suits, and compact breathing systems.

No longer tethered to air hoses, divers are venturing deeper and further into the sea than ever before. Maybe too deep…

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bnbgames/the-refuge-terror-from-the-deep]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: A Colder War
notes.notes:
Take control of one of the two powers and wage wars of political and military influence in Europe Divided.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/924/gddyhiayxGoyOl6Od89PtB.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/europe-divided]Europe Divided[/url][/h1]
[u]2 players; 60-75 minutes[/u]

Europe Divided is rich with history, but features a quick-playing card-driven core mechanic. Players use cards associated with countries they control to establish political and military influence, gain money, and build and deploy their military strength. An elegant deck-manipulation mechanism weakens players’ decks as they grow their influence, creating a tension point between seeking to expand and over-reaching. Players also compete over key political events throughout the game. Will the Velvet Divorce result in the split of the Czech Republic and Slovakia? How will the Bosnian War end? The players will decide the fate of history throughout this period of Europe Divided. 

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/phalanxgames/europe-divided]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Make your Fate!
notes.notes:
Create the hero with the greatest destiny by acquiring traits, facing challenges, and overcoming adversaries!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/900/cXxbEMyVOUwTZ8K3y9lz93.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/call-to-adventure-2019]Call to Adventure[/url][/h1]
[u]1-4 players; 30-60 minutes[/u]

Call to Adventure features a unique "rune rolling" system for resolving challenges, a point-based system that encourages storytelling, and over 150 unique cards. Players begin each game with an origin card that provides their backstory as well as two "starter" abilities. Each round they may either acquire trait cards from the board or face a challenge. Challenges each have two possible paths a player can choose from. For example, players who encounter the Thieves' Guild may choose to train as a spy, or train as a killer. Each challenge has a difficulty that must be overcome by rolling successes on carved runes. The more a player has of the abilities required to overcome the challenge, the more runes they will be able to cast.

notes.title: Harvesters of the Galaxy
notes.notes:
Extract the valuable resources and form uneasy truces in strategic negotiation game Afternova!
 
[h1][img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/925/ji0FKX9yDLy2m7NgdvJA3B.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/afternova]Afternova[/url][/h1]
[u]3-6 players; 30-60 minutes[/u]
A nearby solar system has been obliterated by a supernova. Now is your time to move in and extract the valuable resources from its unstable planets. But these jobs are too dangerous to do alone. Send in teams of Hired Paws and form uneasy truces with your rivals to come away with the best loot. 

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roadtoinfamy/afternova]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Changing Leaves of Ever Tree
notes.notes:
Lead a group of critters, construct buildings, meet lively characters and host events in Everdell!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/836/NPGxqT6jp0TxTnmo0zuZw4.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/everdell]Everdell[/url][/h1]
[u]1-4 players; 40-90 minutes[/u]

Within the charming valley of Everdell, beneath the boughs of towering trees, among meandering streams and mossy hollows, a civilization of forest critters is thriving and expanding. From Everfrost to Bellsong, many a year have come and gone, but the time has come for new territories to be settled and new cities established. You will be the leader of a group of critters intent on just such a task. Will the sun shine brightest on your city before the winter moon rises?

notes.title: Blood for Roses
notes.notes:
Claim glory wreaths and lead your gladiator school to victory in card game Gladiatores.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/882/AOCVeCdaKcVxLV3FTqDec2.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/gladiatores-blood-for-roses]Gladiatores: Blood for Roses[/url][/h1]
Gladiatores: Blood for Roses is a devious bidding and betting combat focused card game for 2-5 players. Play as the owner of a famous gladiator school vying for control of the colosseum in Rome by attracting the most famous gladiators in history to fight for you in deadly arena battles!

Win the game by impressing the crowd, outmaneuvering other players and showing off your gladiator's best fighting skills to gain precious glory wreaths.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jdee/gladiatores-blood-for-roses-0]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: For Glory and Loot!
notes.notes:
Build the most glorious Viking longboat (and beware sheeps)!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/917/bZXBr79KtRRSGoRrtHjCW0.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/longboat]Longboat[/url] is a strategic drafting game in which for 2-4 players compete to build the most glorious Viking longboat.

Players take it in turns to draft cards from a central pool called The River and add them to their boat. Scoring or 'Glory' is based on a number of factors, including the loyalty of the vikings on board and the amount of Loot the player has amassed.

Special cards activate abilities, such as Berserkers that allow a player to steal loot from another's boat. Or sheep that are used to weigh down opponents and rob them of glory.

The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wighthartgames/longboat-the-card-game]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Legendary Villagers
notes.notes:
Choose and enhance an unique Hero in deck building game Village of Legends!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/911/ggPgtFLzy7t3U3tRoDzLy20.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/village-of-legends]Village of Legends[/url][/h1]
[u]2 players; 15-45 minutes[/u]

Village of Legends is a deck building game where players choose a unique Hero and enhance them throughout the game by combining their individual skills with purchased items from the market including; weapons, spells, scrolls, treasures and more. 

Players can also hire creatures to do their bidding and distract their opponents preventing them from accessing the market. By killing opponents' monsters Heroes gain experience points and learn new abilities by reaching defined XP levels becoming even more powerful.

[b] The game with expansion is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/villageoflegends/village-of-legends-the-reapers-hand]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Crouching Dog, Hidden Dragon
notes.notes:
Try Tichu, a partnership climbing card game based on a standard 52-card deck with four additional special cards.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/862/m0COwRfCFyYCmMkInnA7z7.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tichu]Tichu[/url][/h1]
[u]2-8 players; 1 hour[/u]

Tichu belongs to a family of Chinese card games referred to as "climbing games" by John McLeod. It is an evolution of Zheng Fen ("competing for points"). Tichu shares Zheng Fen's set of scoring cards (Kings, Tens, and Fives) and a subset of Zheng Fen's playable combinations. In Zheng Fen the primary goal is to capture scoring cards during trick play. Tichu shares this goal but introduces partnership play and newer/overriding goals which focus primarily on emptying your hand of cards before the opposing team members. Tichu also introduces 4 special cards. The Phoenix and the Dragon replace the 2 jokers in the Chinese game. In the Chinese game, the jokers can be used as the highest single cards or as wild cards in combinations.

notes.title: Birth of New Language
notes.notes:
Take part in creation of Volgare language in Medieval Italy!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/891/K614qiM9GsTWLwStC7is50.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/de-vulgari-eloquentia-deluxe-edition]De Vulgari Eloquentia: Deluxe Edition[/url][/h1]
[u]4-5 players; 1.5-2 hours[/u]

Italy, late Middle Ages: The fabric merchants need to write down their contracts in a language that everyone can understand, and the literates are looking for an alternative to the elite of the traditional Latin language, so the Volgare, the language spoken by the common people, taken from the dialects spoken in the various Italian regions, starts to gain relevance. During this period, Francesco D'Assisi writes his famous Canticle of the Sun and Dante writes the Divine Comedy, both written in Volgare.

In De Vulgari Eloquentia, players have to do their part in the creation of this new language! But who will provide them the proper knowledge to understand the manuscripts in the different dialects? Who will successfully uncover the secrets of the books inside the Papal Library? Who will embrace the religious life, and who will remain a merchant? Some of the players can become a famous banker, someone else can climb the church's hierarchy to be the next Pope! But in the end, who will be the most appreciated and respected for their status and culture?

The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/166119889/de-vulgari-eloquentia-deluxe-edition]Kickstarter[/url] and [url=https://www.giochistarter.it/scheda.php?item=1001669&crowd=1&lingua=0]Giochistarter[/url]!

notes.title: The Sorcerers' Apprentices
notes.notes:
Cast spells, learn arcane runes, and fight for the favour of your professors in Runika!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/895/ew91mMcy1vHIMmEEgRXBV5.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/six-sided-spellbooks]Runika and the Six-sided Spellbooks[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 60-90 minutes[/u]

Each turn, you will draw dice from a bag, roll them, and then use them as currency to create runes and collect points, or to gain the favour of your professors.

The game utilises a unique twist on dice management, to see you pattern-match and puzzle-solve your way to victory.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/foxtale/runika-and-the-six-sided-spellbooks]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Struggle of Incarnates
notes.notes:
Gather team of Heroes to face off against stalwart, quirky, and skill-testing Bosses that come equipped with their own special deck of cards!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/891/08l9dAhtaoDaUXpDFL6Td1.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/raid-boss]Raid Boss[/url][/h1]
[u]1-4 players; 45-90 minutes[/u]

Raid Boss is a 1-4 player cooperative battle puzzle designed like a strategy RPG. It keeps all of the teamwork, combos, and collaboration, but none of the endless grinding! You control a Hero with a mechanically distinct and heavily themed set of abilities. Each Hero has an Assist that can be used at ANY time - including other players’ turns!

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/skeletonhand/raid-boss-a-dangerous-cooperative-battle-for-1-4-h-0]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: I'm no Superman
notes.notes:
Build the clinic of your dreams - hire doctors, nurses, and maintenance staff; build new modules, offer specialized treatment, and even build a parking lot or two!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/884/4FRyZxL4RdxqMM2013SDJ1.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/clinic]CliniC: Deluxe Edition[/url][/h1]
[u]1-4 players; 1-2.5 hours[/u]

Your Town Center is flourishing, but as the city grows, the need for emergency medical care grows with it. Fortunately, you and your business partners have the wherewithal to build a clinic to help those in need of more than first aid. You quickly get a pre-admissions facility built to help process and route the different cases into the appropriate queues.

Unfortunately, just before groundbreaking, your differing views of the ideal clinic cause a schism between you, and you go your separate ways, with patients already lining up in pre-admissions. Each of you decides to build the clinic of your dreams, trying to hire doctors, nurses, and maintenance staff, and build new modules, specialized services, and even parking, in order to meet the needs of the patients ailing in pre-admissions.

This is your Clinic! Build it however you like to give patients the care they need, so you can make your Clinic the most popular one in town!

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/avstudio-ludibooster/clinic-deluxe-edition]Kickstarter![/url][/b]

notes.title: Real Men Play Hockey
notes.notes:
Feel all the key aspects of Hockey, while gameplay is staying streamlined and fun!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/886/euSOxyKxPqtGqwwJUoRO27.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dicehockey]Trick Shot[/url][/h1][u]2-4 players; 30-90 minutes[/u]

Trick Shot is a fast-paced Ice Hockey board game with cool plastic miniatures and a streamlined ruleset. Whether you are a hardcore hockey fan, or a board-gamer, looking for a challenging tactical skirmish - we’ve got you covered!

Trick Shot combines grid movement and press-your-luck mechanisms into a quick to play and quick to setup fun boardgaming experience. Trick Shot strikes a fine balance between luck and strategy, while being easy to explain and get to the table.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wolffdesigna/trick-shot]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Dumb, Dumber and Dumbest
notes.notes:
Play as one of the world leaders left on earth, after aliens have collected the intelligent people to inhabit their new and improved version of our planet!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/862/DG2DmtvJAWPd0AdZkgkKT3.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/world-dumbination]World Dumbination[/url][/h1]
[u]2-5 players; 50-120 minutes[/u]

The game board is a map of the world where players build military bases and move units. Cards are used for a whole range of actions, for yourself and your opponents. So in short the game is all about combining the best card actions with clever movement on the board!

Each player has different starting points, as you can choose to play the leader of the USA, Venezuela, Turkey, Russia – or, of course, North Korea!

In case the players get too clever, there are Dumbness cards in the mix to make sure some kind of stupidity will take place. These cards can give you the Nobel Peace Prize, change targets for you actions, or change things in almost every possible way.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/muzakgames/world-dumbination]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Alternate Storyline
notes.notes:
Return to the world of Anachrony and change the fate of New Earth in a new expansion!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/865/npR73QjDzDuisf5Cmlpp72.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/anachrony-fractures-of-time]Anachrony: Fractures of Time[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 1-2.5 hours[/u]

In the alternate storyline of Fractures of Time, Anachrony’s first major expansion, the four original Paths and the newly formed, sanguine Path of Unity have gained access to a powerful new technology called Flux. Flux Cores can be acquired in the Amethynia Valley, the expansion’s new main zone. By using the Flux Cores to power up their Fracture device, players may move (“Blink”) one of their already placed Exosuits to a new action space instead of placing a new one, or immediately retrieve some of their Workers or Free Action markers. This can result in never-before-seen action efficiency, but just like the Time Rifts, the Flux technology is a double-edged sword. Without a sufficiently advanced Fracture device, overusing it can cause Temporal Glitches; hectic negative effects such as shutting down the Exosuit bay slots, temporarily disabling buildings, or making players more prone to Anomalies.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/024/779/878/fdeda05d375139c9ed515e05033bcfe2_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-1.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1555354441&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=c97a6d5257495faec084f27990437b0d[/img]

[b]Note that you can back Anachrony: Fractures of Time Expansion and Infinity Box on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/438141406/anachrony-fractures-of-time-expansion-and-infinity]Kickstarter[/url]! [/b]

notes.title: Underwater Cosmos
notes.notes:
Enter a vast, underwater cosmos: a mysterious interconnected world of sharp teeth, glowing eyes, and black ink.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/868/dhOb2yAuq5v0RZ1pt57Zd5.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/oceans]Oceans[/url][/h1]
[u]2-6 players; 45-105 minutes[/u]

Oceans portrays the dynamic ecosystem that exists below the water’s surface through the specific traits of individual species and the interaction of those traits among species to determine which species survive, which thrive, and which go extinct.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/024/347/165/351f30cd3842f1b9f76b5312541d835d_original.gif?ixlib=rb-1.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1552064794&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=c9c5c72ceba03ba7c0e7a18bf151f418[/img]

[b]The game is raised more than 2000% of funds on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/northstargames/oceans-a-standalone-game-in-the-evolution-series]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: VENOM Assault
notes.notes:
Defeat global terrorist organization VENOM before they unleash havoc upon the world!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/865/MJ8ead6wndz7XopiPrK8p7.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/venom-assault]VENOM Assault[/url][/h1]
[u]1-5 players; 30-90 minutes[/u]

VENOM Assault is a cooperative deck building game with dice-based combat. Players will use their turns to recruit new Freedom Squadron Soldiers and Vehicles into their hands that they will use to challenge one of the seven VENOM leaders on the board. Each card will have set abilities that can help bring about victory, but VENOM can also call upon their own troops to help them out as well.

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/supermouse/venom-assault-villains-and-valor]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Modules of Infinity
notes.notes:
Dear Tabletopians, now premium users can play such modules from [b]Anachrony: Infinity Box[/b] as Doomsday, Pioneers of New Earth and Guardians of the council. They were also added to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/869241/Tabletopia__Anachrony__Modules/]Steam DLC[/url] (so owners already have access), and the [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/anachrony]base game[/url] is free from now!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/791/hi4YTdKrilTaZGsA6yqxzA.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/anachrony-modules]Anachrony: Modules[/url][/h1][h1][u]2-4 players; 1-2.5 hours[/u][/h1]

It wasn’t long until the Paths realized that the powerful Exosuits can offer more than mere protection to their Workers. Through new engineering and scientific solutions, they developed methods to improve their Exosuit models with Neutronium, Uranium, Titanium, and even scientific Breakthroughs. This way, even the more dangerous areas of the Outback became accessible, with their vast amount of salvageable materials, forgotten relics of the Old World - and, of course, new dangers to face.

notes.title: Martian Chronicles
notes.notes:
Try yourself as a pioneer in the development of the biggest, most advanced colony on Mars!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/850/ctllZRDfVzNLdyxzyZcVnR0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/on-mars]On Mars[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 1-3 hours[/u]

In 2037, the first settlers arrived on Mars! The base camp was already settled and now, during the next fifty years, a group of very brave people from private space exploration companies are establishing a major colony ruled by a terrestrial organization, the D.O.M.E. (Department of Operations for Mars Exploration).

The goal of humanity on this new planet is to learn how to value water, air and the the things we need to live more than money — and in the end, become a self-sufficient colony independent of any terrestrial organization. Do you dare to take part in mankind's next biggest conquest?

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/024/753/546/1c2a49f6a0c2ae304630d1f4af96ae82_original.png?ixlib=rb-1.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1555107733&auto=format&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=9f3cab38fa682965af33c68c8f6d2604[/img]

[b]The game was successfully funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eaglegryphon/on-mars-by-vital-lacerda-with-artwork-by-ian-otool]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Dance of Swords
notes.notes:
Face the endless challenges in Warriors Legacy!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/856/bzXNh1Sq7xC6aKyefCwq79.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/warriors]Warriors Legacy[/url][/h1]
[u]2 players; 30-60 minutes[/u]

Warriors has been created by passionate artists that have the vision to create a card game that completely eliminates the fact that you might need a certain build of some sorts to survive against another build.

This game is so brutal that if you're lucky enough and your strategy matches up just right you might be able to take out the fiercest foe you've ever faced.

notes.title: Anti-Corruption Operation
notes.notes:
Travel, explore and fight in a Galaxy at war to prevent an ancient entity known as the Corruption in a new game X-ODUS from [url=http://boredgameink.com/]Bored Game Ink[/url].

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/846/yQEXllzE2yD3YvsCOZdbX7.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/x-odus-rise-of-the-corruption][h1]X-ODUS - Rise of the Corruption[/h1][/url]
[u]1-4 players; 1.5-2.5 hours[/u]

A cooperative adventure and tactical board game. Set in the distant future, players take command of powerful and unique spaceships. They travel, explore and fight in a Galaxy at war to prevent an ancient entity known as the Corruption to rise and destroy all life.

[b]Coming soon on Kickstarter! (start is planned for June 4th)[/b]

notes.title: One small step for computer
notes.notes:
Simulate being a computer program in the Apollo XI lunar module's on-board computer and try to help astronauts to land safely in board game MOON.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/842/WtJRwuBzhSZMHsvVg6qxk5.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/moon]MOON[/url][/h1]

In 1969, millions of people around the [b]Earth[/b] gathered around their television sets to witness an event that was happening 384,000 km away. The Eagle lunar landing was on its way to land on the [b]moon[/b], and it relied on the non-stop calculations of its [b]on-board computer[/b], which accomplished this with less computing power than a modern digital watch. 

However, three minutes before landing, the computer triggered several [b]alarms[/b]: a radar that should have been switched off during the landing procedure unexpectedly switched on. The on-board computer, which needed to devote its [b]scarce[/b] computing resources to landing the lunar module, could easily become overwhelmed by this extra work. 

Fortunately, the software that managed the on-board computer, designed by a team of engineers led by [b]Margaret Hamilton[/b], was smart enough to detect the problem. The computer alerted the astronauts, effectively saying [u]"I am overloaded with more tasks than I should be doing right now, so I'm going to focus only on the important tasks, those that have to do with landing."[/u] 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/024/533/216/1f52ebba34bdf459be2d4098ac4ef01f_original.png?ixlib=rb-1.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1553532332&auto=format&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=ef127c8c887200ffb923e232e3af3fd8[/img]

[b]Game was funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/garaizar/moon-0]Kickstarter[/url] in 10 hours![/b]

notes.title: Return to Glen More
notes.notes:
Become a Scottish clan leader in Glen More II: Chronicles from [url=http://funtails.de/en/welcome/]Funtails[/url]. This game is a sequel to Glen More, expanding the gameplay substantially compared to the original.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/842/qcUgG34y6uqQtsdIU2pZR6.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/glen-more-ii-chronicles]Glen More II: Chronicles[/url][/h1]
[u] 2-4 players; 1-2 hours [/u]

In this game, each player represents the leader of a Scottish clan from the early medieval ages until the 19th century, a leader looking to expand their territory and wealth. The success of your clan depends on your ability to make the right decision at the right time, be it by creating a new pasture for your livestock, growing barley for whisky production, selling your goods on the various markets, or gaining control of special landmarks such as lochs and castles.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/024/402/430/4693218680929d88b66ef91c0812b508_original.png?ixlib=rb-1.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1552490328&auto=format&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=85bb3da82ecaf3aceb113a69e12fa0c0[/img]

[b]The game was successfully funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/funtails/glen-more-ii-chronicles]Kickstarter[/url] and you still have a chance to make a pledge![/b]

notes.title: Woe to the Vanquished
notes.notes:
Challenge yourself as Roman patrician trying solve problems with barbarians, workers, mercenaries and senators in semi-competitive game of decline and treachery!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/787/7D5yaFyeEVFtX2lO2UG2d9.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/vae-victis]Vae Victis[/url][/h1]
[u]2–6 players; 20–40 minutes[/u]

Rome is going to hell. Redneck barbarians are raiding the borders, the economy is in freefall, and the sewer workers are on strike...again. To top it all, mercenaries and slaves have delusions of grandeur (they want to be paid, for Jupiter's sake!), while those petty pencil pushers at the Senate indulge in never-ending rhetoric displays. As a wealthy patrician, you're pretty sure it is expected that you lend your help to Rome in this dire time of need, but then again will your "friends" do the same? The Ides of March are around the corner...

[b]Game is already funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1031232934/vae-victis-a-tabletop-game-about-decline-and-treac]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Sweet dreams are made of this
notes.notes:
Incarnate a dreamer collecting dreamshards in mysterious locations and create dreamscapes with these shards, stroll along paths, climb mountains and pass through waterfalls. 

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/835/6BUXfZn6rLxYwLj3Ppf8k3.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dreamscape_2019]Dreamscape[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 30-45 minutes[/u]

Dreamscape is a unique "dream building" game. It offers a game experience that cannot be compared to any other game, with a unique combination of route-planning, resource collecting and ultimately building your own little Dreamworld as a small tableau. In the end, the wonderful dreamscapes you will create will leave you with a magical feeling, constantly renewed.

notes.title: Worlds of Mystery
notes.notes:
Meet three mystical card games from [url=https://japanimegames.com/]Japanime Games[/url] and [url=https://www.dominagames.com/]Domina Games[/url]. Explore Frontier Town in the hopes of finding Eden in Argoat; escape a sinking island while rescuing precious relics in Pralaya; or take a wander through the Wonders of Miraris!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/830/tDwIZfA1OjuJGBF33MRPV1.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/argoat]Argoat[/url][/h1]
[u]3-5 players; 45-60 minutes[/u]

In your pursuit of ancient knowledge, you have learned that the legendary paradise of Eden has reemerged somewhere in the world. Stories claim that Eden is a land of beauty without compare, and that its residents are bestowed with eternal life. However, the way to Eden is not open to all. Should it be discovered, the paradise will once again fade into darkness.

Your sources indicate that Eden slumbers somewhere in the vicinity of a certain Frontier Town. In order to discern its exact location, you must first seek the eight Fragments of Ancient Knowledge hidden across the land. As you arrive in the Frontier Town, you meet the eyes of several other outsiders who no doubt have the same goal in mind.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/835/OlxyhcXzFKbscM9yjRLUT9.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/pralaya]Pralaya[/url][/h1]
[u]2-5 players; 20-30 minutes[/u]

Long ago, there was an island nation in the southern sea that enjoyed a great period of cultural prosperity. Surrounded by natural beauty and gifted with tremendous intellect, the island's residents believed their peaceful lifestyle would go on for all time.

But one morning, a fearsome demon broke free and began to drag the island into the depths of the sea. With the end growing near, the king ordered his most loyal retainers to gather as much of the nation's knowledge and as many of the island's treasures as they could, and flee to the northern lands.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/833/eQxArZNxVHRJPrPV9OYoa3.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/miraris]Miraris[/url][/h1]
[u]3-6 players; 10-20 minutes[/u]

As you gaze into an antique mirror, a strange and wonderful land comes into focus. A world of mystery and dreams awaits within the reflection. But, you're not alone; another figure stands beside you.

Discover the secrets of the Dream World, reflected in the antique mirror, as you explore its many Wonders. The Wonders, however, can only be visited by one person at a time. You will need to think carefully about where you wish to visit, as other visitors may make the same choice - leaving you both without entry. But if you make it through, bountiful rewards await.

[b]Check out [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/370924922/domina-anthology-featuring-pralaya-miraris-and-arg]Kickstarter campaign[/url] to learn more about these games![/b]

notes.title: Through the Wastelands and Wilderness
notes.notes:
Become the greatest cartographer of the Kingdom of Nalos in Cartographers: A Roll Player Tale! 

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/813/pqWya81js7Td90hSUx1L27.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/cartographers-a-roll-player-tale]Cartographers: A Roll Player Tale[/url][/h1]
[u]1-6 players; 30-45 minutes[/u]

Queen Gimnax has ordered the reclamation of the northern lands. As a cartographer in her service, you are sent to map this territory, claiming it for the Kingdom of Nalos. Through official edicts, the queen announces which lands she prizes most, and you will increase your reputation by meeting her demands. But you are not alone in this wilderness. The Dragul contest your claims with their outposts, so you must draw your lines carefully to reduce their influence. Reclaim the greatest share of the queen’s desired lands and you will be declared the greatest cartographer in the kingdom. 

[b]The game is also available on [url=https://itunes.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1274379679?mt=8]iOS[/url] and [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Tabletopia.TabletopiaApp]Android[/url] tablets![/b]

notes.title: Fresh Blood
notes.notes:
Become Vampire or Hunter in dynamic, re-imagined deck builder Crave setted in a modern fantasy world!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/829/x0MeGg21DnEdCYPPUFfkw0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/crave]Crave[/url][/h1]
[u]2 players; 25-35 minutes[/u]

Today, Vampires still roam our streets and influence those around them to do their bidding. Vampire Hunters are not far behind, using whatever makeshift weapons they can find, including hockey sticks, garlic stun-guns, yield sign shields, and anything else that will help. 

You’ll represent either Vampires or Vampire Hunters to defeat your rival. Along your path, you’ll need the help of others, including werewolves, human groupies who want to join your side, elves, giants, and a host of other creatures. Who will win? It’s up to your choices as you build a force set on ruling the night. 

[b]Game was successfully funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/blackforeststudio/crave-a-strategic-deck-building-card-game-for-2-pl]Kickstarter[/url], and you still have a time to choose side in eternal battle...[/b]

notes.title: Siege of Holy City
notes.notes:
To the trenches! Waylay your besieged foe or outlast the onslaught of the invaders - only one will emerge victorious.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/826/EKc9mr24zqvQyyMf86ZuZS.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/freedom]Freedom![/url][/h1]
[u]2 Players, 1.5-2 Hours[/u]

It's a siege game, a test of will, endurance and tactics between the besieged freedom fighters and the besieging imperial forces, who have come to crush the rebellion. This universal contest is presented through a dramatic history of the siege of a Greek Holy City (Messolonghi) by Ottoman forces during the Greek War of Independence. 
 

[b]Note that this highly asymmetrical game is available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/phalanxgames/freedom-4]Kickstarter[/url] right now![/b]

notes.title: Conclave Power
notes.notes:
Perform good deeds, sabotage your friends, and become Pope in this fast-paced take-that card game for 2-8 players.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/824/5h6mp0RaMEhpAVTuRp9Km3.png[/img]
[h1] [/h1][h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/pope-or-nope]Pope or Nope[/url][/h1]
[u]2-8 Players; 20-30 Minutes[/u]

His Holiness Pope Peter II lies on his deathbed. You are among the few Cardinals he trusts to serve as his successor, but you have to earn it by performing good deeds. To complicate things, the other Cardinals won't go down without a fight; they'll do everything they can to sabotage your every move. Pay them back in kind. 

[b]You may also support [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1406587118/pope-or-nope]Kickstarter Campaign[/url] of the game![/b]

notes.title: Neon Killer
notes.notes:
Try yourself in survival horror, exploration board game Halls of Horror inspired by movies like Cube. Search for the keys, find the exit and escape the deadly killer stalking the corridors!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/809/9lj5Yel52bRuVd4bL0n1r1.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/halls-of-horror]Halls of Horror[/url][/h1]
[u]1–4 Players; 60–90 Min[/u]

You wake up in an unfamiliar room. Your entire body hurts, and you can hardly remember last night. Maybe there was a party at a club, or you were supposed to meet with a promising client, or you remember being mugged in an alley but nothing else… it doesn’t matter. Now you are here, and an industrial camera follows your every move. A voice plays over a crackling speaker. “Welcome, participant… to the Halls of Horror!” 

[b]Game will be launched on Kickstarter in 2019, so you may follow [url=http://ifun4all.com/hohboardgame/]game site[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/606487219777885/]Facebook group[/url] if you don't want to miss exact date.[/b]

notes.title: Pirates of Norwegian
notes.notes:
Through trading, raiding, fighting and colonization, build upon your power in order to achieve the ultimate goal of calming the throne!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/724/z8WjxzLkucZ35vlzLYXyiC0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/vikingjarl]Vikingjarl[/url][/h1]
[u]2–4 Players; 60 Minutes[/u]

It is the age of Conquering, Pillage, and Trade. Ragnar Ironhand, the King of Kaupang grows old and is looking for his most suitable successor. Ragnar gathers his four children and challenges them to leave Kaupang in search of fame and fortune in foreign lands. Whoever returns home as the most prosperous sibling, will lay claim to the throne. Gather your Viking warriors and set sail, but beware the whims of the fickle Norse gods as well as of your backstabbing and ambitious siblings, who are all vying to claim the throne for themselves.

[b]Vikingjarl is available on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1535378163/vikingjarl]Kickstarter[/url] right now![/b]

notes.title: And our friends are all aboard
notes.notes:
Set your sails and calibrate your compass in Feudum: Rudders & Ramparts! It's time to take artisan-edition vessels and castles out for a spin!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/816/1JLc53WdYqpsce9qeyF9V0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/feudum-rudders-and-ramparts]Feudum: Rudders & Ramparts[/url][/h1]
[u]2–6 Players; 80–180 Min[/u]

The Rudders & Ramparts expansion features artisan-edition vessels and castles that may be used purely for decoration - or to play a military variant of the game [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/feudum]Feudum[/url]! Upon acquiring a regular vessel or feudum, players may pay an additional shilling to upgrade to a deluxe vessel or castle feudum. Players earn +1 attack for a deluxe vessel and +1 defense for a castle feudum. At the dawn of each epoch, players must pay 1 shilling to maintain each castle or deluxe vessel in their possession - or lose their advantage! 

 
[b]You still have a few days to support game on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/464687699/feudum-rudders-and-ramparts]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: West Paladins vs. the World
notes.notes:
Build fortifications, commission monks and defend the city in unique worker drafting, action selection game [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/paladins-of-the-west-kingdom]Paladins of the West Kingdom[/url]!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/808/11A5040AdY2kiOFOgBCAi0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Paladins of the West Kingdom[/h1]
[u]1-4 Players; [u]90[/u][u][u]–[/u]120[/u] Minutes[/u]

Paladins of the West Kingdom is set at a turbulent time of West Francia's story, circa 900 AD. Despite recent efforts to develop the city, outlying townships are still under threat from outsiders. Saracens scout the borders, while Vikings plunder wealth and livestock. Even the Byzantines from the east have shown their darker side. As noble men and women, players must gather workers from the city to defend against enemies, build fortifications and spread faith throughout the land. Fortunately you are not alone. In his great wisdom, the King has sent his finest knights to help aid in our efforts. So ready the horses and sharpen the swords. The Paladins are approaching. 

[b]Also note that just few days left before [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/shem/paladins-of-the-west-kingdom]Kickstarter[/url] Campaign's end![/b]

notes.title: I Require Only That You Kneel
notes.notes:
Climb your way to the top of Achaemenid Empire and become a right hand of the emperor in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/xerxes]Xerxes[/url], an upcoming resource management game by Alcyon Creative.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/3c71ced5e217392241b8dc47ee872156e1acf494.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/xerxes]Xerxes[/url][/h1]
1-4 players; 30-45 Minutes

In this boardgame each player assumes the role of one Satrap, each with his own special ability and characteristics. Every turn the players are trying to collect resources for taxes set from Xerxes, construct buildings or launch campaigns. Each player has a number of Tax and Campaign cards to resolve in order to satisfy Xerses and earn his favor (counted as Victory Points). The player that reaches 25 Victory Points earns the favor of Xerxes and wins the game; alternatively, the one with the most Victory Points at the end of the 7th round (7 years of Reign).

Try the game out on Tabletopia and support it on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/alcyon-ludibooster/xerxes]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Galactic Overlord
notes.notes:
Compete to control a newly-discovered star cluster in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/hyperspace]Hyperspace[/url], an upcoming 4X game by Sandy Petersen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/42b39a47873de00eb7925049948cc7c1cedf552a.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/hyperspace]Hyperspace[/url][/h1]
2-4 players; 30-150 Minutes

Hyperspace is a fast-moving strategy game about interstellar expansion. In it, you take the part of an interstellar civilization competing to control a newly-discovered star cluster! Construct your empire, fight for resources, and research technology. Each alien species has its own unique flaws and advantages, and victory lies in recognizing this. The game takes place in a star cluster built up of individual pieces that changes every time you play.

Pre-order your own physical copy of the game on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/petersengames/hyperspace]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Alpaca Driven Economy
notes.notes:
Somewhere between the mountain ranges of Bolivia and Peru, the altitude of more than 3,000 meters imposes tough demands on the people to utilize the scant vegetation for their needs. Plan cleverly and be flexible enough to adapt your production and warehousing to the rough conditions of South American highlands in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/altiplano]Altiplano[/url], the new bag-building card game by dlp games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/31dc1b789cb3fca66be9bfd8193ef2d4ce276e3f.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/altiplano]Altiplano[/url][/h1]
2-5 players; 60-120 Minutes

Altiplano, a bag-building game along the lines of Orléans set in the South American highlands of the Andes — the Altiplano — is not a simple game, presenting players with new challenges time and again. There are various ways to reach the goal, so the game remains appealing to try out new options and strategies, but success or failure also depends on whether your opponents let you do as you like or thwart the strategy you are pursuing. The competition for the individual types of goods is considerable — as is the fun in snatching a coveted extension card from under another player's nose! Aside from building up an effective production, you must deliver the right goods at the right time, develop the road in good time, and store your goods cleverly enough to fill the most valuable rows with them.

notes.title: Last Quest of a Fiend
notes.notes:
Reap souls for your demonic benefactor in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mephisto-the-card-game]Mephisto[/url], an upcoming card game by Dylan Mangini.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ce98b3036d2e00867992fe496b8ca158debba365.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mephisto-the-card-game]Mephisto[/url][/h1]
1-4 players; 15-45 Minutes

Mephisto is a dungeon crawling card game where you play as a power hungry adventurer who’s made a deal with the archdemon Mephistopheles. In exchange for unholy strength, you must collect the souls of monsters you defeat in the dungeon. The catch is — you aren’t the only one who’s agreed to this pact, but only one of you will receive the demon’s gift. Race to collect the most souls for Mephisto before time runs out or be doomed to serve the beast for eternity!

Support the game's release on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/631404185/mephisto-the-card-game]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Human Mind, and Nowhere Else...
notes.notes:
Coordinate a group of dissidents or suppress dissent in [url=https://tabletopia.com/news/newspeak-2019]NewSpeak[/url] - a code-breaking team game of subterfuge, set in a bleak future for 3-6 citizens.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ebc1ef2ac63c284443227acc112299a92e66dafd.jpg[/img]
 
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/news/newspeak-2019]NewSpeak[/url][/h1]
3-6 Players; 45-60 Minutes

NewSpeak is a tense game of dystopian subversion in which you take the role of either the 'dissidents' or the 'moderators' in a mind-bending battle of wits to determine the reality around you. Dissidents utilise matching underground codes to coordinate meetings at one of the locations on the map. They then each secretly use their location dials to declare their intended meeting point.

The Mods, in a short amount of time, then have to determine where they expect the Dissidents to meet by inferring their intent from a book of every possible code set the subversives could use, and agree upon a location to direct a state raiding party.

As the game progresses, moderated locations produce potential accomplices for the Dissidents to recruit, as undesirables are driven from now sanitized districts. However, as the Dissidents progress their mission to 'hack' as many locations as possible, the Moderators strike back with increasing numbers of surveillance outposts, installed to limit the Dissident's ability to move around the city undetected.

The [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/itbboardgames/newspeak]Kickstarter[/url] campaign for the game's second printing is currently underway, so take this chance to fight for future reality.

notes.title: Guardians Of Time
notes.notes:
Restore the damaged continuity of the events in [url=https://tabletopia.com/news/tangled-timelines]Tangled Timelines[/url], new hand management game from The Daniel Zayas Company.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/7ac4b00bad2ddbf64d557299cf04e37899d94333.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/news/tangled-timelines]Tangled Timelines[/url][/h1]
1-4 players; 15-45 Minutes

In Tangled Timelines, you will lead a rescue mission which transcends time and space. Heroes from other worlds have been cast out of time due to an unknown spatial anomaly. It is up to you to rebuild the best hero timelines and as diverse a team as you can. You will send heroes to rescue others like them, sometimes rescuing themselves from another time! Using the right hero at the right time is paramount to winning this game and saving time as we know it!

notes.title: Beyond The Stygian Portal
notes.notes:
Save Haven town from annihilation at the hands of a horde of monsters from beyond the [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/shadowrift]Shadowrift[/url], in this new deck-building game from Game Salute.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/34ac7925b44f4cdf57740635e01d241b70a82ca7.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/shadowrift]Shadowrift[/url][/h1]
2-6 players; 45-120 Minutes

In Shadowrift heroes must band together and fight against monsters, while learning new attacks, spells and skills. Cards in your deck will define you as an adventurer and complement the strengths of your fellow heroes. Unlike other deck-builders, there is constant interaction with your fellow players as you figure out who will gain which benefit from the limited supply of townsfolk, offer their coin to help construct walls, and seek healing from anyone who's learned such magic. Since the monsters won't stop coming until the last Shadowrift is sealed or the town has been built into a mighty fortress, you'll need every boost you can take.

notes.title: All About Birds
notes.notes:
Take on a role of an ornithologist and discover many different kinds of birds in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/wingspan]Wingspan[/url], new competitive, medium-weight, card-driven, engine-building board game from Stonemaier Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/27e289364753ca30d5bbe168b802b1a4a37b1791.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/wingspan]Wingspan[/url][/h1]
1-5 players; 40-75 Minutes

In Wingspan, you are bird enthusiasts — researchers, bird watchers, and collectors — seeking to discover and attract the best birds to your aviary. Each bird extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your habitats. Each habitat focuses on a key aspect of the growth of your aviary. The winner is the player with the most points accumulated from birds, bonus cards, end-of-round goals, eggs, cached food, and tucked birds.

notes.title: Make Your Perfect Blend
notes.notes:
Sip a cup of tea as you buy ingredients, solve puzzles, and combine flavours with family and friends! Immerse yourself in the beautiful and thematic world of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/chai]Chai[/url], an upcoming card game by Deep Aqua Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ce93439c6e02101367a3a9b3846b971386d9cfd8.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/chai]Chai[/url][/h1]
1-5 players; 20-60 Minutes

In Chai, you will step into the shoes of a tea merchant, combining tea flavours to make a perfect blend. Specializing in either rooibos, green, oolong, black or white tea, you will buy and collect ingredients to fulfill your customers’ orders. To be the best tea merchant at the end of the day, you are striving to have the most victory points from completed tea customer cards. Additional points are given from awards and remaining money.

Pre-order your own physical copy of the game on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/strider88/chaian-immersive-tea-board-game]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Despair Beyond Mechanics
notes.notes:
Investigate an ancient subterranean complex of unknown origin. Collect equipment, interact and utilize environment, fight monsters, and immerse yourself in rich narrative elements of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/machina-arcana]Machina Arcana[/url], an upcoming thematic adventure game by Adreama Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/f4be67a53f6badae233215198bcb10a53f2b8671.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/machina-arcana]Machina Arcana[/url][/h1]
1-4 players; 120-180 Minutes

In Machina Arcana, the objective of the game is to progress through the tale and face the endgame at the finale of each scenario. The main goal behind Machina Arcana is to provide players with a chilling game that can never be played the same way, mechanisms that enable varying strategies and approaches, and an extensive framework that combines everything smoothly. The game scales by default; there is no need for special conditions based on the player count. As the story progresses, so does your gear. But beware! If you are too slow, horror might very well prevail and devour you whole...

Pre-order your physical copy of the game through [url=https://machina-arcana.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders]Kickstarter[/url] Late Pledge!

notes.title: Survive the Arena and Tame the Wilds
notes.notes:
Battle your opponents in the gladiatorial arenas of the Silvestrem in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/wild-assent-arena]Wild Assent: The Arena[/url], new card driven skirmish game by Lazy Squire Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/fda6410bd67ddb832d670fcde889836011dd0fd6.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/wild-assent-arena]Wild Assent: The Arena[/url][/h1]
1-4 players; 30-60 Minutes

Wild Assent is a miniatures board game with solo, player-versus-player and cooperative modes. Hunt the dangerous creatures of the Wilds, by yourself or with friends, fighting not just for survival, but to keep your expedition running. Regardless of the mode you choose, Wild Assent offers strategic and varied combat, ensuring no two battles are the same.

Pre-order your physical copy of the game through the [url=https://app.crowdox.com/projects/1449412950/wild-assent-survive-the-arena-and-tame-the-wilds]Wild Assent Late Pledge[/url]!

notes.title: Glory of the Fierce Ones
notes.notes:
Send hunters to distant Slavic lands, fight monsters, defy dark and terrible gods and compete with others for the most Glory in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/monster-slayers-of-slawia]Monster Slayers of Slawia[/url], new fast-paced, cutthroat card game game by Into the Unknown.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/5c93a1e8fb65f3395555045d7804db048d146ee3.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/monster-slayers-of-slawia]Monster Slayers of Slawia[/url][/h1]
2-3; 30-60 Minutes

Monster Slayers of Slawia is a language independent card game, mixing strong competitive elements with a touch of innovative opportunistic coop for maximum fun! Easy to learn rules let you play the game straight out of the box, while the abundance of abilities and interactions make it hard to master even after dozens of play sessions!

Support the game's physical release through currently ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1492106834/monster-slayers-of-slawia-card-game]Kickstarter[/url] campaign!

notes.title: 3 New Steam DLCs - Available Now!
notes.notes:
Dear Tabletopians, today we announce another flight of highly requested games from our library - now available as Steam DLCs! You can now buy [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/noir]NOIR[/url], [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/between-two-castles-of-mad-king-ludwig]Between Two Castles of Mad King Ludwig[/url] and [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-networks]The Networks[/url] to play them forever, with no subscription required. As usual, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/fe2811748b0f03baac6a81a17bd9d8ace8442981.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/noir]NOIR[/url][/h1]
NOIR is a game of hidden identities and deduction. Each player receives a secret identity from among 25 suspects and an open role that determines his available moves and victory conditions.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/649ac307e674b12c141c6093126f95d41f173ed8.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/between-two-castles-of-mad-king-ludwig]Between Two Castles of Mad King Ludwig[/url][/h1]
Between Two Castles of Mad King Ludwig is a competitive tile-drafting game in which each tile is a room in a castle. You work together with the player on your left to design one castle, and with the player on your right on another castle. On each turn you select two tiles from your hand, reveal them, then work with your partners to place them. To win, you have to share your attention and your devotion between two castles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/6f8b6b340bbed2a90d7ba24afe1b3417aaf2b95f.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-networks]The Networks[/url][/h1]
Welcome to the TV business! You are the owner of a new television network. All you have are three awful public access shows, a small amount of cash, and endless ambition. Plus, it looks like you're not the only new TV network in town... Whose network will get the most Viewers and win the game?


You can purchase these new DLCs on our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560/Tabletopia/]Steam product page[/url].

Tell us in the comments which games you would like to see as DLCs.

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Merchants and Miners
notes.notes:
Take the role of a Mining Corporation CEO and outcompete your opponents in the [url=https://tabletopia.com/news/miners-lagoon]Miner's Lagoon[/url], new resource management game by Gizco International.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/2bfea8366d02fa8eada5eefe3e03edef626fcd29.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/news/miners-lagoon]Miner's Lagoon[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 75-150 Minutes

Miner's Lagoon is a worker placement board game with highly strategic and competitive gameplay, a great theme, and beautiful illustrations. To this end, you will navigate the Lagoon to build a team of miners and merchants, open up galleries, mine and process ores, make shipments, buy equipment, buy artifacts and close deals to score the most Victory Points.

Support first physical release of the game on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gizco/miners-lagoon]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: A New Chapter for the Legend
notes.notes:
Set sail for open seas and distant shores and return with gold and glory for your clan in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/reavers-of-midgard]Reavers of Midgard[/url], new worker placement game by Grey Fox Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/895b60422396705b4888bfecae075f158e5bd506.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/reavers-of-midgard]Reavers of Midgard[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 75-90 Minutes

Reavers of Midgard is a single worker placement game with elements of set collection, dice combat and engine building set in the Champions of Midgard universe. You'll be looking to gain glory by raiding nearby villages for their riches, sacking well-fortified castles and battling both man and monster on the open seas. You'll not only need to take your rowdy crew of vikings and the food needed to keep them happy along for the ride but you'll also have to recruit a crew of elite warriors - the Reavers.

Support the game's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/152730994/reavers-of-midgard-the-sequel-to-champions-of-midg]Kickstarter[/url] campaign, there are only a couple of days left!

notes.title: Breed to Beatdown
notes.notes:
Mix and match different genetic traits to create the ultimate warriors and demonstrate their prowess on the arena in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mutants_2019]Mutants[/url], new deck-building game by Lucky Duck Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/93cca517a7f1872ac2e0ec9e1fffed2142c4338d.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mutants_2019]Mutants[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 45-60 Minutes

In Mutants, players gain prestige by dominating the arena with powerful mutants — and whoever collects the most prestige wins. In each round, players take turns until all players have used every card in their hand. At the end of the round, the player whose token is closest to the top space of the arena track scores prestige based on the round track. The game proceeds in this way for five rounds, after which players reveal their archives and gain additional prestige based on the freeze value of the mutants they have placed there.

Support the release of the game by pledging to its currently ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/372651021/mutants-an-innovative-asymmetric-deck-builder]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: The King Demands a Castle
notes.notes:
Design a grandiose castle for your king, using all your planning and collaborative skills in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/between-two-castles-of-mad-king-ludwig]Between Two Castles of Mad King Ludwig[/url], new drafting game by Stonemaier Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/649ac307e674b12c141c6093126f95d41f173ed8.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/between-two-castles-of-mad-king-ludwig]Between Two Castles of Mad King Ludwig[/url][/h1]
2-7 Players; 45-60 Minutes

Between Two Castles of Mad King Ludwig is a competitive tile-drafting game in which each tile is a room in a castle.
