You work together with the player on your left to design one castle, and with the player on your right on another castle. On each turn you select two tiles from your hand, reveal them, then work with your partners to place them. To win, you have to share your attention and your devotion between two castles.

notes.title: War of the Worlds on Tabletopia
notes.notes:
"War of the Worlds: the New Wave" is an asymmetrical deck-building game with a playing board for 2 players, age 10+ by Jet Games Studio and Lavka Games.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/594/rzHtL46VECMffmkiQMvgg1.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/war-of-the-worlds-the-new-wave]War of the Worlds[/url]
2 Players; 30-60 Minutes

The game events unfold several years after the original "War of the Worlds" story be Herbert Wells. Extraterrestrial invasion occurs again, but this time the Martians arrived on a giant spaceship which lands in one of the backwater districts in Scotland. 

During the game, one player commands the alien forces, and the other one becomes a leader of UK self-defense units.

notes.title: Epic Spell Wars of the Battle Wizards on Tabletopia
notes.notes:
Did you know that magical wizards are battling to the death ... and beyond ... right now!? "Why battle?" you might ask. "What have I got to prove, magic man?" Only who's the most awesomely powerful battle wizard in the entire realm, that's what! As a Battle Wizard, you'll put together up to three spell components to craft millions (okay, not really) of spell combos. Your spells might kick ass, or they could totally blow – it's up to you to master the magic.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/553/9jWogJulEDe5WZZS9KXz02.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/duel-at-mt-skullzfyre]Epic Spell Wars of the Battle Wizards[/url]
2-6 Players; 15-45 Minutes

You will unleash massive damage on the faces of your wizard rivals in a no-holds-barred, all-out burn-down to be the last Battle Wizard standing. And it doesn't stop there! Powerful magic items bring on a whole new level of bloody carnage as you and your mighty wizard opponents tear each other limb from limb in an orgy of killing! Do you have what it takes to use epic spells in a war at Mt. Skullzfyre? Will YOU be the Ultimate Battle Wizard!?! 

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/duel-at-mt-skullzfyre]Epic Spell Wars of the Battle Wizards[/url]: Duel at Mt. Skullzfyre is a humorous card game depicting a vicious, over-the-top battle between a variety of comically illustrated wizards. The game focuses primarily on creating three-part spell combos to blast your foes into the afterlife. The unique Dead Wizard cards allow players to stay in the game even after their wizards have been defeated.

notes.title: Wild Assent: The Hunt is now on Tabletopia
notes.notes:
Battle your opponents in the gladiatorial arenas or hunt the dangerous creatures to keep the expedition alive in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/wild-assent-the-hunt]Wild Assent: The Hunt[/url] - new tactical game by Lazy Squire Games.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/575/ABOQyFxPXdv6LIqPuD1eW4.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/wild-assent-the-hunt]Wild Assent: The Hunt[/url][/h1]
1-4 Players; 15-45 Minutes

Wild Assent is a board game with solo, player-versus-player and cooperative modes. Battle your opponents in the gladiatorial arenas of the Silvestrem in Wild Assent’s skirmish mode. Hunt the dangerous creatures of the Wilds, by yourself or with friends, fighting not just for survival, but to keep your expedition running. Regardless of the mode you choose, Wild Assent offers strategic and varied combat, ensuring no two battles are the same.

You can get your own copy of the game on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1449412950/wild-assent-survive-the-arena-and-tame-the-wilds]Kickstarter[/url] right now. The game is already funded with 24 stretch goals unlocked!

notes.title: Understanding Poetry of the Matter
notes.notes:
Use trends, discover elements and learn actual science in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/periodic-a-game-of-the-elements]Periodic: A Game of The Elements[/url] - new educational game by Genius Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/bd045ea6ebcb2e3627ef8cf546748f1a72d8d717.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/periodic-a-game-of-the-elements]Periodic: A Game of The Elements[/url][/h1]
2-5 Players; 30-50 Minutes

In Periodic: A Game of The Elements, players activate periodic trends to maneuver across the Periodic Table discovering elements to score points. The goal is to land on and discover specific elements shown on available Goal Cards. As players move across the board, they’re also racing to end their turn within specific families of elements, competing with other players for the limited Academic Achievement points. The player with the most points at the end of the game wins!

Get your own copy of the game by pledging to its current [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/geniusgames/periodic-a-game-of-the-elements]Kickstarter[/url], which only has a couple of days left!

notes.title: At the Center of All Infinity
notes.notes:
The conquest of space was one of the main human achievements of the 20th century. In 1957, the first satellite named "Sputnik 1" has been placed into orbit. Four years later, Yuri Gagarin has performed the first human space flight on "Vostok 1" ship. This game is dedicated to the first [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/space_explorers]space explorers[/url] — i.e. all the outstanding people who have made spacefaring possible!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/8e6b6ff3d763e240ae42ad0dffce3b930d8bf182.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/space_explorers]Space Explorers[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 20-40 Minutes

Each player becomes the Head of a Research & Development Hub in the Space Research Center. You recruit best Specialists to your team and produce large-scale space projects — from placing satellites and manned spaceships into orbit to launching automated interplanetary stations!

The game ends when the players complete all the available Projects or when one of the players recruits 12 Specialists to his/her Hub. The Specialists and Projects bring you Progress points. The player with the highest amount of Progress points wins.

Support the game's physical release on the currently ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chadelkins/space-explorers]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Keys to Prosperity
notes.notes:
In the new game by R&D Games, the great river [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/key-flow]Key Flow[/url] passes through the new Key Lands, carrying ships laden with resources for building and trade. Along the riverside, buildings are built, boats are moored in docks, and animals graze in the fields. Players build communities alongside this river, and send workers to work in both their own and their neighbors' businesses, enabling their economy to develop and flourish.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/dadb4fe50cdd3c2c07ad3fd0b4e8f1e7a15cb382.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/key-flow]Key Flow[/url][/h1]
2-6 Players; 60-90 Minutes

Key Flow is a card-driven game based on many of the ideas contained in the award-winning game Keyflower. The game flows quickly over four game rounds (seasons), allowing players to develop their own unique village, with many ways to score points for their buildings, animals, keyples, resources and other items.  Points are scored from the village cards in various ways, through upgrading buildings, and from gathering gold. The player who scores the most points wins.

Only a couple of days left in the game's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/breese/key-flow]Kickstarter[/url] campaign, so take this opportunity to pre-order your physical copy!

notes.title: Legendary King of the Hill
notes.notes:
Become one of the ancient heroes in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/world-of-mythology]World of Mythology[/url] - an upcoming strategic role-playing game by Jumperound.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/043036ab0e51a328c7ca0b7d5c8dc1b2970b2281.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/world-of-mythology]World of Mythology[/url][/h1] 
2-5 Players; 90-120 Minutes

World of Mythology is a successor of the card game World Of Mythology created by Jumperound creative lab. Players take roles of Heracles, Ramesses, Fenrir, Baba Yaga and Karna and have to finish quests, get their powerful artifacts, sweep away mythical creatures, build temples to praise their deeds, gather treasures and treacherous secrets in order to summon own Legendary Boss or fight together against the main enemy - dreadful Cthulhu.

The game is currently on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jumperound/world-of-mythology-king-of-the-hill]Kickstarter[/url], so check it out!

notes.title: We Take It Day By Day
notes.notes:
Manage your resources, build your crew, and fight legendary battles to become Kingpin in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/welcome-to-the-jungle]Welcome to the Jungle[/url] - new area control card drafting game by Coffee Cake Gaming.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/757601beec91fe70171acc4e0121a3cf3ef434b1.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/welcome-to-the-jungle]Welcome to the Jungle[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 60-120 Minutes

Welcome to the Jungle  is an inventory and land management game, with card battling elements. Players take on the role of rival crew leaders working their way to becoming kingpins of the jungle. Buying and selling goodies — and even gambling — are used to acquire enough resources to take over, raise levels, and become kingpin of territories in the city. Players also battle each other for control over opposing players territories by drafting cards to build up a crew of characters with which they will fight. The first player to control the most territories at kingpin level wins.

The game is currently on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/coffeecakegaming/welcome-to-the-jungle-the-board-game]Kickstarter[/url], so check it out!

notes.title: The Darkness Has Returned
notes.notes:
Become a noble hero gathering an army to crush the dark forces at the borders of your kingdom in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/draconis-invasion]Draconis Invasion[/url] - an upcoming fantasy deck-building game by KEJI Inc.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/910b157d27bfdb6f9d1acbe4ae00f0cc4a8b8147.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/draconis-invasion]Draconis Invasion[/url][/h1]
1-6 Players; 45-90 Minutes

In Draconis Invasion players start with a basic deck consisting of Gold cards and Defender cards. The cards in your deck are weak when the game begins, but your goal is to build your deck, gather more money, form a fiercer army, and summon enough strength to defeat the darkness that threatens the realm. When the dust settles and the battle is over, the player with the most Glory Points will stand triumphant as the King's mightiest champion.

The game's crowdfunding campaign is at its final day on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/loudaboutgame/draconis-invasion-wrath-dark-fantasy-deck-building]Kickstarter[/url], so don't miss it!

notes.title: Not On Our Watch
notes.notes:
Stop the conspiring acolytes from breaking the seals holding back the evil Unhallowed in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/set-a-watch]Set a Watch[/url] - an upcoming cooperative card game by Rock Manor Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/8e8063d8a3ff1a85740b8859a165804183800cb6.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/set-a-watch]Set a Watch[/url][/h1]
1-4 Players; 20-60 Minutes

In every round Set a Watch you will visit a new location and battle a line of monsters trying to make their way into camp using your dice and unique character abilities. Manipulating the Creature line is essential to solving each round’s combat puzzle. 
It is a battle to stay alive and keep the campfire burning! Use your wits and skill to fight for the light…or all will perish in the darkness.

The game is already funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mikegnade/set-a-watch]Kickstarter[/url], so check it out!

notes.title: 5 New Steam DLCs - Available Now!
notes.notes:
Dear Tabletopians, today we announce another flight of highly requested games from our library - now available as Steam DLCs! You can now buy Euphoria, Sellswords, Millennium Blades, Maximum Apocalypse and Raiders of the North Sea to play them forever, with no subscription required. As usual, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/e484f37a89270cf34d06636b284b5b1468751317.png[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/euphoria-build-a-better-dystopia]Euphoria: Build a Better Dystopia[/url][/h1]
Euphoria is a worker-placement game in which dice are your workers. The number on each die represents his level of awareness that he's in a dystopia. Worker knowledge enables various bonuses and impacts player interaction. If the collective knowledge of all of your available workers gets too high, they might desert you. Your path to victory is paved with the sweat of your workers, the strength of your allegiances, and the tunnels you dig to infiltrate other areas of the world.

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sellswords-olympus]Sellswords[/url][/h1]
Sellswords is a tile-placement game (they're cards, not tiles, but you get the idea) for two players in which heroes gather for the battle of a lifetime. Each of the fifty heroes has its own ability to help turn the tiles of battle in your favor!

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/millennium-blades]Millennium Blades[/url][/h1]
In a world very much like our own, Millennium Blades is the world’s most popular collectible card game. Continuously in print for more than a thousand years, the game has seen countless expansions and untold billions of cards in circulation. Players from around the world and from all walks of life seek to become world champions by mastering duels and collecting the game’s rarest and most coveted cards. 

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/maximum-apocalypse]Maximum Apocalypse[/url][/h1]
Maximum Apocalypse is a cooperative game where each player plays as survivor with actions and gear in the form of cards. Players explore the landscape and react to threats from roaming monsters while trying to fend off starvation and scavenge for the resources needed to complete their mission and escape.

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/raiders-of-the-north-sea]Raiders of the North Sea[/url][/h1]
Raiders of the North Sea is set in the central years of the Viking Age. Players will need to assemble a crew, collect provisions and journey north to plunder gold, iron and livestock. There is glory to be found in battle, even at the hands of the Valkyrie. The aim is having the most Victory Points (VP) at the game’s end. Victory Points are gained primarily by raiding Settlements, taking Plunder and making Offerings to the Chieftain. The game ends when either 1 Fortress raid remains, all Valkyrie are removed, or all Offerings have been made.

You can purchase these new DLCs on our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560/Tabletopia/]Steam product page[/url].

Tell us in the comments which games you would like to see as DLCs.

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: A City Corrupted From Within
notes.notes:
Become one of the city's secret evil leaders and seek the favor of the ancient Necromancer in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dark-domains]Dark Domains[/url] - an upcoming competitive worker placement game by Laboratory H.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/36ca632ba117be13acd0784a3bbeac6ec9021a26.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dark-domains]Dark Domains[/url]
2-5 Players; 120 Minutes

Dark Domains is the perfect melding of classic euro-mechanics and strong dark fantasy theme. Each player takes on the role of a secretly evil city leader who is expanding the frontier of Harrows into the hinterland, but ultimately will attempt to corrupt their domain and turn it against the city. Players must use minions, henchmen, monsters, and magic to stamp out the good and cover their domain in darkness.

You can help to fund physical release of the game by pledging to it's current [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/laboratoryh/dark-domains]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Glimpses of the Future
notes.notes:
Create the best possible timeline in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/a-thief-s-fortune]A Thief's Fortune[/url] - an upcoming thematic card drafting/engine building game by Artipia Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/c586db3f6e51b6fb7ed4c800ad7402fc1f8ee0f6.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/a-thief-s-fortune]A Thief's Fortune[/url][/h1]
1-4 Players; 45-90 Minutes

A Thief's Fortune is a card game for 1-4 players in which each player represents a different possible future of the same character. By visiting different locations, interacting with local characters and making sure that certain events you have seen actually happen, you try to find the path that will lead you as far away as possible from danger.

Support the game's physical release on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/241478362/a-thiefs-fortune-by-artipia-games]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Violence, Betrayal and Mischief
notes.notes:
Lead your clan of woodland critters living in a world recently devoid of humans in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/squarriors-the-card-game]Squarriors[/url], the card game based off the hit comic series and published by Cold War Inc.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/b2e2e3fb2b801d18a0ab404022807d214387465b.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/squarriors-the-card-game]Squarriors[/url][/h1]
2 Players; 30-120 Minutes

Squarriors features skill-based gameplay, world-class artwork, narrative-driven content, dual-purpose cards and abundant tactical options. In Squarriors there is no randomized deck to draw from. All cards will start either already in play or in your hand. Since there is no random deck draw, tailoring your strategy ahead of time and carefully choosing your cards is a must if you wish to dominate the enemy! 

You can support the game and the comic by pledging in their currently ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/devilsdue/squarriors-new-oversize-hardcover-and-variant-card/]Kickstarter[/url].

notes.title: Who is Who in London?
notes.notes:
Martin Wallace's design, originally set in a different universe, has been now translated into the myths and legends of Victorian London, in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/nanty-narking]Nanty Narking[/url] - new edition of now classic hand management game Discworld: Ankh-Morpork, brought to you by [b]PHALANX[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/c0e2fdb2bb2ed24767ffbf5d266a6d6b60c7dbeb.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/nanty-narking]Nanty Narking[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 60 Minutes

Nanty Narking is a Victorian board game of wit and podsnappery that reintroduces the well-known bestseller of Martin Wallace. The action takes place on the map of London, with players placing their followers and buildings on the board through card play. The rules are relatively simple: Play a card and do what it says. At the beginning of the game, each player draws a secret personality with specific victory conditions. You need to fulfill your goal while also trying to prevent others from winning!

The game's physical release is already funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/phalanxgames/nanty-narking]Kickstarter[/url], so don't miss it!

notes.title: Legends of the Black Flag
notes.notes:
Start with only a handful of coins and become the most notorious pirate of your era in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/ruthless]Ruthless[/url] - new deck building game by Alley Cat Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/432dbecf908dd6af66239e116b1cf68562d2f5a5.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/ruthless]Ruthless[/url][/h1]
2 players; 40-75 Minutes

Ruthless is a pirate themed deck building game in which players will gather their crew and fight with their opponents.  Every turn a player must play a card or set of cards from their hand after which they may buy new cards to their deck. The deck consist of pirate cards, which allow to attack opponent, draw more cards and perform many more profitable actions, and treasure cards which allow to buy more and better pirates. At the end of third and each subsequent round the players will compare the strenght of their crew in play. The player with the strongest crew wins the battle and gain most points. After a set number of rounds the game is over and the player with most points wins.

notes.title: Take What You Deserve
notes.notes:
Create powerful combos with creatures and spells to outscore opponents and win territories in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/war-of-supremacy]War of Supremacy[/url] - an upcoming king of the hill, fantasy card game by Lost Treasure Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/520eaf9e5508fff58bd3a82189fb74cbf24aff33.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/war-of-supremacy]War of Supremacy[/url][/h1]
2-5 players; 30-60 Minutes

War of Supremacy is a free-for-all card game in which all players are fighting over a battleground to claim it as their own. If a player gains control over a number of territories they will win the game. With all players fighting for themselves, the battlefield becomes an all-in brawl with only one winner. Players take turns, using creatures from their hand to attack the opponent’s creatures currently defending the Territory. If a player manages to defeat the defending creatures, they take control of the Territory, placing all their creatures used in the attack into defense. That player will then become the defender in which all other players are trying to defeat. Players can combine creatures with spell cards that offer a wide range of game changing effects.

The game is at its final week on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1618796001/war-of-supremacy-0]Kickstarter[/url], so make sure you check it out!

notes.title: Ascend Beyond The Realm of Chaos
notes.notes:
Customize power sets and engage in an epic battle for godhood in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/endogenesis]Endogenesis[/url] - an upcoming card drafting and hand management game by David Goh. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/f5ab3cc017c4759b4bfd3b57a120478bc14eac1f.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/endogenesis]Endogenesis[/url][/h1]
3-4 players; 60-120 Minutes

Endogenesis is a competitive arena-styled card game. Collect Skills from the Realm of Knowledge to customize your character with different powers, and upgrade them with Shards that you can earn by defeating your enemies. Also joining the fray are vicious Monsters from the Realm of Chaos. The most powerful of these are called Legendaries; killing them will reward its slayer with a Prism. Be the first to collect 3 Prisms and you win!

The game is already funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/davidgoh/endogenesis]Kickstarter[/url], so check it out!

notes.title: All Fears Will Be Remembered
notes.notes:
Every Friday the 13th, an ancient curse unleashes a horrible monster on the helpless citizens of Misfortune Lane. The adults hide indoors clutching lucky trinkets while their weapons gather dust. This year their kids have decided to end this dreadful cycle once and for all, in the story of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-curse-of-misfortune-lane]The Curse of Misfortune Lane[/url] - an upcoming deck-building and press your luck game by Howling Hog Games. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/3ff5740a1c1e110f6f3197a4e5a410e52ed854e9.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-curse-of-misfortune-lane]The Curse of Misfortune Lane[/url][/h1]
2-5 players; 30-45 Minutes

In The Curse of Misfortune Lane one player plays as the monster and all other players team-up as a group of kids. They will explore town in search of weapons and lucky items, all while trying to avoid angry adults and monster traps. During the Night, they will try to break the curse and save everyone! The Monster will litter the town with bad luck and lure other players to locations that contain useless weapons, making sure that the curse over Misfortune Lane will remain unbroken. ​

Try the game out on Tabletopia and support it on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1981698043/the-curse-of-misfortune-lane]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Heroes of Shanty Town
notes.notes:
Scavenge for resources, raise distilleries, produce moonshine and sell it into your Saloons to maximize the profits, because when time is up, only one Hero will be able to pay for the ride out of "Shanty Town" and win in [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2fat2fly/moonshiners-of-the-apocalypse]Moonshiners of the Apocalypse[/url] - an upcoming worker placement game by 2Fat2Fly. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/fcff567865598acdfc1d9b26f1ac18ff7d632226.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2fat2fly/moonshiners-of-the-apocalypse]Moonshiners of the Apocalypse[/url][/h1]
2-4 players; 60-120 Minutes

Moonshiners of the Apocalypse is a morally questionable, not so cooperative mashup of town-building and 4x game, with a tad of dice combat. Set in an alternative post-apocalyptic 1920's, players compete over exploring and re-building the deserted "Shanty Town". Explore and discover, scavenge for resources and build houses for the poor survivors. All of this while fighting off the hordes of disgruntled crowds that roam the town with the sole purpose of messing with your precious achievements. 

Try the game out on Tabletopia and support it on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2fat2fly/moonshiners-of-the-apocalypse]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: It Gets Worse Here Every Day
notes.notes:
Take on the role of a crew leader using cash and goodies to take over territories in the jungle. But beware. Everyone wants a piece of the pie and others are furthering their claim, and tightening their grasp on territories they control. Gather the crew, weapons, and abilities to fight them in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/welcome-to-the-jungle]Welcome to the Jungle[/url] - new area control card drafting game by Coffee Cake Gaming. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/757601beec91fe70171acc4e0121a3cf3ef434b1.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/welcome-to-the-jungle]Welcome to the Jungle[/url][/h1]
2-4 players; 60-120 Minutes

Welcome to the Jungle is an inventory and land management game, with card battling elements. Players take on the role of rival crew leaders working their way to becoming kingpins of the jungle. Buying and selling goodies — and even gambling — are used to acquire enough resources to take over, raise levels, and become kingpin of territories in the city. Players also battle each other for control over opposing players territories by drafting cards to build up a crew of characters with which they will fight. The first player to control the most territories at kingpin level wins. It’s all for the taking if you have the guts to grab it.

notes.title: Just When I Thought I Was Out...
notes.notes:
After a successful bank heist, everything is going according to plan until the police get a breakthrough in their investigation. Accusations are made, fingers are pointed, your only choice now is to escape the city before it is completely locked down. To leave the city with as much of the money as possible, you need the [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/escape-plan]Escape Plan[/url] - unfolding in an upcoming exploration adventure game by Eagle-Gryphon Games. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/d0961c9c4a6e0fa6be59e717cc530f50678cc2ed.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/escape-plan]Escape Plan[/url][/h1]
1-5 players; 60-120 Minutes

In Escape Plan, players move on a modular board trying to reach the best spots to recover their loot and escape from the city with more money than the other thieves. The cops are trying to thwart their escape plan. Players play cards to aid their escape and slow the other players down. The players take actions that allow them to move and to engage gangs, mules, and snitches. As a tactical game with no direct conflict, it contains asymmetric roles set by missions that players may achieve during the game while avoiding the police. The players' roles as thieves are individual with every player for themselves. In the end, only the player who escapes with the most cash wins.

You can try the game out on Tabletopia and support its development on recently launched [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eaglegryphon/escape-plan-by-vital-lacerda-with-artwork-by-ian-o]Kickstarter[/url].

notes.title: Road to Civilization
notes.notes:
Take on the role of a prehistoric tribe and transform it into a Nation whose influence will echo through the ages, in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dominations-road-to-civilization]Dominations[/url] - an upcoming area control tile placement game by Holy Grail Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/9fce1ed6b42b67c74096698eabe397cb8062edb3.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dominations-road-to-civilization]Dominations[/url][/h1]
2-4 players; 60-120 Minutes

In Dominations, you will place your triangular Dominos to expand your population and attain the Knowledge that will determine how your society is shaped over time. You can use this Knowledge to build Cities and master Skills; thus creating the legacy for which your Civilization will be remembered. All this will earn you points and the player with the most points at the end of the game wins! Will your Civilization become a wealthy hub of trade and commerce? A cultural and political powerhouse? A haven of science and craftsmanship? The birthplace of a great religion? It's up to you…

The game is already funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/148661905/dominations-road-to-civilization]Kickstarter[/url] and currently at its final week, so don't miss it out!

notes.title: A Right to Rule
notes.notes:
Establish your legacy in 1015, as one of Vladimir the Great's children and potential successor to the throne. Overcome a fierce power struggle between the heirs to rule as the next leader of Kievan Rus in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/rurik]Rurik: Dawn of Kiev[/url], an upcoming area control and resource management game by PieceKeeper Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ed15e4354340b02151d0d8ca9af4adbadc1ea78b.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/rurik]Rurik: Dawn of Kiev[/url][/h1]
4 players; 60-120 Minutes

Rurik: Dawn of Kiev is a euro-style realm building game with a new mechanic - "auction programming." Players openly bid for actions with their advisors. Stronger advisors earn greater benefits at the cost of performing their action later than other players. Conversely, weaker advisors earn lesser benefits but perform their action quickly. This planning mechanism adds a fun tension to the game. Although deploying your troops for warfare seems to be the easiest path for success, the people value a ruler who leads well in a variety of endeavors. Construct buildings and perform great deeds or pursue your own agenda by ruling large areas of land and collecting tribute. Will you win over the hearts to become the next Grand Prince or Princess of Kiev?

You can support the game's first physical release on currently ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/83162467/rurik-dawn-of-kiev]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Twilight Before The Last Eclipse
notes.notes:
Travel back in time to the greatest city in Mesoamerica. Witness the glory of the powerful pre-Columbian civilization. Strategize, accrue wealth, gain the favour of the gods, and become the builder of the magnificent Pyramid of the Sun in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/teotihuacan-city-of-gods]Teotihuacan: City of Gods[/url], an upcoming worker placement game by NSKN Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/f2e2b3327def2a63cc9500bd6408063580df0bb1.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/teotihuacan-city-of-gods]Teotihuacan: City of Gods[/url][/h1]
1-4 players; 90-120 Minutes

In Teotihuacan: City of Gods, each player commands a force of worker dice, which grow in strength with every move. While managing their workforce and resources, players develop new technologies, climb the steps of the three great temples, build houses for the inhabitants of the city, and raise the legendary and breath-taking Pyramid of the Sun in the centre of the city. Each game is played in three eras. As the dawn of the Aztecs comes closer, player efforts (and their ability to feed their workforce) are evaluated a total of three times. The player with the most fame is the winner.

notes.title: He Who Rules The Skies
notes.notes:
Create your dream team of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/paisleyplanecrafters]Planecrafters[/url] and build most unusual airplanes in an upcoming hand management and set collection game by Paisley Board Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/c3d0a7fc3487a3f0c2f8bca714b32d6ddac35498.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/paisleyplanecrafters]Planecrafters[/url][/h1]
2-4 players; 30-60 Minutes

In Planecrafters players compete to hire the best employees, assemble the most productive factory, deliver planes and sell them to earn crowns. Better planes sell for more crowns. But what really makes a factory succeed is its workers. Hiring employees for your factory will cost you crowns, but they're also a great investment. Employees can speed the production of planes, help you find better parts, sabotage your opponents’ factories, or receive crowns from the bank. At the end of the game, the player with the most crowns wins.

Try the game out on Tabletopia and support it on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/paisleyboardgames/planecrafters-a-fantasy-plane-building-card-game]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: One Favored By The Ruler
notes.notes:
Become the head of a Great House of Luthadel in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mistborn-house-war]Mistborn: House War[/url] - a game of negotiation and betrayal set in the world of Brandon Sanderson's novels. Contending with myriad problems plaguing the Final Empire, will you rise to power and prestige or fall in ruin and disgrace? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/096f743b8b69869e6773bbb11ac4136c1548f42c.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mistborn-house-war]Mistborn: House War[/url][/h1]
3-5 players; 60-90 Minutes

Mistborn: House War is a resource-management game set during the events of the first Mistborn novel. Players assume the roles of various factions and must work together to solve the "Problems" facing the Final Empire. In order to solve these problems players must expend a certain combination of resources, but in return they receive Favor from the Lord Ruler. If the players are able to defeat Vin, then the player who has the highest amount of Favor wins. If the Unrest reaches 8, then the rebellion occurs and the player with the least Favor (the faction furthest from the Lord Ruler) wins.

notes.title: A Kid With a Sweet Tooth
notes.notes:
The fair is here and it's time to [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/nosh]Nosh[/url] on all your favorite treats in this new set collection game by Crafty Games. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/4f74e3adc5ad9795a8a03dd75790f6e88d223f7a.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/nosh]Nosh[/url] [/h1]
3-5 players; 20-40 Minutes

In Nosh, players bid their limited allowance on groups of treats available at each day of the fair. Everyone has their own secret favorites, and only certain combinations of treats can score each day. To win the game, a player has to carefully time their biggest bids on the treats they like the most and the ones that score the biggest on each day's Nosh cards.

notes.title: Glory for Gory
notes.notes:
Dispatch your strongest gladiators and most ferocious beasts to earn crowd favor in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/gorus-maximus]Gorus Maximus[/url], an upcoming trick-taking game of gladiatorial combat. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0e5dd47b8ab9784a7ef2a8104df1521a7ed90a8d.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/gorus-maximus]Gorus Maximus[/url]
1-8 players; 15-25 Minutes

Gorus Maximus can be played "player vs. player" or in teams. Players are dealt a hand of ten gladiator cards and must contribute one gladiator to each bout (trick). There is a preferred school (trump suit) and the strongest gladiator from this school wins the bout. If no preferred gladiator entered the fight, then the strongest initiating gladiator (suit called for) wins. Players must follow the initiating school if possible, or they may "challenge" by matching the strength of the last gladiator played, immediately changing the preferred school to that of their gladiator! Players compete to collect gladiators with positive crowd favour and avoid those with negative favour. The player with the highest favour at the end of the round earns 1 crowd support. The first player to earn 3 crowd support has won the support of the masses and earns the title: Champion of Gorus Maximus!

First physical release of the game is already funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/insideupgames/gorus-maximus-a-trick-taking-game-of-gladiatorial]Kickstarter[/url], so don't miss it out!

notes.title: A Mission For A Better Tomorrow
notes.notes:
In the distant future, the home planet is overpopulated and riots loom. The only solution seems to be to advance into space. Explore other planets, build space stations and conduct interplanetary trade under the name of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/solarius-mission]Solarius Mission[/url], the upcoming dice drafting and resource management game by Spielworxx. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/e3f9c13cc8d23323609cd35bfc7cfd755ab11c0b.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/solarius-mission]Solarius Mission[/url][/h1]
2-4 players; 15-25 Minutes

In Solarius Mission players explore far away planets, develop new technologies with their tech dice, and send settlers into space. They try to prevent space contamination.  Who acts especially prudent, who will win in the end? Solarius Mission is a tactical and strategic civilization game in a pulp science-fiction setting. It can best be described as a mid-weight euro-style game, built around importance of thinking ahead and optimizing personal strategies.

You can support the game's development through currently ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2061975914/mike-and-odes-solarius-mission-2nd-edition]Kickstarter[/url] campaign.

notes.title: Not All Who Wander Are Lost
notes.notes:
Survive a journey through the ominous woods, while suspecting that one of your partners is already corrupted by an Ancient Evil that sleeps in that [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/forsaken-forest]Forsaken Forest[/url], an upcoming co-operative social deduction game by Forsaken Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ae4338d5e438845979d89912adb98292520a4a7e.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/forsaken-forest]Forsaken Forest[/url]
4-8 players; 20-40 Minutes

Forsaken Forest is a social deduction card game set within a mysterious forest, inexplicably warped by dark magic. In order to win you must navigate to your team’s veiled Destination before the opposing team navigates to theirs, or eliminate everyone who stands in your way. Along the way, you’ll need to manage your resources wisely, gain the trust of your fellow travelers, and fend off the evils of the Night.

You can get your own physical copy of the game on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/240175861/forsaken-forest-revival-a-social-deduction-strateg/]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Garden of the Majestic Clear Lake
notes.notes:
Build an imperial garden by creating the landscape and placing the scenery in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tang-garden]Tang Garden[/url], an upcoming tile placement set collection game by ThunderGryph Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/3c76b89cfc5650ed1778ddaf1126b285cc548bd7.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tang-garden]Tang Garden[/url][/h1]
2-4 players; 60 Minutes

Tang Garden is a Zen-like game that will take you to the first golden age of China, where players will progressively build a garden by creating the landscape, placing the scenery and projecting their vision through vertical panoramas. During the construction, noblemen will visit the garden to admire the surroundings and the way the natural elements coexist in the most breathtaking scenery humankind has ever laid their eyes upon.

Try the game out on Tabletopia and support it on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gonab/tang-garden]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: A Race for Life
notes.notes:
Attempt to save an African Savannah, preserve its ecosystem and ensure there is a future for its wildlife in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/serengeti]Serengeti[/url], new area control deck building game by HAL-13.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/31c06a43ff66857983cdd599401e596c010596b5.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/serengeti]Serengeti[/url][/h1]
2 players; 30-45 Minutes

In Serengeti, your primary mission is to keep a close eye on all species, and make sure they can thrive in their environment. The game is played over a variable number of turns during which players will track animals, providing them with unique ways to deal with the various threats in the game as well as helping them efficiently manage their resources. At the end of the game, victory points will be awarded depending on the players' deck content as well as majority in the Savannah. The competition track may also tilt the outcome in favour of the player who best achieved to stay ahead of his opponent!

The game is already funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roguemvox/serengeti-revised-and-expanded]Kickstarter[/url], so check it out!

notes.title: New Marriage of King Henry
notes.notes:
Take a role of ambitious Lord and make your family the most influential one in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tudor]Tudor[/url] - a worker placement eurogame by Academy Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0a2b57a34512e0fd519ff8417aa16408fbf793d0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tudor]Tudor[/url][/h1] 
2-4 player; 90-120 Minutes

In Tudor, players serving the noble house in the court of King Henry VIII. You will work to gain prestige by placing members of your own family in positions of influence. But whether dealing with the clergy, spying on your rivals, or preparing for the king‘s latest marriage - surviving the intrigues of this court will require not only influence, but also skill and cunning. By acquiring offices and power in different areas of the court, the players will gain Prestige as the leaders of their families. Whoever collects the most Prestige will climb the ranks of the aristocracy and win the game.

Try the game out on Tabletopia and order your physical copy on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/617871702/tudor]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Find Your Own Path Through the Forest
notes.notes:
Travel along Alaskan shores and discover truth about Cutie's parents' whereabouts in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/patootie]When Cutie Met Patootie[/url], a new area movement/pattern building game by The Daniel Zayas Company.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/63a08d7d440a160c9ace2ed985d8b1a2224a794f.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/patootie]When Cutie Met Patootie[/url][/h1]
1-4 players; 30-45 Minutes

In When Cutie Met Patootie, players then take turns playing a path card each turn. These cards are used for building the map, helping visitors collect sprite gems and spend those gems to advance visitors along the built map. Players connect paths to create a pyramid shape, ever tightening the forest path! The end of the game is triggered when one visitor reaches the top. Players reveal their secret roles, each detailing specific sprite gems for which they earn points. The person with the most sprite gem points wins!

Support the game's physical release through [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sinisterfish/villagers-card-drafting-and-village-building-for-1]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: New Chapter For Mankind
notes.notes:
Become an architect of a future colony on the Red Planet in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/pocket-mars]Pocket Mars[/url], a new dynamic card game by Board&Dice.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/41da99784d3f5a8004e30b134bb041e34bf94e71.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/pocket-mars]Pocket Mars[/url][/h1]
1-4 players; 30 Minutes

The main objective in Pocket Mars is the preparation of an infrastructure that will allow more colonists to move to Mars. Players will undertake projects to send their colonists to Mars, where they will work in preestablished buildings to improve and upgrade the colony, as well as build new constructions that will allow the colony to prosper.

The player who most effectively allocates their colonists will score the most points and be victorious.

notes.title: Machine That Builds The Machine
notes.notes:
Discover quirky combinations of factories, puzzle out the best placement of all your workers and manufacture as many goods as possible in your [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/fantastic-factories]Fantastic Factories[/url], new worker placement and hand management game by Joseph Z Chen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/02710de55b60e3f5da8b39352ea70312e998e66d.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/fantastic-factories]Fantastic Factories[/url][/h1]
2-4 players; 60 Minutes

Fantastic Factories is an engine-building, dice-placement tabletop game for 1 to 5 players for ages 14+ and takes 45 to 60 minutes. Race against other players as you try to build the most efficient set of factories in the shortest amount of time. You must carefully manage your blueprints, train your workers, and manufacture as many goods as possible in order to achieve industrial dominance! 

Support the development of the game through ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1602062107/fantastic-factories-a-dice-placement-engine-buildi]Kickstarter[/url] project!

Reign over the kingdom of Israel during its golden age in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/wisdom-of-solomon]Wisdom of Solomon[/url], the upcoming strategy worker placement game by Funhill Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0c20f16c65943df661b29e7037781d73691117e8.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/wisdom-of-solomon]Wisdom of Solomon[/url]
1-5 players; 60 Minutes

In Wisdom of Solomon, players act as governors for Solomon, sending out workers to gather resources, build structures, and expand Solomon’s influence in the kingdom. The player who curries the most Favor will be crowned the winner! Wisdom of Solomon is a light to medium weight game, meaning that there is plenty of strategy for experienced gamers to enjoy but the game is intuitive and simple enough for new gamers to be able to jump right in.

Try the game out on Tabletopia and support its future release through [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1134773245/wisdom-of-solomon-board-game]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.notes:
Escape quarantined orbital platform by overcoming system malfunctions and completing half-built spaceship, in a quick cooperative card game [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/assembly]Assembly[/url] by Wren Games. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/19f6f47967d4a72c786fd69a89e7260bba070414.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/assembly]Assembly[/url][/h1]
1-2 players; 20 Minutes

Assembly is a cooperative or solo puzzle card game. Using the Command Cards in your hand Draw, Swap, and Rotate Room Modules around the ship until they sit on their matching Blueprint where you can lock them into place to build a ship and escape.

You can support the game's first physical release by pledging to the ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wrengames/assembly-a-compact-solo-or-cooperative-puzzle-card]Kickstarter[/url] campaign.

notes.title: What is This Restless Feeling?
notes.notes:
Find your intrepid partner and escape from the endless Lovecraftian Dreamscape full of maddening visions of terror, in new cooperative card game [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mad-love]Mad Love[/url] by Imp House LLC. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/28dbe4e73dba6b43ae6f02ea35044ea30de945c0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mad-love]Mad Love[/url][/h1]
2 players; 15 Minutes

Mad Love is a Lovecraftian cooperative pocket card game of memory and deduction for 2 people played with a deck of just 18 cards. You and your partner are separated and lost in a nightmare world; you cannot hear or see each other. This means no verbally sharing information or giving visual hints to your partner. The only way to convey information to one another is by adding and dismissing cards, which represent dreams, in and out of the central area of play, a 2x2 grid called the Dreamscape. 

The game is currently at its final days on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/imphouse/mad-love-0]Kickstarter[/url], so don't miss it out!

notes.title: 2 New Steam DLCs - Available Now!
notes.notes:
Dear Tabletopians, we are happy to announce that two highly requested games from our library are now available as Steam DLCs! You can now buy [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/eight-minute-empire-legends]Eight-Minute Empire: Legends[/url] and [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/anachrony]Anachrony[/url] and play them forever, with no subscription required. As usual, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ce213c2cfd5f9870b2315542edd29dcda3c5dc9d.png[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/eight-minute-empire-legends]Eight-Minute Empire: Legends[/url][/h1]
Eight-Minute Empire: Legends is a standalone sequel to the area control game Eight-Minute Empire and does not require the original game to play. Just like the original game, players take turns selecting a card from six on display. The card has an action that the player takes immediately, and actions help players take over the map, but instead of goods, cards now have special abilities, which give players unique advantages and ways to break the rules throughout the game. Build a small empire in a land of legends!

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/anachrony]Anachrony[/url][/h1]
Anachrony features an unique two-tiered worker placement system. To travel to the Capital or venture out to the devastated areas for resources, players need not only various Specialists, but also Exosuits to protect and enhance them - and both are in short supply. The game is played in 4-7 rounds, depending on the time when the looming cataclysm occurs. The elapsed turns are measured on a dynamic Timeline. By powering up the Time Rifts, players can reach back to earlier turns to supply their past "self" with resources. Each Path has a vastly different objective that rewards it with a massive amount of Victory Points when achieved. The Paths' settlements will survive the impact, but the Capital will not. Whichever Path manages to collect most points will be the new seat for the Capital, thus the most important force left on the planet.


You can purchase these new DLCs on our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560/Tabletopia/]Steam product page[/url].

Tell us in the comments which games you would like to see as DLCs.

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Town on the Edge of Abyss
notes.notes:
Something dark is stalking the streets of Upsideville. People are disappearing without a trace. Will the Town and its people be able to win and walk peacefully once again around? Or will the darkness triumph, and the horrifying creature will walk freely between the alleys? Decide the fate of the town with [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/inbetween]InBetween[/url] - new area control and hand management game by Board&Dice.

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/inbetween]InBetween[/url]
2 players; 20-40 Minutes

InBetween is a game for two players, competing against each other to either protect or devour the inhabitants of Upsideville in a tug-of-war between the Human and Creature dimensions. Players take turns playing cards and using abilities that will draw the Characters further into their dimension.
