A visit to annual convention is a big opportunity to pour out your passions by collecting rare products at the best prices. Closing the best deals and completing your collection will get you the title of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/king-of-con]King of Con[/url] - in the upcoming game by Lega Nerd!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/1536825a3a10626dce167076710367efa508343b.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/king-of-con]King of Con[/url][/h1]
2-5 player; 60 Minutes

In King of Con players manage their resources, influence the market supply with demands and try to get the best items through 3 rounds of auctions. Collecting objects will allow you to earn victory points, especially if they fit your secret passions, but also prestige, which expresses itself in new resources to buy other pieces of your collection.

Try the game on Tabletopia and support it's first physical release through [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1453880502/king-of-con-the-game-of-impulsive-buying]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: The best ways to play board games on PC
notes.notes:
The biggest issue with board gaming has always been finding other players. Even when you do track down some potential opponents, pinning them to an agreed time and place can still be tricky. 

As a result, there have been services to co-ordinate online play since the earliest days of the internet. Nowadays they’ve proliferated and become much more polished and usable. If there’s a game you want to play, you’re almost certain to find some software that lets you, often free or for a pittance. 

Here are five of our favourites.

Tabletop Simulator

Tabletop Simulator 

Best for: Real-time games on the internet

Speed: Real-time only

Rules: Not enforced

Top Titles: Star Wars Destiny, Cosmic Encounter

This looks more like a physics engine than a board game client. Your view shows a game table, and you use the mouse to manipulate game components, draw cards, roll dice. It feels odd at first, but it's a stroke of genius. It allows the client to simulate pretty much any tabletop game. Throw in text and voice chat, a busy community and a dazzling cascade of fan-made modules and you've got the world's current favourite game client. It's even got VR support.

You pay upfront for the software then, in theory, you pay for premium game modules, of which there are currently 34 on Steam. In practice there are a huge number of homemade ones in the Steam Workshop. Many are a bit rough and ready, but they work well enough. You’ll need your own copy of the rules, though. 

Of course, while it's useful for trying out a new game you might be interested in picking up, using a free module means the original game creator isn't getting paid. 

Tabletopia

Tabletopia

Best for: Hotseat play around one screen

Speed: Real-time only

Rules: Not enforced

Top Titles: Santorini, Race to the Rhine

Following in the footsteps of TTS, this is another physics-based platform with a smaller library and a bit more polish than its competitor. It's free to download, and gives you access to a limited library of solid titles. If you want the full range to play, you'll have to stump up on a subscription-based model.

Almost everything that's good or bad about Tabletopia runs off that subscription model. On the plus side, the interface on most games is slick and professional. And, of course, paying a subscription means game creators get paid. On the downside, subscribers are scarce, so finding opponents for premium-only games can take a long time.

It is, however, great for hotseat play where all the players sit round the same screen. Not least because you can play a lot of otherwise premium titles this way. That's not a great way to play games with hidden information. But for everything else, Tabletopia offers a pleasing and accessible package.

Vassal

Vassal

Best for: Dedicated gamers who want a lot of options

Speed: Real-time and play by email

Rules: Not enforced

Top Titles: Mage Knight, X-Wing

Want access to a colossal library of tabletop games, many of which aren't available on any other digital platform? You can get it through Vassal, but you'll need to put in some work. It's Java-based, for starters, so you'll find the Vassal installer adds that you your PC if it's not already there. You'll have to download and configure the modules you want to play. It's all a bit of a faff, frankly, but it's worth it in the end.

What Vassal costs in effort it makes up for in flexibility. Its library of games is huge. They're all free, but you're asked to only download and use ones for games you own. You can play live, although there's no real lobby system, so it’s wiser to arrange games with friends or on forums. But you can also play games by email, sending log files back and forth.

Vassal's original purpose was to facilitate the play of monster wargames. The sort of things that have hundreds of counters and play-hours. There's still plenty of them among its modules library. Nowadays, however, users have created modules for all sorts of games. Plus, wargames themselves have become far more accessible. Try something like Commands & Colors: you might be pleasantly surprised.

Board Game Arena

Board Game Arena

Best for: Slow burning strategy by email

Speed: Real-time and asynchronous

Rules:  Enforced

Top Titles: Through the Ages, Hanabi

If you wander into BGA's website, you'll find it a barebones affair. Register and start playing, though, and you'll discover a service full of impressive features and boasting a big list of games. According to the site's creator, he has licences to offer all of them online. The majority are free, although there's a premium subscription service to unlock a few more and support the site. 

There are a lot of websites that let you play games online, but BGA is unusual in offering real-time play alongside asynchronous games. Action unfolds as you watch in your browser, and icons keep everyone informed of each other’s status. You choose which mode you want before selecting or starting a game.

The site even enforces the rules of the game you're playing, although the quality of the interface varies a lot. It can be hard to work out what's going on in some of the more complex games. As you might imagine for a free service that works in your browser, BGA has a solid user base, making it easy to find opponents.

Yucata

Yucata

Best for: Long term players who like ranks and stats

Speed: Asynchronous only

Rules:  Enforced

Top Titles: A Few Acres of Snow, Jaipur

There are plenty of places to play asynchronous board games. What distinguishes this German site is the range of games and features on offer. There are over 100 titles to play, a ranking system, and a replay feature you can use to study strategies. Chrome users even have a browser plugin available to track their games.

Playing games by email can take a long time: potentially months depending on the speed of your opponents. On the plus side, it does give you plenty of time to think about your moves. And there are some gems among the games on offer, including out-of-print and hard-to-find titles unavailable elsewhere.

Yucata started out purely as a hobby project. It’s still free to use and free of adverts, and is supported entirely through player donations.

Honourable mentions 

While those five are the top picks for online play, there are plenty of other competitors to consider. The best known is probably BrettSpielWelt, a German community that offers free real-time play via its Java client. It's old, though, and it shows. And it can be hard for English speakers to get to grips with the interface and to communicate in game.

Another venerable program is Cyberboard, which lets you record log files for play by email games. It's free and doesn't need any third-party software. But its user base and range of available modules is small. ZunTzu and newcomer BattleGrounds Games clients are also worth checking out.

Other websites worth checking out for browser play includes SpielByWeb, Boite a Jeux and For Whom The Web Rocks. ACTS is a limited-feature site that tracks card decks and dice rolls for multi-player games. 

Finally, some publishers make their own online versions. Days of Wonder lets you play some of its games via browser. And many games have dedicated PC versions, too.

notes.title: The Alliance Has Broken
notes.notes:
Unite the warring clans and become the next Goblin Emperor by proving your strength in a series of strategic battles inspired by Stratego and War in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/goblin-grapple]Goblin Grapple[/url] - an upcoming card game by Silver Gaming Company. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/e30421f1fa974185abdba14b9da54392a3471a6c.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/goblin-grapple]Goblin Grapple[/url][/h1]
2-4 player; 15-30 Minutes

Goblin Grapple is a bluffing and trick-taking game where players race to gain points by collecting goblins in battle. The goal of the game is to collect 100 points worth of goblins over multiple rounds of play. Players start the game with 5 goblin cards and can use them to build their armies and challenge their opponents. Cards are secretly played into armies with the last goblin card played being revealed when entering battle. To challenge another player’s army, attacker plays a goblin from their hand face-up. The defender will then reveal their last army card played. The stronger goblin wins the battle, unless special goblin abilities are activated, and the winning player will take all face up cards from the battle, placing them into their garrison. Once a garrison reaches 21 points or more, the round ends. Players will add points from their garrison and army to their total score.

You can get physical copy of the game by supporting currently ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/silvergamingcompany/goblin-grapple]Kickstarter[/url] project!

notes.title: Sentinels of the Timeline
notes.notes:
Thwart the nefarious plot of Augustus von Loghan, who is threatening to destroy time itself in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/castle-von-loghan]Castle Von Loghan[/url] - a cooperative adventure game by Underground Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/c6056e6a89e0a388f2522bc63613ae11234ae339.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/castle-von-loghan]Castle Von Loghan[/url][/h1]
1-6 player; 60-120 Minutes

Castle Von Loghan is a co-op, group-decision making, survival board game that offers a unique narrative, morphing game boards and diceless combat. The game includes several game-modes, such as Story Campaign and Exploration. Working together as one group, the players adventure inside Castle von Loghan where they will face an array of dangers but also will find several valuable treasures. During each turn, players have to decide where to go next, solve the secrets of the room in which they have arrived, battle the enemies protecting it, then prepare for the next encounter. The only route to winning the game is through survival — and to survive, they need to work together.

Try the game out on Tabletopia and join other agents on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1890003488/castle-von-loghan]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Rescue the Target and Remain Unseen
notes.notes:
Become an agent of the secret government project, specializing in undercover missions in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/blight-chronicles-agent-decker]Blight Chronicles: Agent Decker[/url] - a scenario driven solo deck building game by Board&Dice.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/8560194e4714ae8360777640ac1f98b0ddeee6f6.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/blight-chronicles-agent-decker]Blight Chronicles: Agent Decker[/url][/h1]
1 player; 60-120 Minutes

In Blight Chronicles the Agent starts the game with the same deck, but as you face different obstacles your move set will change, and so will your gear. When dealing with an obstacle you’re faced with a choice: Do you knock it out without making too much noise, or eliminate it and take its gear? Choose your stages well! Each has a different set of obstacles and goal, affected by choices you made in previous stages. They also allow you to collect different gear. It’s your chance to show Blight and the World that you’re worthy, ready to face everything on your path. The Mission awaits!

Try the game out on Tabletopia and join the agents ranks through [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1293726726/blight-chronicles-agent-decker]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Tournament of Seven Kingdoms
notes.notes:
Young Seeker, your time has come. Travel through Kingdom of Pomme and discover your destiny in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/my-little-scythe]My Little Scythe[/url] - new area control family game by Stonemaier games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/08cec1a6cb4ed1bb19016ba07513fd9dc7a18999.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/my-little-scythe]My Little Scythe[/url][/h1]
1-6 players; 45 Minutes

My Little Scythe is a competitive, family-friendly game inspired by the bestselling game, Scythe. Each player controls 2 animal miniatures embarking upon an adventure toward Castle Everfree. In an effort to be the first to earn 4 trophies from 8 possible categories, players take turns choosing to Move, Seek, or Make. These actions will allow players to increase their friendship and pies, power up their actions, complete quests, learn magic spells, deliver gems and apples to the Castle, and perhaps even engage in a pie fight.

notes.title: Fortune Favours the Bold
notes.notes:
Travel on expeditions to far off regions of the world. Fantastic animals, beautiful orchids, glittering treasures, lost explorers, maps and more all await discovery. Fame and fortune will come to those brave enough to trek into the untamed wilds of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/exploriana]Exploriana[/url] - an upcoming game of exploration and discovery set towards the end of the 19th century. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/d9faea3f199318de8b3b14b7ada2a938b6a5b3fd.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/exploriana]Exploriana[/url][/h1]
2-5 players; 45 Minutes

Exploriana is played over several rounds. Players collect income, buy useful equipment and then decide which of three regions of the world they wish to send their explorers; South America, Africa or The Far East. Exploration is a dangerous pursuit, perils lurk just waiting to doom an expedition to failure! Useful items and local guides can help a beleaguered explorer but if their expedition runs into too much trouble they could become lost, never to be seen again! The players must decide just how far to push their luck and see if fortune really does favour the bold!

Try the game on Tabletopia and support its release on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/exploriana/exploriana-a-game-of-exploration-and-discovery]Kickstarter[/url].

notes.title: 4 New Steam DLCs - Available Now!
notes.notes:
Dear Tabletopians, we are happy to announce that four highly requested games from our library are now available as Steam DLCs! You can now buy [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/viticulture-essential-edition]Viticulture[/url], [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tuscany-essential-edition]Tuscany[/url], [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/feudum]Feudum[/url] and [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/argent-the-consortium]Argent: the Consortium[/url] and play them forever, with no subscription required. As usual, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/38e38666eddbedaa02bd0360dcb396c536519734.png[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/viticulture-essential-edition]Viticulture[/url][/h1]
In Viticulture: Essential Edition, players find themselves in the roles of people in rustic Tuscany who have inherited meager vineyards. Every season is different, so the workers have different tasks they can take care of in the summer and winter. Fortunately for the players, people love to visit wineries, and many of those visitors are willing to help out when they visit. Using those workers and visitors, players can expand their vineyards by building structures, planting vines, and filling wine orders. Players work towards the goal of running the most successful winery in Tuscany.

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tuscany-essential-edition]Tuscany[/url][/h1]
Tuscany is collection of expansions that reimagines original Viticulture in several new ways. It features new extended board, introduces new types of cards for structures and specialized workers. 
This collection is intended to take gameplay Viticulture to a whole new level, with additional area control mechanic and more opportunities for diversifying your strategies.

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/feudum]Feudum + Expansions[/url][/h1]
Feudum is an economic medieval game of hand and resource management. With many strategies at their disposal, players optimize four actions per turn in attempt to score the most victory points. You will compete to acquire coveted feudums, which increase your membership status in one of six guilds. If you run your guilds wisely, maintain control of key locations and adapt best to changing events, you will be victorious. Long live the King!

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/argent-the-consortium]Argent: the Consortium[/url][/h1]
The time has come for the selection of a new Chancellor at Argent University of Magic, and you are among the likely candidates for the job. Argent: The Consortium is a cutthroat worker-placement/engine-building game of manipulation and secrecy in which the criteria for victory are secret and the capabilities of your opponents are constantly changing. You'll need to outwit the other candidates, use your spells at the right moment, and choose the correct apprentices to manage your plan.

You can purchase these new DLCs on our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560/Tabletopia/]Steam product page[/url].

Tell us in the comments which games you would like to see as DLCs.

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: This City has to Burn!
notes.notes:
Play as vengeful witches and bring ruin to [url=https://tabletopia.com/news/triora]Triora[/url], the city that burned your leader, in this new area control game by Arcano Games. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/43bc5dedddef54024d5a6f81dad4af17370fb2a1.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/news/triora]Triora[/url][/h1]
2-4 players; 40-100 Minutes

Triora is a "Euro" style game where players compete to destroy the city. To bring ruin to Triora the Witches will use herbs to make potions and spread plague and curses to the different places in Triora's region, wile they flee from the Inquisition that are hunting the then. Triora has a mechanic focus on resource management, without influence of luck, and with good tactical deepness. The players will not affect each other directly, but their choices of play have great influence to the strategy of their opponents.

notes.title: Can You Escape Titan Station?
notes.notes:
Run for your life through the corridors of the collapsing space station to find that last escape pod and become the only survivor in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/no-escape]No Escape[/url] - an upcoming tile placement / take that game by OOMM. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/9969f9f417cc832667b0c4b4a384819cbd91b159.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/no-escape]No Escape[/url][/h1]
2-8 players; 15-45 Minutes

No Escape is a fast-paced, strategic maze-building tile game. Use actions against each other, increase the maze for your opponents, and move using a creative dice system. Be strategic when placing dead ends to block your opponents, as every dead end will also give players advantages. Play your Action tiles when they'll provide you the greatest advantage, but hold onto them too long and you may be forced to discard them all. The first player to make it out of the maze wins.

Try the game on Tabletopia and support its development through [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/oommgames/no-escape]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Journey for the Crystals
notes.notes:
Become professional Curse Breaker and explore arcane secrets hidden within ancient ruins in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mystery_of_the_temples]Mystery of the Temples[/url] - new area control / set collection game by Deep Water Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/5455b80d258576db2785c5d2cc34a605228fa889.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mystery_of_the_temples]Mystery of the Temples[/url][/h1]
2-4 players; 20-45 Minutes

In Mystery of the Temples, players take on the role of Curse Breakers of the Magic Academy, traveling between the wilderness and the temples in order to collect crystals of various colors. Fusing the colorful crystals on the Crystal Grid in the correct order breaks the curse of the temple, and you earn runes and victory points in the process. Once a player has broken five curses, highest amount of victory points wins.

notes.title: Born in Water, Dice in Wine
notes.notes:
Seek the help of the spirit world for most abundant harvest, in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/rice-dice]Rice Dice[/url] - new dice worker placement game by APE Games. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/36b0ed4f97243a6ff5e62746395906feabc73f31.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/rice-dice]Rice Dice[/url][/h1]
2-5 players; 30-40 Minutes

In Rice Dice, a streamlined version of Spirits of the Rice Paddy, you roll the custom dice and choose one action based on the results: add rice paddy cards to your field, run water through your paddies, assign laborers to plant and harvest, or add weeds to opponents' fields. Rice Dice rewards a player's ability to optimize the process of flooding, planting, weeding, and harvesting — but it plays in just a fraction of the time!

Try the game on Tabletopia and support it on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/apegames/rice-dice-a-spirits-of-the-rice-paddy-dice-game-fo]Kickstarter!

notes.title: The King is Dead!
notes.notes:
Send your servants into the [url=https://tabletopia.com/news/crypt]Crypt[/url] chambers to pilfer the best treasure in new set collection game by Road To Infamy Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/1f9c546d4172fe79d8364f536f2b6b92ff426e89.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/news/crypt]Crypt[/url][/h1]
2-4 players; 20 Minutes

Crypt is a light set collection game with a press you luck mechanic with easy-to-learn rules and exciting strategic gameplay, all in 20 minutes. Claim Treasure cards by placing Servant dice and choosing any value on each die to designate each Servant’s effort. The higher the value, the more likely your Servant will become exhausted when you roll the dice. You can also push out your siblings’ Servants by placing dice with values exceeding the occupying Servants’ total effort.

Pre-order physical copy of the game in the currently ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roadtoinfamy/crypt-1]Kickstarter[/url] project!

notes.title: The Ancient Stares Back
notes.notes:
Stop the eldritch beings from breaking into our world in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/i-am-the-fourth-wall]I am the Fourth Wall[/url] - one vs. all assymmetrical card game by Slinky Gibbon Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/6232c335ce18f430fe597662823a217f12979010.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/i-am-the-fourth-wall]I am the Fourth Wall[/url][/h1]
1-7 players; 30-45 Minutes

I am the Fourth Wall is a game of Lovecrafian horror set in jiving 1950’s suburbia. It focuses on tight teamwork and coordination, careful hand management, and the option to take on high risk/reward strategies. One player takes on the role of the Wall, one of the many ancient beings hell-bent on driving the world into perpetual madness, seeking to five gates to the nightmare world beyond. They will face oﬀ against the remaining 2-6 players, who become the Investigators, everyday people who know that their only chance to save humanity lies in closing all of the gates, and thus banishing The Wall from their world... for a time.

Try the game on Tabletopia and support it on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/217570777/i-am-the-fourth-wall-asymmetrical-cthulhu-horror-c]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Quest for Dwarven Glory
notes.notes:
Grab your digging tools and prepare for [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/gem-rush]Gem Rush[/url], an easy-to-learn tile placement and hand management game by Victory Point Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/212497ff09e8f7868eb5a9ca640129a7c0f570d9.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/gem-rush]Gem Rush[/url][/h1]
1-4 players; 30-60 Minutes

In Gem Rush players use gem cards to construct new rooms, and use the rooms to replenish their gems. Race your friends for fortune in rush mode, or work together to save the mine in crisis mode. Either way, you've got to dig fast and manage your gems carefully.

A typical card includes two gemstones; you can count it as either – or as both if you can find the right spot to use them. The game board changes each time you play as the playing area is constructed out of modular room tiles, each with different abilities and different opportunities for further construction.

You can support the release of the 2nd Edition on currently ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/567823005/gem-rush-second-edition]Kickstarter[/url] project!

notes.title: Harsh Times Call for Harsh Measures
notes.notes:
Build your empire in the dieselpunk world of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/crisis-new-economy]CRISIS: The New Economy[/url] - new expansion for the gritty economic game of worker placement and resource management by LudiCreations.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/f4ce8aa1b396c87caf3ed5e11c1204e621715652.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/crisis-new-economy]CRISIS: The New Economy[/url][/h1]
1-5 players; 45-120 Minutes

Axia is still a place where small pockets of commercial innovation persist. Local entrepreneurs are developing new technologies, while others find ways to benefit society and the environment. Many of those can be lucrative new opportunities for the right investor. In Crisis: The New Economy these new opportunities are represented by 15 new Company cards. These are shuffled together and 5-8 of them are randomly chosen. Their equivalent replacements are then removed from the game, and Setup proceeds as in the base game.

The new Companies add more variability and replayability. They offer new avenues to money and VP as well as resources. The expansion also includes a variant for players that want a game with quicker access to the 5th Manager token.

Try the expansion on Tabletopia and support it's release on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ludicreations/crisis-the-new-economy]Kickstarter[/url]!

notes.title: Battle of Rorke’s Drift
notes.notes:
Hold your position and repel the relentless charge of fierce enemies in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/zulus-on-the-ramparts]Zulus on the Ramparts[/url] - new solitaire wargame by Victory Point Games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/5568fbaec07c2a7d2b4f196b41a9663f2d179303.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/zulus-on-the-ramparts]Zulus on the Ramparts[/url]
1 player; 25 Minutes

Zulus on the Ramparts! is a solitaire States of SiegeTM game of The Battle of Rorke’s Drift in South Africa during the Anglo-Zulu War of 1879. At this battle, approximately 140 British soldiers and auxiliaries defended a small compound (in an area less than half the size of a baseball field) against 4000+ crack Zulu warriors – and won. This action saw more Victoria Crosses awarded (the highest medal for bravery in Britain) to a single regiment at a battle than any other before or since. Its legend has grown to become one of the greatest “stands” ever in military history.

notes.title: Surreality Has Become Our New Reality
notes.notes:

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/new-corp-order]New Corp Order[/url]

New Corp Order is a game of infiltration, manipulation and world domination. As the top executive of one of the world's leading MegaCorps, your task is to improve the public image of your company through the wise manipulation of the 4 biggest Media Conglomerates. Infiltrate their structures and use that influence to your advantage, even if that means playing one conglomerate against the other. After all, the prize is big: The World.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/3bb889d53f37763c904f44fa5d8f415ec6cea597.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/nemo-s-war-second-edition]Nemo's War[/url]
1-4 players; 60-120 Minutes

Nemo’s War is based on the novel "20,000 Leagues Under the Seas" by Jules Verne. It’s a single-player game of underwater exploration and combat circa 1870. You are Captain Nemo, commander of the Nautilus. You will search the oceans, fight vessels of all nations, brave the hazards of the seas, find mysterious treasures, behold and chronicle amazing wonders, and travel around the world in your quest for knowledge and vengeance.

notes.title: On the Verge of Darkness
notes.notes:
In the world on the brink of annihilation, a great evil seeks to conquer the earth. Only the ancient enchantment has long hidden the existence of magic and the dark realms from humanity. 
Will it only serve to blind mankind from their one chance at mounting a defense against the coming onslaught? The answer lies beyond [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-veil]The Veil[/url] - in a new dark fantasy deck building game by Logan Gendron. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/6ff3a2411f2b6bd4ef7e028f9b84d6b4b5e8e1a4.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-veil]The Veil[/url][/h1]
2-4 players; 45 Minutes

Pick one of the thematic decks and defeat your opponents in a character driven combat.  deck building mechanics include a private market for each player allowing characters decks and abilities to be thematically appropriate to their class. Villain characters are more powerful permitting dynamic 1 vs 2 games while eliminating the problems of traditional free-for-all matches. A choose-your-own-adventure style campaign mode that allows 1 to 5 players to immerse in the the story of the world.

notes.title: And The Wheels Keep Turning
notes.notes:
Discover and rebuild abandoned steampunk metropolis in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/city-of-gears]City of Gears[/url] - an award winning worker placement and area control game by Grey Fox Games. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/f4e48d8d578969e2758c8139cbb3824aed45ef06.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/city-of-gears]City of Gears[/url][/h1]
2-4 players; 45 Minutes

City of Gears is a game of exploration, area control, worker placement, and engine building. From your Factory, you must race to claim ownership over the magnificent ruins of an abandoned clockwork metropolis. Each turn, you roll dice, activate City Tiles, move your automaton workers to reactivate areas of the city or to sabotage opponents. Along the way, you will develop your Factory with special powers which provide you with powerful bonuses. 

City of Gears is now available in our game library and will be added to our mobile library very soon. 

Don't miss your chance to get your copy of the game through [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/152730994/city-of-gears-a-game-of-discovery-development-and]Kickstarter[/url], as the campaign is already at its final hours!

notes.title: The Fight Never Ends
notes.notes:
Outplay your opponent in dynamic battles of wits and martial arts in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/exceed-red-horizon]Exceed[/url] and [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dragon-punch]Dragon Punch[/url] - two fighting games, presented by Level 99 Games.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/b74f391f576c6bdeaf6d261d91e1419d786a5674.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/exceed-red-horizon]Exceed[/url][/h1]
2 players; 20-30 Minutes

Exceed is an easy-to-learn head-to-head fighting card game, featuring fighters from different universes and brisk tactical gameplay. Whether you prefer to fight with cerebral tactics, high-energy combos, or sheer reckless abandon, we've got you covered! Whether you're coming to EXCEED from the world of video games or as an expert card gamer, there's a lot to experience in the system.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/8aa1e29b0631cfad142d19364f3bb3728abc0b7b.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dragon-punch]Dragon Punch[/url][/h1]
2 players; 15 Minutes

Dragon Punch is a quick two-player card game inspired by video games such as the Street Fighter series, in which the players try to outwit each other with the timing and positioning of their attacks and defenses. The guessing game is never exactly the same; chosen cards may not be used again for a time, taking damage gives players the opportunity to secretly upgrade their moves, and each player also has a unique character card with special moves.

notes.title: Truth Behind A Bribery Scandal
notes.notes:
Be on a right side in the ruthless game of alliances, betrayal and corruption in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/billionaire-sergeant]Billionaire Sergeant[/url] - a social deduction game about Hong Kong Police in the 1960 - 70s.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/c4e0880632df6051625396a119c7abb49f5a62bf.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/billionaire-sergeant]Billionaire Sergeant[/url][/h1]
4-6 players; 30-60 Minutes

Billionaire Sergeant involves 3 parties: Royal Police, Corrupted Police and Sergeant. Unlike other games, players’ party can be changed from time to time. Even you and other friends are royal police at the beginning, some of your colleagues may not be able to resist the temptation and turn to the dark side. Or maybe, a corrupted police would feel guilty and would like to turn over a new leaf. At this critical moment, who else can you trust?

notes.title: A Conflux of Realities
notes.notes:
Create the best possible timeline in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/infinities-defiance-of-fate]Infinities: Defiance of Fate[/url] - an upcoming strategic adventure game with resource management, map building and dice drafting. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/392ab5a8f642126eaa8a5d2074ffc574eb12a939.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/infinities-defiance-of-fate]Infinities: Defiance of Fate[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 40-120 Minutes

Infinities: Defiance of Fate is set in a cross-over setting of fantasy and science-fiction worlds connected by multiversal rifts. As these rifts open, factions from each world collide as their realities blend into one another. The game boasts a hybrid gameplay style, blending strategy card game and tactical wargame mechanics with narrative elements. A leader acts as your avatar as you immerse yourself into the game’s worlds. Each leader is represented as a playmat with an attribute track and a unique set of abilities called Gambits. You can play unit cards in your leader's group to bolster attributes and gain new abilities. You can also play ability cards to perform one-shot effects or prepare cards in your Timeline for future activation. For your turn, roll action dice and use them to explore map tiles, play cards, attack other leaders, and secure objectives. Shape the very worlds they walk on, and fulfill or redefine their destinies. 

The game is currently on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vatales/infinities-defiance-of-fate]Kickstarter[/url], so check it out!

notes.title: Twilight of the Mad King
notes.notes:
Pick a hero and fight your way through the grand tournament in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dice-throne]Dice Throne[/url] - a fast-playing game of skilled card play and dice manipulation by Mind Bottling Games. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/a24a13cf2fcffea53ce901124d42ff11a3162afc.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dice-throne]Dice Throne[/url][/h1] 
2-6 Players; 30 Minutes

Dice Throne is a game of intriguing dice, tactical card play, powerful heroes, and unique abilities. Select from a variety of heroes that play and feel completely distinct from one another. Attack opponents and activate abilities by rolling your hero's unique set of five dice. Accumulate combat points and spend them on cards that have a large range of effects, such as granting permanent hero upgrades, applying status effects, and manipulating dice directly (yours, your teammate's, or even your opponent's).

Second season of the game is currently on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roxley/dice-throne-season-two]Kickstarter[/url], so check it out!

notes.title: My Deck Is Only Of Trap Cards
notes.notes:
Build decks, play the meta, crack boosters and compete in tournaments in the world of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/millennium-blades]Millennium Blades[/url] - a CCG-simulator game by Level 99 Games.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/d0b2101c6ac36101751aba0d09132918f0e3a869.jpg[/img] 

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/millennium-blades]Millennium Blades[/url][/h1]
2-5 Players; 80-120 Minutes

In Millennium Blades you play as a group of friends who play the fictional CCG. The game takes you from Starter Deck to Regionals in about 2-3 hours. Multiple games can also be chained together to form a Campaign, going from Regionals to Nationals in game 2 and from Nationals to Worlds in game 3, with each game introducing ever more powerful cards and higher stakes, but also resetting the power of the game so that each player has a fair chance to win each 'season' of the campaign. At its heart, it’s a commodity trading game, except that instead of cubes or stocks, the things you’ll be buying, selling, and speculating on are trading cards that can be used throughout the game in periodic tournaments. By trading wisely, playing the market, working together with friends, building collections, and winning tournaments, you’ll secure points and become the Millennium Blades World Champion.

notes.title: Colonization Begins
notes.notes:
Develop the infrastructure for mining operations and compete for control over the resource-rich planet of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/pandorum]Pandorum[/url] in the new cosmic strategy eurogame by Cosmodrome Games.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/17400fcf86146dbb906befa2c6895c59006aac1a.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/pandorum]Pandorum[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 45 Minutes

Welcome to Pandorum — a far-far away and unfriendly planet. No life, no breathable atmosphere, but lots of exploitable resources! For three long star cycles, the Galactic Council considered the issue of the planet’s colonization. Meanwhile, four largest space corporations managed to deploy their harvesters — huge construction and production platforms — on the Pandorum’s orbit.

Now when the decision has been made, at last, it’s time to start landing on the spotted with calderas planet’s surface! Take command over engineering services, construct production sites, update harvesters, build fortifications, elaborate logistics and infrastructure for the planet. Don’t forget about your rivals: they are wide awake to rob you of your earned Quids — intergalactic currency.

You can pre-order the game through the ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1985527540/pandorum-the-board-game]Kickstarter[/url] project.

notes.notes:
Six legendary Guilds compete for the favour of the Royal Family, a favour that brings with it a prize of unrivaled value — the Royal Centenary Contract, guaranteed work for 100 years. The [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/smiths-of-winterforge]Smiths of Winterforge[/url] will stop at nothing to claim this highest honour in this new competitive strategy game by Rule & Make. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ceaaf130884f1783a8076a4be994cba99bd25e21.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/smiths-of-winterforge]Smiths of Winterforge[/url][/h1]
1-6 Players; 90-120 Minutes

Each Player manages one of the six mighty Guilds of Winterforge. Throughout the game, you will compete against your fellow Smiths to earn Reputation Points (RP) for your Guild. You gain these points by forging Contracts, employing a full Crew, upgrading your Skills, and paying off any Loans taken from the Bank. 
There are many paths to riches and reputation, are you going to take the right one?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ceaaf130884f1783a8076a4be994cba99bd25e21.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/smiths-of-winterforge]Smiths of Winterforge[/url][/h1]
1-6 Players; 90-120 Minutes

Each Player manages one of the six mighty Guilds of Winterforge. Throughout the game, you will compete against your fellow Smiths to earn Reputation Points (RP) for your Guild. You gain these points by forging Contracts, employing a full Crew, upgrading your Skills, and paying off any Loans taken from the Bank. 
There are many paths to riches and reputation, are you going to take the right one?

notes.title: I've Come Up With a New Recipe!
notes.notes:
In [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/cooksncrooks]Cooks & Crooks[/url] players are international chefs competing between each other. But unlike most competitions, these cooks don’t mind playing dirty! They will try to obtain victory while sabotaging their opponents' efforts by stealing their supplies, swapping ingredients in their ovens or even by adding a nasty ingredient to another recipe. Be the most crooked cook in order to win!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/4c2fdbf1b8f417e7cac55d115ba3b34ff84a89c1.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/cooksncrooks]Cooks & Crooks[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 20-40 Minutes

Cooks & Crooks is a family game with hand management and card drafting. The objective of the game is to score the most points by adding the proper ingredients specified on the dish cards. After 6 rounds, the player with the highest score wins!

Developed by Detestable Games, this gateway game is easy to learn and fun to play. You can the physical copy from their current [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1221882583/cooks-and-crooks-experience-the-satisfaction-of-ru]Kickstarter[/url] project.

notes.title: We All Deserve a Second Chance
notes.notes:
The famous Vital Lacerda boardgame comes back in a new edition! [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/co2-second-edition]CO2: Second Chance[/url] revises and enriches of the original competitive game CO2 published in 2012 and also includes a brand-new cooperative game, in which the players have to collaborate to save the world.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/43ddaad2ac47f1db1bc1b4b765e4f4b6337bf0d1.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/co2-second-edition]CO2: Second Chance[/url][/h1]
1-4 Players; 45-150 Minutes

In the game CO₂, each player is the CEO of an energy company responding to government requests for new, green power plants. The goal is to stop the increase of pollution while meeting the rising demand for sustainable energy — and of course profiting from doing so. You will need enough expertise, money, and resources to build these clean power plants. Green Power Plants that you've built, UN Goals you've completed, Company Goals you've met, and Expertise you've gained all give you Victory Points (VPs), which represent your Company's reputation — and having the best reputation is the goal of the game … in addition to saving the planet, of course.

To learn more about the game, check out it's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wolffdesigna/warpgate-0]Kickstarter[/url] project, which is currently underway.

notes.title: Art of War and Trick of Deception
notes.notes:
Outplay your opponent at strategic army maneuvering in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/warriors-of-jogu-feint]Warriors of Jogu: Feint[/url] - new bluffing card game from Monsoon Publishing.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/2dd8c0457c76c25765c477b0f0014642616dbfd5.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/warriors-of-jogu-feint]Warriors of Jogu: Feint[/url][/h1]
2 Players; 20-30 Minutes

Warriors of Jogu is a two-player card game in which players take turns playing units into one of five locations. The five locations are numbered 2 to 6, and at the end of each round battle happens at only one or two of these locations. Each unit that is in a battle location contributes its strength multiplied by the value of the location, and the sum of the contributions from all of a player's units is their strategy rating for the round. However, each player only knows one of the two battle locations, while their opponent knows the other battle location!

Check out the game's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1190687571/warriors-of-jogu-feint]Kickstarter[/url] project, which is already funded and currently at its final week.

notes.title: Tabletopia Goes Mobile
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that we have launched the Beta version of Tabletopia on Tablets! 
[url=https://itunes.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1274379679?pt=118594584&ct=steam_news&mt=8]Download Tabletopia for iPads now[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/c6df1300fa276549da6cebfa03ac7ca3382eb3e1.png[/img]

Tabletopia Mobile now runs on iOS Tablets (Apple iPad Mini 2 or higher) and is accessible for free. Six games are already available and 500+ more from our extensive catalog are on the way:

[h1]1. [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/champions-of-midgard]Champions of Midgard[/url][/h1]
A hit worker placement game about Viking clans waging war against mythological Norse beasts by Grey Fox Games
[h1]2. [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-shipwreck-arcana]The Shipwreck Arcana[/url][/h1]
Very clever cooperative deduction game by Meromorph Games
[h1]3. [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/hansa-teutonica]Hansa Teutonica[/url][/h1]
One of the best competitive eurogames by Argentum Verlag
[h1]4. [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sub-terra]Sub Terra[/url][/h1] 
Cooperative survival horror board game by Inside the Box
[h1]5. [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/burgle-bros]Burgle Bros[/url][/h1] 
Cooperative stealth game about daring robbery by Fowers Games
[h1]6. [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mint-works]Mint Works[/url][/h1] 
Light worker placement game of planning a city’s industry by Five24 Labs

Right now we’re porting games best for the Pass & Play mode already featured on Tabletopia Mobile. These include games with no hidden information and smaller setups due to screen size limitations compared to PC. Later the Online Multiplayer mode will be added, as well as support of Android tablets.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ad727032951d6c4ea208eb3d7e0883f70ada0342.png[/img]

With Tabletopia Mobile, publishers and game authors will be able to create mobile versions of their games in Workshop (Pro Subscription required) and playtest or demonstrate them on tablets. Stand alone apps featured in iOS and Android stores will also be supported with time. You can learn more about it [url=https://tabletopia.com/pages/mobile]here[/url].

Your feedback is very important to us! Feel free to contact us (at info@tabletopia.com ) with any comments after you give Tabletopia Mobile a try.

Yours,
Tabletopia Team

notes.title: Those Frenchies Seek Him Everywhere
notes.notes:
In the year is 1793, France cowers under the Reign of Terror, and not even the innocent are safe from the guillotine. In the midst of this turmoil, one man uses courage and cunning to fight the brutality. Join [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/scarlet-pimpernel]The Scarlet Pimpernel[/url] on his daring adventures in this beautiful new euro strategy game!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0b9c894805a54917eca33a98857d3c65d435ce34.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/scarlet-pimpernel]The Scarlet Pimpernel[/url][/h1]
2-6 Players; 60-120 Minutes

In Scarlet Pimpernel, you play as members of the league helping the Scarlet Pimpernel accomplish seven missions, rescuing the innocent from the guillotine. No mission will be as important as the last, for you save the young Dauphin, heir to the French throne, by whisking him away to Vienna.

Become a Member of League and Sir Blakeney's trusted advisor through [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eaglegryphon/the-scarlet-pimpernel-signature-edition]Kickstarter[/url], during final weeks of the crowdfunding project.

notes.notes:
Try your luck in the merciless city of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dicetopia]Dicetopia[/url] and send out your agents to take over neighbourhoods, snatch loot, perform shifty actions and carry out sneaky missions!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/2923469e49bdbbff7608184a13d32bfb929e4680.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dicetopia]Dicetopia[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 30 Minutes

Dicetopia is a challenging and quick strategy game for 2-4 players with a playtime of 30 minutes. The game introduces a fresh mix of area control, worker placement and secret objectives. On players turn they will deploy one of their agents to a neighbourhood in the city. notes.title: Ride the Fire! Let It Out!
notes.notes:
Become the budding guitarist and hone your musician's craft by playing various songs in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/re-chord]Re-Chord[/url] - a new guitar-themed light euro game. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/c18eac424c59e30e17a5e955be29818855dbeba3.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/re-chord]Re-Chord[/url][/h1]
1-5 Players; 40-60 Minutes

In Re-Chord guitarists each have a hidden secret color which only they know until the very end of the game. There are three options per turn but the main action is choosing a pick from either the public draft pile or the bag, then deciding where to place it. Each pick has a power relating to the board or other picks which creates intense strategic choices. Guitarists attempt to get the most of their color picks onto each fret of the board by the time scoring is triggered. In addition to gaining popularity via area control, players have cards with real guitar chords on them which they attempt to score based on certain pick placements. Play resumes until the first four frets are full and the player with the highest total popularity score wins.
 
Re-Chord is already funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/692298020/re-chord-0]Kickstarter[/url], so the best way to get this game is to become a backer.

notes.title: Human Mind, and Nowhere Else...
notes.notes:
Coordinate a group of dissidents or suppress dissent in [url=https://tabletopia.com/news/newspeak]NewSpeak[/url] - a new code-breaking team game of subterfuge, set in a bleak future for 3-6 citizens. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/fb1d24a933a5f1785001d00731cea5c0201ede39.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/news/newspeak]NewSpeak[/url][/h1]
3-6 Players; 45-60 Minutes

NewSpeak is a tense game of dystopian subversion in which you take the role of either the 'dissidents' or the 'moderators' in a mind-bending battle of wits to determine the reality around you. 

Dissidents utilise matching underground codes to coordinate meetings at one of the locations on the map. They then each secretly use their location dials to declare their intended meeting point.

The Mods, in a short amount of time, then have to determine where they expect the Dissidents to meet by inferring their intent from a book of every possible code set the subversives could use, and agree upon a location to direct a state raiding party.

Depending on whether the majority of Dissidents have successfully coordinated at a single location, or the Mods have caught them in an attempt at subversion will determine whether that location becomes 'hacked' or 'moderated'.

As the game progresses, moderated locations produce potential accomplices for the Dissidents to recruit, as undesirables are driven from now sanitized districts. However, as the Dissidents progress their mission to 'hack' as many locations as possible, the Moderators strike back with increasing numbers of surveillance outposts, installed to limit the Dissident's ability to move around the city undetected.

notes.title: Human Mind, and Nowhere Else...
notes.notes:
Coordinate a group of dissidents or suppress dissent in [url=https://tabletopia.com/news/newspeak]NewSpeak[/url] - a new code-breaking team game of subterfuge, set in a bleak future for 3-6 citizens. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/fb1d24a933a5f1785001d00731cea5c0201ede39.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/news/newspeak]NewSpeak[/url][/h1]
3-6 Players; 45-60 Minutes

NewSpeak is a tense game of dystopian subversion in which you take the role of either the 'dissidents' or the 'moderators' in a mind-bending battle of wits to determine the reality around you. 

Dissidents utilise matching underground codes to coordinate meetings at one of the locations on the map. They then each secretly use their location dials to declare their intended meeting point.

The Mods, in a short amount of time, then have to determine where they expect the Dissidents to meet by inferring their intent from a book of every possible code set the subversives could use, and agree upon a location to direct a state raiding party.

Depending on whether the majority of Dissidents have successfully coordinated at a single location, or the Mods have caught them in an attempt at subversion will determine whether that location becomes 'hacked' or 'moderated'.

As the game progresses, moderated locations produce potential accomplices for the Dissidents to recruit, as undesirables are driven from now sanitized districts. However, as the Dissidents progress their mission to 'hack' as many locations as possible, the Moderators strike back with increasing numbers of surveillance outposts, installed to limit the Dissident's ability to move around the city undetected.

The game's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/itbboardgames/newspeak-a-game-of-code-breaking-in-a-dystopian-fu]Kickstarter project[/url] is currently ongoing, so take this chance to fight for future reality.

notes.title: It's All In the Syllabus!
notes.notes:
Prepare exceptionally talented apprentices for their legendary adventures in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dragonsgate-college]Dragonsgate College[/url] - a strategic dice-drafting game that puts players in charge of Student Houses locked in a battle for recognition and prestige.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/6592bbecb8b6e0ebca724758dbe0cce72a288207.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dragonsgate-college]Dragonsgate College[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 90 Minutes

Each turn players draft dice that allow them to perform multiple actions: recruiting new apprentices and teachers, placing new facilities on their player boards, and more. Each turn they also have the opportunity to raise the general skill levels of their House, in order to give their apprentices a greater push towards performing feats of bravery and cunning.

Constructing student facilities, hiring seasoned adventurers as teachers, dabbling in the arcane arts of wizardry and subterfuge, and cleverly outmaneuvering your opponents - all this awaits you within the walls of this ancient university. Prove your worth, and maybe you will even get a tenure!

notes.title: This City Needs a New Boss
notes.notes:
[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/catham-city]Catham Сity[/url] is steeped in intrigue and deceit — corrupted officials, bribed cops, lying journalists… One must have the thick fur and sharp claws to survive here, in this dump, and even prosper. Here, each day is a choice between gaining a support of different groups or turning your clandestine resources against your rivals.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/c8e4848db6938dd74f1cae6386be9e538c54463d.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/catham-city]Catham Сity[/url][/h1]
2-6 Players; 30-60 Minutes

Catham City is a fast-playing thematic card game, where the players race to collect enough influence to become the new underground boss of Catham. Each turn, a player choses one of two possible actions - play cards from hand to earn influence, gain more cards and even mess up opponent plans or take stack of cards to his hand from the market area. The game contains 8 different decks of cards, each with unique ability and art, but you use only five each play.

notes.title: Fragments of Memory
notes.notes:
Recall your memories scattered throughout the Cosmos in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dejavu]Deja Vu[/url], innovative Mancala sowing and Tableau Building game. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/124ab386a7e1f4f303a5a213b312d67d32d90aa0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dejavu]Deja Vu[/url][/h1]
2 Players; 45-90 Minutes

Deja Vu is the game about a helping the nameless girl collect her scattered memories across the universe and bring them together into a coherent pictures in her mind. The central feature of Deja Vu is a “Binary System” in which you manage two completely different but seamlessly interacting mechanisms at once. To win the game, you must perform well both tactically and strategically. In the tactical part, players collect wooden tokens on the map with various combinations of color and shape. In the strategic part, players use the wooden tokens they gained to add cards to their tableau. A balance and efficient long-term planning is the key to victory.

notes.title: Subtle Art of Winemaking
notes.notes:
Discover new ways of playing Viticulture in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tuscany-essential-edition]Tuscany: Essential Edition[/url] - a collection of expansions for acclaimed winery management game by Jamey Stegmaier.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/b7094e34db43f37ffeafe5a15dc1c836b904512c.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tuscany-essential-edition]Tuscany: Essential Edition[/url][/h1]
1-6 Players; 60-150 Minutes

Tuscany is a worker placement game about winemaking in rural Italy. It’s essentially the good old Viticulture but with expansions added for more diverse experience.

As an owner of a meager vineyard, you will start with a few plots of land, an old crushpad, a tiny cellar, and three workers. Through a series of seasons and years you will be allocating workers to expand your vineyard, build structures, plant vines, make wines, and fulfil orders. Will you become the first to call your winery a true success?

notes.title: Ultimate Chapter of Classic Drama
notes.notes:
The ancient Greek world was ruled by the Olympian gods, 12 beings of immense power, but also victims to their own feelings, passions and vices. They vied for supremacy very often even amongst themselves, sometimes through brute force like hurling bolts of lightning, but they also conspired against each other through guile and intricate machinations.
[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/deus-ex-machina]Deus Ex Machina[/url] is the game the gods were playing when they tried to consolidate their power by working in the shadows, manipulating mortals to do their bidding, either showering them with promises of immortality and other divine gifts, or bending them to their will with dreadful threats and curses. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/204301e027f8635176193e6a6edde6fb2d56315e.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/deus-ex-machina]Deus Ex Machina[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 30-45 Minutes

Deus ex Machina is a competitive game for 2 to 4 players with an innovative hero placement mechanism in which each player takes the role of an Olympian god trying to achieve supremacy over the other gods via manipulation of heroes and behind the scenes planning. Their ultimate goal is to accumulate the most Glory Points by having heroes complete quests. The winner of the game is the player who has completed his secret objective.

notes.title: Plan T from Outer Space
notes.notes:
Capture people, exchange them for alien warships, fight other captains to carry out missions from alien command in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tremble-humans]Tremble, Humans![/url], new hand management/secret deployment game by Cosmodrome Games.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ffb37585c1d227872da32ae5703aece07bb18df0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tremble-humans]Tremble, Humans![/url][/h1]
2-5 Players; 45-90 Minutes

[i]Tremble, Humans![/i] is a highly thematic board game, where players take roles of alien generals, invading earth to fill their cargo with intergalactic currency – humans. Each turn of the game some cites are available for attacks and players simultaneously choose a place to attack, splitting their fleet between cites, if necessary. But one city is too small for two generals – so if there are multiple players trying to invade a city, their armies will fight and only the strongest will capture the humans! After the round, generals can buy support – new ships and stations are available for purchase, as well as the amount of fuel will increase during invasion, making alien fleets larger. After 8 rounds and additional goals scoring the richest player wins.

notes.title: Clash in Skies of Europa
notes.notes:
Dear Tabletopians, one of our most popular games Scythe now has new expansion [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/414238/Tabletopia__Scythe_The_Wind_Gambit/]The Wind Gambit[/url] available as a Steam DLC! You can now buy both expansions along with the base game and play forever, with no subscription required. As usual, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/7f9c8a011abe55876079dac50f43f4d75a3fcdf3.png[/img]

[h1][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/414238/Tabletopia__Scythe_The_Wind_Gambit/]Scythe: The Wind Gambit[/url][/h1]
This expansion to Scythe adds 2 new modules that can be played together or separately at any player count and with either the base game or other Scythe expansions. 

• [b]Airships[/b]: (1 miniature per faction; 16 tiles) An airship is a new type of unit that is distinctly different from characters, mechs, and workers. Unlike those units, airships never control territories. Airships are moved via a Move action, and rivers and lakes do not constrain their movement. Each airship has two randomly combined abilities (1 aggressive and 1 passive ability; same combo for all players).

• [b]Resolutions[/b]: (8 tiles) The resolution module changes the way a game of Scythe ends. If you play with this module, ignore the standard end-game trigger (when a player places their sixth star, everything stops and the game ends). Instead, the resolution tile for the current game will determine when and how the game ends.

[h1][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/414232/Tabletopia__Scythe_The_Wind_Gambit__Invaders_from_Afar/]Scythe: The Wind Gambit + Invaders from Afar[/url][/h1]
You also have an option to buy The Wind Gambit along with previous Scythe expansion Invaders from Afar in a single bundle. 

Scythe: Invaders from Afar adds two new factions: 10 miniatures, 62 custom wooden tokens, and 2 faction mats. While empires rise and fall in Eastern Europa, the rest of the world takes notice. Two distant factions, Albion and Togawa, send emissaries to scout the land and employ their own distinct styles of conquering.   

You can purchase the base game as well as expansions packages on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560/Tabletopia/]our Steam product page[/url].

Tell us in the comments which games you would like to see as DLCs.

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Delicate Balance of Power
notes.notes:
The coastal city of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/trieste]Trieste[/url] is a flurry of trade and activity, but where there's power, there are always those who will compete to grab as much of it as they can. Conflict erupts in the streets, shops, and back alleys. Only one can truly rule Trieste. Will it be you?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/bbcfde60169e9d9f16b8296b941fdb80ab89ea2a.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/trieste]Trieste[/url][/h1]
3 Players; 30 Minutes

Trieste is a card game where three players take on the roles of Thief, Merchant, or City Watch respectively. Each role has its own unique deck and victory conditions. Turns are played out simultaneously, with each player selecting an action without knowing those chosen by opponents. 

The City Watch player levies taxes on the Merchant, and patrols the streets for the Thief, looking to fill the city's jail with ne'er-do-wells. Players in the role of the Merchant are out to cut deals and line their coffers, in a quest for untold riches. As the Thief, that player is attempting to pilfer coins from the Merchant, while earning infamy and the respect of the secretive Foxtail Gang.

notes.title: Spirited Away
notes.notes:
Once an age, a mythic wind lifts the veil between the spirit world and ours. Whimsical seraphs, drawn to the vigor of an ancient forest, descend through clouds to, once again, take up their centennial game.

You are one – a being of great power and curiosity. The life of the forest fascinates you, and you eagerly gather plant, animal, and sprite alike to add to your mystical menagerie. But beware,
for you are not alone. Other [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/spirits-of-the-forest]Spirits of the Forest[/url] just like yourself contest to collect the life of the forest as well!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/03de79b17f529125ca93b2920a08f7fc79b5f079.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/spirits-of-the-forest]Spirits of the Forest[/url][/h1] 
1-4 Players; 30-60 Minutes

In Spirits of the Forest, players represent the four elements that nourish the forces of nature. Up to four players compete to acquire the most (of 9 different) spirit symbols which are bound to a different element of Nature.

Each turn, a player will draft up to 2 Spirit tiles from the Forest (a common pool of 48 Spirit tiles), collect Favor tokens and move, place, or recover Gem-stones.

Players continue taking turns until all tiles have been collected from the Forest. At the end of the game, players score Nature points for each Spirit (augmented by Favor tokens) they have a majority of. The winner is the player with the most Nature points at the end of the game.

notes.title: City of the Yellow King
notes.notes:
Be first to summon Lost [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/carcosa]Carcosa[/url] and the King in Yellow in this new tile-laying, area-control game of secrets, schemes and sacrifice! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/75eb9bcdba08a967dabcc9cf779ad5798887b854.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/carcosa]Carcosa[/url][/h1]
1-4 Players; 45-60 Minutes

In Carcosa, you will summon the city of the Tattered King, one tile at a time! Use your cultists to tap ley lines, conduct rituals and explore the districts of Carcosa itself. If your cultists displease you, you can sacrifice them to the dark waters of Lake Hali for the pleasure of the King. 

Only the most devious leader will be able to marshal his cult through The Coming of Carcosa and earn the right to wear the Pallid Mask!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/75eb9bcdba08a967dabcc9cf779ad5798887b854.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/carcosa]Carcosa[/url][/h1]
1-4 Players; 45-60 Minutes

In Carcosa, you will summon the city of the Tattered King, one tile at a time! Use your cultists to tap ley lines, conduct rituals and explore the districts of Carcosa itself. If your cultists displease you, you can sacrifice them to the dark waters of Lake Hali for the pleasure of the King. 

Only the most devious leader will be able to marshal his cult through The Coming of Carcosa and earn the right to wear the Pallid Mask!

notes.title: Take Back Ravenport
notes.notes:
Assemble your guild and defy the overlord in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/rebels-of-ravenport]Rebels of Ravenport[/url] - new competitive card drafting strategy game, currently on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/secretweapongames/rebels-of-ravenport]Kickstarter[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/43448c320911490a06bafd709862ecf8326f71da.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/rebels-of-ravenport]Rebels of Ravenport[/url][/h1]
2-6 Players; 40 Minutes

In Rebels of Ravenport, players take the role of guild leaders who must defeat the monsters and expand their guild. Each player starts off with a small guild of 3 rebels, and can attack one monster each turn. They roll the 3 dice to determine how much damage they deal against the monster. Each rebel deals 1 to 3 damage when a specific number (1 through 6) is rolled. To defeat the monster, they must deal damage greater than or equal to the monster's health. If successful, the guild gains reputation and victory points.

notes.title: Polished by Ashes to Pass as a Gold
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Steampunk world of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/brass-empire]Brass Empire[/url], where rival corporations compete and battle to expand their territory and authority. Companies work to optimize their labor force and resources to mine the most Brass in each territory using corporate espionage, technology, security, and even sabotage.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/d6715e40b08fe8e2d107d8a7aefd65afa2c179e6.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/brass-empire]Brass Empire[/url][/h1]
1-5 Players; 40-60 Minutes

Brass Empire takes place in a Steampunk universe and each player takes on the role of a different corporation hiring the best employees, constructing building, and manufacturing steam-powered machines. Players battle and sabotage each other to amass economic wealth and influence to win the game.

Each turn, you will play Employee cards from your hand to gain resources. These resources will allow you to acquire new Employees, Buildings and Units for your deck. Along the way, you will acquire buildings to enhance your hold on the region and command units to sabotage other companies. At the end of the game, the player with the most Brass is the winner.

Campaign for New Canton, an expansion for Brass Empire is currently ongoing on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mikegnade/brass-empire-new-canton-expansion-original-reprint]Kickstarter[/url], so check it out!

notes.title: Be Strong and Get the Job Done
notes.notes:
Since the day of release, our game library expanded with more and more titles every month. And now we passed another big milestone. We now have 500 games available. To celebrate this, we want to present you an english release of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/orconomics]Orconomics[/url], a game of striving businesses, shrewdness and acumen. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/9317f5b4d86c938991c016826a351b20eeb1664b.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/orconomics]Orconomics[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 45-60 Minutes

Hey Orc! Are you sad that the days of heroes are in the past? Do you feel upset that brave warriors such as yourself have no chance to use their fury and courage? If so, we have just the thing for you! Dive into the world of business, a vortex of competition, a fight to be the best. Build up your companies with your strong green hands and bargain to the bitter end with your rivals. Legends will be told of your glorious business ventures!

In Orconomy, competing against each other to establish companies in ten industrial sectors. Companies in each industrial sector generate income or losses, and grant players abilities that can be used during
the game. As players build their business empire, they will also gain or lose Trophies depending on their presence and domination in different industrial sectors.

notes.title: Don't Poke the Dragon
notes.notes:
A single card deck to play over 18 designer games. That's the idea behind [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/book-of-dragons]Book of Dragons[/url] by Robert Burke. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/bbd59fbd0c388c517d78fdcfe19126a9ed6599d6.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/book-of-dragons]Book of Dragons[/url][/h1]

Book of Dragons is not just a card game, but a game system. It includes a deck of large, tarot-sized cards, beautifully illustrated by world-renowned artist Kerem Beyit. Think of it as a modern deck of playing cards, but instead of playing poker, blackjack, and other traditional card games, a host of designer games utilizing a plethora of modern design mechanics can be played.

Crowdfunding project for the game has launched for on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/478379924/book-of-dragons]Kickstarter[/url], started only a couple of days ago, so make sure you give it a try!

notes.title: At the Center of All Infinity
notes.notes:
The conquest of space was one of the main human achievements of the 20th century. In 1957, the first satellite named "Sputnik 1" has been placed into orbit. Four years later, Yuri Gagarin has performed the first human space flight on "Vostok 1" ship. This game is dedicated to the first [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/space_explorers]space explorers[/url] — i.e. all the outstanding people who have made spacefaring possible!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/8e6b6ff3d763e240ae42ad0dffce3b930d8bf182.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/space_explorers]Space Explorers[/url][/h1]
2-4 Players; 20-40 Minutes

Each player becomes the Head of a Research & Development Hub in the Space Research Center. You recruit best Specialists to your team and produce large-scale space projects — from placing satellites and manned spaceships into orbit to launching automated interplanetary stations!

The game ends when the players complete all the available Projects or when one of the players recruits 12 Specialists to his/her Hub. The Specialists and Projects bring you Progress points. The player with the highest amount of Progress points wins.

notes.title: Embers of the Galactic War
notes.notes:
Live the story of the battleship [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/ironclad]Ironclad[/url] and her crew of outlaw Heroes amidst a galactic Cold War, in this new cooperative space opera game by Alcyon Creative.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/fbc8d2faf260fd7994e4eca58f4948a2e9e2e0e2.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/ironclad]Ironclad[/url][/h1]
1-3 Players; 45-60 Minutes

In Ironclad, players collectively control the battleship and follow a campaign of 10+ scenarios, ensuring that their ship and her systems as well as her crew and its morale remain intact along their adventure. Each scenario will feature interesting decision points. The consequences of these choices will have benefits and/or repercussions within the current game as well as impact on future scenarios. With each passing scenario, the story unfolds according to the choices the players have made.

You can take your part in the story, as the game has just launched it's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/alcyon-ludibooster/ironclad-story-driven-space-opera-cooperative-boar]Kickstarter[/url].

notes.title: By the Sword of Leinad, you shall prevail!
notes.notes:
[url=https://tabletopia.com/news/queens-army]The Queen’s Army[/url] is a solo variant expansion to Feudum. The game pits you against Queen Ann in an epic battle to score the most veneration points over 5 epochs.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ddb7ec718a20773fb9cf8a265b19bfe046884ef3.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/news/queens-army]Feudum: The Queen's Army[/url][/h1] 
1 Player; 60-90 Minutes

The Queen’s tyranny is spreading into every corner of the kingdom. Her foot soldiers scour the countryside to hunt the behemoth—the bewitched king that was once her husband! Your small band of rebels will need sharp wits and a bit of luck to save the king and reclaim the land’s virtue, as well as your own.

First, her Majesty will ruthlessly target the bewitched King (The Behemoth) in effort to diminish your fame. After the King is dead (or by the dawn of third epoch), she will mount her black horse to pursue your band of rebels with a vengeance.

The Queen plays the game with unlimited resources and no movement restrictions. Any actual resources she acquires along the way count as veneration points!
