notes.title: And Now a Word From Our Sponsor
notes.notes:
Manage shows and compete for viewers in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-networks]The Networks[/url], new card drafting and set collection game by Gil Hova.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/7d5f8ca08e000a508aa58e905e6a43829fb9259f.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-networks][h1]The Networks[/h1][/url] 
1-5 Players; 90 Minutes

In The Networks, you and your opponents are new television networks, and you need new programming. For this, you’ll need Shows, Stars, and Ads.

Shows need Stars and Ads. Stars give you bonus viewers (points), and Ads give you extra money. You’ll need everything you can get; you'll have a small amount of resources and time, and you must grab the latest hot show before your opponents.

The player with the most viewers after five seasons wins!

notes.title: And Now a Word From Our Sponsor
notes.notes:
Manage shows and compete for viewers in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-networks]The Networks[/url], new card drafting and set collection game by Gil Hova.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/7d5f8ca08e000a508aa58e905e6a43829fb9259f.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-networks][h1]The Networks[/h1][/url] 
1-5 Players; 90 Minutes

In The Networks, you and your opponents are new television networks, and you need new programming. For this, you’ll need Shows, Stars, and Ads.

Shows need Stars and Ads. Stars give you bonus viewers (points), and Ads give you extra money. You’ll need everything you can get; you'll have a small amount of resources and time, and you must grab the latest hot show before your opponents.

The player with the most viewers after five seasons wins!

notes.title: Epic Saga of the Mysterious World
notes.notes:
Explore the perilous domain filled with nefarious monsters, mysterious strangers and treacherous locations. Prove yourself in battle, defeat a primordial evil and save the land from darkness in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/gloom-of-kilforth-a-fantasy-quest-game]Gloom of Kilforth[/url], new game by Hall or Nothing Productions. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/18c41baef24b030fe494957fbce7e63b6b5b9989.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/gloom-of-kilforth-a-fantasy-quest-game][h1]Gloom of Kilforth[/h1][/url] 
1-4 Players; 180 Minutes

Gloom of Kilforth is a game of high fantasy with a gothic edge, where 1-4 players, working individually or together, assume the roles of heroes on a journey through a dark world of magic and peril. They will visit strange places, meet stranger people and defeat powerful enemies in their mission to discover mysterious artefacts and mystical spells. Each player follows their hero’s tale, an epic saga from modest beginnings through to a climactic battle that will decide the fate of the world...

If you want to embark on this epic quest, check out the game's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tristanhall/gloom-of-kilforth-a-fantasy-quest-game-expansions]Kickstarter[/url] project.

notes.title: Golden Dreams of California
notes.notes:
Search the land and press your luck on the gold fields of California, play your cards right to strike it rich or bluff your way to victory in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/end-of-the-trail]End of the Trail[/url], new hand management game by Elf Creek Games. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/24adf13d049e46dd8f5f98a8af50fb7a5d3ef6af.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/end-of-the-trail][h1]End of the Trail[/h1][/url] 
2-4 Players; 40 Minutes

End of the Trail is a competitive card game for 2-4 prospectors and fortune seekers. Players manage a hand of cards to secure transportation, prospect land, and take a shot at winning a title to more land at the poker table. Cards have three uses, each corresponding to a particular phase of the game: to prospect land tiles and discover how much gold a claim will produce, to collect and play cards that build a good poker hand, and to purchase additional cards in auction to help with prospecting, poker, or both.

The game is currently on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/brentdickman/end-of-the-trail-find-fortune-in-the-california-go]Kickstarter[/url], so don't miss it out!

notes.title: Squared Circle and the Techne of Elixir Brewing
notes.notes:
Welcome to [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-valley-of-alchemists]The Valley of Alchemists[/url], a land in the heart of mountains, carved by a glacier thousands of years ago. Each year, when Winter leaves the Valley and Mother Spring wakes the World to life anew, Alchemists arrange a slight contest of mixture preparation. Learn and strive for greatness, and maybe it will be you who wins the Spring contest and with it, the title of the best Alchemist in the Valley.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/24adf13d049e46dd8f5f98a8af50fb7a5d3ef6af.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-valley-of-alchemists][h1]The Valley of Alchemists[/h1][/url] 
2-4 Players; 60 Minutes

The Valley of Alchemists is a family game for 2-4 players based on Set Collection and Pattern Building mechanics. Players manage resources to get the most cards in the right combinations so that they gain experience points. The winner is the player with the most experience points at the end of the game.

Go toe to toe with the other alchemists and gain fame, glory, and the title of alchemist of the year! With each elixir you concoct, you’ll learn new things, making it easier to find new ingredients to produce your next potions. Use magic to change the characteristics of your alchemical creations!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1118278224/the-valley-of-alchemists]Kickstarter project[/url] for the game launched just a couple of days ago, so take this chance to create the ultimate elixir!

notes.title: Heroes of the Universe
notes.notes:
Experience retrofuturistic adventure, full of flying saucers, rocket ships and space stations in twenty scenarios campaign of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/space-cadets-away-missions]Space Cadets: Away Missions[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/f81c44d0731b601d3b9de8d70722ce9101459bcb.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/news/space-cadets-away-missions?draft=False][h1]Space Cadets: Away Missions[/h1][/url]

1-6 Players; 90 Minutes

Space Cadets: Away Missions is a cooperative, scenario-based, tactical action game for 1-6 players, which is set in the Golden Age of science fiction. In this game, the third standalone title in the Space Cadets franchise of cooperative/team space-themed games from Stronghold Games, players take on the roles of adventurous human spacemen who explore UFOs, acquire Alien technology and fight hostile extraterrestrials. 

Each turn, spacemen have three action points to spend on activities such as firing their atomic rifles, analyzing exotic equipment, or subduing the malicious Brain-in-a-Jar. When the spacemen are finished, the aliens take their turns by following simple movement and combat protocols; seven types of hostile aliens threaten the players, from the repulsive mind leeches to the rampaging titanic sentinels.

notes.title: The Last Sunset of the Old World
notes.notes:
Craft your deck with powerful faction cards, explore and exploit the system’s worlds, and gain the most influence so you can lead civilization to a new beginning in the wake of the [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/helionox-deluxe-edition]Helionox[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/797621d80307639a4c20f1e1be6b87c3ba971a7c.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/helionox-deluxe-edition][h1]Helionox[/h1][/url]
1-4 Players; 90 Minutes

In Helionox, terrible events plague the solar system as the result of a dying sun. Players are the Architects of the future, vying for influence among the remaining populace.

Helionox is a movement based deck building board game where great leaders vie for control in a shattered solar system. One to four players can attempt mastery over competitive, cooperative, and solo modes. Designed to play fast with a quick setup and an imminent ending, Helionox has tension to spare from the first turn to the last.

Announcing the newest release in the illustrious Gryphon Bookshelf Series, [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/titan-dice]Titan Dice[/url] is a fast paced dice rolling game for the whole family!
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/dc872c9323aaf6a7caea5c42b42f567d9a9e13c9.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/titan-dice][h1]Titan Dice[/h1][/url]

The Titans have been imprisoned for millennia, but now they have escaped! They are emboldened to overthrow the gods, but first they will need an army... notes.title: Card Defense of the Nexus
notes.notes:
Combination of the popular MOBA (Multiplayer Online Battle Arena) strategy videogame genre with unique and solid card driven mechanics, [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/elo-darkness]ELO Darkness[/url] stems from the desire to create something new, coming at customizable card games from a completely different perspective.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/3a7df698dd942f6c0f8cb637717e3611132f4300.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/elo-darkness][h1]ELO Darkness[/h1][/url]
2 Players; 50 Minutes

ELO Darkness is a MOBA-inspired boardgame in which 2 players fight against each other in an epic 3-Lane arena.

Players each have a deck of 40 cards representing a team of five Heroes, each one of these with a specific role on the battle front. Each deck contains heroes special ability cards as well as action cards that display the tactical choices on the Lane. The goal of the game is to reach and destroy the opponent's base on the board. To do this, players line up their cards through a simultaneous action selection mechanism and once they have revealed them, they can trigger abilities and activate heroes. Furthermore, to expand possibilities and strategic options, players deal with Boss-Events during the course of the game and also have the option to farm resources each turn, by discarding cards from their hand, in order to gain Gold (used to buy items) and level up the Heroes.

The game is already funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/reggiegames/elo-darkness-0]Kickstarter[/url], don't miss it out!

notes.title: Fate of the Subconscious Realm
notes.notes:
Side with Bliss or Gloom, rally your Emotions and shape the Inside World's Identity in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/cerebria-the-inside-world]Cerebria[/url], an upcoming area control team game from Mindclash Games. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/4cc5b21e21fb95d77dbb381b4162df02bdcfa826.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/cerebria-the-inside-world][h1]Cerebria: The Inside World[/h1][/url]
1–4 Players; 1-2 Hours

Players assume the role of Spirits, followers of the Inside World's two opposing forces, Bliss and Gloom, with the goal of shaping Cerebria's Identity to their image. For that purpose, they have been granted power over the Emotions, Cerebria's denizens: they can invoke, move, empower and evolve Emotions to influence and control Cerebria's Realms and Frontiers.

Cerebria's state is in constant flux until a Spirit triggers a Revelation - these are key moments in the game when the current game state is evaluated and is preserved as a permanent Bliss or Gloom fragment on the Identity. Which side will dominate the Identity, who will establish final control over the Inside World?

The game's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/438141406/cerebria-the-inside-world]Kickstarter[/url] ends in just a couple of days, so take this opportunity to immerse yourself in this new and vibrant fantasy world.

notes.title: We Must Go Deeper This Time
notes.notes:
Sub Terra with Expansions now available as DLC

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/e90272843ba3efad001bc548a50cb6901bd397c8.png[/img]

Dear Tabletopians, one of our most popular games Sub Terra is now available in Steam DLC form, along with [b]3 new expansions[/b]! You can now buy complete game and play it forever, with no subscription required. As usual, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sub-terra][h1]Sub Terra[/h1][/url]
1–6 players, 75 min

Sub Terra is a cooperative survival horror board game. You and up to five friends are cave explorers who have become trapped deep underground. You must quickly explore a tile-based cave system to find the way out before your flashlights die and you're lost in the darkness forever.

You'll need to work together to overcome deadly subterranean hazards - stick together for safety, or split up to cover more ground. One wrong step could knock you unconscious and your friends will need to stage a rescue. Light and hope are scarce. And worst of all, you don't think you're alone down here...

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sub-terra][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/06eed56d38479e2f3e0eb0cbace4443960d88270.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sub-terra][h1]Sub Terra: Investigation[/h1][/url]
Not all of you made it out alive. With the help of a mysterious corporation, you return to the cave to search for your fallen friends.

Investigation adds 15 new item cards that grant your cavers powerful abilities. Recover them from the cave floor, or choose the ruthless Agent who starts fully equipped. The darkness hides many things. Be prepared.

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sub-terra][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ae67d516996e1daf2f6aa3e8866b61b383e2fc91.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sub-terra][h1]Sub Terra: Extraction[/h1][/url]
You've returned to the cave, and you're not alone. A new threat has emerged from the shadows - faster, deadlier, and hunting you down…

Extraction adds more horrors to the cave with the new fast-moving Leaper hazard card. Fight them off with the Mercenary, a flexible blend of cautious explorer and powerful defender. Above all else, you must carry proof of the infestation back to the surface, or die trying...

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sub-terra][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/2488faa55711f65499061dfedde5cef512a166eb.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sub-terra][h1]Sub Terra: Annihilation[/h1][/url]
The nightmares in this cave must be destroyed, by any means necessary.

Annihilation introduces a totally new way to play the game. Push deeper into the cave to reach points of structural weakness, plant powerful bombs, then get back to the exit before they detonate. The Exterminator can stop horrors from spawning and is immune to gas, helping keep your escape routes open while you complete your mission. This isn't going to be easy.

You can now purchase the base game with all three expansions as a single package. To buy DLC, open Tabletopia in Steam and go to Sub Terra page, where a Buy DLC button is now available. You can also buy DLCs directly through [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560/Tabletopia]our product page[/url] on Steam.
Tell us in the comments which games you would like to see as DLCs.

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Destiny of Those Trapped in the Event Horizon
notes.notes:
Explore the galaxy, earn prestige and fulfilling your hidden objectives in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/stellar-leap]Stellar Leap[/url], an upcoming 4X game by Weird Giraffe Games. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ab11931b9329e85a09ee414e12e4fbba75c9e1e7.jpg[/img]

[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/stellar-leap][h1]Stellar Leap[/h1][/url]
2–4 Players; 90 Min

Stellar Leap is a space exploration game with resource management, variable player powers, hidden objectives, and game changing events!

There's three divisions at your disposal, Intelligence, Mining, and Labor, but they can only be activated once per turn. There's also your High Command, that can take two actions from the following choices: populate, tax, discover a planet, and attack another species. Events are triggered by players at various points in the game and can have minor or lasting effects, usually being better for the player that triggered the event!

Turns are fast and player engagement is high as resources are gathered on each player's turn. Are you going to spend your resources fulfilling missions or traveling to the furthest reaches of the galaxy? Take a risk and mine an asteroid and you might just hit it big!

Stellar Leap is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/weirdgiraffegames/stellar-leap?ref=preview&token=56424aeb&utm_campaign=StellarLeapKickstarter&utm_content=Kickstarter&utm_medium=Tabletopia&utm_source=TabletopiaLink]currently on Kickstarter[/url], so don't miss your chance to explore this new frontier.

notes.title: Check that wine for poison

These are uncertain times. There has been a power void since the coup. Everyone strives to gain the support of the four most powerful and influential figures in the city.

notes.title: Ambitions of a Truly Galactic Scale
notes.notes:
Make sure everything is going just according to keikaku in the upcoming card game [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/supervillain-this-galaxy-is-mine]Supervillain. The Galaxy is Mine[/url]. 

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/009/gV0sz72vKK4zzf3YlOGgO9.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/supervillain-this-galaxy-is-mine]Supervillain. This Galaxy is Mine[/url][/h1]
2–4 Players; 60 Min

"Supervillain. This Galaxy is Mine" is an intense card strategy of galactic domination inspired by all sci-fi worlds put together and fueled with frenzied humor! 
Superheroes vanished. Now you and other Villains are struggling for control over the Galaxy. You build Secret Facilities, as they provide you with supreme powers, and launch Asteroids to bring chaos and destruction to miserable planets of other Villains. For this worthy goal, you use billions of devoted Minions — your construction force and invaluable resourse for covert operations! 

Each card in the game is unique and may be used in multiple ways, thus, allowing for infinite combinations. Outwit other Villains, gain enough Domination points and be proclaimed the only Supervillain of The Galaxy! 

The game's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1957487380/supervillain-this-galaxy-is-mine]Kickstarter campaign[/url] started only a couple of days ago and it's already funded. Don't miss your chance to become the prime villain!

notes.title: Daring Dreamers vs. Dreaded Darkness
notes.notes:
Fight over the dreamscape until morning in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dare-to-dream]Dare to Dream[/url][/b], an upcoming card game that's currently on Kickstarter. 

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/009/aUahhvu61CwoopmRxp9mN2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dare-to-dream]Dare to Dream[/url][/b][/h1]
3–4 Players; 45 Min

[i]Dare to Dream[/i] is an asymmetrical battle between The Darkness - a single player with endless hordes of monsters and nightmares at their disposal - and The Dreamers - a team of players who must rely on their few loyal Guardians to protect them through the night.

Every hour, new Monsters and Nightmares can brought into play by The Darkness and sent at the Dreamers. Monsters and Nightmares are fleeting things, gone forever once they have been used, while the Dreamers' Guardians persist through the night. The Dreamers' goal is to win by outlasting The Darkness; if morning safely arrives, the Dreamers win. But if The Darkness can wake the Dreamers enough times, the forces of dread have prevailed and The Darkness wins instantly!

 
The game is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/turtledreamgames/dare-to-dream-an-asymmetric-card-game-of-nocturnal]on Kickstarter[/url] just for a couple more days, so don't miss it out!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/009/aUahhvu61CwoopmRxp9mN2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dare-to-dream]Dare to Dream[/url][/b][/h1]
3–4 Players; 45 Min

[i]Dare to Dream[/i] is an asymmetrical battle between The Darkness - a single player with endless hordes of monsters and nightmares at their disposal - and The Dreamers - a team of players who must rely on their few loyal Guardians to protect them through the night.

Every hour, new Monsters and Nightmares can brought into play by The Darkness and sent at the Dreamers. Monsters and Nightmares are fleeting things, gone forever once they have been used, while the Dreamers' Guardians persist through the night. The Dreamers' goal is to win by outlasting The Darkness; if morning safely arrives, the Dreamers win. But if The Darkness can wake the Dreamers enough times, the forces of dread have prevailed and The Darkness wins instantly!

 
The game is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/turtledreamgames/dare-to-dream-an-asymmetric-card-game-of-nocturnal]on Kickstarter[/url] just for a couple more days, so don't miss it out!

notes.title: Race for Survival
notes.notes:
Card-driven race game [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/inhabit-the-earth]Inhabit the Earth[/url][/b] is about creating your own species and then breeding them in various environments in order to score most points. 

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/003/HHLMNWKSvijuDlxi7FMOy0.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/inhabit-the-earth]Inhabit the Earth[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 60–90 Min

[i]Inhabit the Earth[/i] is a race game played on six continent boards. Players create their own menagerie of up to six creatures, each of which is represented by up to six cards, by using cards to introduce, multiply, evolve, and adapt their creatures. Each of the 162 unique cards can be used differently to provide you new opportunities to migrate your species, facilitate breeding, gain special abilities and, ultimately, find more ways to score victory points.

notes.title: Expand Your Feudum!
notes.notes:
Time to [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/feudum-expansions]expand your Feudum[/url][/b] and bring new resources, actions, and monsters to the game!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/000/tXHfLvoPzbpBQaIMcZUgn6.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/feudum-expansions]Feudum: Expansions[/url][/b][/h1]
2–6 Players; 75–180 Min 

[i]Feudum[/i] is an economic medieval game of hand and resource management.

We introduce the expansions for this high-acclaimed game, including:
[list][*][b]Windmills and Catapults.[/b] This expansion lets you add new tiles and/or a 6th player to the game as well as introduces windmills and catapults, used during goods collection and attacks.
[*][b]Seals and Sirens.[/b] This expansion lets you add another food source and a monster to the game. 
[*][b]Alter Ego.[/b] This expansion lets you swap up to 6 of your action cards before the game begins with alternate cards featuring new special abilities. 
[*][b]Squirrels and Conifers.[/b] This expansion replaces the green food cubes with pink ones and creates a multiplying food source on the map.[/list]

[quote=Lance Myxter of Undead Viking ]"[i]Feudum[/i] is a rarity of rarities in the board game world. Feudum feels like it's a Pandora's box of that thing that I’m looking for: Tons of exploration and tons of ways to win. This is a game that I will be pulling down on a repeated basis. The game is absolutely fantastic."

notes.title: Fire! Fire Everywhere!
notes.notes:
Fire! Save the treasures of the Great Library in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/alexandria]Alexandria[/url][/b] an asymmetrical & unconventional game for 2-4 players published by LudiCreations and illustrated by Vincent Dutrait.

The game is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ludicreations/alexandria-1]now hot on Kickstarter[/url], don't miss it!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/000/GZdz1guqJbSbdaXgp1yZa8.jpg[/img]
[h1] [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/alexandria]Alexandria[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]Alexandria[/i] is a sandbox adventure eurogame.

As one the the four different Heroes with different skills and motivations, you will use a limited supply of time to move through the burning corridors of the Great Library of Alexandria. 

You will look for scrolls, items and even scholars that you can save, while each round the gameplay area will shrink, as parts of the library are slowly consumed by fire!

notes.title: DLCs Come to Tabletopia! Scythe and Champions of Midgard with Expansions
notes.notes:
Dear Tabletopians, we are very glad to announce that DLCs just became available on Tabletopia! With this new feature you can now buy games on Tabletopia to play forever, and no subscription is needed.

As the first batch, we’re happy to bring you [i]Scythe[/i] with [i]Invaders from Afar[/i] and [i]Champions of Midgard[/i] with [i]Valhalla[/i] and [i]The Dark Mountains[/i]. [i]Sub Terra[/i] with several new expansions is coming really soon, and we plan on adding more games later. Tell us in the comments which games you would like to see as DLCs!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/999/RkymgPZkmyzm5Z5PwjZLUL.png[/img]

You can buy DLCs in two ways:
[list][*] [b]Directly in Tabletopia client[/b]. Launch the Tabletopia Steam application. On the eligible game’s page, click [b]Buy DLC[/b] to purchase the game (you will be redirected to Steam). 
[*][b]Through [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560/Tabletopia/]our page on Steam[/url].[/b] Add as many DLCs as you would like to your Cart.[/list]


[h1][b]Scythe + Invaders from Afar[/b][/h1]
[i][b]Scythe[/b] is an engine-building game set in an alternate-history 1920s period. Each player represents a character from one of the factions of Eastern Europe who are attempting to earn their fortune and claim their faction's stake in the land around the mysterious Factory. Players conquer territory, enlist new recruits, reap resources, gain villagers, build structures, and activate monstrous mechs.[/i]

[b]Please note that when buying an expansion, the base game is included in the price![/b]

[list][*][b]Limited offer:[/b] 15% launch discount!
[*]1–7 players, 16+, 90–120 min.
[*]As usually, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/414231/Tabletopia__Scythe/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/414232/Tabletopia__Scythe_Invaders_from_Afar/


[h1][b]Champions of Midgard + Valhalla + The Dark Mountains[/b][/h1]

[i][b]Champions of Midgard[/b] is a middleweight, Viking-themed, worker placement game with dice rolling in which players are leaders of Viking clans who have traveled to an embattled Viking harbor town to help defend it against the threat of trolls, draugr, and other mythological Norse beasts. By defeating these epic creatures, players gain glory and the favor of the gods.[/i]

[b]Please note that when buying an expansion, the base game is included in the price![/b]

[list][*][b]Limited offer:[/b] 15% launch discount!
[*]2–5 players, 10+, 60–120 min.
[*]As usually, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/414230/Tabletopia__Champions_of_Midgard/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/414234/Tabletopia__Champions_of_Midgard_Valhalla/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/414233/Tabletopia__Champions_of_Midgard_The_Dark_Mountains/

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Rolling in the Farm
notes.notes:
The Summer is coming to an end, but there's still a lot of farming to do, and no time for siesta. In [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/la-granja-no-siesta]La Granja: No Siesta[/url][/b] you will be will expanding your farms, bringing goods to the market, and delivering goods.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/994/c9CON5Nr708uyLfOvcUhk7.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/la-granja-no-siesta]La Granja: No Siesta[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 30–45 Min

[i]La Granja: No Siesta[/i] is a dice game about managing a farm.

Players are landlords who manage small farms on Majorca. They need to collect resources to cross them off on their scoring sheet in order to get the most victory points, and sometimes they need to have a little time off and have a Siesta!

[quote= The Opinionated Gamers]"The rural heartbeat of [i]No Siesta[/i] is about manipulating stuff to achieve your objectives. It’s a game about priorities and (mild) risk… and my boys and I found it be enjoyable and fast-moving."

notes.title: One Artifact to Rule Them All
notes.notes:
Tired of generic magic artifacts in each fantasy game? [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/enchanters]Enchanters[/url][/b] gives you a chance to create your own unique gear. Merge items and spells, then smash approaching monsters to save the village.

The game is only [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gindie-ludibooster/enchanters?ref=33fm51]a week more on Kickstarter[/url] and was funded in 9 hours with many stretch goals unlocked, don't miss it.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/994/XsaqUnbgEZoDmw1yMrUn94.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/enchanters]Enchanters[/url][/b][/h1]
3 Players; 15–60 Min

[i]Enchanters[/i] is a dynamic card drafting game for 2-4 players inspired by CRPG magic item generators.

You are the Enchanters — mighty heroes who defend helpless villages with their magic and wits. During the game each of you will be crafting a powerful magical artifact to defeat hordes of attacking monsters. The winner will be the one who has the most fame at the end of the day.

notes.title: You Got Mail!
notes.notes:
All's fair in love and war. Who will court the Princess of Tempest, whose letter will reach her first? Play [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/love-letter]Love Letter[/url][/b] a smash hit from AEG designed by Seiji Kanai on Tabletopia!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/992/hYbI24HoHtOGfEiLVvX0s1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/love-letter]Love Letter[/url][/b] [/h1]
2–4 Players; 20 Min

[i]Love Letter[/i] is a little card game of risk, deduction, and luck for 2–4 players.

Your goal is to get your love letter into Princess Annette's hands while deflecting the letters from competing suitors. From a deck with only sixteen cards, each player starts with only one card in hand; one card is removed from play. On a turn, you draw one card, and play one card, trying to expose others and knock them from the game.

[quote=Giant Fire Breathing Robot]"[i]Love Letter[/i] is an amazing, short, filler-style game. [...] Not only is it strategically fun, but it provides laughter, eye rolls, accusations, and all the thrill that comes with the best interactive games."

notes.title: New Games Digest: August
notes.notes:
Here's our monthly digest of new games! Read on to learn about [i]Runicah, Ninja Monkeys, Realm Warfare, Biosphere-5[/i], and [i]Cauldorn Bubble and Boil[/i].

Note that some of these games are now on Kickstarter where you can support them after first trying on Tabletopia.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/990/jZlMzzU5ce2yP2YVJzICDQ0.png[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/runicah]Runicah[/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 20–40 Min

[i]Runicah[/i] is a Norse themed set/trick collection game. Collect runes of a particular set, all the while working with and against your opponents. Players will compete to be the first to complete their own unique set of runes.

[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/theplayfulgnome/runicah-norse-theme-card-game-focused-on-player-in]The game is now on Kickstarter, check it out![/url][/b]

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/969/WdSrxHz9oF5btkKir7NWp6.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/ninjamonkeys]Ninja Monkeys[/url][/b]
[/h1]
2–6 Players; 10–25 Min

[i]Ninja Monkeys[/i] is a family friendly strategy card game. If you took some of your best (pillow forts, imaginary friends) and worst (you’re grounded, monsters under the bed) childhood experiences and turned them into a card game, you would have the fast moving, “take that” game!

The game comes to Kickstarter on September 26th, mark your calendar.

notes.title: Fight the Fate
notes.notes:
In [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-shipwreck-arcana]The Shipwreck Arcana[/url][/b] by Meromorph Games you and your friends are fortune tellers trying to prevent terrible fates from befalling each other. Make 7 correct predictions before your impending doom crushes you.

This beautifully illustrated game is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/meromorphgames/the-shipwreck-arcana]now on Kickstarter and is already funded[/url]!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/983/wLpbPf6QzgADMPybzVzShi0.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-shipwreck-arcana]The Shipwreck Arcana[/url][/b] [/h1]
2–5 Players; 15–30 Min

[i]The Shipwreck Arcana[/i] is a compact, co-operative game of deduction, evaluation, and logic.

Players take turns playing tokens according to rules found on an ever-changing tableau of cards, in order to convey information to the rest of the group before their doom arrives. 

[quote= Gameosity]"Its simplicity is its brilliance — while the randomness of the available arcana can be occasionally hampering and the game often extremely challenging, for those who appreciate this sort of deductive logic it’s going to be a fantastic little filler."

notes.title: New Games Digest: Battle for the Universe, Prohibition, Ghost School, Battle of Souls, Spellslingers
notes.notes:
In July's new games digest we introduce five new titles recently added to our catalog: [i] for the Universe, Prohibition, Ghost School, Battle of Souls, Spellslingers[/i].

Note that some of these games are now on Kickstarter where you can support them after first trying on Tabletopia.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/965/yam19x9o7Out1CEiJEBHz0.png[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/bftu]Battle for the Universe[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 15–45 Min

[b]Battle For the Universe[/b] is a competitive, two-player card game, where players construct decks to prove they lead the ultimate super powered team in Slab City! The players choose Heroes, Villains, or anything in between, along with locations where they can square off to display their prowess or save the day.

[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bftucreator/battle-for-the-universe-a-competitive-heroic-card]The game is in its final hours on Kickstarter, give it a go![/url][/b]

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/893/BsLSgTBNRq24yx2ZLVGjyF.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/prohibition]Prohibition[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 75–120 Min

In [b]Prohibition[/b] you are running a Gang in New York in 1921 competing to gain the most prestige by 1927 so you can secure an invitation to the Atlantic City Conference and help organize crime in America. You gain Prestige through bootlegging: producing and selling Booze, Extortion, expanding your Turf, and completing devious Schemes.  

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/924/w31asKtfHWluuamWTsUkx2.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/ghost-school]Ghost School[/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 15–45 Min

[b]Ghost School[/b] is a card game that involves playing cards and keeping your fear meter in check. 2-5 players explore a haunted school with the goal of being the last one standing. The more frightened you become the more difficult the game gets. 

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/924/KPUiqb1NLPIOu1KxGuYkI1.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/battle-of-souls]Battle of Souls[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 5–30 Min

[b]Battle of Souls[/b] is a trading card game similar to MTG and Yugioh where players battle with historic warriors to become the King of History!

[b][url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/battle-of-souls-tcg--2#/]The game is now on Indiegogo![/url][/b]

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/929/yGsWoXZbw2hRAAyre3VNK6.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/spellslingers]Spellslingers[/url][/b][/h1]
2-8 Players; 5–20 Min

[b]Spellslingers[/b] is an easy to learn and fast-paced card game. There are no hit points, mana, tokens, dice, or counters. There's no need to waste your time consulting with a judge. The game is simple, but allows for a surprising amount of strategy.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/965/TP314nydmTc70zii1CfRzR.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: When The Worlds Collide
notes.notes:
Your reality is broken and torn apart, and you must be the first to piece it back together in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/entropy-worlds-collide]Entropy: Worlds Collide[/url][/b] a fast and competitive game of risk & deception.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/961/7PG7sjF2PdEwCDUVh6Ub93.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/entropy-worlds-collide]Entropy: Worlds Collide[/url][/b][/h1]

[i]Entropy: Worlds Collide[/i] is a competitive card game of risk, deception and action management for 2 to 4 players.

Each turn, players secretly select an action from the six they have available. All players then reveal and resolve their chosen action at the same time, trying to avoid Clashes that cancel actions. Take risks, deceive and outwit your opponents to save your world, and earn your right to return home!

[quote=Gameosity]"[i]Entropy[/i] is an action selection game and its a set-collection game, but more than anything it’s a get-inside-your-opponents’-heads kinda game. There is a little bit of bluffing and a little bit of deduction with each play, and that really keeps things spicy."

notes.title: When The Worlds Collide
notes.notes:
Your reality is broken and torn apart, and you must be the first to piece it back together in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/entropy-worlds-collide]Entropy: Worlds Collide[/url][/b] a fast and competitive game of risk & deception.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/961/7PG7sjF2PdEwCDUVh6Ub93.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/entropy-worlds-collide]Entropy: Worlds Collide[/url][/b][/h1]

[i]Entropy: Worlds Collide[/i] is a competitive card game of risk, deception and action management for 2 to 4 players.

Each turn, players secretly select an action from the six they have available. All players then reveal and resolve their chosen action at the same time, trying to avoid Clashes that cancel actions. Take risks, deceive and outwit your opponents to save your world, and earn your right to return home!

[quote=Gameosity]"[i]Entropy[/i] is an action selection game and its a set-collection game, but more than anything it’s a get-inside-your-opponents’-heads kinda game. There is a little bit of bluffing and a little bit of deduction with each play, and that really keeps things spicy."

notes.title: The Sky Just Got Bigger
notes.notes:
Skyward, the world’s first airborne city, is back and it's bigger than ever! Two expansions were just added to make for the ultimate [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/skyward-expansions]Skyward[/url][/b] experience. Check it out.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/960/tlyAvYWR23LyGoy2IyX1tz1.jpg[/img]

[h1] [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/skyward-expansions]Skyward: Expansions[/url][/b][/h1] 
2–4 Players; 30–45 Min

[i]Skyward[/i] is a strategy card drafting game of control versus opportunity for 2-4 players. The following expansions are included:
[list][*][b]Allegiance Expansion:[/b] with this expansion you’ll be able to earn prestige by building new societies, not just new cities. At the end of the game add the VP from your completed Allegiances to your final score.
[*][b]Discord Expansion[/b] gives you the opportunity to find peacetime applications for treasures from the war. At the end of the game, the player with the most Discord cards loses 4 Victory Points.[/list]
[quote= Gameapalooza]"[i]Skyward: The Airborne City[/i] is a really nice game. [...] if you are looking for an easy to teach / play city builder that's portable and gorgeous, I'd highly recommend [i]Skyward[/i].[...] Game designer Brendan Evans came up with an efficient 'I split/you choose' game mechanic."

notes.title: Every Night Fighting Hard!
notes.notes:
Welcome back to the world of Crisis! LudiCreations presents [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/diesel-demolition-derby]Diesel Demolition Derby[/url][/b] a new game set in the grim dieselpunk universe shared by [i]Crisis[/i] and [i]Long Live the Queen[/i] (look for them on Tabletopia). This time you are members of an underground fighting league where you will compete on the arena with other robots! 

[i]Diesel Demolition Derby[/i] is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ludicreations/diesel-demolition-derby]now live on Kickstarter[/url], check it out.

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/957/qe7YsLCh95TpzcSifOogD1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/diesel-demolition-derby]Diesel Demolition Derby[/url][/b][/h1]
2–6 Players; 20–30 Min

[i]Diesel Demolition Derby[/i] is a tactical drafting hand-management card game for 2-6 players. 

Players will compete in a series of quick arena matches by fielding their robotic contraptions in battle against each other. Select a card and pass the rest to your opponent. Then reveal it and resolve the abilities. And try to balance choosing what is good for yourself while avoiding giving your opponents the chance to strike back!

notes.title: Thunderbirds Are Go!
notes.notes:
In [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/thunderbirds]Thunderbirds[/url][/b] by the famous designer Matt Leacock the year is 2065, and you are agents of a secret organization committed to saving human life. With your fleet of technologically advanced land-, sea-, air-, and space- vehicles you are ready to help, and your motto is: ‘Never give in, at any cost!’

The game is based on the cult 1960s British science-fiction television series and was published to celebrate the show's 50th anniversary.

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/955/a6mMMXPtBJnRofkaLLi660.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/thunderbirds]Thunderbirds[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]Thunderbirds[/i] is a co-operative game based on a cult sci-fi series.

Players will work together using Thunderbirds characters and high-octane vehicles to complete rescue missions and save the day by thwarting the evil plans of their Nemesis, The Hood. And remember, ‘Never give in, at any cost!’. 

[quote=On The Game]"[i]Thunderbirds[/i] is a very fun co-op game and while there are clear similarities to fans of Pandemic, it has enough differences to stand on it’s own two feet. Every decision you make is important to achieving the goal of defeating the Hood. A great game to add to the collection."

notes.title: Time to Hack Some Servers
notes.notes:
The humanity needs saving, this time from vicious Super Computers! In [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/renegade]Renegade[/url][/b] you are the hackers in a dystopian future, where humanity is on the brink of disaster. Can you save the world?

[i]Renegade[/i] is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/567823005/renegade-2]now on Kickstarter[/url], funded in under 2 hours, give it a go!

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/952/tChbJHhgH10bf83B8gpPD0.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/renegade]Renegade[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 60–90 Min

[i]Renegade[/i] is an abstract-euro thematic cyberpunk deck-building game for 1-4 players.

As outcast Renegades, you must save the humanity from the powerful Super-Massive Computers by hacking into a network of five servers. Employ informational, destructive, deceptive, and cognitive attacks to outsmart "the system" and win!

[quote=Board Gamers Anonymous]"This is a really fun puzzle game with deckbuilding, positional play, and great style. A lot of heart went into the design and development of the game, and it shows."

notes.title: 7 Faction Army: The Invaders are Here
notes.notes:
What can be more endearing to a tabletop player than to get an expansion for a great game? [i]Scythe[/i] fans, this is for you: now that [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/scythe-invaders-from-afar]Invaders from Afar[/url][/b] is added to our catalog, you can play [i]Scythe[/i] on Tabletopia with all 7 factions for the ultimate experience!

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/951/Ofyr318ozS19NyIlxONOrD.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/scythe-invaders-from-afar]Invaders from Afar[/url][/b][/h1]
1–7 Players; 90–120 Min

[i]Scythe: Invaders from Afar[/i] is an expansion for [i]Scythe[/i]. It adds two new factions—Albion and Togawa—and two new player mats, making it possible to play with 7 players.

[quote=The Cardboard Herald]"While Invaders From Afar doesn’t fundamentally change Scythe, it really rounds out the variety in the game; keeping it fresh, alive, and interesting. I think Albion and Togawa are the most interesting of the now 7 factions."

notes.title: Play Games, Read About Games
notes.notes:
Most of us read about board games almost as much as we play them. So why not read something professionally made by those who care about our hobby? 

[i]Casual Game Insider[/i] is a popular magazine which promotes digital and analog gaming and is now on Kickstarter to fund their 6th year of publication. We recommend [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/stratusgames/casual-game-insider-board-game-magazine-year-6]checking it out![/url]

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/945/HSuDXzYUoknCnz9IkSF2jF.png[/img]

Find below an exerpt from the fully packed and highly enjoyable Summer 2017 issue featuring an article about digital gaming:

[quote=Casual Game Insider]"More full-featured online services have sprung up, allowing for 3D modeling of boards and pieces, virtual reality interaction, and much greater freedom of creation.

Tabletopia is a prime example of this. With over 350 board games [almost 450 as of today], gamers from all over the world can connect over a variety of genres: light games, heavy games, social games, solo games, card games, and everything else you could possibly imagine. 

[...] The platform has become so popular that some publishers are releasing their games digitally before the physical version comes out."

notes.title: Master of the Galaxy: Per Tabletopia Ad Astra
notes.notes:
[b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/master-of-galaxy]Master of the Galaxy[/url][/b] is a fast-pacing, innovative 4X board game with bag-building & card drafting in which you jump to the stars and build your galactic civilization. After two years of development the game [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1402889231/354143093?token=11d57f1f]hits Kickstarter on July 18[/url] to be released by [url=http://www.aresgames.eu/]Ares Games[/url] and [url=http://igrology.ru/eng/]Igrology[/url]

Don’t miss the special [i]Master of the Galaxy[/i] giveaway on Gleam for a chance to win one of three available Kickstarter exclusive copies! The more points you collect, the higher your chance to win. Find the link [url=https://tabletopia.com/news/master-of-galaxy-kickstarter]on our website[/url]

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/943/n8ZxDGxemugTLfZxJiseE3.png[/img]

[i]Master of the Galaxy[/i] was initially created and developed on Tabletopia, which was also used for extensive digital playtesting. [b]4000 people played it online during 3400 hours[/b], something that is impossible to achieve with physical prototypes! The game was also often requested by players for our Learn & Play sessions.

Thanks to numerous testing sessions and feedback the authors made many important changes to the gameplay, including:
[list][*]Totally remade government cards and added unique abilities
[*]Improved conflict and leader cards
[*]Added more player interaction
[*]Substantially revamped development cards
[*]Added a new path to victory for those who want to develop science not expansion, etc.[/list]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/943/ghy3zm6MGRvmytHStsP5H7.jpg[/img]

The game was also presented to many publishers on conventions and fairs. Igrology Studio decided to release the game together with Ares Games, publishers of [i]War of the Ring[/i], [i]Sword and Sorcery[/i], [i]Wings of Glory[/i], and many other popular titles.

[b]Stay in touch: [/b]
[list][*]Join the [url=https://www.facebook.com/masterofthegalaxy]game’s Facebook group[/url] to stay up-to-date with all the hottest news.
[*][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/master-of-galaxy]Play the game today for free on Tabletopia[/url] while you wait for the campaign to start on July 18.[/list]

[img]https://tabletopia.com/static/files/000/943/rcZ424eIqtrkX2uqCzEyPD.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Games of the Rising Sun
notes.notes:
Great news for those who like classic two-player Japanese games! Meet two additions to our catalog: [i]Hanafuda[/i] and [i]Shogi[/i].

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/moon-rabbit-hanafuda]Moon Rabbit Hanafuda[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 60 Min

[i]Hanafuda[/i] (literally 'Flower card') is a deck of beautiful cards originated in 18th-century Japan.

The deck consists of 48 cards divided into 12 suits of four cards each. Each suit represents one of the twelve months of the year or individual plants.

[i]Koi-Koi[/i] is a popular Japanese game. Match cards from your hand and the deck to cards in the field to create Yaku or point combinations. 

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/903/2c0BYclidQ1YzPvt08fc62.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/japanese-chess=]Shogi & Chu Shogi[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 105–120 Min 

[i]Shogi[/i] is known as the Japanese chess and is played on a 9×9 board, and the object is to capture the opponent's king. The two main differences with Western chess are:
[list][*]not only pawns but almost any piece can promote if it reaches the opponents three last rows
[*]captured pieces become property of the capturing player and can be "droped" back on the board.[/list]
[i]Chu Shogi[/i] is played on a 12×12 board and each player controls 46 pieces. The object is to capture your opponent's King (and Crown Prince, if they have promoted their Drunk Elephant). Unlike [i]Shogi[/i], this game is played without drops.  

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/924/Ckx2W0ZnEqX03LVau4mUb1.jpg?maxwidth=1800&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

notes.title: Enter the Shadows
notes.notes:
Revisit the beloved worlds of [i]Mistfall[/i] and [i]Heart of the Mists[/i] and take on the roles of iconic Heroes in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/shadowscape]Shadowscape[/url][/b] a mini dungeon crawler from NSKN Games.

Awaken, pick up your sword and follow the whispers that guide you into the depths! 

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/932/XxMKXp60zONt9m9OHk0fZ2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/shadowscape]Shadowscape[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]Shadowscape[/i] is a mini dungeon crawl played on a modular board of rooms filled with monsters, treasures and traps set in the Mistfall universe.

As legendary Heroes each with their own set of four double-sided Action Cards, you will be attacking monsters, searching through rooms, moving and preparing for the next rounds. Move, plot and fight competitively, cooperatively, or solitaire!

[quote=Ricky Royal]"I really like it. [...] The rules are simple and streamlined. Very quick to play, very fluid. The Action Cards and Fate Cards give you a lot of depth, allowing you to create strategies and develop your characters as you play through the dungeon."

notes.title: "It's Never Not a Good Idea to Sail to Tortuga"
notes.notes:
Ahoy mateys! In [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tortuga-1667]Tortuga 1667[/url][/b] you are a pirate sailing the waters of the Caribbean. Attack the Spanish for treasure, mutiny against selfish captains, and brawl against your fellow corsairs. It's a pirate's life!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1i2JTif9Aiw&feature=youtu.be]Watch TWIST Gaming play Tortuga 1667 on Tabletopia![/url]

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/931/5Nuca7rB810GRTCOlM7g22.jpg[/img]

[h1] [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tortuga-1667]Tortuga[/url][/b][/h1]
2–8 Players; 20–40 Min

[i]Tortuga 1667[/i] is a social deception game about pirates, mutiny, plunder, and deceit.

Each player has a secret loyalty to the French or the British. Each team will attempt to transfer as much treasure as possible from a central Spanish galleon to their ship, without giving away their motive to other players. 
[quote=Alex W.]"I love this game! No game is ever the same, and it’s always exciting. You never know who is going to do what or if you are trusting the right person. Everyone I have introduced to this game has loved it too."

notes.title: Imperium in Your Pocket
notes.notes:
Want to conquer the space but don't have too much time? [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/pocket-imperium]Pocket Imperium[/url][/b] from LudiCreations, a 4X microgame of galactic dimensions, might be just what you neeed! 

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/931/iPoztsNzPpzRtbtxyJATVI0.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/pocket-imperium]Pocket Imperium[/url][/b] [/h1]
2–4 Players; 30–45 Min

[i]Pocket Imperium[/i] is a micro space 4X game for 2-4 players with programmed, simultaneous action selection.

As leaders of one of four different spacefaring races, you will compete against the other races to explore the galaxy to find resources, expand your fleet with newer, stronger, and faster ships, and ultimately conquer your foes by engaging in open warfare. 

[quote= TechRaptor]"[i]Pocket Imperium[/i] is a decent, strategic, competitive puzzle game. Get this game if you like strategy to be the most important part of a game and like to try to outguess as well as outmaneuver your opponents."

notes.title: A Game to Please the Gods
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Roman Empire! Your task in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/minerva]Minerva[/url][/b] a new strategic board game from the acclaimed author Hisashi Hayashi, will be to keep the territories under control and build new cities to please the goddess of Wisdom.

The game is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pandasaurus/minerva]on Kickstarter for 3 more days[/url] and is almost 1000% funded!

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/929/MButntCSzB1e22mBHdOtu6.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/minerva]Minerva[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 60–90 Min

[i]Minerva[/i] is a unique tile-laying resource-management strategy game.

As state managers deployed by the Roman Empire to develop flourishing cities, you will race to build military and cultural facilities to assist cultural activities and construct temples and layout the city so that it is worthy of its temples. The player who develops his city best, will earn the favour of the goddess Minerva and win the game.  

[quote=All the Meeples of the Rainbow]"Awesome new tile laying game. I love tile placement and this had a lot of great choices to be made. I haven't played anything like it."

notes.title: Roll for the Nightmares
notes.notes:
Enter, night. In [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/lucidity-six-sided-nightmares]Lucidity: Six-sided Nightmares[/url][/b] you are a Dreamer who will need to collect dreams and gain power to escape from the nightmares forever. But be wary: those same dreams that bring salvation can also be your undoing.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/foxtale/lucidity-six-sided-nightmares]This game is on Kickstarter now![/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/6d5489df3296033d4ddb8dd89eae36ddd3ac00de.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/lucidity-six-sided-nightmares]Lucidity: Six-sided Nightmares[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 20–30 Min

[i]Lucidity: Six-sided Nightmares[/i] is a strategic press-your-luck dice collection and manipulation game.

Every turn, draw dice from a collective bag, return two, and roll the remainder. After you have suffered their effects, you choose whether to rest or press your luck and extend your turn. You win by collecting 15 power symbols on your rolled dice, freeing yourself from the dream world's grasp.

[quote= Edo's Game Reviews]"This is easily the most interesting push-your-luck game I've played in a while. This is a super cool game. I've found it to be compelling, interesting, and engaging... This one is recommended."

notes.title: New Games Digest: The Hackers Guild, Hat-Trick + Players, Norsaga: Odds and Endings, Metal Dawn, Campo Bello, Werewolf Vs Vampire
notes.notes:
Hey Tabletopians,

In today's new games digest we introduce six new titles recently added to our catalog: [i]The Hackers Guild, Hat-Trick + Players, Norsaga: Odds and Endings, Metal Dawn, Campo Bello, Werewolf Vs Vampire[/i]. Note that some of these games are now on Kickstarter where you can support them after first trying on Tabletopia.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/4db3944e57048cd548b05523b629cde03d2cc59c.png[/img]


[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-hackers-guild]The Hackers Guild[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 90 Min

[i]The Hackers Guild[/i] is a cooperative game where you will take on the role of members of The Hackers Guild, and will try to work together to find login creentials and malware to complete the final hack against Monolith Global's data center.

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/924/53s6RGb73bKe3zdFZQL4J1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/hat-trick-base-game-players-expansion]Hat-Trick + Players[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]Hat-Trick[/i] is a highly-tactical football card game for two players (managers) that simulates a complete football (soccer) match. 

Managers use player-cards to make a football pitch and move their players, while two identical sets of action cards let them perform various actions: short passes, long balls or dribblings. 

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/924/hdlIqS7fMPK5JpT9vcw6I3.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/norsaga]Norsaga: Odds and Endings[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 30 Min

[i]Norsaga[/i] is a 2-4 player puzzle battle card game in which players take the role of Viking poets who are vying to describe their personal saga and their heroic ancestry, while embellishing their story with tricks they've inherited.

[i]Odds and Endings[/i] is an expansion, introducing immortal heroes, cursed relics, strange realms, and more lying about your ancestors. [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/meromorphgames/norsaga-odds-and-endings-expansion]Now on Kickstarter![/url][/b] To play, select respective setup.

[img]https://tabletopia.com/static/files/000/813/uHb1CAZKrLpykg6NBSk6k1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/metal-dawn]Metal Dawn[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 60–90 Min

[i]Metal Dawn[/i] is ais a new sci-fi action-adventure cooperative game. The players are a united faction of agents whose mission is to destroy the forces of the machine while hacking the network to take down the satellite before it’s too late.

[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/everythingepicgames/metal-dawn]This game's on Kickstarter now![/url][/b]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/924/5Y70K20ZHSpQ4AzH6x5jn6.jpg[/img]


[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/campobello]Campo Bello[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 10–20 Min

[i]Campo Bello[/i] is a fun, abstract family game for 2-4 players that adds a multiplayer twist to the traditional peg solitaire game. To win Campo Bello, remove your pieces from the board first.

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/924/beT5fxIi3RVTIC3nTjLFZ3.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/campobello]Werewolf vs. Vampire[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 15–25 Min

[i]Werewolf vs. Vampire[/i] is a tactical game that brings these creatures to life through their unique abilities. Plan ahead by building paths through this unknown world. But watch out, your opponent is trying to block you just as much as you are trying to block them! Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dinkheller/werewolf-vs-vampire]This game's on Kickstarter now![/url][/b]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/924/YoRPzLvkDchhVM7Bv4RR14.jpg[/img]

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Travel the 12 Realms of Fairytale
notes.notes:
Welcome to the world where famous tales and heroes come to life! In [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/12-realms-dungeonland]12 Realms: Dungeonland[/url][/b] a new dungeon crawling game, Red Riding Hood and Prince Charming and many others set out in a quest to change the tale's endings and stop the foul magic that has spread throughout the lands.

The game is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/magecompany/12-realms-dungeonland-0?ref=project_tweet]now on Kickstarter[/url], funded and on the way to more stretch goals, check it out!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/c32937e8d31dae6c58d5a2d3f3a15fd7635bb1cf.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/12-realms-dungeonland]12 Realms: Dungeonland[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]12 Realms: Dungeonland[/i] is a dungeon crawling game for the whole family set in a fairytale world.
 
As famous folklore characters, each with unique abilities, you will venture across famous tales to stop great villains that have been mutated by dark magic which invades their tales and attempts to change them forever. The game features a cooperative, campaign, arena, and master quest modes, no two sessions will be the same!

[i]The Tabletopia version includes only a part of the game that has to do with specific scenario. Is just a demo to feel the mechanisms of the game.[/i]

notes.title: Build Your Magic Order
notes.notes:
A great conjunction of planets is approaching! Soon the new [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/archmage]Archmage[/url][/b] of the Ruined City will be announced and hailed across the land. Will it be you?

[i]Archmage[/i] by Game Salute is now in its [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gamesalute/archmage]final week on Kickstarter[/url], and you can already try it today!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/b22c2ebfeb4ae23bb9bfd8fe6604d16415c5004c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/archmage]Archmage[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 60–120 Min

[i]Archmage[/i] is a hybrid of euro-style and thematic board games, featuring exploration, resource management, area/map control, etc.

As talented but inexperienced Mages, you will try to fulfill your destiny of becoming an Archmage, a wizard that weaves all six spheres of magic into one. On your way to success you will travel the lands, build an Order of Mages, recover lost relics, recruit followers, build your own tower, and cast mighty spells.

notes.title: What's Your Fate?
notes.notes:
You are an adventurer who was chosen to play The Game, and if you lose the price is your life... Are you brave enough to risk your neck? [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/hand-of-fate-ordeals]Hand of Fate: Ordeals[/url][/b] is a board game adaption of the best-selling multi-platform, storytelling deck-builder of the same name. 

The game is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chaoticpattern/hand-of-fate-ordeals]10+ times funded on Kickstarter[/url] and the campaing will only last another 6 days, so have a look!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/02d600bb89fcddd1acc2c981a7fde93c633824aa.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/hand-of-fate-ordeals]Hand of Fate: Ordeals[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 60–120 Min

[i]Hand of Fate[/i] is an adventure deck-building game that can be played competitively or co-op with 1–4 players.

As adventurers you will explore the land, shop to acquire weapons and abilities, encounter characters, locations and enemies. At the end of each round you try to find and defeat three dungeon bosses while also competing to see who can gain the most fame.

[quote= Avid Tabletop Gamer]"[i]Hand of Fate: Ordeals[/i] opened strong and only got stronger. The game play is an intuitive deck builder, with exploration heavily inspired by the original game. It very effectively captured the excitement of wondering what we’d find next, with most of the cards having wonderfully drawn artwork."

notes.title: All Your Territory Are Belong To Us!
notes.notes:
You are a Dark Overlord and you must struggle with other Lords for the supremacy of the regions surrounding the isolated town in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/covil]Covil[/url][/b] a new game from the author of [i]Dwar7s Fall[/i] (also on Tabletopia).

[i]Covil[/i] is a tribute to awesome 80's cartoons and it's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vesuviusmedia/covil-the-dark-overlords]already funded on Kickstarter[/url], go check it out! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/1dfad9db20adc2e93c988bc577ee0fabec3d25e1.jpg[/img]

[h1] [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/covil]Covil[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 40–90 Min

[i]Covil[/i] is a tableau building resource management and area control game for 1 to 4 players.

As a Dark Overlord with unique powers, over the course of four days you will be summoning troops, summoning reinforcement, activating artifacts and performing other actions, and, of course, trying to dominate as many territories as possible. Unleash your minions now!

[quote=Undead Viking]"The game feels like a good rush. It's fast, brutal and a lot of fun. If you like area control games and this fantasy theme, I strongly suggest that you try it."

notes.title: Get Ready to Fight!
notes.notes:
Choose your champions and test your fighting skills against one another in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/battlecon-war-of-indines]BattleCON[/url][/b] a game which combines the fast-paced combat of a duel with the strategic decisions of a board game. The game is based loosely around the mechanics and tactics present in 2D fighting games.

Don't forget that we're teaching and playing this game this [b]Sunday, Jun 18 at 11 AM (EDT)[/b]. [url=https://tabletopia.typeform.com/to/cw6GQh]Join now![/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/84ca894184df5a26de5dc481fed559327bb02f7e.jpg[/img]

[h1] [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/battlecon-war-of-indines]BattleCON[/url][/b] [/h1]
2 Players; 30–60 Min

[i]BattleCon: War of Indines[/i] is a fast-paced dueling combat card game for 2 players.

Take control of 18 different characters, from a fire elemental, an ocean guardian and her panda familiar, a space-bending trapper, a shadowy assassin, and more. Build strategic attacks, use your champion's unique abilities to smash your opponent on the board. The last player standing wins!

[quote=Boardgame Authority]"[i]BattleCon: War of Indines[/i] is a lot of fun.  It is a solid fighting game that feels like an old school video game. The amount of game that is in the box is generous to say the least. [...] Each of the fighters have a completely different feeling from the other fighters, this also lends to the high degree of replayability."

notes.title: Explore Galaxies Far Far Away
notes.notes:
The year is 3042, and the humanity is at long last ready to explore the galaxy and colonize new planets in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/kepler-3042]Kepler-3042[/url][/b] Get ready to begin an unarmed competition in a game where space discovery and future meet real science.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/1f0e836a9de02f51309abda9aa09b5dac27314f6.jpg[/img]

[h1] [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/kepler-3042]Kepler-3042[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 60–90 Min

[i]Kepler-3042[/i] is a resource management game with a sci-fi theme. 

As space explorers, you will send your ships to colonize, exploit, and terraform the planets of the Milky Way using a limited quantity of resources: Energy, Matter and Antimatter. You can burn through some, losing them forever, in order to complete additional actions and speed up your strategy.

[quote= Opinionated Gamers]"The game has a solid mechanic and you have a lot of choice. The different position of the planets and the events will offer enough variety and replaybility. Mechanics win against theme in [i]Kepler-3042[/i], but the mechanic fits really well with the theme."

notes.title: Hope is All We Have
notes.notes:
The Universe is collapsing into itself and now the mankind is facing the most terrible catastrophe ever. Only you and your friends can now save the world in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/hope]HOPE[/url][/b] a beautiful sci-fi game about navigating the space and terraforming planets. Are you ready?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/380d203bda2b61db99736ff144b33fff32a676f7.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/hope]HOPE[/url][/b] [/h1]
2–4 Players; 60 Min

[i]HOPE[/i] is a meta-cooperative game of space exploration and science fiction.

As an elite member of the Human Organization to Preserve Existence (HOPE), your mission is to fight the regression of the Universe. You will travel from galaxy to galaxy racing against the time and terraforming barren planets into habitable worlds. Be swift and bold, the future of all humanity is at stake!

[quote= Polyhedron Collider]"[i]HOPE[/i] is a great looking, fun strategy game for up to four players. It’s easy to set up and once you get your head around the mind-bending optical illusion, simple to play. There’s even a few additional game modes such as the Traitor mechanic which I’m sure will add even more tension."

notes.title: Start the Revolution!
notes.notes:
Welcome to [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/fidelitas]Fidelitas[/url][/b] a medieval city where the citizens are preparing for a rebellion and it is you they need to lead the revolution! Are you worthy of the honour? The game is designed by Jason Kotarski and Philip duBarry ([i]Black Orchestra[/i], [i]Spirits of the Rice Paddy[/i], look for them on Tabletopia).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/174124aae9a124da7cc7d9e03701e7c3bacc862e.jpg[/img]


[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/fidelitas]Fidelitas[/url][/b] [/h1]
1–4 Players; 30–45 Min

[i]Fidelitas[/i] is a hand management card game about maneuvering the masses in a medieval town.

Players are placing their citizens from their hand into various locations around the city to gain the credibility needed to lead the rebellion against the corrupt crown. Players also have secret goals they attempt achieved during the game.

[quote= Board Game Quest]"The easy to learn nature makes it an idea game if you are just looking to unwind and relax. If you are a fan of tactical card games and are looking for an accessible game that plays well with two, give [i]Fidelitas[/i] a look."

notes.title: Back to Euphoria
notes.notes:
Revisit the dystopian world of Euphoria to fight for control of the city in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/leaders-of-euphoria-choose-a-better-oppressor]Leaders of Euphoria: Choose a Better Oppressor[/url][/b] by Overworld Games. Find your allies and banish your enemies with ray guns in this social deduction tabletop game!

Will you choose a better oppressor?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0a0968628ff0a19c75ca8a702651029284641a4b.jpg[/img]


[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/leaders-of-euphoria-choose-a-better-oppressor]Leaders of Euphoria: Choose a Better Oppressor[/url][/b] [/h1]
4–8 Players; 15–30 Min

[i]Leaders of Euphoria: Choose a Better Oppressor[/i] is a social deduction game set in the world of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/euphoria-build-a-better-dystopia]Euphoria[/url] by Stonemaier Games.

Choose your faction, find your allies, banish those who oppose you, and ensure your leadership of the dystopian society. No player elimination adds more strategic choices and control to create a "gamer's" social deduction game.

[quote= Forrest Bower, Bower's Game Corner]"[i]Leaders of Euphoria[/i] is one of the best large group deduction games I think I have ever played."

notes.title: Set The Clocks, It's Time For War!
notes.notes:
Prepare to conquer your enemies in a world of all-out civil war and chaos in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/clockwork-wars]Clockwork Wars[/url][/b] a new fast-paced game from Eagle-Gryphon Games. Position your unique troops, research powerful discoveries, employ espionage, and destroy the foes!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/aa2cd46337aa45e2478386effaa9aa43ad1a5446.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/clockwork-wars]Clockwork Wars[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 60–120 Min

[i]Clockwork Wars[/i] is an epic board game of conquest, discovery, and espionage set in a fantasy-steampunk universe.

You will command a unique race of human-animal hybrid factions or the race of Pureblooded humans. Your goal is to vanquish your foes and accumulate the most victory points through seven turns of play. 

[quote=Dale Yu]"[i]Clockwork Wars[/i] is well thought out meld of thematic conquest game mixed with a secret and simultaneous action selection and resolution phase... It’s an intriguing take on a map conquest game, and one that is set up nicely for Eurogamers to enjoy."

notes.title: Celts vs Romans
notes.notes:
The Roman legions advance! On the night of [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/samhain]Samhain[/url][/b] the Celtic clans gather to decide who will lead the resistance. Are you worthy enough? Prove your skill in this new board game!

Samhain is now smashing it on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/36818957/samhain]Kickstarter[/url], go check it out! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/e9ddad4c2680180845f6558650825f2cda64ea46.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/samhain]Samhain[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]Samhain[/i] is a euro game with a variety of mechanics and a Celtic mythology setting.

As leaders of Celtic clans, you will try to become the most powerful one in order to be placed in charge of the resistance against the Romans.

Manage your clan the best you can, place your clan members on the village locations, obtain resources and manage them properly in order to expand your clan and mess with your opponents!

notes.title: Keyflower Tournament Is Finished!
notes.notes:
The First Official International Online Keyflower Tournament on Tabletopia is now over! 64 people from over 20 countries and almost all continents (except Africa and Antarctica :)) took part in the competition, and now the Ultimate Champion was decided.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/60c1dabd402c26cd5226f4a090cb1354dbc50282.png[/img]

Congratulations to Mikhail Gavrikov (aka Migelius) from Kazakhstan, who wins a copy of [i]Keyflower[/i] autographed by the authors and an opportunity to play the game online with Sebastian Bleasedale, the co-author of the game. By the way, Mikhail also holds the record for the max points scored—95!

All quarter-finalists will receive a 6 month premium Tabletopia subscription. Congrats, KP (USA), Bryson (CAN), rngesus.wept (USA), scottdawn1 (USA), Swivel (BRA), TheGoodTheBadAndTheMeeple (FRA), flashvoyagergtr (RUS)!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/94f486aa48d82b4270134a452d94daea64afb95f.png[/img]

The [url=https://youtu.be/mo22yZ3WtIw?t=2m2s]record of the epic final struggle[/url] is available on YouTube, as well as the videos of the two semi-finals (see links below).

Thanks for participation, Tabletopians! And a special thanks to our judges and streamers: Bibr, [url=https://www.twitch.tv/martin_silenus]Martin[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/TabletopAya]Ayatsuru[/url].

[h1]Tournament links:[/h1]

notes.title: Rule the Ancient Egypt
notes.notes:
The dynasties of Ancient Egypt rise and fall. Will your rule be strong enough in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/iunu]IUNU[/url][/b] by Ludi Creations? Feed your citizens, protect them from invaders, and secure their places in the afterlife.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ludicreations/iunu]Check the game out on Kickstarter today[/url], it's already funded!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/bf93a1d006e9d05218994abe5eed9ba9f9acade1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/iunu]IUNU[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 30–45 Min

[i]IUNU[/i] is a card game set in the ancient Egyptian city of the same name, the city of pillars.

As heads of an Egyptian dynasty, you will try to bring the citizens (cards) of Iunu under your influence through careful planning and scheming as well as securing their place in the afterlife. Will your dynasty stand the test of time?
