notes.title: Cast in Stone
notes.notes:
In [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/kumo-hogosha]Kumo Hogosha[/url][/b] you fight to prove your strength and to show your skills to the gods to try and become a Guardian of the Clouds, a demigod amongst men. Climb into the Arena and master its ever-changing environment! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/6004df571338f5946c6079e1326453dc26ab1fb9.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/kumo-hogosha]Kumo Hogosha[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 25–30 Min

[i]Kumo Hogosha[/i] is a wrestling game for 2–4 players who will compete for domination of a stone. 

As muscular Kumotori, the valiant warriors, you will fight against each other to push the Stone of Balance into your opponent’s camp, all the while rotating the Arena itself! The first team to pull the Stone out from the side of the opponent becomes the Kumo Hogosha.

[quote=Board Game Anonymos]"It’s rare to find an abstract game with a new angle like this, let alone with such high production quality and a theme so inviting. The sumo wrestlers work perfectly, running, throwing, blocking, and pushing into each other to control the stone."

notes.title: Angry Birds in New Zealand
notes.notes:
Your homeland is under attack and only you can fend off the invaders! Terrible beasts, among them dogs, possums, rats and weasels, invade your country and it's you, the brave birds, who will need to defend it. 

[b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/moa]Moa[/url][/b] is a new game by the acclaimed author Martin Wallace ([i]Brass: Birmigham[/i], also on Tabletopia) and is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/13415575/moa-a-martin-wallace-board-game-of-birds-and-mamma]now on Kickstarter[/url] with only 5 days left.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/56cc95384e8d9ade93ccd388ffd9d2d00420ceb9.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/moa]Moa[/url][/b][/h1]
3–5 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]Moa[/i] is a strategy area control game where you control tribes of birds in New Zealand.

As noble birds with human traits, you will be competing with your fellow players for control of the regions while staving off the advances of the intruding mammals. 

[i]Moa[/i] is a fantasy interpretation of the clash between the original inhabitants of New Zealand and the wave of settlers from over the seas.

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/moa]Moa[/url][/b][/h1]
3–5 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]Moa[/i] is a strategy area control game where you control tribes of birds in New Zealand.

As noble birds with human traits, you will be competing with your fellow players for control of the regions while staving off the advances of the intruding mammals. 

[i]Moa[/i] is a fantasy interpretation of the clash between the original inhabitants of New Zealand and the wave of settlers from over the seas.

notes.title: New Games Digest: Loot & Recruit, ELO Darkness, Metras, Bangkok Klongs, and War of the 9 Realms
notes.notes:
Hey Tabletopians,

So many new games appear on the platform these days that we decided to introduce a new "column" where we will tell you about our newest releases in a nutshell. Today please welcome [i]Loot & Recruit, ELO Darkness, Metras, Bangkok Klongs[/i], and [i]War of the 9 Realms[/i].

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/bangkok-klongs]Bangkok Klongs[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 45–60 Min

In [i]Bangkok Klongs[/i] players place boats on the Klongs (canals) of Bangkok, trying to take the best places. When a scoring round occurs filled up squares can be scored. After scoring players have to remove a boat which they can take in stock. The stock will be scored at the end of the game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/fa2f9847c9de9ce3d3f3e7c6986967a22c4839f2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/loot-recruit]Loot & Recruit[/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 45–60 Min

In [i]Loot & Recruit[/i] you become a contestant in a crazy Goblin festival as you compete for the title of Goblin King.

During the festival, you will add new cards to your deck, recruit Goblins for victory points, attack other players, and hire minions to perform special actions.  

[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vilegeniusgames/loot-and-recruit]This game's on Kickstarter now![/url][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/5e0296f2caed2390cc5788038869dfc9ff8298f4.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/elo-darkness]ELO Darkness[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 40–50 Min

[i]ELO Darkness[/i] is a MOBA-inspired boardgame, based on card-driven mechanics, in which 2 players fight against each other in an epic 3-Lane arena. 

Players each have a deck of 40 cards representing a team of five Heroes, each one of these with a specific role on the battle front.

[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/reggiegames/elo-darkness]This game's on Kickstarter now![/url][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/b45878a0785bcf830af4ed6025f30fe8ad49ae3e.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/war-of-the-9-realms]War of the 9 Realms[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 45–90 Min

[i]War of the 9 Realms[/i] is a tile based tactical skirmish game based on the Realms of Norse Mythology. Each realm is comprised of unique Norse characters and their wondrous abilities.

The game allows you to pit these against each other in a bid to claim total victory. The victors will reshape the World in their own form.  

[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/laurenceobrien/war-of-the-nine-realms]This game's on Kickstarter now![/url][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/cfcf861166a5d3bea4afa866d4dfdb1cb5581de4.jpg[/img]


[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/metras]Metras[/url][/b][/h1]
3–4 Players; 45–60 Min

In [i]Metras[/i] you are the head of a Noble Family of the Empire of Metras seeking the favor of Emperor. You will hold lavish parties, resort to intrigue and corruption, or face epic missions on behalf of the Emperor.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/35216ffb7af806beadc1a3b1218bb4e19eacd7b8.jpg[/img]

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Make This City Extra Large!
notes.notes:
Time to build the best city in the world in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/card-city-xl]Card City XL[/url][/b] the ultimate card city building game in which your city automatically evolves under your eyes. Start the game with only a single building card before you: City Hall, and develop the most profitable metropolis ever!

[i]Card City XL[/i] was [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/avstudio-ludibooster/card-city-xl]funded on Kickstarter[/url] within the first 10 hours, check it out!

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/card-city-xl]Card City XL[/url][/b] [/h1]
2–4 Players; 20–60 Min

[i]Card City XL[/i] is a card city building game where your city grows on its own.

As the newly sworn-in Mayor, your task is to encourage the growth of the residential, commercial, industrial and cultural districts to satisfy the demands of the residents. 

Each turn, you build new buildings, and then they evolve on their own, if their surroundings are right. Watch with astonishment as your city grows before your eyes.

notes.title: Corporate Warfare in the Dark Future
notes.notes:
The future is grim. Man and machine fight for dominance over the Earth’s last remaining resources. This is [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/farsight]Farsight[/url][/b] an epic sci-fi strategy game developed for over 8 years by veteran wargamer Jamie Jolly to make a simple system that will appeal to newer gamers and hardened tacticians alike.

Play the game online now and don't forget to [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/315276384/farsight-corporate-warfare-in-a-dark-future]check out their successful Kickstarter campaign[/url], only 10 days left!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/69dde9742e10aac0b204f923a2d630c5927e4955.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/farsight]Farsight[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 50–90 Min

[i]Farsight[/i] is a strategic war game set in the sci-fi world of distant future. 

Players control one of the four dominant corporations, in a campaign to control a sprawling map. Each turn, you will deploy units face-down to the battlefield, revealing them when they are spied upon, or enter combat. On a parallel Shadow Map hidden specialists spy on the enemy and sabotage their units.

[quote=Board Meetings]"[i]Farsight[/i]  provides an accessible, engaging and strategic wargame, and it does so quickly, elegantly, and effortlessly."

notes.title: Travel to the Heart of the Mists
notes.notes:
The time has come to brave the mists again, now with the standalone expansion [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mistfall-heart-of-the-mists]Mistfall: Heart of the Mists[/url][/b] in which the legendary adventure from [i]Mistfall[/i] by NSKN Games continues. 

Join mighty heroes, face ruthless enemies and dire threats, and brave the path that will lead you into the Heart of the Mists!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0b44bebc895d4e4ad679f701c6d9d202ef7ab005.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mistfall-heart-of-the-mists]Mistfall: Heart of the Mists[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 30–120 Min

[i]Heart of the Mists[/i] is a fully cooperative card-based adventure game set in a dark fantasy world of wonder and peril. It can be played standalone or fully combined and integrated with [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mistfall]Mistfall[/url]

In this adventure you will find new Heroes, Enemies, Encounters, and Quests, as well as alternative versions of some of the base game mechanisms. Gather up your resolve, check your gear and get ready to go to brave the heart of the perilous Mists!

[quote=Jonathan Rowe]"[i]Heart of the Mists[/i] in every way takes what was good about Mistfall and either keeps it good or makes it great. The prospect of introducing the new Heroes to the old ones in “guest starring…” roles is very exciting for old-timers but this is an ideal jumping-on point for newcomers to the game and its world."

notes.title: Play Later Mode Added to Tabletopia
notes.notes:
Hey Tabletopians, 

We’re glad to announce Play Later, a brand new feature in our Playground that lets you schedule games for future!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/4c6c83955449156d6a709b79ec02733d95889064.png[/img]

It’s not always possible to play here and now. With Play Later you can plan the time and game you want to play up to 14 days ahead and let other people join if the time’s convenient for them. 

Also, you can add the event to your calendar so that you don’t miss it. Tabletopia will remind you about the game 15 minutes prior through your browser (you need to allow push-up notifications from Tabletopia in your browser to use this feature). 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/bd9a6840b6175abc68fc719eef04d54e23862434.png[/img]

Our Learn & Play events are now also featured on this page so that you always know what’s being learned and played this week. 

Let us know what you think of this new feature in [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/4PsHHKm]Discord[/url]!

[h1][b]How To Start With Play Later[/b][/h1]
[b]To see all scheduled games,[/b] go to Playground > Find & Play > Play Later. All games are displayed in your local time for maximum convenience. 

[b]To join a game,[/b] click the room > Join. And don’t forget to open Tabletopia when the game is due :)

[b]To schedule a game:[/b]
[list][*]Create a game room as usual.
[*]Check “Schedule for later” in the Room Options section.
[*]Choose the date and time and enter an optional welcome message. Your scheduled game is ready! [/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/4e53e7ef4802ce4f942b21f9b58dd1b563331540.png[/img]

The game will be displayed in the Play Later section for other players to join. At the time of the game, you will need to launch it once the players are assembled. For more details on Play Later see [url=http://help.tabletopia.com/knowledge-base/play-later/]our article in Help[/url]

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Can You Find and Stop Him?
notes.notes:
#1 most-anticipated party game of 2016 (as per BGG community) is now available on Tabletopia for free! Play [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/playground/secret-hitler/play-now]Secret Hitler[/url][/b] online with your friends. Will you be the liberals and help uncover and stop the Secret Hitler? Or will you try to install your cold-blooded leader?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ca38049fe7734927d0af885a3bf94eaf0feb64dd.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/playground/secret-hitler/play-now]Secret Hitler[/url][/b][/h1] 
5–8 Players; 45 Min

[i]Secret Hitler[/i] is a social deduction party game of political intrigue and betrayal set in 1930s Germany.

Each player is randomly and secretly assigned to be a liberal or a fascist, and one player is Secret Hitler. The liberal team must pass five liberal policies or assassinate Secret Hitler. The fascist team has to pass six fascist policies or elect Secret Hitler chancellor after three fascist policies have passed.

[quote=Elan Lee (Exploding Kittens)]"This game is great! It takes all the fun of a giant social game like Werewolf or Mafia and makes it faster, more fun, and easier to make decisions. This has become the party game of choice at my house!"

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/playground/secret-hitler/play-now]Secret Hitler[/url][/b][/h1] 
5–8 Players; 45 Min

[i]Secret Hitler[/i] is a social deduction party game of political intrigue and betrayal set in 1930s Germany.

Each player is randomly and secretly assigned to be a liberal or a fascist, and one player is Secret Hitler. The liberal team must pass five liberal policies or assassinate Secret Hitler. The fascist team has to pass six fascist policies or elect Secret Hitler chancellor after three fascist policies have passed.

[quote=Elan Lee (Exploding Kittens)]"This game is great! It takes all the fun of a giant social game like Werewolf or Mafia and makes it faster, more fun, and easier to make decisions. This has become the party game of choice at my house!"

notes.title: Stop the Russian Steamroller!
notes.notes:
Revive and rewrite one of the most important battles of World War I in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/heroes-of-the-great-war-limanowa-1914]Heroes of the Great War: Limanowa 1914[/url][/b] a tactical war board game designed so that both casual players and hardcore wargamers can enjoy it. Can you stop the Russian Steamroller or will the history of the World War I be forever rewritten?

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2038926808/heroes-of-the-great-war-limanowa-1914-0]Support the game on Kickstarter today![/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/15a809f2285f88727581fa1b2193dce742dfa34f.jpg[/img]

[h1] [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/heroes-of-the-great-war-limanowa-1914]Heroes of the Great War: Limanowa 1914[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 30–90 Min

[i]Heroes of the Great War: Limanowa 1914[/i] is a tactical board game set in the Eastern Front of World War I.

Players personify the commanders of four different army corps as two opposing parties: Austro-Hungarian units and the forces of the Russian Empire. With the help of their combat units players will lead skirmishes, plan maneuvers over various terrains, set traps using secret battlecards, and lay sieges to fortified towns. 

[quote=Rob Oren, Dice Tower]"Simple combat, precisely detailed, a lot of passion put into this game. This game is really at the grand strategy level, but easy to play. It's not overly complex, but its strategic enough to suck you in. The way the combat system works it's just brilliant! This is a great game, this is something that you really wanna sink your teeth into!"

notes.title: Let Juju Dice Rain!
notes.notes:
Meet [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/konja]Konja[/url][/b] a casual two-player dice game of Relics, Clouds and Juju by Pleasant Company Games. The game is brought to you by the creators of [i]Ancient Terrible Things[/i] (also on Tabletopia) and builds on the same Dicequest game system used there.  

[i]Konja[/i]  is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pleasantcompanygames/konja]now on Kickstarter until 25 May 2017[/url] and is already funded. Make sure to check this dice game out!


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/f61b25a3300268195fd84cb4222c7a8400747d74.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/konja]Konja[/url][/b] [/h1]
2 Players; 30–60 Min

[i]Konja[/i] is a 2-player, press-your-luck, tactical dice game, in which players assume the roles of shaman wizards, summoning a great storm. 

Using Relics, Spells and rolling Bones (dice), the game involves rolling and spending dice combinations to acquire resources and Clouds, which are worth points in the game. The winner is the first wizard to summon a great storm and bring rain to the dry land.

[quote= Cardboard Quest]"[i]Konja[/i]  exudes a sense of uniqueness. [...] There’s a lot going on in [i]Konja[/i] . We appreciated the light dusting of Yahtzee the design incorporates without making it the focus of the game."

notes.title: Pyramid Building for Newbies
notes.notes:
Welcome to [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sailing-toward-osiris]Sailing Toward Osiris[/url][/b] where the Pharaoh is dead it is now your task to honour him with grand monuments to become the successor to the throne. Deploy workers, please the capricious gods, and finish the memorial before the barge reaches the pharaoh's tomb! 

Also, we recommend checking out this [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dailymagicgames/sailing-toward-osiris]board game's Kickstarter campaign[/url] (funded!).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ae963afb3f6083132854206a506fe8655ec58d90.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sailing-toward-osiris]Sailing Toward Osiris[/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 60 Min

[i]Sailing Toward Osiris[/i] is a euro-style game with worker placement, resources management, project completion, and no direct conflict.

Aa the Governors of Egypt, you will be gathering resources, using favors from the gods, and utilizing citizen powers to build sphinxes, obelisks, and pylons on the River Nile.

Who will build the greatest tribute to the late king and become the next Pharaoh?

[quote=Geek Dad]"[i]Sailing Toward Osiris[/i] gives you a lot of meaty decisions to make—you’ll often be pulled in a couple different directions [...]. The ever-dwindling access to resources is a fantastic mechanic, and I recommend engaging in some friendly (or unfriendly) negotiation for some extra player interaction."

notes.title: More Aliens, More Frontiers
notes.notes:
Good news, everyone! [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/alien-frontiers-factions]Alien Frontiers: Factions[/url][/b] was added to our catalog, which means that you can now play one of our hits [i]Alien Frontiers[/i] with various cool alien factions and use their unique powers!

Also, read [url=http://blog.tabletopia.com/tory-niemann-dont-underestimate-the-glossy-vibrant-dice/]our interview with the game's author Tory Niemann[/url] if you haven't read it before.

 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0bef0f491eb8bd4ff80b31d68d8439a4b33cae26.jpg[/img]


[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/alien-frontiers-factions]Alien Frontiers: Factions[/url][/b] [/h1]
2–5 Players; 60–90 Min

[i]Alien Frontiers: Factions[/i] is an expansion for [i]Alien Frontiers[/i] and adds a number of items to the base game:
[list][*]Factions, each providing a special ability and new orbital facilities.
[*]Agendas, which are hidden objectives that allow a player to earn bonus points at game's end or when the agenda is revealed in-game.
[*]New Alien Tech cards.[/list]
[quote=Tory Niemann, game's author]"My favorite Faction is the Scavenger Fleet. Being able to get dice all the time and being able to use them immediately is a big edge. I’m also fond of the Uranian Syndicate in a four or five player game, since there is bound to be lots of conflict. "

notes.title: The Explorers of the Galaxy
notes.notes:
Time to explore and dominate some galaxies! Put your conqueror skills to the test in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/galaxy-of-trian-new-order]Galaxy of Trian: New Order[/url][/b] a dynamic tile-based game set in space. Vie for control over nebulas and planetary systems, gain credits and minerals, and conquer the entire Galaxy.

Also, take a look at this [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1118278224/galaxy-of-trian-new-order]board game on Kickstarer[/url], where it was funded within 4 hours!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/aefd821a70af93fd99a707bc8a9a786677bdcabc.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/galaxy-of-trian-new-order]Galaxy of Trian: New Order[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 45–120 Min

[i]Galaxy of Trian: New Order[/i] is a dynamic tile laying game with a science-fiction theme.

As commanders of alien races, you will use triangular double-sided tiles to build a galaxy full of nebulae, gas clouds, and planets. Use your missaries and ships to explore and take control of the galaxy, and your ﬂeet to fight for dominance. Get the most credits and minerals to win!

[quote= The Game Boy Geek]"It really does feels like you're in outer space. I love the tile-laying aspect, it feels like [i]Carcassonne[/i] on steroids. It's a heavier game with a lot of choices to make. And as you play each race, they all have different abilities and different flavor as well".

notes.title: The Revolution is Here
notes.notes:
Get ready for the industrial revolution! [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/brass-birmingham]Brass: Birmingham[/url][/b], a finely brewed sequel to the famous economic strategy boardgame [i]Brass[/i] by Martin Wallace, is now on Tabletopia.
 
The game is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roxley/brass-an-industrial-revolution]now at full steam on Kickstarter[/url] and you can still jump on the bandwagon and back it if you hurry!

 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/a099429e472e50ec569059dab2b1e4856e5c0bee.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/brass-birmingham]Brass: Birmingham[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 150–180 Min

[i]Brass: Birmingham[/i] is an economic strategy game and a sequel to Martin Wallace' 2007 masterpiece, [i]Brass[/i].

As competing entrepreneurs in Birmingham during the industrial revolution in 1770-1870, you will develop, build, and establish your industries and network, in an effort to exploit low or high market demands.

The game offers a very different story arc and experience from its predecessor with multiple interesting new strategies waiting for you to discover. Also new in this game:
[list][*]Dynamic board setup
[*]New canal/rail scoring
[*]3 new industry types, etc.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/f30f74cc83858935dbd74b7cf9f729a1ce395f3d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: A Bag Full of Fun
notes.notes:
Bonjour! We invite you to travel to the French medieval city of [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/orleans]Orléans[/url][/b] where you will compete to take dominance of the area by trading, aquiring goods, making progress in sceince, etc. 

The game is currently [b]rated #30 on BGG Top 100[/b] and is highly praised by players and critics alike with numerous awards and nominations.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/fd5cdbc858cfebcefac664da632967475ee31188.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/orleans]Orléans[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 90–120 Min

[i]Orléans[/i] is an innovative bag-building euro game where players compete in different areas in the medieval setting. 

Through the game you will assemble a following of farmers, merchants, knights, monks, etc. to gain supremacy through trade, construction and science in medieval France. After 18 rounds points are awarded for development, citizens, and goods. The player with the most points wins.

[quote=GeekInsight ]"[i]Orléans[/i]  is just a fantastic experience. Experienced gamers will see a bevy of familiar mechanics, but an entirely new game. While it relies on random draws of tiles, it provides numerous tools for players to achieve the deck composition that they want. The whole thing is a marvel and immensely enjoyable. Play it if you can."

The game is currently [b]rated #30 on BGG Top 100[/b] and is highly praised by players and critics alike with numerous awards and nominations.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/fd5cdbc858cfebcefac664da632967475ee31188.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/orleans]Orléans[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 90–120 Min

[i]Orléans[/i] is an innovative bag-building euro game where players compete in different areas in the medieval setting. 

Through the game you will assemble a following of farmers, merchants, knights, monks, etc. to gain supremacy through trade, construction and science in medieval France. After 18 rounds points are awarded for development, citizens, and goods. The player with the most points wins.

[quote=GeekInsight ]"[i]Orléans[/i]  is just a fantastic experience. Experienced gamers will see a bevy of familiar mechanics, but an entirely new game. While it relies on random draws of tiles, it provides numerous tools for players to achieve the deck composition that they want. The whole thing is a marvel and immensely enjoyable. Play it if you can."

notes.title: Rule the Highlands
notes.notes:
In mid-19th century Scotland was becoming an industrialized country, and it is you who can help one of the clans become the most powerful in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/clans-of-caledonia]Clans of Caledonia[/url][/b] by Karma Games.

The game's already [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/680649956/clans-of-caledonia-a-game-about-whisky-trade-and-g]super succesfull on Kickstarter[/url], and you now have a chance to play it on Tabletopia before backing. Even more so, [b]we're teaching the game for free with the author[/b] this weekend (Sunday)! Don't miss your chance, [url=https://tabletopia.typeform.com/to/cw6GQh]sign up now[/url]. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/3f77eab7a315a49519cc0a4c52f15d3e6ac6facb.jpg[/img]

[h1] [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/clans-of-caledonia]Clans of Caledonia[/url][/b] [/h1]
1–4 Players; 30–120 Min

[i]Clans of Caledonia[/i] is a mid to heavy economic game that is set in 19th-century Scotland.

As proud members of the old clans, players will produce whisky, bread and cheese from grain and milk and then  trade and export the goods. Use your unique abilities and cunning skill to earn the greatest wealth and fame!

[quote= Board Game Quest]"[i]Clans of Caledonia[/i] is a wonderful game. [...] if you’re a fan of games such as [i]Terra Mystica[/i], [i]Clans of Caledonia[/i] offers something equally fulfilling in an equal or shorter playtime. Any gamers out there looking for a game of heavy management and economics should be focusing their attention here."

notes.title: Portal Here, Portal There...
notes.notes:
Imagine that you’re part of a team of Swiss scientists who discover a way to open portals to other dimensions. Now you can learn a lot of mysteries unknown to the rest of humanity... Unless the hideous creatures from the portals get to you first!

No time to waste! Close the portals in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/multiuniversum]Multiuniversum[/url][/b] but make sure to get most knowledge before you do that.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/2c964b17ca91cc44d4c53866ef3ca9518e18329c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/multiuniversum]Multiuniversum[/url][/b][/h1]
1–5 Players; 20–40 Min

[i]Multiuniversum[/i] is a card game puzzle in which players are competing to close the most portals and to get the most knowledge from other dimensions.

You will use actions on your cards to do research, move between 5 modules of the Hadron Collider, prepare tools so you can close portals to alternative realities. After all portals are closed, the scientist who got the most knowledge points receives the Nobel prize and wins the game.

[quote=A Meeple, Myself, and I Review]"[i]Multiuniversum[/i] has flexibility in spades. It’s a weird, quirky puzzle of a game, but I think that it’s one that’s pretty engaging and fun." [/quote]

notes.title: Help Wanted, Ask Nasty
notes.notes:
It's another busy day at the fantasy [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/cavern-tavern]Cavern Tavern[/url][/b] where the patrons are famous heroes and the barkeep is a nasty and greedy dwarf. Your mission is to be the best employee Nasty the Dwarf has ever had and keep your job at all costs. Are you ready? 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/e399ab34f3d193343a8370f2615cfd2d18b00bdf.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/cavern-tavern]Cavern Tavern[/url][/b][/h1]
1–6 Players; 60–120 Min

[i]Cavern Tavern[/i] is a dice placement competitive board game for 1-6 players about working in a fantasy tavern.

Your job will be to serve the most drinks, spend time in the kitchen, do chores, and maintain good relations with the barkeep.

To stand out from other workers and gain your employers favor, you’ll need to skillfully manage the orders from your customers as well as dice and items picked up on tables left by the patrons.

[quote=Eduardo Baraf, Edo's Game Reviews ]"Fun, fantastic theme and art execution. It's very well done, it's nicely balanced, it's fantastic!"

notes.title: It's Show Time!
notes.notes:
Imagine that you are the boss of a large TV network and you can show whatever you like to millions of viewers! Wouldn't it be fun? Here's your chance in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/prime-time]Prime Time[/url][/b] a game where you will pick and schedule TV shows to try and win the love of viewers and revenue from advertising.


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/5b47f441ad58382270ec5695499ac54324e688e4.jpg[/img]


[h1] [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/prime-time]Prime Time[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 15–45 Min

[i]Prime Time[/i] is a resource management game that combines a worker placement mechanism with a card system.

As TV executives, you will try to create ideal TV schedules by hiring talented actors, producers and writers to the show and deciding how to arrange your Guide to please the most audience. So will you win the prime time and become the #1 network?

notes.title: Fifteen Men on the Dead Man's Chest
notes.notes:
Prepare for an adventure of high piracy in beautiful [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dead-man-s-doubloons]Dead Man’s Doubloons[/url][/b] where players take on the role of legendary corsair captains. Treasure maps, mysterious island, skirmishes, pillaging, ghost ships — it has everything, if a pirate's life's for you!

Check out the game's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gonab/dead-mans-doubloons]successfull Kickstarter campaign[/url] (funded in 5 hours, many stretch goals already unlocked), until it's too late.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/adb59c0bbd9134acd8ea8f21efe4426a721fc9ab.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dead-man-s-doubloons]Dead Man’s Doubloons[/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 30–60 Min

[i]Dead Man's Doubloons[/i] is an action-packed simultaneous action selection game of high piracy.

As savvy pirate captains in control of a ship and a crew, you will skirmish with one another while searching for treasure map fragments.

Then, you will follow one of the several paths to the buried treasure. And the final phase brings the ships back to sea in an epic battle royale! Who will become the richest pirate?

[quote= Pawn's Perspective]"I was a huge fan of [i]Dead Man's Doubloons[/i] since the first time I played. It’s fast, even with a full compliment of players, fun, and so full of pirate theme that you’ll be grabbing booty (heh) and talking like a pirate within a few short turns into the game."

notes.title: Burgle's Eleven
notes.notes:
Do you like movies about heists as much as we like them? Cunning plans, daring heroes, dire dangers... All this you will find in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/burgle-bros]Burgle Bros.[/url][/b] the ultimate cooperative tabletop heist by Tim Fowers ([i]Paperback[/i], [i]Fugitive[/i] also on Tabletopia). Assemble your team and pull of the heist of the century!


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/d77a6f59af1f2e2b8bf7b88d6110da33dca3a575.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=vhttps://tabletopia.com/games/burgle-bros]Burgle Bros.[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 90 Min

[i]Burgle Bros.[/i] is a cooperative game for 1-­4 players about organazing and pulling off a heist. 

As a team of burglars, you will try to carry out a robbery of a highly secure building without getting caught. Each player uses unique powers to avoid guards, navigate alarms and get out.

[quote=Peter Sciretta]"[i]Burgle Bros.[/i] is an intensely strategic game filled with fun, highly thematic moments. Have you ever wanted to  pull off a huge heist? This is the closest you’ll get without breaking the law.”

notes.title: It’s Never Lupus
notes.notes:
Dreaming about a  medical career? With [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/healthy-heart-hospital]Healthy Heart Hospital[/url][/b] you can have a look at how a hopital is managed from the inside without spending years and thousands on education! See if you can shoulder the responsibilities or will have to find a place to hide the victims of your "care".

Also, don't miss our Learn & Play live session teaching and playing this game this Saturday, Apr 22 at 2 PM (EDT)! [url=https://tabletopia.typeform.com/to/cw6GQh]Sign up here >[/url] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/2e432dcaa6b1e0f8596cabc7367fe11367a55a40.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/healthy-heart-hospital]Healthy Heart Hospital[/url][/b][/h1]
1–5 Players; 60–90 Min

[i]Healthy Heart Hospital[/i] is a cooperative game for 1 to 5 players about managing a hospital.

As leading Physicians, you will have to manage hospital administration while still trying to cure the patients that come pouring into the hospital each round. Will you be able to raise your hospital's reputation and bring back its former glory?

[quote= TechRaptor]"[i]Healthy Heart Hospital[/i] is a great game that will really appeal to gamers who enjoy cooperative games such as Pandemic. The theme is excellent for a cooperative game, and the game’s sense of humor manages to lighten the tone."

notes.title: Race in the Name of Caesar
notes.notes:
Ave Caesar and let the race begin! In [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/chariots-of-rome]Chariots of Rome[/url][/b] by Victory Point Games you will participate in an exciting race around the Circus Maximus and will try to impress the crowd and gods alike to become the victor.

The game [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/567823005/chariots-of-rome]has just launched on Kickstarter[/url], race to check it out!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/7d789f3bc4d6facaca9b32212972cc6906ea98a1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/chariots-of-rome]Chariots of Rome[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 45–120 Min

[i]Chariots of Rome[/i] is a competitive, chariot-racing board game for 2 to 4 cunning drivers set in ancient Rome.

You will control a unique charioteer competing on the giant track. Demostrate your skill, handle the dangerous corners, ram and whip opponents and impress the crowds and gods. Win this race!

[quote=Gaming Trend]"[i]Chariots of Rome[/i] recreates the frantic and brutal nature of a chaotic chariot race. [...] the game takes a deliciously nasty turn with the ability to attack your fellow racers. [It] is all about risk versus reward, and it works brilliantly."

notes.title: Face Your Waterloo
notes.notes:
Relive the glorious battles of the past with wargames on Tabletopia! We introduce [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/napoleonic-20-waterloo-20]Waterloo 20[/url][/b] by Victory Point Games, a game based on the Waterloo campaign of 15-18 June 1815 between Emperor Napoleon and the Anti-French side.

The [i]Napoleonic 20 Series[/i] features games of modest complexity, each with a focused scope and low unit density (typically fewer than twenty pieces per side).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/3267744c597625b43b38f9fc3f75710fdcea8e65.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/napoleonic-20-waterloo-20]Waterloo 20[/url][/b][/h1]
1–2 Players; 50 Min

[i]Waterloo 20[/i] is a historical wargame and the first in a series of games featuring low unit density on the map (20 pieces or less per side) and medium complexity.

The dramatic, fast-playing turns provide for operational level maneuvers and feature compelling historical narrative with random event cards and night game turns.

[quote= Board Game Quest]"A great starter set of Napoleonic battle scenarios supported by an appealing game system where players truly feel like commanders on the battlegrounds of Waterloo."

notes.title: Break the Magic Seals
notes.notes:
It's time to explore the dungeon of the Arcana Tower in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/five-seals-of-magic]Five Seals of Magic[/url][/b] and find some powerful spells! Use the dice of four matching colors to break the seals and clear a path to the scrolls.

Take a look at the new revised edition of the game [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/maydaygames/five-seals-of-magic-board-game-2-5-player-60-minut/]now on Kickstarter[/url] (funded) complete with:  
[list][*]updated rules, including a new use for your familiar spell
[*]revised game board
[*]three new spell circles available as add-ons[/list]
 
Also, a free live Learn & Play session of [i]Five Seals of Magic[/i] is scheduled for the next week, stay tuned for further announcement!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/744d3700bc45dd0a71ad43035092ac226e558b12.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/five-seals-of-magic]Five Seals of Magic[/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 30–60 Min

[i]Five Seals of Magic[/i] is an adventure dice rolling set collection game.

As mages seeking more power, you will try to break seals and open way to magic scrolls on the map of a dungeon. Keep an eye on your opponents and be sure to use your powers at the right time and at the right place. The player who collects the most powerful scrolls wins!

[quote=Dan King, Game Boy Geek]"The artwork is awesome. I love when casting your spells, you can catapult them together to get a bunch of cool effects."

notes.title: Catch Me If You Can
notes.notes:
Will you be the Chaser or the Chased? [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/fugitive]Fugitive[/url][/b] is a new game by Tim Fowers ([i]Paperback[/i], [i]Burgle Bros[/i] are also on Tabletopia) where one player is a fugitive trying to make it out of town while being pursued by an unstoppable marshal. Fun, easy, and just 10 minutes to play!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/c15d9b8b55f668b0c44a14a3b4db3ce2da9a6f78.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/fugitive]Fugitive[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 5–20 Min

[i]Fugitive[/i] is a tense two-player deduction card game set in the world of Burgle Bros.

The fugitive plays cards face down to the table trying to work their way to a goal, while the agent must guess those cards to uncover them. If all the cards are face up, the fugitive is caught. Bluff, guess,  and win!

[quote= Geek Dad]"I think [i]Fugitive[/i] is an excellent game for two. It plays fairly quickly and I love the cat-and-mouse mind games that go on."

notes.title: When the Oil Peaks
notes.notes:
In the near future, when peak oil happens, will the world grind to a halt or will it continue into the tomorrow without oil? It is for you to decide in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/peak-oil]Peak Oil[/url][/b] a new heavily-themed euro game about crisis and profit.

[i]Peak Oil[/i] is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1031232934/peak-oil-a-tabletop-game-about-crisis-and-profit/description]now live on Kickstarter[/url], and was funded during the first five hours. Take a look!


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/adc1b03bf9fb7fb3ff0d4874398f58024e620701.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/peak-oil]Peak Oil[/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 45–75 Min

[i]Peak Oil[/i]  is an eurotrash-style game of worker placement, set collection and push your luck for 2 to 5 players.

As top managers at big oil companies, you will assign your agents to different spots on the board to win majorities and do actions: drill and ship oil, buy hi-tech start-ups and meddle with the media to lead your crumbling oil giant into the future without oil. 

[quote=Board Gaming For the Win]"[i]Peak Oil[/i] is a fantastic game of drilling, shipping, & investing in the future. [i]Peak Oil[/i] hits on the real reality of things."

notes.title: Get Inside the Cell
notes.notes:
Biology can be very fun! With [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/cytosis-a-cell-biology-game]Cytosis[/url][/b] you get to play inside a human cell and learn how enzymes, hormones and receptors help fend off viruses. Smart is the new sexy, they say? ;)

The game is a huge Kickstarter hit, funded almost 20 times over, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/geniusgames/cytosis-a-cell-biology-board-game]take a look at the campaign now[/url]!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0352b84b5809d1de5eb14fcdafc3c66bd6c0afaf.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/cytosis-a-cell-biology-game]Cytosis[/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 50–75 Min

[i]Cytosis: A Cell Biology Game[/i] is a worker placement game that takes place inside a human cell.

You will start out with a number of workers and will be placing one of them on any available location within that cell. Locations provide players with actions or resources (e.g., mRNA, ATP). Your goal is to score the most Health Points by building enzymes, hormones, and/or receptors. 

[quote= A Pawn's Perspective]"[i]Cytosis[/i] is more than just a worker placement game. It’s an extremely good worker placement game. Between the different ways to score during the game, the goal mechanic, and the event deck, there’s plenty of paths to victory."

notes.title: Make & Break Connections in PeltaPeeps
notes.notes:
PeltaPeeps are an ancient race from the world of Peltan that go eye to eye with other player peeps. Make & break connections while shifting strategy to win in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/peltapeeps]PeltaPeeps[/url][/b] a game loosely based on gender and neural networks. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/717778e3092fabce121c1ca64e77127dea9690c0.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/peltapeeps]PeltaPeeps[/url][/b][/h1]
2–6 Players; 10–75 Min

[i]PeltaPeeps[/i] is a fast paced boardless board game that combines negotiation and placement.

You will take turns to place and connect your pieces to the growing board made up of PeltaPeeps. By flipping or moving another player's "Peeps" you can prevent them from scoring. Combine bluffing and negotiation to become the winner! 

[quote=Unfiltered Gamer ]"[i]PeltaPeeps[/i] is one of those games that has very simple rules, but a lot of playability and strategy. Playing [i]PeltaPeeps[/i] takes putting together a puzzle to a new level!"

notes.title: Panic at the Castle!
notes.notes:
Your castle is under attack and you need to work together with your friends to defend it against all sorts of monsters! Plan, trade, hit, slay, and keep the castle safe in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/castle-panic]Castle Panic[/url][/b] a beloved cooperative classic. 

Expansions coming soon!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/89b00a8bdfbec3a93ac06fbcd589d31568c40155.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/castle-panic]Castle Panic[/url][/b][/h1]
1–6 Players; 60 Min
[i]Castle Panic[/i] is a cooperative tower defense game for 1 to 6 players ages 10 and up.

Work together to defend the castle in the center of the board from monsters that attack out of the forest at the edges of the board. You will all win or lose together, but in the end only one player will win and be declared the Master Slayer!

[quote=Board Game Quest]"[i]Castle Panic[/i] it is so easy to learn and play that it makes a game great for first time players into the co-op arena. Every time I have played this game I have had a fun time."

notes.title: Riichi Mahjong Is Now on Tabletopia
notes.notes:
Good news for those who love classic games — [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/riichi-mahjong]Riichi Mahjong[/url][/b] was added to our free catalog! notes.title: Introducing Hotseat Mode on Tabletopia
notes.notes:
Today we introduce a new way to play games on Tabletopia: Hotseat mode. 

Now you can play any game in our catalog with your friends or family on the same desktop, including games with hidden information, like a hand of cards!
[list][*][b]To play a game on one PC,[/b] click [b]Play Hotseat[/b] on the game’s page and choose a setup for your number of players, if available. The game will start loading immediately.

[*]While in game, click [b]End Turn[/b] to pass the turn to the next player. Note that your hand will now be hidden and your opponent will not see it.[/list]

Test the new mode now in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/santorini]Santorini[/url] and check other [url=https://tabletopia.com/games?category=hot-seat]games perfect to play in Hotseat[/url] in our new category.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/01867c8f277d315173d4ae4e4682ebf35da1af00.jpg[/img]

If you have any feedback about our Hotseat, please don’t hesitate to use the “Send Feedback” option in the game client or contact us at help@tabletopia.com.

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: This Game is on Fire
notes.notes:
Add some fire and action to the trick-taking genre with [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/ladder-29]Ladder 29[/url][/b] a new game by the authors of [i]Fleet[/i]. The game is now [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2005228768/ladder-29-ladder-climbing-firefighters-extinguishi]live on Kickstarter[/url], show it some love!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/a0f2821f61e617bff8b4071f53d12f0f16f69d89.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/ladder-29]Ladder 29[/url][/b] [/h1]
2–5 Players; 30–45 Min

[i]Ladder 29[/i] is a hot climbing/trick-taking game about firefmen extinguishing their hands of cards.  

As brave firefighters, players will attempt to play all thirteen cards in their hand. Various difficult challenges will limit your abilities and choices. But the greater the risk, the bigger the reward!

[quote=League of Nonsensical Gamers]"[i]Ladder 29[/i] evokes all the timeless qualities of a classic card game combined with a fresh modern hook that is approachable and extremely satisfying."

notes.title: The Stuff of Legends
notes.notes:
Get ready to compose the most beautiful and heroic saga that will span generations in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/norsaga]Norsaga[/url][/b] by Meromorph Games. Recount your heroic exploits and prove that among viking war-poets, you and you alone are truly worthy of renown!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/a17cc506a46c03caa1422fc63daf07c8b4709418.jpg[/img]


[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/norsaga]Norsaga[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 30 Min

[i]Norsaga[/i] is a 2-4 player puzzle battle card game.

As Viking poets skalds, you will contend to create your personal epic saga and heroic ancestry by playing hero cards to fill out your family trees. The first player to achieve the perfect mix of heroics necessary to complete their saga wins the game.

[i]Into the Myths[/i] expansion included!

[quote=Gameocity]"We liked a lot about [i]Norsaga[/i]. We enjoyed the puzzle, strategy-driven nature of its gameplay. We thought that the artwork was absolutely phenomenal, and we really loved the theme and flavor."

notes.title: Ready, Steady, Dungeon Time!
notes.notes:
Get ready to enter the dungeon... and be back in 5 minutes. Race against Time in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dungeon-time]Dungeon Time[/url][/b] by Ares Games to find the equipment, achieve your missions and start the exciting dungeon adventure over and over again!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ab4247e5f4fac612789257920c5418b895496a2e.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dungeon-time]Dungeon Time[/url][/b][/h1]
1–5 Players; 10–60 Min

[i]Dungeon Time[/i] is a real time, cooperative card game for 1-5 players.

Players will draw and play cards, and each card shows either an item or a mission. To fulfill a mission, ask other players to put their cards in stack then play the mission on top. 

Try to beat the clock, going through the missions as fast as you can. Easy, isn't it?

[quote=Board Game Quest]"I love the realtime nature of the game, and also the coordination that’s required because of it. While [i]Dungeon Time[/i] isn’t going to impress anyone with its depth, it more than makes up for it with its sheer fun and craziness."[/quote]

notes.title: Wake Up, The Euphoria Has You
notes.notes:
The world as we know it has ended, and you find yourself in a dystopian city with a few workers that are oblivious to their situation in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/euphoria-build-a-better-dystopia]Euphoria[/url][/b] a game by Stonemaier Games. This world is all they've ever known, and you may use them at your whim to build a better dystopia and rewrite history.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/1840afc47a525c5f19b271586c073708d83929d8.jpg[/img]


[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/euphoria-build-a-better-dystopia]Euphoria[/url][/b][/h1]
2–6 Players; 60 Min

notes.title: Gather Your Pixelated Army
notes.notes:
Pixelated heroes battling each other are back and cool again! Step back into the golden age of strategy games with [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/pixel-tactics]Pixel Tactics[/url][/b] by Level 99 Games, a two-player combat game where cards can be used in a ton of different ways.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/40536b38f3e01c04f308cdc4c0151bfacc6eb74a.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/pixel-tactics]Pixel Tactics[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]Pixel Tactics[/i] is a head-to-head card game of tactical combat for two players.

From your deck of 25 cards, you will choose a leader and then take turns placing cards and attacking. Each card can be activated in multiple ways. The first to eliminate the other Leader wins! 

[quote=Board Game Quest]"An easy to learn, highly tactical game that has immense replay value. Gamers who like lots of options and enjoy games where cards interact with each other will love this one."

notes.title: TGIF? I Don't Think So
notes.notes:
Tired of your old hidden movement games à la [i]Scotland Yard[/i] where one player is the culprit and the rest chase him down? Here's a new twist: how about one player is the undying psychopath and the rest try to escape him and stay alive?

Give a try to [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/last-friday]Last Friday[/url][/b] a take on popular slasher horror movies brought to you by Ares Games.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ba625591295fe2435a7dc8948e2aba22c08183cb.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/last-friday]Last Friday[/url][/b][/h1]
2–6 Players; 30–120 Min

[i]Last Friday[/i] is a hidden movement, hunting and deduction board game, inspired by the popular "slasher" horror movie genre.

In the role of young campers, the players will try to survive a long weekend of terror while one of them takes the role of a serial killer hiding in the shadows of the forest.

Will you survive this Friday?

notes.title: The Park is Now Open: Create your own Rex in Dinosaur Island
notes.notes:
Have you ever wanted to create your own dinosaurs? Or open a Dino Park? You're lucky because [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dinosaur-island]Dinosaur Island[/url][/b] a new game from the designers of [i]Dead of Winter[/i] and [i]Titans of Industry[/i], makes these dreams come true! And you are safe from being devoured by any [i]Indominus rex[/i] you might cook up ;)

[i]Dinosaur Island[/i] is already [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pandasaurus/dinosaur-island-1]15 times funded on Kickstarter[/url], try it now online for free before bying!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/78b184dbf2ef28f0f2a4030de59a7515c1fc3332.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dinosaur-island]Dinosaur Island[/url][/b] [/h1]
2–4 Players; 60–120 Min

[i]Dinosaur Island[/i] is a worker placement game about creating the world’s greatest dinosaur theme park.

You will have to collect DNA, research the DNA sequences of extinct dinosaur species and then combine the ancient DNA in the correct sequence to bring these prehistoric creatures back to life. Then you will build the most thrilling dino park, and try to attract (and keep alive!) the most guests.

[quote=Man VS Meeple]"There are multiple strategies you can use in this game. Plus who wouldn't want to play [i]Jurassic Park[/i] in a game!" [/quote]

notes.title: Crime Sweeps the City in Noir
notes.notes:
There's a Killer at large and he's killing civilians right under the Inspector's nose! In [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/noir]NOIR: Deductive Mystery Game[/url][/b] you'll take part of either the criminal or the good guy and will try to thwart the opponent and win.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/6cb7035f9d7d4e73bb7c5e37564ff423a064e80d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/noir]NOIR: Deductive Mystery Game[/url][/b] [/h1]
2 Players; 10–15 Min

[i]NOIR: Deductive Mystery Game[/i] is a two-player game of hidden identities and deduction.

Players receive a secret identity and an open role that determines their moves and victory conditions. The criminal's goal is to kill 14 characters or the Inspector and the detective must capture the culprit using secret information and intuition.

Two other game variants are also available!

[quote=Dad's Gaming Addiction]"There’s a lot of strategy and thinking required with this game. Those who enjoy deduction and logic puzzles will get a lot of this particular card game." [/quote]

notes.title: To Infinity And Beyond
notes.notes:
Welcome to the not-too-distant future! In [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/farlight]Farlight[/url][/b] by Game Salute you will set out to explore, mine, and colonize outer space and forge the future of the faraway stars.

The game is already successfully [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gamesalute/farlight]funded on Kickstarter[/url], and there's still time enough to play it online for free on Tabletopia and support!

The designer Nick Sibicky also created [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/kings-forge]King's Forge[/url][/b] available on Tabletopia as well.

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/farlight]Farlight[/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]Farlight[/i] is a game of blind bidding, tile placement, and light resource management for 2-5 players.

As members of various space organizations you will compete to design the most efficient and powerful spacecraft, make scientific breakthroughs, construct facilities on distant worlds, and transport colonists to the farthest reaches of our Solar System.

Who will win this race for space?

notes.title: Barbarians Vs Romans
notes.notes:
The Roman Empire is dying, and barbaric forces gather at its borders to pillage and conquer in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/germania-magna]Germania Magna: Border in Flames[/url][/b] a new semi-cooperative historic card game. But to overcome the mightly enemy, the barbarians must set aside the rivalry and constant wars between tribes and forge new alliances.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/d5399008b9771b774b298ae3d4c10f2ac5ba79dd.jpg[/img]

[h1] [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/germania-magna]Germania Magna: Border in Flames[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 30–60 Min

[i]Germania Magna: Border in Flames[/i] is a hand-management cooperative take that card game.

As Germanic warlords, players will lead their warriors into Roman provinces to try and conquer them cooperatively. But beware, the alliances will shift each round. Can you prove yourself as a worthy leader and achieve eternal glory for yourself?

[quote= Sam Healy of Dice Tower]"It feels like the historic version of [i]Smash Up[/i]. A thumb up!"

notes.title: Build a Better Ant Colony

Are you ready to become the best and fittest ant species?

[quote=Giant Fire Breathing Robot]"[i]March of the Ants[/i] is a great game. It fires on all cylinders and should appeal to a wide audience."

notes.title: Heroes Wanted: Win a Bar Shootout in Half-Pint Heroes
notes.notes:
In the Half-Pint Pub, tempers are running hot, any moment things could break down into a full-out brawl... Prove your skill of bar-fighting in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/half-pint-heroes]Half-Pint Heroes[/url][/b] a new trick-taking game of predicting, betting and winning sets of cards.

The game is now being crowdfunded on [url=https://www.spiele-offensive.de/Spieleschmiede/Half-Pint-Heroes/]Spieleschmiede[/url] and already funded! Have a look, or a pint ;)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/3e6399ed0808d99683b9cba485cb1ffd4d74a744.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/half-pint-heroes]Half-Pint Heroes[/url][/b] [/h1]
2–7 Players; 30–60 Min

[i]Half-Pint Heroes[/i] is an easy to learn, but hard to master, card game for 2-7 players.

During 10 rounds you will play sets of cards from your hand to try and beat the sets of your opponents. You'll also need to predict how many sets you'll win each round and bet against other players to try to set up a brawl or a shootout!
 
[quote=Vital Lacerda (Vinhos, The Gallerist, Lisboa)]
"The game is fun, quick and you can take a lot of laughs from it. The perfect game for a great half an hour between two heavy games, specially with a good beer."

notes.title: Your Personal Game Coach on Tabletopia
notes.notes:
Playing board games is fun, discovering new games is even more fun, reading the rules for each game...not so fun for many people. Especially if it’s a complex game with a lot of rules, like Scythe or Terra Mystica.

That’s why we at Tabletopia would like to introduce our new service — your personal board game coach! With this service it is you who chooses the game, time and people to play with, and we teach you.

 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0d327b01389824f6897b0199b86e394f36309075.png[/img]

[h1][b]How this works:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Choose any board game from [url=https://tabletopia.com/games]our catalog of over 360+ titles[/url].
[*]Choose the day and time when you can play.
[*]Contact us a couple of days before the chosen date to book the lesson and receive confirmation.
[*]Pay $15/hour in advance via PayPal.
[*]Invite any number of friends (they play for free or you can split the cost).
[*]One of our coaches, Vlad or Anton, will meet you online at the chosen time, teach you the rules and play the first introductory game with you. [/list]

To take part, you will need a mic and speakers. Also, we strongly recommend joining [url=https://discord.gg/4PsHHKm]our Discord server[/url] for in-game voice communication.
 

Interested? Send a message to info@tabletopia.com now to book your first gaming lesson! Or arrange an individual learn & play session for a friend as a very special present! ;)


Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: (H)expand and Exterminate!
notes.notes:
The year is 2248 AD, the Earth-Mars Empire is torn apart and the global clash cannot be avoided in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/hexpanse]Hexpanse[/url][/b] a new tactical game about conquering planets. Choose your faction and start the (h)expansion!

Also, don't miss the [b]live demo with the game's author[/b] planned for this Saturday, Feb 25 at 1 PM (EST). [b][url=https://tabletopia.typeform.com/to/cw6GQh]Sign up now![/url][/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/a74e3063ebacada93880bc160d81e7f26e9d52bb.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/hexpanse]Hexpanse[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 30–60 Min

[i]Hexpanse[/i] is a fast, hexagon based tactical board game of planetary conquest.

As interstellar commanders and warlords, you will be battling for control over a single planet. To do so, you will be deploying troops from your mothership, mining for valuable resources, and using unique abilities of your factions.

notes.title: We Call Him... RARRR!!
notes.notes:
There are monsters everywhere! Taller than buildings, they came to wreak havoc, battle, and destroy our cities. Daikaiju!

Thankfully, in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/rarrr]RARRR!![/url][/b] it is you who control them and seek to ravage the most cities to claim their smoking rubble as your prize. Are you ready?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/e2bf54cfc437f87cc923da3764490878b7f5c7f3.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/rarrr]RARRR!![/url][/b] [/h1]
3–6 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]RARRR!![/i] is card game of earth-shaking battles between giant Japanese movie monsters.

Build your monster by drafting monster abilities such as fire, electric, toxic and radioactive, and power cards to maximize the monster’s powers. Then battle with other players for the right to destroy the world's greatest cities!

[quote=Father Geek]"I am very pleased with [i]RARRR!![i] Its game play is tight, crazy hard at times, and highly enjoyable. I truly enjoyed the feeling that I was the monster I created and kicking buildings down to rubble."

notes.title: The King is Dead, Long Live the King!
notes.notes:
Kingmaking in board games is usually not welcome, but this is a game where you're supposed to do exactly that! [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/kingdom-of-aer-king-maker]Kingdom of Aer: King Maker[/url][/b] is a fast and fun game where you decide who is most worthy to become the new King or Queen.

The [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cheshmonkey/kingdom-of-aer-kingmaker]game's now in Kickstarter[/url] and the guys need you support!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/27cc7998703a4a7661e9c8f815d5e705565d33c8.png[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/kingdom-of-aer-king-maker]Kingdom of Aer: King Maker[/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 10–20 Min

[i]Kingdom of Aer: Kingmaker[/i] is a quick and easy social backstabbing game about alliances and betrayal.

Players will battle for the crown, all the while assassinating royalty, betraying allies, stealing gold and doing pretty anything to ensure their royalty survives. Win the crown for your House!

[quote=Australian Tabletop Gaming Network]"[i]Kingdom of Aer: Kingmaker[/i] is more than just an elimination game, it is a well thought out game with clever yet simple mechanics and amazing art. If you are a fan of [i]Coup[/i] and [i]Resistance[/i] this game is a must have."

notes.title: Tabletopia Update: February 15
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, a new update on Tabletopia just rolled out!

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Game: When players place dice into bags, their upper side is now kept. Also, when drawing dice from a bag at the start of a game, they now appear randomized, which is important while playing such games as [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/roll-player]Roll Player[/url][/b]
[*]Various improvements on the portal.[/list]

[h1][b]Fixed[/b][/h1]

[*]Errors while searching for games with apostrophe in their titles.[/list]

Happy gaming, see you at the table!

notes.title: In Space They Can Hear You Run
notes.notes:
You're deep in space and are suddenly under attack by aliens... Grab your escape pod or suit and run for your life! And beware alien Warriors, Spawns, and Queens patrolling the space around the station.

So, who will be able to escape to safety in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/survive-space-attack]Survive: Space Attack![/url][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/1afc70847bcedc528560a57a7eac21dd5b3fc108.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/survive-space-attack]Survive: Space Attack![/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]Survive: Space Attack![/i] is a reimplementation of a beloved classic [url=https://tabletopia.com/news/survive-escape]Survive: Escape From Atlantis![/url] also on Tabletopia, but with some additional mechanics and features from the authors of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/space-cadets-dice-duel]Space Cadets: Dice Duel[/url]

You'll find here: new fighter ships to capture and redeploy aliens, laser turrets that can defend the station, new alien and tile abilities, and more!

 [quote=Mark Jackson of Opinionated Gamers]"[i]Survive: Space Attack![/i] takes pretty everything that works from the classic Survive game system, strips out the parts that don’t, adds more decisions, and keeps it ripping right along at a family-friendly pace. My boys asked for this every night for a week when we first got it!"[/quote]

notes.title: By Faith Alone
notes.notes:
500 years ago Martin Luther started the Reformation with his "Ninety-Five Theses”. To commemorate that important deed, Spielworxx and Stronghold Games released [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sola-fide-the-reformation]Sola Fide: The Reformation[/url][/b] by illustrous authors involved previously with such classics as [i]Twilight Struggle[/i] and [i]1960: The Making of the President[/i].

And now you can give this historically-flavored game a try on Tabletopia!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/7fa98499201f205f403e347cdc6aa7fc31c76ea7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Tabletopia Update: February 9
notes.notes:
Hey Tabletopians,

Here’s a list of features and fixes from our latest release.

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Game page: Improved access to rules, added list of setups.
[*]Country and city selection in player profile made easier, and other minor improvements.
[*]Lobby: You will now be asked to confirm that you want to leave the lobby if you already took a seat.
[*]Game: Added Korea and India regions to game servers to reduce ping, improve response and stability for players from these regions.
[*]Game: You can now use magnetic map for decks.[/list]

[h1][b]Fixed:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Player profile: City selection for certain countries.
[*]Game: While moving or rotating an object other objects on top of it did not keep their position.
[*]Find & Play: Players directly took seats in the lobby by clicking “Open Lobby” in the Details pop-up.
[*]Find & Play: Players could not create new rooms due to erroneous room limits.
[*]Find & Play: Players received notification "Room not found" after clicking the room ID in the general chat.[/list]

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Make Beer, Not War!
notes.notes:
Welcome to [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dragon-brew]Dragon Brew[/url][/b] Choose your race and make some booze in this richly thematic and strategic game that is now open on Tabletopia. 

The [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/augustgames/dragon-brew-make-beer-not-war]game's campaign on Kickstarter[/url] is brewing really nicely, check it out now ;)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/87cba1527817f4de529f766eaf4477a675212993.jpg[/img]

[h1] [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/dragon-brew]Dragon Brew[/url][/b][/h1] 
2–4 Players; 60–120 Min

[i]Dragon Brew[/i] is a fantasy themed beer brewing game for 2-4 players using worker placement, card drafting.

As a head brewer, you will lead your fantasy race in a competition to win the annual DragonKeep beer festival. You will be building brewery estates, harvesting grain, questing for ingredients, and more to earn top prize.

[quote=katamaridomination]"You can draw comparisons to [i]Viticulture[/i] but this game does booze making better. The pacing and mechanics I felt were super strong, and the theme was fantastic." [/quote]

notes.title: Choose Your Part: Knight, Thief, Goblins, Dragon, or Cave?
notes.notes:
Playing as a knight is common, and not many will be surprised to impersonate a Dragon. But have you ever played as the Cave??

In [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/vast-the-crystal-caverns]Vast: The Crystal Caverns[/url][/b] a totally asymmetric cave-crawling adventure, now on Tabletopia, you can do exactly that!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/18a8b60eb476e5be40c915813b660d9243c5c32b.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/vast-the-crystal-caverns]Vast: The Crystal Caverns[/url][/b][/h1]
5 Players; 45–75 Min

[i]Vast: The Crystal Caverns[/i] is an asymmentric adventure game where you become the brave Knight, Goblin horde, massive Dragon, malevolent Cave, or cunning Thief. 

Each role has its own powers, pieces, and paths to victory...and there can be only one winner. And with a Cave constructed of tiles, and decks full of monsters, special abilities, and game-changing events, no two playthroughs will ever be the same!

[quote=Tom Vasel of Dice Tower]"More asymmetrical than any other game I've played. I really like the game because it's unique." [/quote]

notes.title: Keyflower Tournament Update: Registration closed, matches schedule under way
notes.notes:
Hey Tabletopians,

On February, 1 player registration for the first International Online Keyflower Tournament was closed. [b]64 people from over 20 countries[/b] signed up to take part and compete to win our prizes! 

 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/60c1dabd402c26cd5226f4a090cb1354dbc50282.png[/img]

[h1][b]Tournament Schedule[/b][/h1]
During the next week the tournament schedule will be formed and made available. We're striving to make all matches convenient for participants from the various countries.

The games will start not earlier than February, 10, and some participants will have their matches later. Each contestant will be contacted on email to let them know the date and time of their games.

We're also planning on streaming some of the tournament matches. Stay tuned!

notes.title: The Great Alien Escape
notes.notes:
If you knew your planet was going to explode, what would you do? Beat it! In [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/lift-off-get-me-off-this-planet]Lift Off! Get me off this Planet![/url][/b] you race to save your aliens and do exactly that.

And don't miss the live demo with author scheduled for this Sunday, Feb 12 at 1 PM (EST)! [b][url=https://tabletopia.typeform.com/to/cw6GQh]Sign up here >[/url][/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/e653180c03b12a030d8441c2fce342d102e8e5b2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/lift-off-get-me-off-this-planet]Lift Off! Get me off this Planet![/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 45 Min

[i]Lift Off! Get me off this Planet![/i] is a fast-paced semi-cooperative game with a fresh, lightweight take on unit placement and resource management.

Use the moon and spacecrafts to get your Aliens off the planet before it explodes. The cooperative-to-competitive dynamic and imminent doom creates strong tension and drama at the end of the game.

[quote=BoardGameDuel.com]"[i]Lift Off! Get me off this Planet[/i]  is a gorgeous modular board game that is fun for the whole family. The engaging artwork, cute components and light gameplay make for a great addition for any game night."[/quote]

notes.title: I Will Survive!
notes.notes:
On Tabletopia we often publish brand new games and games that are not yet in print. And it's with special pleasure that we announce a dear old family classic that recently joined our collection — [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/survive-escape-from-atlantis]Survive: Escape from Atlantis![/url][/b] by Stronghold Games.  

Are you ready to escape from the sinking island of Atlantis and return home with treasure and artifacts? Get on board now!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/849ba54ae4db53744a5302d49f7029c4ef0dc92f.jpg[/img]


[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/survive-escape-from-atlantis]Survive: Escape from Atlantis![/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 45 Min

[i]Survive: Escape from Atlantis[/i] is a cutthroat game where players seek to evacuate their pieces from an island that starts to sink.

On your way to safety of the surrounding islands you must remember where your highest-valued pieces are located and beware sea serpents, whales, and sharks!

[quote=Boardgaming.com]"[i]Survive![/i] is a great light-strategy game for serious gamers, as well as a fun game to play with the family! This is a true classic." [/quote]

notes.title: This Game Is Super Hot!
notes.notes:
Part strategy, part shooter, SUPERHOT is the bestselling independent FPS in which time moves only when you move. And now [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/superhot-the-card-game-demo]SUPERHOT Card Game[/url][/b] by Board and Dice and Manuel Correia takes its unique game mechanics to the world of tabletop games.

SUPERHOT Card Game is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1293726726/superhot-the-card-game/description]now on Kickstarter[/url], funded within 2 hours and selling like hotcakes! The game available now on Tabletopia is a [b]solo demo version[/b] of the game. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/136b45a4159f1125fbf2e1ed521ab13ff7721074.jpg[/img]

[h1] [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/superhot-the-card-game-demo]SUPERHOT Card Game[/url][/b][/h1]
1 Player; 15–45 Min

[i]SUPERHOT Card Game[/i] is a micro deck-building game where you use abilities and items to deal with increasing threats. 

Enemies, scenery, and objects that you eliminate are added to your hand, giving you improved abilities and more possibilities while bringing you closer to victory. 

But be careful — the more cards you use, the faster you move through time!

notes.title: Go Ninja, Go!
notes.notes:
Valiant samurai, a clan of mysterious ninjas, one defenseless village... If you like Akira Kurosawa’s [i]Seven Samurai[/i], here's a board game version of it on Tabletopia: [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/7-ronin]7 Ronin[/url][/b] by Grey Fox Games!

So, will you defend the village, or destroy it? 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/b8c0dd3d6e224a356a90664c7ec7e21cbd23dc9d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/7-ronin]7 Ronin[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 15–30 Min

[i]7 Ronin[/i] is an asymmetric tactical two-player game of bluff and intuition set in feudal Japan.

One player controls a group of ninja attacking a village, and the other defends it with seven ronin (masterless samurai). Both players will have to best the opponent at planning their moves, anticipating enemy actions, and making the best choices under the given circumstances.

[quote="The League of Nonsensical Gamers]"[i]7 Ronin[/i] offers engaging choices at a fast and consistent pace, has a complexity that is deceived by its simple presentation, and delivers its fun in under an hour." [/quote]

notes.title: Indiana Jones and the Gilded Compass
notes.notes:
Do you like rolling dice? Would like to go on an adventure? Then the new game by Grey Fox Games [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/order-of-the-gilded-compass]Order of the Gilded Compass[/url][/b] about discovering valuable artifacts is exactly what you need!

This board game is a reimplementation of [i]Alea Jacta Est[/i] with various improvements added.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/14532b96d69ff87c95d8a063f9a364c566a6f805.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/order-of-the-gilded-compass]Order of the Gilded Compass[/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 30–60 Min

[i]Order of the Gilded Compass[/i] is a dice assignment game for 2-5 players. As treasure hunters, you will be searching the globe to unearth fantastic and valuable artifacts.

Assign your archaeologist dice to five different locations at the right time, acquire treasure maps and specialists, or dive for sunken treasure! 

[quote=http://boardgamersanonymous.com/]
"[i]Order of the Gilded Compass[/i] is a good one. It’s quick, easy to teach, accessible for very young ages, and there are a ton of dice." [/quote]
