notes.title: Your Zoo Just Got Expanded: 3 Expansions for Zooloretto Released
notes.notes:
Good news for all the zoo and animal lovers: three new expansions for [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/zooloretto]Zooloretto[/url][/b] were just added to our catalog.

[i]Zooloretto[/i] is a family style game about managing your zoo and populating it with various animals. The game received numerous awards including the prestigious Spiel des Jahres.

And now you can add more variety to this game on Tabletopia by including not one but three different expansions!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/26215e3c01f69f31c2874c21749a4d74c6b0babf.jpg[/img]

[list][*][h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/zooloretto-the-savings-book-expansion]Zooloretto The Savings Book Expansion[/url][/b][/h1]
With this little addtition a player can get additional money during the game.

[*][h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/zooloretto-xxl-expansion]Zooloretto XXL Expansion[/url][/b][/h1]
Share animals by sending them to other zoos to get reward. Includes two extra trucks.

[*][h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/zooloretto-exotic-expansion]Zooloretto Exotic Expansion[/url][/b][/h1]
Build a new jungle experience path with strange exotic animals. The stands pay double because of the increased business.
[/list]
Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Deep Underground Adventures
notes.notes:
Welcome to the darkness! You are trapped deep underground, the light and hope are scarce. Can you escape?..

Prove your worth in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sub-terra]Sub Terra[/url][/b] a thrilling new cooperative survival horror board game. It is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/itbboardgames/sub-terra-a-cooperative-survival-horror-game-for-1]now doing really great on Kickstarter[/url] and is available to play online on Tabletopia! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/20a73fefe5a6fe74a903386ff1a0bba151f81ba6.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sub-terra]Sub Terra[/url][/b][/h1]
1–6 Players; 45–75 Min; 2017

[i]Sub Terra[/i] is a 1-6 player cooperative game of terrifying cave escape.

As amateur cavers, you and your friends will be exploring a tile-based cave system, attempting to survive the deadly perils and get out before the lights die or the darker things beneath the Earth catch up to you... Run from the darkness or you'll be lost forever! 

[quote=Tom Palmer, Cranky Old Gamer]"A tightly-crafted thriller of a game that will make you scared of the dark all over again, and begging to see the light of day!"[/quote]

notes.title: Our Gods Are Perfection
notes.notes:
It is the middle of the 5th century AD, and the gods are dying. But in the face of the Dark Age they're up to one final epic clash and ready for you to lead them into battle in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/twilight-of-the-gods][b]Twilight of the Gods[/b][/url] a new combat card game.

Check out the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/567823005/twilight-of-the-gods-age-of-revelation]game's Kickstarter campaign[/url], already funded!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0ba9d465421e6628cb24413b044248df3c7e7988.jpg[/img]
 
[h1] [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/twilight-of-the-gods][b]Twilight of the Gods[/b][/url][/h1]
2 Players; 30–90 Min

[i]Twilight of the Gods[/i] is a 2 player expandable (not collectible) card game in which each player uses a modifiable 50-card deck.

As mythical and legendary deities with particular strategies—Aggression, Negotiation, Mysticism, or Sanctuary—you will battle to the death to see who is the strongest god. In this battle you will use human armies, mystical beasts, and heroes of renown from both past and future.

[quote=The Cardboard Republic][i]Twilight of the Gods[/i] manages to do something quite rare in the competitive customized card game genre: offer up something truly new and original. Every turn is a series of important decisions, and every card can serve you in multuple ways.[/quote]

notes.title: Tabletopia Launches International Keyflower Tournament
notes.notes:
Hey Tabletopians,

We are happy and excited to announce our first [b]official International Online Keyflower Tournament[/b] organized together with R&D Games, publishers of the game.

This is your chance to prove yourself against the world’s best board gamers and compete for valuable prizes. It’s also a unique opportunity to meet people from different countries who share your passion. Without even leaving your home! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/60c1dabd402c26cd5226f4a090cb1354dbc50282.png[/img]

[h1]What is Keyflower?[/h1]
[b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/keyflower]Keyflower[/url][/b] is an economic strategy board game with tile and worker placement mechanics in which players create and manage New World colonies.

[i]Keyflower[/i] is ranked 27 on BGG top 100 games and 22 on BGG Strategy games.

[h1]What Are the Prizes?[/h1]
[list][*][b]Winner:[/b] a copy of [i]Keyflower[/i] autographed by the authors and an opportunity to play the game online with Sebastian Bleasedale, the co-author of the game.
[*][b]All quarter-finalists, including winner:[/b] a 6 month premium Tabletopia subscription (worth $60).[/list]

[h1]How Do I Take Part?[/h1]
Any person in any country who is 18+ years old can take part. Participation is free-of-charge, and no Tabletopia account is required to participate.

To sign up, fill in the [url=https://tabletopia.typeform.com/to/Qe9ZyU]Player Registration form[/url]. Registration ends on [b]February 1, 2017[/b].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/df45533c403269e42c294f7e7dc498c680b29fab.jpg[/img]

[h1]How Will The Tournament Be Run?[/h1]
The tournament will take the format of Single Elimination duel format. Each match will consist of a single two-player game.

The first round of matches will start [b]after February 10, 2017[/b].

[h1]How Can I Help?[/h1]
If you don’t feel like actually playing in the tournament but still want to take part and help (for a reward, of course), you can become our [b]referee or/and streamer[/b]. Contact us at tourney@tabletopia.com to apply and learn the details.
 
[h1]Useful Links[/h1]
[list][*][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mdOvcpNwmpAL3CXNPkMZ0LmOfz2vRl1iedgKZkY0g-A]Tournament Rules and Regulations[/url] with all necessary info and details.
[*][url=https://tabletopia.com/playground/play/keyflower-yoeg55]Free Training Room[/url] where you can start training now for free.[/list]
 
We wish all participants good luck and a lot of fun. See you at the table!

notes.title: Automotive Revolution is Here
notes.notes:
If you enjoy complex games in which gameplay is tightly tied with the theme, we've got good news for you!

[b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/kanban-automotive-revolution]Kanban: Automotive Revolution[/url][/b] a board game by Vital Lacerda that puts you in the driver's seat of an entire production facility, is now available to play online on Tabletopia. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/b6e636129c30463c9b7fefed09c0b6d173054b0f.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/kanban-automotive-revolution]Kanban: Automotive Revolution[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 90–120 Min

[i]Kanban: Automotive Revolution[/i] is a heavyweight game about assembling automobiles focused on economics and resource management.

As ambitious managers, you will try to impress the bossess through smooth, solid, and efficient management in order to secure your career.

[quote=Jonathan Degann of Opinionated Gamers]"The learning curve to get started may be challenging, but so are the opportunities to tease out new tactics with each successive play.  If you like meaty games, expect to be picking your teeth for a long time."[/quote]

notes.title: When the Spy Falls
notes.notes:
Being a spy is tough most times. All the more so if you even don't know where you are! [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/spyfall]Spyfall[/url] is a highly-acclaimed party game in which you get to be a spy and try to understand what's going on around you. [url=https://tabletopia.com/playground/play/spyfall]Play it now online on Tabletopia![/url]

As Spyfall is a game with communication at its core, we strongly recommend using [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/4PsHHKm]our official Discord channel[/url] for in-game voice communication.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/dfe8fdc1f5a263976677480c13b6080bbfa6c0ca.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/spyfall]Spyfall[/url][/b][/h1]
3–8 Players; 15 Min; 2016

[i]Spyfall[/i] is a party game about uncovering a spy in the company. All players but the spy receive cards with locations and start asking each other questions trying to guess who among them is the secret agent. The spy doesn't know where he is, so he has to listen carefully! 

After a few rounds of guessing, suspicion and bluffing, the game ends and whoever has scored the most points is victorious.

[quote=Sam Healy of Dice Tower]"One of my favourite, if not favourite party games out there. Just a really good fun time! I can't recommend it strong enough." [/quote]

notes.title: A Fighter's Codex
notes.notes:
A customizable but non-collectable card game? One deck of cards that you can play for years and it still will be interesting? Nonsense? No! Codex!

[b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/codex-card-time-strategy]Codex[/url][/b] is a customizable, non-collectable card game inspired by real-time strategy video games such as Starcraft and Warcraft 3. It took over 10 years to get Codex right and now it's also available on Tabletopia! And stay tuned for live events scheduled for January.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/7dc1d3f4ccdf84dd6c21f23d5cb685b047856e7d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/codex-card-time-strategy]Codex[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 45 Min; 2016

[i]Codex[/i] is a real-time strategy in turn-based card form for two players.

The goal of the game is to destroy the opponent's base. To do this you will control three different heroes and have access to a tech tree that allows them to use different strategies each time they play. Each game you have access to a number of effects equal to about three Magic: The Gathering decks!
[quote=Alan Kwan on BGG ]"This game, as I see it, addresses many issues in so many different games all at once that it isn't funny. Many things which other games did wrong, Codex does it right. Many things that other games did well, Codex does it even better. It's even a scary thing that any game ever accomplishes that. Codex is not a miracle. It is many miracles in one."[/quote]

notes.title: The Amazing World of Trains
notes.notes:
[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/railways-of-the-world][b]Railways of the World[/b][/url] is a classic railroad board game by Martin Wallace and Glenn Drover from BGG Top 100 and it's now on Tabletopia.

Build your budding railroad network into a vast empire. Connect New York to Chicago, earn the most money, develop bigger and faster locomotives, and become the next Railroad Baron!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/82e927e39e0b00e33adb058f3f430f98cacea3a8.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/railways-of-the-world][b]Railways of the World[/b][/url][/h1]
2–6 Players; 120 Min; 2005

[i]Railways of the World[/i] is a classic game system about building a railroad empire. As a railroad baron you will be making profits by devilering passengers and finished goods, deciding the best routes and building the tracks.

[quote="rpg.net"][i]Railways of the World[/i] is a beautifully themed game that really feels like a railroad game. The creative force is a lot of what makes the game fun, as you watch your empire slowly blossom. The game is almost pure strategy and there's quite a lot of it." [/quote]

notes.title: The Amazing World of Trains
notes.notes:
[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/railways-of-the-world][b]Railways of the World[/b][/url] is a classic railroad board game by Martin Wallace and Glenn Drover from BGG Top 100 and it's now on Tabletopia.

Build your budding railroad network into a vast empire. Connect New York to Chicago, earn the most money, develop bigger and faster locomotives, and become the next Railroad Baron!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/82e927e39e0b00e33adb058f3f430f98cacea3a8.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/railways-of-the-world][b]Railways of the World[/b][/url][/h1]
2–6 Players; 120 Min; 2005

[i]Railways of the World[/i] is a classic game system about building a railroad empire. As a railroad baron you will be making profits by devilering passengers and finished goods, deciding the best routes and building the tracks.

[quote="rpg.net"][i]Railways of the World[/i] is a beautifully themed game that really feels like a railroad game. The creative force is a lot of what makes the game fun, as you watch your empire slowly blossom. The game is almost pure strategy and there's quite a lot of it." [/quote]

notes.title: "Dear Sir or Madam, Will You Read My Book?"
notes.notes:
Word-building meets deck-building in the unique game [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/paperback][b]Paperback[/b][/url] that is now available on Tabletopia. Complete Westerns, Science Fiction, Romance, or even the rare Best-Seller to gain Fame. Will you become the most successful paperback writer?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/66ea67140fa146a35dfb5835a57d9a4b51076e09.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/paperback]Paperback[/url][/b][/h1] 
2–5 Players; 45 Min; 2014

[i]Paperback[/i] is a unique word game with card-drafting and deck-building mechanisms. Variant included for cooperative play.

As a paperback author you will try to finish novels for your editor. You will be forming words, purchasing letters, and using the abilities of the letters in your words to gain Fame. 

[quote=Kennen_Rudd]"I love this game. It's incredible how well the word building works as an action/money restriction mechanic for a deck builder."[/quote]

notes.title: The Principles of Cheesonomics
notes.notes:
Do you like cheese? And economic games? [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/cheesonomics]Cheesonomics[/url][/b] by Eagle-Gryphon Games is fresh on Tabletopia, and is't all about cheese and economics. With various flavors and sharpness variants, this game will suit just about anyone's taste.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/578e79bffad9af4d23a65300e7f3927d94e79349.jpg[/img]
 
[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/cheesonomics]Cheesonomics[/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 20–30 Min; 2016

[i]Cheesonomics[/i] is an original card game that incorporates strategic set collecting, memory, and hand management.

You will churn, produce, and sell various types of cheese and try to control and manipulate the supply and demand on dairy markets throughout North America. 

[quote=Game Boy Geek]"[i]Cheesonomics[/i] is a good solid economic card game. I really like trying to time the market right. I can recommend this game." [/quote]

notes.title: Tabletopia and Indie Game Alliance Announce Partnership
notes.notes:
Tabletopia and the Indie Game Alliance (IGA) announced a partnership today to increase the visibility of IGA member games on the Tabletopia platform and make their promotion and demonstration easier.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/acfbedc22178324993cb4aa57cec356188322674.jpg[/img]

Under the terms of the deal, Tabletopia will exclusively share with IGA the gameplay statistics for supported games and IGA will recommend Tabletopia to its members for playtest and demo purposes. Also, from now on the IGA's volunteer demo team, the Minions, may teach and demonstrate IGA-supported games on the Tabletopia platform and receive 'Loot Points'.

[quote=IGA Executive Director Matt Holden]"We're very excited about the new dimension that our partnership with Tabletopia adds to the Indie Game Alliance. This partnership will be a game-changer for member publishers looking to playtest their games inexpensively, or just get the word out about a project in advance of a crowdfunding campaign."[/quote]
 
On the [url=https://www.indiegamealliance.com/]IGA website[/url] member companies will now be able to attach links to Tabletopia games to their game profiles and add a special "Play on Tabletopia" button. A [url=https://www.indiegamealliance.com/tabletopiagames.php]dedicated page[/url] on the website also shows all the IGA games available for play and demonstration on Tabletopia. We hope that this partnership will result in many-many new games added to Tabletopia!


[i]Founded in 2014, the Indie Game Alliance is an international guild comprised of more than 450 independent tabletop game designers and publishers based in Orlando, FL USA. In addition to its international demo team and ever-expanding convention presence, the IGA also offers its members significant discounts on manufacturing, services and support through its partner program, consulting and development services, and a variety of tools and resources on its website, indiegamealliance.com.[/i]

notes.title: The Raiding Season is Open!
notes.notes:
It's that season again... the raiding season! Ready to plunder some gold and impress the Chieftain? Then hop on board: [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/playground/play/raiders-of-the-north-sea]Raiders of the North Sea[/url] are waiting for you on Tabletopia.

The game is a part of the North Sea trilogy and is beautifully illustrated by The Mico.

[h1][b]Raiders of the North Sea[/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 60–80 Min; 2015

[i]Raiders of the North Sea[/i] is a strategy game with a unique "place one worker-take one worker" mechanic set in the central years of the Viking Age.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/39d66e4ff84b60810b7cee4b2a612230c77b5521.jpg[/img]

As Viking warriors, you will seek to impress the Chieftain by raiding unsuspecting settlements. Gather your warrioirs, collect provisions, journey north to plunder gold, iron and livestock, and find glory!

[quote=Sam Healy (Dice Tower)]"I really enjoy this game a lot. The level of combat and interaction between players is spot-on. Two "long-boats" up!" [/quote]

notes.title: Stay Classy: 20+ Board Game Classics for Free
notes.notes:
As our library of games expands with more and more titles every month, finding a simple game to learn the basics of Tabletopia can become difficult.

To get the hang of the interface and capabilities, starting with the classics may be the best idea. These are the games that you’ve been familiar with since childhood and don’t need to learn the rules to. They’re simple, they’re streamlined, they’re classic! And free on Tabletopia. 

Read more in [url=http://blog.tabletopia.com/stay-classy-20-classic-board-games-on-tabletopia/]our blog article[/url] to learn about 20+ classic strategy, card, domino, and dice games we offer!

[url=http://blog.tabletopia.com/stay-classy-20-classic-board-games-on-tabletopia/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/13ddd5d07aa24e7943ba2547b4e589b8f3a56f37.png[/img][/url]

[b]To search for classic games on Tabletopia[/b], go to All Games and select "Classical" in the "All Games" filter in the upper left corner. The professionally made games you are looking for are on the first two pages.

notes.title: Beginner's Guide and Other News
notes.notes:
Hey Tabletopians,

So many of you joined us since our recent realease on Steam. It's great!

At the same time we understand that for new players and beginners the system might seem a bit overwhelming. That's why we've prepared a [url=http://help.tabletopia.com/knowledge-base/beginners-guide/]Beginner's Guide[/url] for you to get you started on Tabletopia in 4 simple steps. Check it out now!

[url=http://help.tabletopia.com/knowledge-base/beginners-guide/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/bd4b5188b7bd9fc7fa794b28c1944133d6e63000.png[/img][/url]

***
Next, we would like to let you know that we constatly gather and analyze your feedback about connection issues, glitches, freezes, and slow response. We're working really hard to fix these bugs. In our recent technical release the following fixes were made:
[list][*]Main page performance and loading speed boosted (expected to decrease from 18 sec to 5-7 sec)
[*]Caching for most frequently-used data enabled
[*]Server capacities increased
[*]Link to access the game's page added to the game lobby[/list]
More things are planned and already in development. Your feedback helps a lot, and the more detailed (including logs, computer characteristics, etc.), the better.

***
Also, for those of you who make your games on Tabletopia, please be sure to [b]add only games that were created and designed by you[/b]. Our moderators will be forced to delete all games that are added without the permission of their right-holders.

Let's keep Tabletopia 100% licensed and a place where each can create, playtest, and demonstrate their own games. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Near and Far is Here!
notes.notes:
We're glad to announce that [b][url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/near-and-far]Near and Far[/url][/b] the newest storytelling game by Ryan Laukat, is now available for play on Tabletopia for free. The game is a sequel to [i]Above and Below[/i] and was recently successfully funded on Kickstarter by 7,245 backers (to be released in May 2017).

Ryan Laukat will also host a live demo of [i]Near and Far[/i] this [b]Saturday, Dec 10 at 2PM EST[/b]. [url=https://tabletopia.typeform.com/to/cw6GQh]Sign up now![/url]

And also don't miss our [url=http://blog.tabletopia.com/ryan-laukat-interview/]exclusive interview with Ryan[/url] about this game and other Red Raven titles.  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/3eb2bb3de4ee2abcfa7e83e8b78d34953ddd96e8.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Near and Far[/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 60–120 Min; 2017

In [i]Near and Far[/i], you and up to three friends explore many different maps in a search for the Last Ruin, recruiting adventurers, hunting for treasure, and competing to be the most storied traveler. 

The Tabletopia version features the arcade mode of the game and two different maps.

[quote= Rahdo]"It's a world that I just want to go to! A must-have game."[/quote]

notes.title: Early Access for Tabletopia is Over
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce that our Early Access stage on Steam is now over. We would like to thank you all for supporting us during this period. Thanks for the bugs you've found, for the feedback you've provided, for the games you've played and created, and for simply being there with us from the start.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/bd820c064b36613e22647cae6dccdfd6b8529664.png[/img]

Since the beginning of Early Access in March, we’ve worked hard to add over [b]80 games[/b] and a bunch of new features, to name a few:
[list][*]New user friendly lobby 
[*]Smart matchmaking game suggestions 
[*]Ready-check feature
[*]Real-time notifications
[*]Game results mode
[*]Improved user profile and many other small tweaks, improvements, and bug fixes.[/list]

We still have a long to-do list and a lot of plans, and we will continue adding new games and new features for you around the clock.

Note that the Early Access stage for the browser version still continues. But we plan on making the basic access free-of-charge on all platforms by the end of this month when Tabletopia is commercially released. Stay tuned, and happy gaming!

notes.title: The Seven Dwarfs without Snow White
notes.notes:
The winter is coming, and the dwarfs need to prepare: collect gems, build castles, and stock up enough food. Are you ready to help them? 

[url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/playground/play/dwar7s-fall-6pdwyq]Try Dwar7s Fall now online for free[/url] and support the game's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vesuviusmedia/dwar7s-fall]Kickstarter campaign[/url], on until Saturday Dec, 3.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/74c9adbece0547febce2c1e5bd2e18991119776a.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/dwar7s-fall]Dwar7s Fall[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 20–60 Min; 2017

[i]Dwar7s Fall[/i] is a worker placement, area control game about collecting gems in order to trade them for food. Build a mighty Kingdom, slay monsters, and get ready because the winter is near!

[quote=Gaming Bits]The game is lots of fun and mixes several mechanics together quite nicely. There’s plenty of strategy to the game yet it’s not a hard game to play. It’s a really fun game that the whole family can enjoy.[/quote]

notes.title: Warmonger: Deck-Building War Game (only on Tabletopia)
notes.notes:
We're really proud to announce [b][url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/warmonger]Warmonger[/url][/b] a deck-building direct interaction game that is available to play on Tabletopia only. 

[quote=Dan May, the designer of Warmonger]When I first discovered Tabletopia and saw what could be accomplished on your platform, it was actually the reason I decided to commission art and finally complete the game, which I have had in developmental stages for years. I added sound effects and even licensed music to use in the musicbox. It's a finished product, and Tabletopia is the only place to play it. [/quote]

The author has also promised to make a live demo of this game in the upcoming weeks, so stay tuned!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/810a61565a58f97d0352f8a75a986e6e7ea6ed6f.png[/img]

[h1][b]Warmonger[/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 90–150 Min; [url=https://www.boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/212968/warmonger]Game on BGG[/url]
 
[i]Warmonger[/i] is a simple yet strategic board game for 2-4 players, combining the structure of a deck building game with the direct player interaction of a war game.

As the crown's greatest Warlord, you must prove your worth by defeating the lesser Warlords contesting for the throne. You'll need to win the loyalty of many followers, build mighty fortifications, and devise cunning tactics to become the new ruler of the kingdom... May the best Warlord win!

notes.title: Tabletopia is Now Free-to-Play on Steam
notes.notes:
Starting Nov 22, 9PM EST, [b]Tabletopia becomes free-to-play on Steam*[/b]. From now on you can join Tabletopia on Steam for free, as well as play most of the 300 games featured on the platform. 

If you purchased Tabletopia during the Early Access stage, [b]you now have 30 days of Premium for free as a thank you for supporting us.[/b] After these 30 days expire, you will be switched to the free plan. If you don’t yet have Premium, consider purchasing it to unlock the full Tabletopia potential and give your support to favourite authors and publishers.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/a439829e4ce97474ee15efd207f4e610d89e7be5.png[/img]

Moreover, today we also introduce the [b]in-app purchases[/b] that will be directly available in the Tabletopia Steam client. These purchases have replaced the subscriptions for Steam users in order to make Tabletopia more accessible to all players.

In-app purchases are basically [b]short-term Premiums[/b] that you buy once to receive full Premium access for a specified period of time: [b]3, 7, 14, or 30 days[/b].

[b]With any Premium purchase you get:[/b]
[list][*]unlimited access to all our games, expansions, and setups
[*]ability to invite your friends outside Tabletopia or fellow players to any games for free, including premium games
[*]up to 10 open games simultaneously[/list]

In-apps give you more flexibility without any long-time commitment or recurring payments. [i]You[/i] decide when you need your Premium and for how long.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/1804f8630569611d8474d7a27dba5b899d744a37.png[/img]

*Note that the [b]Early Access stage for the browser version still continues[/b]. You cannot create a free account in the browser. However, you can now create a free account in Steam and then access the browser version with your Steam credentials for free (for details see [url=http://help.tabletopia.com/knowledge-base/steam-account-activation/#Getting_Access_to_Browser_Versionfor_Steam_Users]Activating Steam Account[/url]). 

In a few weeks we plan to make the browser version free-to-play as well with subscritpion-based Premium access.

Fore more details and answers about in-apps and free Tabletopia, see our [url=http://blog.tabletopia.com/free-tabletopia-on-steam-in-apps]special article on blog[/url].

http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560

notes.title: Lobby 2.0 is Now Live
notes.notes:
Meet the new game lobby on Tabletopia: crisp, friendly, more easy to handle, and with several new and updated features! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/1952ac95b70337b185050912879b99983358a049.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New and Revamped Features:[/b][/h1]
[list][*][b]New design and look:[/b] Lobby 2.0 is more simple, friendly and easy to understand and manage.
[*]I[b]nvite players:[/b] You can now invite not only your Tabletopia friends but also other users who have experience playing this game. Also, don’t forget that you can invite people who don’t have Tabletopia accounts: share the link/room number with them. It’s free.
[*][b]Game status:[/b] The process of gathering players for the game is now more clear.
[*][b]Switch game:[/b] You can now switch to another game without even leaving the lobby! Hover the cursor over the game box and click [b]Switch[/b], then select a new game.
[*][b]Private/public room:[/b] Making the room visible or invisible to other players in Find & Play is now also more intuitive. Private rooms are not shown in Find & Play.
[*][b]Spectators:[/b] Players who enter the room but do not take seats, are displayed as Spectators.
[*][b]Custom background (Premium):[/b] Premium users can change the background image of the rooms they create. Click the [b]Settings[/b] icon to access this and other room settings.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0dd7d78bad1af137ec10792315264fd0ed5f758c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Features Planned for Future:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]More room settings: Allowing other players to invite players, manage game flow and seats, etc.
[*]Appropriate setup: When switching the game, the system will select the setup most appropriate for the number of players in the room.
[*]Further player statuses enhancements.
[*]Further design tweaks, improvements, and some other features.[/list]
 
We really hope you like our new lobby. Happy gaming and see you at the table!

notes.title: Reconstructing Lisboa (Live Event with Author)
notes.notes:
Launched just recently [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2002188924/lisboa-vital-lacerdas-new-game-of-rebuilding-and-i]on Kickstarter[/url] and already 300% funded, [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/lisboa]Lisboa[/url] is a new game by Vital Lacerda ([i]The Gallerist, Vinhos[/i]) about the reconstruction of Lisbon after the great earthquake of 1755.

[url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/playground/play/lisboa-qd04yx]Try this board game now for free[/url] on Tabletopia. And come join us for the [b]live event with Vital Lacerda[/b] himself teaching [i]Lisboa[/i] next Saturday, [b]November 26 at 2PM[/b] (EST)! Registration for the event will start next week. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/4233532abc616c88cbce65961fda7e5406fdfc31.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Lisboa[/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 90–150 Min; 2017

[i]Lisboa[/i] is a city building and economic hevyweight eurogame. As nobility members and architects you will use your influence in the reconstruction and business development of the new city of Lisbon after the great earthquake of 1755. 

[quote=Vital Lacerda]
"I’m very excited about this game, and for the first time, I’m using a hand management mechanics complemented with an action selection system." Read more about creation of this game in [url=http://blog.tabletopia.com/vital-lacerda-interview/]our interview with Vital[/url][/quote]

notes.title: Good Dwarf, Bad Dwarf
notes.notes:
When dwarves cannot hire a Burglar, they must dig up the crystals themselves. But who says they need to be fair? After all, the mine can only have one owner... In [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/quartz]Quartz[/url] you will race to mine the best crystals and become the richest dwarf while thwarting your opponents on every step.

[url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/playground/play/quartz-znn18n]Play Quartz now online for free[/url] on Tabletopia! Also, with [i]Quartz[/i] we now officially have 300 games in the catalog!

[h1][b]Quartz[/b][/h1]
3–5 Players; 45–60 Min; 2016

[i]Quartz[/i] is fast and tense game of push-your-luck and risk management.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/60eb6dfd7989c1216bb0fec521e5ea6ba0de35d0.jpg[/img]

Acting as dwarven miners, you'll explore a newly discovered mine for five days and try to secure the best crystals for yourself while keeping your "colleagues" at bay. 

At the end of the fifth day, the dwarf who earned the most money will become the only owner of the mine. Will you accept this challenge?

[quote=Gaming Unplugged][i]Quartz[/i] is a solid presentation, with fun artwork, great components, and a super fun push-your-luck element that has a solid theme. [/quote]

notes.title: Of Robits and Riddles
notes.notes:
Do you like having adventurs, telling stories, making interesting decisions (and friends)? Then try [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/robit-riddle-storybook-adventures]Robit Riddle[/url] a beautiful award-wining storytelling game featuring amazing art by John Ariosa ([i]Mice and Mystics[/i]).

[url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/playground/play/robit-riddle-storybook-adventures-mjiyt0]Play it now for free[/url] on Tabletopia and check out the game's ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/babageekgames/robit-riddle-storybook-adventures]campaign on Kickstarter[/url]. 

[h1][b]Robit Riddle[/b][/h1]
1–6 Players; 5–45 Min; 2017

[i]Robit Riddle[/i] is a co-operative story telling game for the whole family where no game master is needed. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/7ea39c4a0309c904136cb7d7842c776444bffad3.jpg[/img]

As one of six unique robot characters, you will set out for adventure to search for your missing pets, the Robits.

Choose a character and follow the story in the book. When facing encounters, you will make important decisions and together with your companions create an interesting shared story. Can you find the missing pets?

[quote=Cyrus Kirby Father Geek ]"This is a great introduction to roleplaying games and a wonderful adventure for family and friends. Do play this game and get swept away by the story that you help create." [/quote]

notes.title: Beer Empire Strikes Back
notes.notes:
Oktoberfest may be over, but there's always time for some good beer! [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/beer-empire-2]Beer Empire[/url] is a new board game by Board&Dice about brewing the amber beverage while expanding your brewery and preparing for a festival.

The game is now [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1293726726/beer-empire-the-board-game-0]live on Kickstarter[/url] and is avaialble to [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/playground/play/beer-empire-2-z8rq8b]play online for free[/url] on Tabletopia.
 
[h1][b]Beer Empire[/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 60–120 Min

[i]Beer Empire[/i] is a competition board game mainly based on a set-collection mechanism.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/852af11b323c4853e61b97364d289a91f7ed2d44.jpg[/img]

As the owner of a brewery you will design your recipes by skillfully matching recipe ingredients, like light and dark malts, hops, etc., gain and use resources in order to brew the best beer of the festival.
It’s time to open your own brewery and develop some unique recipes!

[quote=Polyhedron Collider]"[i]Beer Empire[/i] is, like a good beer, simultaneously complex and straightforward. It’s a great mix of worker placement, strategy and interdependency."[/quote]

notes.title: Build a New Better World
notes.notes:
Meet [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/pioneersprogram]The Pioneers Program[/url] a game about rebuilding towns in a post-apocalyptic world brilliantly illustrated by The Mico. This board game is avaialble to [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/playground/play/pioneersprogram-jg2gm9]play online for free[/url] and is now [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1207064031/the-pioneers-program-apocalyptic-town-rebuilding-b]live on Kickstarter[/url] with only a few days left, so hurry up.


[h1][b]The Pioneers Program[/b][/h1]
3–6 Players; 30–75 Min; [url=http://www.boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/196031/pioneers-program]Game on BGG[/url]

[i]The Pioneers Program[/i] is a card driven town building game set in post-apocalyptic world.


[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/96047d8df6043134b92359b934359ef47311519f.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/96047d8df6043134b92359b934359ef47311519f.jpg[/img][/url]

As humanity's last hope you will be planning, building, venturing into the wastes and completing research missions in your harsh new world. Each round you will select a new survivor to help you, each with their own strengths. Grow your town, search the wastes, and fight to defend what is yours!

notes.title: Learn & Play: 6 Demos for This Week
notes.notes:
Good news, Tabletopians!

Starting this week, there will be many more free demos available for you and your friends on Tabletopia. This week we host 6 events, and the first one is tonight! As usually, you can choose any board games you want to play online with us on our [url=https://tabletopia.typeform.com/to/cw6GQh]Learn & Play portal[/url] 

Here's the full list for this week:

[b]Kraftwagen[/b] — 25.10.16 — 6PM (EDT)
[b]Imperial Settlers[/b] — 27.10.16 — 6PM (EDT)
[b]Cult[/b] — 29.10.16 — 1PM (EDT)
[b]Argent: The Consortium[/b] — 29.10.16 — 6PM (EDT)
[b]Transylvania: Curses & Traitors[/b] — 30.10.16 — 1PM (EDT)
[b]Village[/b] — 30.10.16 — 10PM (EDT)


In future, we plan to have a couple live demos during the week and several during the weekend at fixed times. So that you can always be sure that if you visit Tabletopia, say, on a Sunday evening, there will always be a game for you to learn and play with others.


[url=https://tabletopia.typeform.com/to/cw6GQh][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/b6298ad45ea951acc501b9d5d7af2bd8c9df36c8.png[/img] [/url]

Also, join us for the [b]Halloween 2016 celebration[/b]! We teach and play two spooky games this weekend: [i]Cult[/i] and [i]Transylvania: Curses and Traitors[/i]. No tricks, only treats ;)

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Going Up!
notes.notes:
Build your city in the skies in [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/skyward]Skyward[/url] a clever and unique strategy card drafting game set in a world where buildings float, airships rule, and pigeons are rodents of the sky. The game is now [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chaoticpattern/skyward-the-airborne-city]on Kickstarter[/url] and already funded!


[h1][b]Skyward[/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 30–45 Min; 2016; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/209664/skyward]Game on BGG[/url]

[i]Skyward[/i] is a beautiful strategy card drafting game of control versus opportunity for 2-4 players.
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ddd525fbb52be02c1b4c786e057444178e742883.jpg[/img]

During the game, you will be building Skyward, the world’s first airborne city, constructed above the point where four empires meet. You and other cultural luminaries vie for control by becoming the Warden to be ultimately declared  the “Founder of Skyward”.

notes.title: In Space They Can Hear You Digging
notes.notes:
Deep space, asteroids, resources, miners, aliens... No, it's not the setting for a new Alien movie, it's [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/darkrock-ventures]Darkrock Ventures[/url] a new fast-paced and richly-thematic worker placement game by Magic Meeple Games on Tabletopia.

[url=https://tabletopia.typeform.com/to/cw6GQh]Learn how to play[/url] [i]Darkrock Ventures[/i] this Saturday at 1PM EDT (5PM UTC).

[h1][b]Darkrock Ventures[/b][/h1]
1–5 Players; 30–45 Min; 2016; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/166418/darkrock-ventures]Game on BGG[/url]

[i]Darkrock Ventures[/i] is euro game incorporating dice and dice manipulation, with worker placement, resource farming and exporting.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/271fe4b0f1ba4596f3da8ec1085e72fa09806ff2.jpg[/img]

Players will be controlling a mining company working in harsh conditions of deep hostile space to acquire the most credits. Lives are lost in this line of work daily, but if you run a good crew you can make it out alive and rich!

[quote=Undead Viking]"A very clever and challenging game. I've throughy enjoyed playing Darkrock Ventures." [/quote]

notes.title: All Hail Odin!
notes.notes:
Who will become the new Jarl? Who will rule in the name of Odin? Find out now in [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/in-the-name-of-odin]In the Name of Odin[/url] a new games by NSKN Legendary games that has joined our catalog.

Read the [url=http://blog.tabletopia.com/nsks-legendary-interview/]interview with the NSKN Legendary games[/url] where they talk about this game, their future plans and the games they're brining to Essen this weekend!


[h1][b]In the Name of Odin[/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 45–60 Min; 2016; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/184700/name-odin]Game on BGG[/url]

[i]In the Name of Odin[/i] is a strategy game for 2-5 players with hand management and set collection mechanics.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/3e14860686520318155dbaf3ddf2de2b53403755.jpg[/img]

As brave warriors, shrewd traders and bold explorers, you will compete to become the new Jarl. You will construct buildings in your village, gather companions, recruit famous Vikings, and build longships that will carry you to fame and glory!

[quote=Rahdo]Of all the Viking games I played so far, this one is probably my favourite. [/quote]

notes.title: Feel the True Italian Passions
notes.notes:
Plunge into the rich atmosphere of Renaissance Genoa full of intrigue and deception in [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/brides-bribes]Brides & Bribes[/url] The game was just recently funded on Kickstarter.

 
[h1][b]Brides & Bribes[/b][/h1]
3–5 Players; 75–120 Min; 2016; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/188343/brides-bribes]Game on BGG[/url]

[i]Brides & Bribes[/i] is a strategy worker placement and resource management board game set in Genoa during the Renaissance period.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/e7b0c9494b728bdecf8361cd94daf363af39e926.jpg[/img]
 
As one of the five families competing to become the new Doge, you will secretly send family members with the right skills into Genoese boroughs to hire new employees, get new workers, and convince the local lord that your family is worth a marriage with his beautiful daughter. The incredible interaction between players makes this game evilly fun.

notes.title: State of Emergence: Whose side are you on?
notes.notes:
Do you like deduction games like Mafia, The Resistance, Avalon, and Werewolf? Do you feel that these games would benefit from adding more strategy and meaningful decisions?

Try [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/emergence]Emergence[/url] a game of cunning, teamwork, and deduction where your individual moves matter as much as your persuasion skills. The game was 900% funded on Kickstarter with over 2000 backers.


[h1][b]Emergence[/b][/h1]
3–6 Players; 35–85 Min; 2015; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/192623/emergence]Game on BGG[/url]

[i]Emergence[/i] is a 3–6 player futuristic team-based deception resource collecting game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/189d4ff6f6867f23fe561a4d14f1e09adc95dfd6.jpg[/img]
  

Acting as Operatives for either the Artificial Intelligence security forces or the Human rebels, you wiil be assimilating data and gaining knowledge in order to convert it into influence.

Your goal: either root out the humans once and for all or corrupt the AI network and infiltrate its populace. And remember: trust no one!

notes.title: Biology Was Never More Fun
notes.notes:
Good news for those of you who love science and unique themes in board games! Check out our newest arrival [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/pathogenesis]Pathogenesis[/url], a deck building game where players are bacterial pathogens attacking the human body. 

The game is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lorencunningham/pathogenesis]now on Kickstarter[/url], and is already funded after just 5 days. It's also available to [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/playground/play/pathogenesis-fz5tgz]play for free[/url]


[h1][b]Pathogenesis[/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 30–60 Min; 2017; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/199309/pathogenesis]Game on BGG[/url]

[i]Pathogenesis[/i] is a deck building game in which players take on the role of bacterial pathogens attacking a human host. The game offers several modes of play including solo play, cooperative, competitive, and team play.

 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/9d84df0ac3cb79a0bb9f624e7461821a27de2bdf.jpg[/img]


The pathogens must survive the body's powerful immune response, adapt in an ever changing environment, and evolve to take on virulence factors to increase their attack, defense, and other abilities. The game is based on 100% real science and the mechanics were created to mimic how real biology works.
 
[quote=Danny C., a cell and molecular biologist and board game enthusiast] "A mechanistically solid and highly versatile deckbuilder in its own right, Pathogenesis has great potential as a wonderful educational tool — taking the incredibly complex science of immunology and making it more digestible and understandable for anyone wanting to learn. Highly recommend giving it a go!"[/quote]

notes.title: Go Nuts for Donuts!
notes.notes:
I love donuts! Do you love donuts? Do you want free donuts? Then [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/go-nuts-for-donuts]Go Nuts for Donuts![/url], the delicious new addition to our catalog that is now free to play, will definitely be to your taste.

Treat yourself and hurry up to grab your copy, the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dailymagicgames/go-nuts-for-donuts-0]game's Kickstarter campaign[/url] is almost over!
 
[h1][url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/go-nuts-for-donuts][b]Go Nuts for Donuts![/b][/url][/h1]
2–6 Players; 20–30 Min; 2016; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/184346/go-nuts-donuts]Game on BGG[/url]

[i]Go Nuts for Donuts![/i] is a fast-paced card game for the whole family with just a sprinkle of strategy.
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/a12aac6e76b45b04f5893cfc9c8430670c524130.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Splice Your Aliens in Space!
notes.notes:
Tired of your ordinary worker placement games? Try [b][url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/chimera-station]Chimera Station[/url][/b], a game where you can customize your workers while racing to build the best space station!

The game is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/michaelmindes/chimera-station-deluxe?ref=nav_search]now on Kickstarter[/url] and is [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/playground/play/chimera-station-hufd3u]free to play on Tabletopia for everybody[/url]


[h1][b][url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/chimera-station]Chimera Station[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 60 Min; 2016; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/163642/chimera-station]Game on BGG[/url]

[i]Chimera Station[/i] is a worker placement game for 2–4 players with customizable workers that you can enhance during the game to get various powers.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/e8049f901f6520afb22cd77c22b955d254b87528.jpg[/img]

During the game you will splice claws, tentacles, and other parts onto your aliens to gain the abilities needed to outperform the competition. Your goal is to construct the space station and take command to gain prestige and win!

[quote=Rahdo]"It is a really cool worker placement game, a very fresh take on the notion of building and tearing apart your workers during the course of the game. [...] It's so delightful, I very much enjoy it!" [/quote]

notes.title: Arabian Nights like Arabian days...
notes.notes:
Become the wealthiest merchant prince or princess in all of Araby in [i]Merchants of Araby[/i] which is now available to play on Tabletopia. Check it out now and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dailymagicgames/merchants-of-araby]back the game on Kickstarter[/url] before it's too late, the campaign is in its final hours!
 
[b]Merchants of Araby[/b]
2–4 Players; 60–90 Min; 2017; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/195231/merchants-araby]Game on BGG[/url]
 
[i]Merchants of Araby[/i] is an economic card game for 2-4 players with strong negotiation element.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/a1b794b068b7208b0e1512cd1d497e4fe60a26b0.jpg[/img]
 
Build your entourage of merchants and allies, invoke virtues, summon djinni, and negotiate to get your camels into caravans. Negotiation is the key here: if you can strike a deal with another player for any game resource or action, feel free to do so!
 
[quote=Undead Viking Videos]"[i]Merchants of Araby[/i] is everything I wanted it to be—a tough, brilliant economic card game with the always welcome aspect of completely open negotiation between the players. Just a fantastic game!"[/quote]

notes.title: Adding Game Results Made Available!
notes.notes:
All hail the winners! With our newest final scoring feature you will now be able to determine the winners at the end of each game and congratulate them with a proper celebration.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/eb4c75715692ca952bac543ec2e59aaa2659dea2.jpg[/img]

 
[b]How does it work?[/b]

[list] 
[*]After you finish playing, the host of the room must [b]select Finish from the game menu[/b] (click Tabletopia logo in the top left corner of the game room > Finish).   

[*]The host then will be able to [b]determine the game outcome[/b]: specify the winners, assign final scores, or choose victory or defeat depending on the kind of game you were playing.

[*]All other players will [b]see the final results[/b] once the host confirms them. The results will also be displayed in the game lobby after you leave the table.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/cf2797a402fe8ef354b2799e56d2b3d903858b6d.jpg[/img]

[b]What else?[/b]

In the game results window you will also be able to [b]add your opponents to friends[/b] right away for future games together. Just click the star next to the player’s name.
 
In future releases we plan on adding these results to your [b]personal statistics[/b] and making [b]sharing the results on social networks[/b] available. Stay tuned!
 
Happy gaming and see you at the table!

notes.title: Smart Suggestions Are Live
notes.notes:
Meet the live smart suggestions on Tabletopia! The new system helps you play more games with people currently online by suggesting you games most likely to interest you all.
 
[h1]How does it work?[/h1]

While you browse Tabletopia, our suggestions system analyzes the games you bookmarked and play most on Tabletopia and compares them to those of other players online. The system tries to find games that are likely to interest as many players now online as possible.

[img]https://beta.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/447/nmATMK9XI4BeGwvzi7Oea7.jpg[/img]
From time to time it sends you a suggestion to play a game online based on the data it gathered. If you accept, it will then proceed to searching for opponents for you. Once the required number of players accept the suggestion, the game starts automatically.
 
We hope that the new feature will make it easier for you to find opponents and play more games on Tabletopia. Be sure to bookmark all games that you’re interested in, so we can arrange more games for you!

[img]https://beta.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/423/osz1bozH9xz0gr8SbNvUIK.jpg?width=1240&height=822&scale=both&format=png&bgcolor=transparent[/img]

Today we are releasing the “ready check” feature on Tabletopia. This feature will let players check in for the game before it begins as well as allow for synchronizing the start of the game for all players.[b][b] [/b][/b]

Once the game host starts the game, the pre-game lobby will appear where players will be able to check ready and see the statuses of other players. During the 5 minutes before the game begins all players need to set their status to Ready, otherwise the game will not start.

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/423/M0VPZrMUP3ELXEcoHEN953.jpg[/img]

[b]The host can:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Start the game at once, before other players check Ready[/*]
 	[*]Cancel the start of the game[/*]
[/list]
[b]Other players can:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Set their status to Ready[/*]
 	[*]Leave the game, if they are not ready to play now[/*]
[/list]
The game will begin automatically once all players set their status to Ready. If any players choose to leave the game, the game host will be able to change the setup and continue with the game or cancel its start.

notes.title: Make Your Own Planet!
notes.notes:
Planetarium is available on Tabletopia

[img]https://beta.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/423/GJsrM6p64suf8zNbbjYvH7.jpg?width=1240&height=822&scale=both&format=png&bgcolor=transparent[/img]
[h1]Planetarium[/h1]
45 Min;  2–4 Players; 2017; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/200454/planetarium][b]Game on BGG[/b][/url]

[i]Planetarium [/i]is a beautiful game of creation, terraforming, and evolution of planets featuring grid movement and hand management.

In [i]Planetarium[/i], players are competing to crash combinations of elements onto planets and evolve the planets in a variety of ways to suit their own secret goals.

Each turn players move Matter tokens in a clockwise direction around the board, amassing gas, rock, water, and metal on four growing planets. They then use cards to make the planets either hostile wastes, or potential cradles for life.

Create your own unique solar system in this richly science-themed game!

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/423/Po1083ayLoXow3vW2EBCP2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Meet Conquest of Speros, Operation F.A.U.S.T. and Dueling Samurai
notes.notes:
[h1]Conquest of Speros[/h1]

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/371/HR0Cq7Gcu2yEgsxoQP3sv5.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

2–4 Players; 30 Min; 2015; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/152767/conquest-speros][b]Game on BGG[/b][/url]

[i]Conquest of Speros[/i] is a quick game of area control and resource domination.

Four competing races work to exercise their dominance over the rich and beautiful land of Speros and to control its valuable resources and ancient Artifacts. You lead a general and his minions, and your mission is: [i]Secure the land and destroy anything that gets in your way![/i]

[h1]Operation F.A.U.S.T.[/h1]

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/352/EomIOfOK21yhk549Y3NMV7.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

3–8 Players; 30 Min; 2015; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/159515/operation-fust][b]Game on BGG[/b][/url]

In [i]Operation F.A.U.S.T. (Fine Art Underground: Stolen Treasures)[/i] players take on roles of independent art patrons in occupied France during WWII and work to acquire the most prestigious collection of art treasures through bluffing and deception.

Take risks, use cunning misdirection, uncover and remember where valuable art resides, and employ strategies to be the first to earn $1,000,000 and win the game!

[h1]Dueling Samurai[/h1]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/421/Ph7AroQuVSw7nDAWHoWex2.jpg[/img]

2–4 Players; 80–240 Min; 2015; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/194659/dueling-samurai][b]Game on BGG[/b][/url]

[i]Dueling Samurai [/i]is an epic game of conquest featuring 68 historic warlords. You'll lead a clan and use your alliances across Japan to end the Age of War using both war and peace.

The game features highly risky card play with rich thematic element where your every move could make or destroy your goal of domination. Immerse yourself in a world of combat, diplomacy, spying, and culture.

notes.title: A Tale of Two Cities
notes.notes:
Between Two Cities is available now on Tabletopia

[img]https://beta.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/417/DTNiX4vUXzr6EKfeWzxmv4.jpg?width=1240&height=822&scale=both&format=png&bgcolor=transparent[/img]

1–7 Players; 20 Min; 2015; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/168435/between-two-cities][b]Game on BGG[/b][/url]

[i]Between Two Cities[/i] is a partnership-driven tile-drafting game in which you work with the players on your left and right to design two cities.

You are a world-renowned master planner who has been asked by two different cities to help them rebuild their city centers.

On each turn you will select two tiles representing city buildings: factories, shops, parks, landmarks, etc.—and work with partners on your left and right separately to place those tiles into each of your two cities.

To win, you have to share your attention and your devotion between two cities, as it is the lower number of points that will be your final score at the end of the game. Will your planning and collaborative skills be enough to design the most impressive cities in the world?

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/417/dXGhHe5NvRlIQRMeyOJPo7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Essential Art of Winemaking
notes.notes:
[i]Viticulture Essential Edition[/i] was added to Tabletopia

1–6 Players;  90 Min;  2015; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/183394/viticulture-essential-edition][b]Game on BGG [/b][/url]

[i]Viticulture Essential Edition[/i] is a worker placement game about winemaking in rural Italy.

It’s essentially the good old [i]Viticulture[/i] (already featured on Tabletopia) but with some of the modules from [i]Tuscany[/i] added for more diverse experience.

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/411/rcALSMCAFsI7ohCgqp7Tl3.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

As an owner of a meager vineyard, you will start with a few plots of land, an old crushpad, a tiny cellar, and three workers. Through a series of seasons and years you will be allocating workers to expand your vineyard, build structures, plant vines, make wines, and fulfil orders. Will you become the first to call your winery a true success?

[i]Viticulture Essential Edition [/i]includes the following expansions from [i]Tuscany[/i]: 36 Mama & Papa cards, Field cards (previously known as "Properties"), expanded/revised Visitors, and 24 Automa cards (solo variant), along with a couple of minor rule changes.

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/411/0YNFX4OiFp1kDKsRIBLql0.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

notes.title: Meet Your New Tabletopia Profile
notes.notes:
Today we have rolled out the improved profile on Tabletopia. The main changes include the new look and the ability to edit your personal details. Also, from now on you will be able to manage your profile directly in Playground.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/bdfaa1adfb58d9c5aef8ac315ca53db6cb6a737a.jpg[/img]

With the new Tabletopia profile you can:
[list]
    [*]Change your personal details, such as your photo, name, country and city, spoken languages, etc. 
    [*]View and manage new information and statistics, such as: last game you played, the games you play most, your active rooms, recommended and bookmarked games, etc.
    [*]Add and manage social network profiles for an easier way to log in (available for the website version only).
    [*]Send personal messages (website version only).
    [*]Change your password (website version only).
[/list]

We hope that starting today, it will be even easier to express yourself on Tabletopia through a new and improved profile as well as find people to play with according to their experience and preferences.

notes.title: It’s Time for Anachrony!
notes.notes:
[i]Anachrony[/i] is now on Tabletopia

1–4 Players; 60–120 Min; 2017;  [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/185343/anachrony][b]Game on BGG[/b][/url]
[i]Anachrony[/i] is a competitive, epic Euro-style strategy game with a time traveling twist set in a grim post-apocalyptic future.

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/409/0N2zh7o1T0p7RQkaV1MfS7.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

As leaders of the four different ideological Paths, you will be venturing out to the devastated areas for resources, utilizing various Specialists, commanding mighty Exosuits, and [u]powering up[/u] mysterious Time Rifts. 

The game is played through a series of Eras until the cataclysmic game-changing event happens: an asteroid destroys the World Capital, New Earth’s last independent city. Can you become the most important force left on the planet after the catastrophic explosion?
[quote=The Cardboard Republic - Ryan LaFlamme] [i]Anachrony is a sprawling medium-weight worker placement game that provides a rewarding experience in any time period.” [/i]	[/quote]

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/409/6j0SjMD0adA8zPQzBNsizN.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

notes.title: Tabletopia Notifications Are Now Live
notes.notes:
Greetings Tabletopians, 

Starting today, a new notification system is introduced on Tabletopia and it will make finding and playing games faster and easier for you.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/1671f903a187362bae7167d2ccafd4d063a6848b.jpg[/img]

With our new notifications, you can keep browsing Tabletopia while staying alert for any changes in your gaming rooms!

notes.title: Trade and Cunning in Middle Ages
notes.notes:
Hansa Teutonica now on Tabletopia

[img]https://beta.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/406/EMcksszoCL34Mtf1ChOK53.jpg?width=1240&height=822&scale=both&format=png&bgcolor=transparent[/img]

[i]Hansa Teutonica[/i], a renowned game featured on the BGG Top 100 games and winner of many prestigious awards, including [i]BoardGameGeek Game of the Year[/i] and [i]Meeples' Choice Award[/i], is now on Tabletopia.

[b]Number of Players[/b]: 1 − 5
[b]Playing time[/b]: 45 − 75 min.
[b][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/43015/hansa-teutonica]Game on BGG[/url][/b]

[i]Hansa Teutonica[/i] is a strategic game about merchant families in the Hanseatic League competing against each other to grow their wealth, expand spheres of influence, and gain prestige.

As a member of the Hanseatic League, you will be deploying your traders and merchants onto paths on the map, and then establish offices, or Kontors, when a path is filled up with your pawns. Also, you will want to improve your traders' "skills" for more opportunities: get more VPs from offices in your network, get more available action points, increase the number of available pawns, and get the right to place pawns and obtain more special pawns.

Choose your own strategy among the many possibilities. But always remember, that the most powerful strategy is only as powerful as how much the other players are willing to do to stop it!

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/406/DxCkD3y5dPSYCnFXRyMuPF.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Will You Hunt for Hitler or Hunt for Gold?
notes.notes:
Weekly digest of new Tabletopia games
 
[h1]1. Black Orchestra[/h1]

[b]Number of Players[/b]: 1 − 5
[b]Playing time[/b]: 45 − 75 min.
[b][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/156858/black-orchestra]Game on BGG[/url][/b]

[i]Black Orchestra[/i] is a tense co-operative game set during Second World War. As historic figures, you are involved in the conspiracy to assassinate Hitler, all the while trying to avoid discovery, capture, and interrogation.

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/398/JxxbyWa6zszihuoeq8abt4.jpg[/img]

Moving across a map of Europe you will gather information and resources to enact any of several possible plots. As the clock ticks and Hitler's ambitions grow, you must build the strength and choose the perfect moment to strike for the kill.
[quote=Acererak]The game is thematic. A lot. [...] Add the historic flavour that Event cards bring, randomly set everytime for maximum replayability, a fitting and very creative artwork and overall component design... Go to Tabletopia and give it a try. You won't regret it.[/quote]

Check out the [url=https://youtu.be/IgMJhbyCc-E]Youtube stream[/url] hosted by game's author Philip duBarry ([i]Spirits of the Rice Paddy[/i], [i]Revolution![/i]). 

[h1]2. Fool's Gold[/h1]

[b]Number of Players[/b]: 3 − 5
[b]Playing time[/b]: 60 − 90 min.
[b][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/132758/fools-gold]Game on BGG[/url][/b]

[i]Fool's Gold[/i] is a strategic game featuring dice rolling, push-your-luck, set collection, and worker placement.

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/398/0eCCuRUvyp1YIGLOQOS940.jpg[/img]

The year is 1849, and the Gold Rush is in full swing in California. As investors you will be sending prospectors on a quest to find gold at various locations—in the mountains, in a forest, at a river—in a fast-paced race to snatch up gold before others beat you to it. The more you dig, the less gold there's left.

Will you be the most savvy one to make fast fortune? Or will you end up with nothing but fool's gold?
[quote=The Game Boy Geek]The game's very balanced. A lot of good decisions to be made![/quote]

notes.title: Games for this weekend No20
notes.notes:
Weekly digest of new Tabletopia games

[H1]1. Terra Mystica and Fire & Ice expansion[/H1]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/389/8Aj3xqKMXiHok0J21TJPT2.jpg[/img]

Terra Mystica is a game with very little luck that rewards strategic planning. Each player governs one of the 14 groups. With subtlety and craft, the player must attempt to rule as great an area as possible and to develop that group's skills. There are also four religious cults in which you can progress. To do all that, each group has special skills and abilities.

Now all the 14 races are available in the base game. We have also updated the visuals and intergrated a new surface instead of the old simple table. Last but not least, you can try out Fire & Ice expansion or the game with promo components!

[b]Number of Players[/b]: 2 − 5
[b]Playing time[/b]: 60 − 150 min.
[b]Suggested age[/b]: 12+

[H1]2. Waste Knights[/H1]

[img]https://beta.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/389/TpAy2mOimgsWHPlITss4D7.jpg[/img]

Waste Knights is a post-apocalyptic adventure game for 2-4 players set in dystopian Australia now called the Waste. Each player becomes a hero who travels around the continent fighting monstrous enemies, accomplishing Tasks to acquire new Gear Cards and hoping to gain enough Reputation in order to fulfill the Mission being played. All players share a common goal set by the Mission, but only the quickest and the most cunning will manage to win!

[b]Number of Players[/b]: 2 − 4
[b]Playing time[/b]: 90 − 240 min.
[b]Suggested age[/b]: 16+

[H1]3. Flag-Bearer[/H1]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/389/ZeYMrHUTzvjZFK9lhJaeI5.jpg[/img]

Two brave armies meet in a battle. Each army has 20 different warriors, which have different qualities and battle skills. You, as an experienced commander, must use them to win. Players try to annihilate three flag-bearers of the enemy and protect one of their own. The player who achieves this goal becomes the winner.

[b]Number of Players[/b]: 2
[b]Playing time[/b]: 30 min.
[b]Suggested age[/b]: 10+

notes.title: Games for this weekend No19
notes.notes:
Weekly digest of new Tabletopia games

[h1]1. Santorini[/h1]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/381/czLhK1oHFZy0tAB2O5zRSR.jpg[/img]

Santorini is a highly accessible pure strategy game that is simple enough for an elementary school classroom. But with enough gameplay depth and content for even hardcore gamers to explore, Santorini is truly a game for everyone.

[b]Number of Players[/b]: 2 − 3
[b]Playing time[/b]: 10 − 20 min.
[b]Suggested age[/b]: 8+

[h1]2. Cyvasse[/h1]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/381/se4Zu6NzuiEgPBriXnV7v6.jpg[/img]

Cyvasse is originally a fictional two-players game in George R.R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire series; he described it as "a bit of chess, a bit of blitzkrieg, a bit of stratego. Mix well and add imagination". The game adaptation created by A. Marston Croft.

[b]Number of Players[/b]: 2
[b]Playing time[/b]: 30 min.
[b]Suggested age[/b]: 10+

[h1]3. Exoplanets[/h1]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/381/Pf9zVZPEbvzvgZ7EKG1uyQ.jpg[/img]

Exoplanets is a medium-light game, where players create their own planetary system on the table.

Players add to the common star, tiles which represent various planets or moons (that protect planets or help create life). Each of these tiles/planets give a different number of tokens (water, atmosphere, asteroids and light) and each planet has their climatic condition, which allows us to create life on these planets.

[b]Number of Players[/b]: 2 − 4
[b]Playing time[/b]: 30 min.
[b]Suggested age[/b]: 12+

notes.title: How to find opponents to play with
notes.notes:
[H1]1. Solo games[/H1]
Tabletopia is a sandbox system. There is no AI to play against - so to play a multiplayer game, you need to play with other real people. However, some games offer an option to play in solo mode. There are a number of them in our game catalog and more being added all the time... please try for example 
[list]
 	[*][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/154203/imperial-settlers]Imperial Settlers [/url][/*]
 	[*][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/169786/scythe]Scythe[/url][/*]
 	[*][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/157809/nations-dice-game]Nations The Dice Game[/url][/*]
 	[*][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/118536/police-precinct]Police Precinct[/url][/*]
 	[*][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/169426/roll-player]Roll Player[/url][/*]
 	[*][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/140717/progress-evolution-technology]Progress: Evolution of Technology[/url][/*]
 	[*][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/160669/town-center-4th-edition]Town Center[/url][/*]
 	[*][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/157526/viceroy]Viceroy[/url][/*]
 	[*][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/148601/1944-race-rhine]1944: Race to the Rhine[/url][/*]
 	[*][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/73761/k2]K2[/url][/*]
 	[*][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/140620/lewis-clark]Lewis & Clark[/url][/*]
 	[*][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/175640/vinhos-deluxe-edition]Vinhos Deluxe[/url][/*]
[/list]
[img]http://crowdpublishing.ru/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/12.jpg[/img]

When you start the game, choose the appropriate setup - for most of the games it is  special - stand alone setup.

[H1]2. Invite friends[/H1]
Until the commercial release of Tabletopia, you are allowed to invite your friends to play any game from our catalog with you - including premium ones. And your friends do not even have to be Tabletopia users. Just create your game room in a browser or Steam client and send them the link. They only need to have a supported type of browser - Explorer, Safari or Firefox.

[img]http://crowdpublishing.ru/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/TTshare.jpg[/img]

[H1]3. Find opponents on Tabletopia[/H1]

[b]Find and play[/b]
Go to the ‘Find and Play’ screen and see if there are any open game tables which you can join. Please pay attention to prerequisites for joining, such as - game knowledge, language and voice support. Also, you can gather a group of players to play any game using the chat window on this screen.
[img]http://blog.tabletopia.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/9-1024x699.jpg[/img]

As soon as you create your gaming room, it will become visible in the Find and Play section for others to see. You can change its visibility or give some additional parameters for your game room by clicking on the “Invite Players” button in your game lobby.

[H1]4. Discord[/H1]
As an alternative to Find and Play, you can search for players on our [url=https://discord.gg/0WlbLX4qhPcSJJbP][u]Discord server[/u][/url]. It is not only a tool for the community to gather, chat and find opponents, but it also gives them ability to create anonymous voice chat channel for their game session. The voice quality in Discord is better than the one provided by Steam internal engine. Also you can use Discord server to talk with players who use browser version of Tabletopia.

[img]http://crowdpublishing.ru/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Discord-Logo-Wordmark-Color-1.png[/img]

notes.notes:

Specific changes include:

     [*]Friends: Added ability to search players by name or login

notes.title: Games for this weekend
notes.notes:
We are welcome new games become available for current testers of Tabletopia!

 
[h1][b]Automania[/b][/h1]
[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/360/k8gIWvCx39JpgmIzYz3PF0.jpg[/img]

In Automania, you run a car factory, trying to produce the most popular cars in the market. To achieve this, you buy tiles to upgrade and customize your factory, and hire specialist employees to help you.

Central to the game are the factory boards: Each player has a factory with three assembly lines, and each assembly line produces one type of car. You can put machine tiles along your assembly lines to change the specifications of your cars. However, your three assembly lines intersect, so each machine tile placed might affect more than one type of car — which means you have to think carefully about where you put those machines.


When a car is produced, it must be sold in one of two markets, and the better the specifications of the car is in line with the demand in the chosen market, the more popular the car will be. The most popular cars reap the highest profits, earning money or prestige — which is what you need to win this game.

 

[b]Number of Players:[/b] 2 − 4

[b]Playing time:[/b] 60 − 90 min.

[b]Suggested age:[/b] 12+

[b]Mechanics:[/b]  Tile Placement, Variable Player Powers, Worker Placement

[b]Theme:[/b] Cars, Industry


 
[h1][b]Artifacts Inc.[/b][/h1]
[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/360/z3FyyKTkXU3C4y5tbol7Lj0.jpg[/img]

New York, 1929: A frenzy of interest in antiquity is sweeping the nation! With museums hungry for mysterious and exotic artifacts — and you hungry for adventure — you start up your own archeology company. Untold wonders await within dangerous jungles, harsh deserts, and wind-swept mountains. Will you gain a reputation as the most intrepid and famous adventurer of all time?


In Artifacts, Inc. players compete to grow the most famous archeology company. Players roll dice, which represent their troop of adventurers, and place them on cards in order to find artifacts, sell them to museums, and purchase new cards representing their company assets. Players can choose to focus on making lots of money by selling artifacts, having museum majorities, creating the best combination of expeditions and buildings, or searching below the waves for lost cities and hidden treasures. The first player to reach 20 reputation triggers the end of the game, and the player with the most total reputation wins!
